jailbreaks without the need for fine-tuning. ICAG leverages agent learning to
conduct an adversarial game, aiming to dynamically extend knowledge to defend
against jailbreaks. Unlike traditional methods that rely on static datasets,
ICAG employs an iterative process to enhance both the defense and attack
agents. This continuous improvement process strengthens defenses against newly
generated jailbreak prompts. Our empirical studies affirm ICAG's efficacy,
where LLMs safeguarded by ICAG exhibit significantly reduced jailbreak success
rates across various attack scenarios. Moreover, ICAG demonstrates remarkable
transferability to other LLMs, indicating its potential as a versatile defense
mechanism.
translated: 大型语言模型(LLM)展示了跨不同应用程序的非凡能力。然而，关于他们的安全，特别是越狱攻击的脆弱性的担忧，持续存在。从深度学习和 LLM 代理学习过程中的对抗性训练中得到启发，我们引入了在上下文中的对抗性游戏(ICAG)来防御越狱，而不需要进行微调。ICAG 利用代理学习来进行一个对抗性的游戏，目的是动态扩展知识来防御越狱。与传统的依赖于静态数据集的方法不同，ICAG 采用迭代过程来增强防御和攻击代理。这个持续改进的过程加强了对新生成的越狱提示的防御。我们的实证研究证实了 ICAG 的有效性，ICAG 保护的 LLM 在各种攻击情景下显著降低了越狱成功率。此外，ICAG 显示出对其他 LLM 的显著可转移性，表明其作为一种多功能防御机制的潜力。

title: VGMShield: Mitigating Misuse of Video Generative Models
summary:
With the rapid advancement in video generation, people can conveniently
utilize video generation models to create videos tailored to their specific
desires. Nevertheless, there are also growing concerns about their potential
misuse in creating and disseminating false information.
  In this work, we introduce VGMShield: a set of three straightforward but
pioneering mitigations through the lifecycle of fake video generation. We start
from \textit{fake video detection} trying to understand whether there is
uniqueness in generated videos and whether we can differentiate them from real
videos; then, we investigate the \textit{tracing} problem, which maps a fake
video back to a model that generates it. Towards these, we propose to leverage
pre-trained models that focus on {\it spatial-temporal dynamics} as the
backbone to identify inconsistencies in videos. Through experiments on seven
state-of-the-art open-source models, we demonstrate that current models still
cannot perfectly handle spatial-temporal relationships, and thus, we can
accomplish detection and tracing with nearly perfect accuracy.
  Furthermore, anticipating future generative model improvements, we propose a
{\it prevention} method that adds invisible perturbations to images to make the
generated videos look unreal. Together with fake video detection and tracing,
our multi-faceted set of solutions can effectively mitigate misuse of video
generative models.
translated: 随着视频生成技术的飞速发展，人们可以方便地利用视频生成模型来创建符合自己特定需求的视频。然而，人们也越来越担心它们在制造和传播虚假信息方面可能被滥用。在这项工作中，我们介绍了 VGMM 盾: 一套三个简单但开创性的缓解通过假视频生成的生命周期。我们从文本{假视频检测}开始，试图了解生成的视频是否具有唯一性，以及我们是否能够将它们与真实视频区分开来; 然后，我们研究文本{追踪}问题，该问题将一个假视频映射回生成它的模型。针对这些问题，我们建议利用预先训练好的模型(关注于空间-时间动态)作为识别视频中不一致性的主干。通过对七个最先进的开源模型的实验，我们发现目前的模型还不能很好地处理时空关系，因此我们可以以接近完美的精度完成检测和跟踪。此外，预计未来的生成模型改进，我们提出了一个{ it 预防}方法，添加不可见的扰动图像，使生成的视频看起来不真实。结合虚假视频检测和跟踪，我们的多方面的解决方案可以有效地减少误用视频生成模型。

title:
How Does Selection Leak Privacy: Revisiting Private Selection and
  Improved Results for Hyper-parameter Tuning
summary:
We study the problem of guaranteeing Differential Privacy (DP) in
hyper-parameter tuning, a crucial process in machine learning involving the
selection of the best run from several. Unlike many private algorithms,
including the prevalent DP-SGD, the privacy implications of tuning remain
insufficiently understood. Recent works propose a generic private solution for
the tuning process, yet a fundamental question still persists: is the current
privacy bound for this solution tight?
  This paper contributes both positive and negative answers to this question.
Initially, we provide studies affirming the current privacy analysis is indeed
tight in a general sense. However, when we specifically study the
hyper-parameter tuning problem, such tightness no longer holds. This is first
demonstrated by applying privacy audit on the tuning process. Our findings
underscore a substantial gap between the current theoretical privacy bound and
the empirical bound derived even under the strongest audit setup.
  The gap found is not a fluke. Our subsequent study provides an improved
privacy result for private hyper-parameter tuning due to its distinct
properties. Our privacy results are also more generalizable compared to prior
analyses that are only easily applicable in specific setups.
translated: 我们研究在超参数调整中保证差分隐私(DP)的问题，这是机器学习中的一个关键过程，涉及从多个参数中选择最佳运行。不像许多私有算法，包括流行的 DP-SGD，调优的隐私影响仍然没有得到充分的理解。最近的工作为调优过程提出了一个通用的私有解决方案，但是一个基本的问题仍然存在: 当前的私有对这个解决方案是否有约束力？本文对这个问题给出了肯定和否定的答案。最初，我们提供的研究证实，目前的隐私分析确实是严格的一般意义上。然而，当我们专门研究超参数整定问题时，这种紧密性就不再适用了。首先通过对调优过程应用隐私审计来演示这一点。我们的研究结果强调了当前的理论隐私界限和经验界限之间的实质性差距，即使在最强大的审计设置。发现的缺口并非偶然。我们随后的研究提供了一个改进的私人超参数调整隐私性的结果，由于其独特的性质。我们的隐私结果也比以前的分析更具普遍性，因为以前的分析只能在特定的设置中很容易地应用。

title:
IT Intrusion Detection Using Statistical Learning and Testbed
  Measurements
summary:
We study automated intrusion detection in an IT infrastructure, specifically
the problem of identifying the start of an attack, the type of attack, and the
sequence of actions an attacker takes, based on continuous measurements from
the infrastructure. We apply statistical learning methods, including Hidden
Markov Model (HMM), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), and Random Forest Classifier
(RFC) to map sequences of observations to sequences of predicted attack
actions. In contrast to most related research, we have abundant data to train
the models and evaluate their predictive power. The data comes from traces we
generate on an in-house testbed where we run attacks against an emulated IT
infrastructure. Central to our work is a machine-learning pipeline that maps
measurements from a high-dimensional observation space to a space of low
dimensionality or to a small set of observation symbols. Investigating
intrusions in offline as well as online scenarios, we find that both HMM and
LSTM can be effective in predicting attack start time, attack type, and attack
actions. If sufficient training data is available, LSTM achieves higher
prediction accuracy than HMM. HMM, on the other hand, requires less
computational resources and less training data for effective prediction. Also,
we find that the methods we study benefit from data produced by traditional
intrusion detection systems like SNORT.
translated: 我们研究 IT 基础设施中的自动入侵检测，特别是根据来自基础设施的连续测量，识别攻击的开始、攻击类型和攻击者采取的操作序列的问题。我们应用统计学习方法，包括隐马尔可夫模型(hMM)、长短期记忆(lSTM)和随机森林分类器(rFC) ，将观测序列映射到预测的攻击行为序列。与大多数相关研究相比，我们拥有丰富的数据来训练模型并评估它们的预测能力。这些数据来自我们在内部测试平台上生成的跟踪，我们在这个平台上对仿真的 IT 基础设施进行攻击。我们工作的核心是一个机器学习管道，它将测量数据从高维观测空间映射到低维空间或一小组观测符号。通过对离线和在线场景中的入侵进行研究，我们发现 HMM 和 LSTM 都可以有效地预测攻击开始时间、攻击类型和攻击行为。如果有足够的训练数据，LSTM 比 HMM 具有更高的预测精度。另一方面，隐马尔可夫模型需要更少的计算资源和训练数据来进行有效的预测。此外，我们发现我们所研究的方法受益于传统入侵检测系统如 SNORT 所产生的数据。

title:
TRAP: Targeted Random Adversarial Prompt Honeypot for Black-Box
  Identification
summary:
Large Language Model (LLM) services and models often come with legal rules on
who can use them and how they must use them. Assessing the compliance of the
released LLMs is crucial, as these rules protect the interests of the LLM
contributor and prevent misuse. In this context, we describe the novel problem
of Black-box Identity Verification (BBIV). The goal is to determine whether a
third-party application uses a certain LLM through its chat function. We
propose a method called Targeted Random Adversarial Prompt (TRAP) that
identifies the specific LLM in use. We repurpose adversarial suffixes,
originally proposed for jailbreaking, to get a pre-defined answer from the
target LLM, while other models give random answers. TRAP detects the target
LLMs with over 95% true positive rate at under 0.2% false positive rate even
after a single interaction. TRAP remains effective even if the LLM has minor
changes that do not significantly alter the original function.
translated: 大型语言模型(LLM)服务和模型通常带有关于谁可以使用它们以及它们必须如何使用它们的法律规则。评估发布的 LLM 的遵守情况至关重要，因为这些规则保护 LLM 贡献者的利益并防止滥用。在此背景下，我们描述了黑盒身份验证(BBIV)的新问题。目标是确定第三方应用程序是否通过其聊天功能使用某个 LLM。我们提出了一种名为目标随机对抗提示(TRAP)的方法，用于识别正在使用的特定 LLM。我们重新利用最初为越狱提出的对抗性后缀，从目标 LLM 获得预定义的答案，而其他模型给出随机答案。TRAP 检测目标 LLM 的真阳性率超过95% ，假阳性率低于0.2% ，即使在一次相互作用之后也是如此。TRAP 仍然有效，即使 LLM 有微小的变化，不会显着改变原来的功能。

title: Quantifying Privacy via Information Density
summary:
We examine the relationship between privacy metrics that utilize information
density to measure information leakage between a private and a disclosed random
variable. Firstly, we prove that bounding the information density from above or
below in turn implies a lower or upper bound on the information density,
respectively. Using this result, we establish new relationships between local
information privacy, asymmetric local information privacy, pointwise maximal
leakage and local differential privacy. We further provide applications of
these relations to privacy mechanism design. Furthermore, we provide statements
showing the equivalence between a lower bound on information density and
risk-averse adversaries. More specifically, we prove an equivalence between a
guessing framework and a cost-function framework that result in the desired
lower bound on the information density.
translated: 我们研究隐私指标之间的关系，这些指标利用信息密度来衡量私有变量和公开的随机变量之间的信息泄露。首先，我们证明了信息密度的上界和下界依次意味着信息密度的下界和上界。利用这一结果，我们建立了局部信息隐私、非对称局部信息隐私、逐点最大泄漏和局部差分隐私之间的新关系。进一步提供了这些关系在隐私机制设计中的应用。此外，我们提供的陈述显示了信息密度下限和风险厌恶对手之间的等价性。更具体地说，我们证明了猜测框架和成本函数框架之间的等价性，这种等价性导致了信息密度的期望下限。

title: Prompt Stealing Attacks Against Large Language Models
summary:
The increasing reliance on large language models (LLMs) such as ChatGPT in
various fields emphasizes the importance of ``prompt engineering,'' a
technology to improve the quality of model outputs. With companies investing
significantly in expert prompt engineers and educational resources rising to
meet market demand, designing high-quality prompts has become an intriguing
challenge. In this paper, we propose a novel attack against LLMs, named prompt
stealing attacks. Our proposed prompt stealing attack aims to steal these
well-designed prompts based on the generated answers. The prompt stealing
attack contains two primary modules: the parameter extractor and the prompt
reconstruction. The goal of the parameter extractor is to figure out the
properties of the original prompts. We first observe that most prompts fall
into one of three categories: direct prompt, role-based prompt, and in-context
prompt. Our parameter extractor first tries to distinguish the type of prompts
based on the generated answers. Then, it can further predict which role or how
many contexts are used based on the types of prompts. Following the parameter
extractor, the prompt reconstructor can be used to reconstruct the original
prompts based on the generated answers and the extracted features. The final
goal of the prompt reconstructor is to generate the reversed prompts, which are
similar to the original prompts. Our experimental results show the remarkable
performance of our proposed attacks. Our proposed attacks add a new dimension
to the study of prompt engineering and call for more attention to the security
issues on LLMs.
translated: 在各个领域对大型语言模型(LLM)(如 ChatGPT)的日益依赖强调了“快速工程”的重要性，这是一种提高模型输出质量的技术。随着公司大量投资于专家提示工程师和教育资源，以满足市场需求，设计高质量的提示已成为一个耐人寻味的挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的 LLM 攻击方法，即快速窃取攻击。我们提出的提示窃取攻击旨在窃取这些基于生成的答案设计良好的提示。提示窃取攻击包含两个主要模块: 参数提取器和提示重构。参数提取器的目标是计算出原始提示符的属性。我们首先观察到，大多数提示符分为三类: 直接提示符、基于角色的提示符和上下文中的提示符。我们的参数提取器首先尝试根据生成的答案区分提示类型。然后，它可以根据提示的类型进一步预测使用了哪个角色或多少上下文。在参数提取器之后，可以使用提示重构器根据生成的答案和提取的特征重构原始提示。提示重构器的最终目标是生成与原始提示类似的反向提示。我们的实验结果显示了我们提出的攻击的显著性能。我们提出的攻击为快速工程的研究增加了一个新的维度，并呼吁更多的关注 LLM 的安全问题。

title: BFT-DSN: A Byzantine Fault Tolerant Decentralized Storage Network
summary:
With the rapid development of blockchain and its applications, the amount of
data stored on decentralized storage networks (DSNs) has grown exponentially.
DSNs bring together affordable storage resources from around the world to
provide robust, decentralized storage services for tens of thousands of
decentralized applications (dApps). However, existing DSNs do not offer
verifiability when implementing erasure coding for redundant storage, making
them vulnerable to Byzantine encoders. Additionally, there is a lack of
Byzantine fault-tolerant consensus for optimal resilience in DSNs. This paper
introduces BFT-DSN, a Byzantine fault-tolerant decentralized storage network
designed to address these challenges. BFT-DSN combines storage-weighted BFT
consensus with erasure coding and incorporates homomorphic fingerprints and
weighted threshold signatures for decentralized verification. The
implementation of BFT-DSN demonstrates its comparable performance in terms of
storage cost and latency as well as superior performance in Byzantine
resilience when compared to existing industrial decentralized storage networks.
translated: 随着区块链及其应用的迅速发展，分散存储网络(DSN)上存储的数据量呈指数级增长。DSN 汇集了来自世界各地的可负担的存储资源，为成千上万的分散式应用程序(dApps)提供健壮的分散式存储服务。然而，现有的 DSN 在实现冗余存储的擦除编码时不能提供可验证性，这使得它们容易受到拜占庭编码器的攻击。此外，对于 DSN 中的最佳恢复能力，拜占庭式的容错共识缺乏。本文介绍了 BFT-DSN，这是一种拜占庭容错分散存储网络，旨在解决这些问题。DSN 将存储加权 BFT 一致性与擦除编码相结合，采用同态指纹和加权阈值签名进行分散验证。与现有的工业分散存储网络相比，BFT-DSN 的实现在存储成本和延迟方面表现出可比的性能，在拜占庭复原能力方面表现出优越的性能。

title:
Federated Multi-Task Learning on Non-IID Data Silos: An Experimental
  Study
summary:
The innovative Federated Multi-Task Learning (FMTL) approach consolidates the
benefits of Federated Learning (FL) and Multi-Task Learning (MTL), enabling
collaborative model training on multi-task learning datasets. However, a
comprehensive evaluation method, integrating the unique features of both FL and
MTL, is currently absent in the field. This paper fills this void by
introducing a novel framework, FMTL-Bench, for systematic evaluation of the
FMTL paradigm. This benchmark covers various aspects at the data, model, and
optimization algorithm levels, and comprises seven sets of comparative
experiments, encapsulating a wide array of non-independent and identically
distributed (Non-IID) data partitioning scenarios. We propose a systematic
process for comparing baselines of diverse indicators and conduct a case study
on communication expenditure, time, and energy consumption. Through our
exhaustive experiments, we aim to provide valuable insights into the strengths
and limitations of existing baseline methods, contributing to the ongoing
discourse on optimal FMTL application in practical scenarios. The source code
will be made available for results replication.
translated: 创新的联邦多任务学习(FMTL)方法巩固了联邦学习(FL)和多任务学习(MTL)的好处，使多任务学习数据集的协作模型培训成为可能。然而，综合 FL 和 MTL 的独特性质的综合评价方法目前在该领域还缺乏。本文通过引入一个新的框架 FMTL-Bench 来填补这一空白，该框架用于对 FMTL 范式进行系统评估。该基准测试涵盖了数据、模型和优化算法级别的各个方面，包括七组比较实验，封装了大量非独立和同分布(Non-IID)数据分区场景。我们提出了一个系统的过程来比较不同指标的基线，并进行了一个案例研究的沟通支出，时间和能源消耗。通过我们的详尽的实验，我们的目标是提供有价值的见解，现有的基线方法的优势和局限性，有助于正在进行的讨论最佳 FMTL 应用于实际情景。源代码将可用于结果复制。

title: Coercing LLMs to do and reveal (almost) anything
summary:
It has recently been shown that adversarial attacks on large language models
(LLMs) can "jailbreak" the model into making harmful statements. In this work,
we argue that the spectrum of adversarial attacks on LLMs is much larger than
merely jailbreaking. We provide a broad overview of possible attack surfaces
and attack goals. Based on a series of concrete examples, we discuss,
categorize and systematize attacks that coerce varied unintended behaviors,
such as misdirection, model control, denial-of-service, or data extraction.
  We analyze these attacks in controlled experiments, and find that many of
them stem from the practice of pre-training LLMs with coding capabilities, as
well as the continued existence of strange "glitch" tokens in common LLM
vocabularies that should be removed for security reasons.
translated: 最近有研究表明，针对大型语言模型(LLM)的敌对性攻击可以“越狱”模型，使其发出有害的声明。在这项工作中，我们认为，对 LLM 的对抗性攻击的光谱远远大于只是越狱。我们提供了一个可能的攻击表面和攻击目标的广泛概述。在一系列具体实例的基础上，我们讨论、分类和系统化强制多种意外行为的攻击，如误导、模型控制、拒绝服务或数据提取。我们在对照实验中分析了这些攻击，发现其中许多攻击源于预先训练具有编码能力的 LLM 的实践，以及常见 LLM 词汇表中继续存在的奇怪的“故障”令牌，出于安全原因应该删除这些令牌。

title: Corrective Machine Unlearning
summary:
Machine Learning models increasingly face data integrity challenges due to
the use of large-scale training datasets drawn from the internet. We study what
model developers can do if they detect that some data was manipulated or
incorrect. Such manipulated data can cause adverse effects like vulnerability
to backdoored samples, systematic biases, and in general, reduced accuracy on
certain input domains. Often, all manipulated training samples are not known,
and only a small, representative subset of the affected data is flagged.
  We formalize "Corrective Machine Unlearning" as the problem of mitigating the
impact of data affected by unknown manipulations on a trained model, possibly
knowing only a subset of impacted samples. We demonstrate that the problem of
corrective unlearning has significantly different requirements from traditional
privacy-oriented unlearning. We find most existing unlearning methods,
including the gold-standard retraining-from-scratch, require most of the
manipulated data to be identified for effective corrective unlearning. However,
one approach, SSD, achieves limited success in unlearning adverse effects with
just a small portion of the manipulated samples, showing the tractability of
this setting. We hope our work spurs research towards developing better methods
for corrective unlearning and offers practitioners a new strategy to handle
data integrity challenges arising from web-scale training.
translated: 机器学习模型越来越面临数据完整性的挑战，由于使用大规模的训练数据集从互联网。我们研究如果模型开发人员发现某些数据被操纵或错误，他们可以做什么。这样的操纵数据可能会导致不利影响，如对后门样本的脆弱性，系统偏差，并在一般情况下，降低了某些输入域的准确性。通常，所有被操纵的训练样本都是未知的，并且只标记了受影响数据的一小部分具有代表性的子集。我们将“校正机器学习”形式化为一个问题，即在训练模型上减轻受未知操作影响的数据的影响，可能只知道受影响样本的一个子集。我们证明了纠错忘却问题与传统的面向隐私的忘却问题有显著不同的要求。我们发现大多数现有的忘记方法，包括从头开始的黄金标准再训练，需要识别大多数被操纵的数据来进行有效的纠正忘记。然而，一种方法，SSD，实现有限的成功，在忘记不良影响，只有一小部分操纵样本，显示了这种设置的易处理性。我们希望我们的工作能够促进研究，发展更好的纠正遗忘的方法，并为从业者提供一个新的策略，以处理网络规模培训所带来的数据完整性挑战。

title: FedADMM-InSa: An Inexact and Self-Adaptive ADMM for Federated Learning
summary:
Federated learning (FL) is a promising framework for learning from
distributed data while maintaining privacy. The development of efficient FL
algorithms encounters various challenges, including heterogeneous data and
systems, limited communication capacities, and constrained local computational
resources. Recently developed FedADMM methods show great resilience to both
data and system heterogeneity. However, they still suffer from performance
deterioration if the hyperparameters are not carefully tuned. To address this
issue, we propose an inexact and self-adaptive FedADMM algorithm, termed
FedADMM-InSa. First, we design an inexactness criterion for the clients' local
updates to eliminate the need for empirically setting the local training
accuracy. This inexactness criterion can be assessed by each client
independently based on its unique condition, thereby reducing the local
computational cost and mitigating the undesirable straggle effect. The
convergence of the resulting inexact ADMM is proved under the assumption of
strongly convex loss functions. Additionally, we present a self-adaptive scheme
that dynamically adjusts each client's penalty parameter, enhancing algorithm
robustness by mitigating the need for empirical penalty parameter choices for
each client. Extensive numerical experiments on both synthetic and real-world
datasets are conducted. As validated by some numerical tests, our proposed
algorithm can reduce the clients' local computational load significantly and
also accelerate the learning process compared to the vanilla FedADMM.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)是一种在保护隐私的前提下从分布式数据中学习的有前途的学习框架。高效的 FL 算法的发展面临着各种各样的挑战，包括异构数据和系统、有限的通信能力和局部计算资源。最近开发的 FedADMM 方法对数据和系统异构性都表现出很强的弹性。然而，如果不仔细调整超参数，它们仍然会遭受性能下降的问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种不精确的自适应 FedADMM 算法，称为 FedADMM-InSa。首先，我们为客户端的局部更新设计了一个不精确性准则，以消除经验设置局部训练精度的需要。这种不精确性准则可以由每个客户机根据其独特的条件独立地进行评估，从而降低了局部计算成本，减轻了不良的散乱效应。在强凸损失函数的假设下，证明了所得非精确 ADMM 的收敛性。此外，我们提出了一个自适应的方案，动态调整每个客户端的惩罚参数，通过减少需要经验的惩罚参数选择，提高算法的鲁棒性为每个客户端。对合成数据集和真实数据集进行了广泛的数值实验。通过数值实验验证，与传统的 FedADMM 算法相比，本文提出的算法可以显著降低客户端的局部计算负载，并加快学习过程。

title: Cybersecurity as a Service
summary:
With the increasing sophistication and sheer number of cyberattacks, more and
more companies come to the conclusion that they have to strengthen their
cybersecurity posture. At the same time, well-educated Information technology
(IT) security personnel are scarce. Cybersecurity as a service (CSaaS) is one
possible solution to tackle this problem by outsourcing security functions to
managed security service providers (MSSP). This chapter gives an overview of
common CSaaS functions and their providers. Moreover, it provides guidance
especially for small- and medium-sized businesses, for asking the appropriate
questions when it comes to the selection of a specific MSSP.
translated: 随着网络攻击越来越复杂和数量越来越多，越来越多的公司得出结论，他们必须加强他们的网络安全姿态。与此同时，受过良好教育的信息技术(IT)安全人员稀缺。网络安全即服务(Cybersecurity as a service，CSaaS)是通过将安全功能外包给受管理的安全服务提供商(MSSP)来解决这一问题的一种可能的解决方案。本章概述了常见的 CSaaS 功能及其提供者。此外，它还特别为中小型企业提供指导，以便在选择特定的 MSSP 时提出适当的问题。

title:
AttackGNN: Red-Teaming GNNs in Hardware Security Using Reinforcement
  Learning
summary:
Machine learning has shown great promise in addressing several critical
hardware security problems. In particular, researchers have developed novel
graph neural network (GNN)-based techniques for detecting intellectual property
(IP) piracy, detecting hardware Trojans (HTs), and reverse engineering
circuits, to name a few. These techniques have demonstrated outstanding
accuracy and have received much attention in the community. However, since
these techniques are used for security applications, it is imperative to
evaluate them thoroughly and ensure they are robust and do not compromise the
security of integrated circuits.
  In this work, we propose AttackGNN, the first red-team attack on GNN-based
techniques in hardware security. To this end, we devise a novel reinforcement
learning (RL) agent that generates adversarial examples, i.e., circuits,
against the GNN-based techniques. We overcome three challenges related to
effectiveness, scalability, and generality to devise a potent RL agent. We
target five GNN-based techniques for four crucial classes of problems in
hardware security: IP piracy, detecting/localizing HTs, reverse engineering,
and hardware obfuscation. Through our approach, we craft circuits that fool all
GNNs considered in this work. For instance, to evade IP piracy detection, we
generate adversarial pirated circuits that fool the GNN-based defense into
classifying our crafted circuits as not pirated. For attacking HT localization
GNN, our attack generates HT-infested circuits that fool the defense on all
tested circuits. We obtain a similar 100% success rate against GNNs for all
classes of problems.
translated: 机器学习在解决几个关键的硬件安全问题方面显示出巨大的前景。特别值得一提的是，研究人员已经开发出了基于图形神经网络(GNN)的新技术，用于检测知识产权(IP)盗版、硬件木马(HT)和逆向工程电路等。这些技术已经证明了出色的准确性，并受到了社会的广泛关注。然而，由于这些技术是用于安全应用，因此必须对它们进行彻底的评估，并确保它们是健壮的，不会危及集成电路的安全。在这项工作中，我们提出攻击 GNN，第一个红队攻击基于 GNN 的技术在硬件安全。为此，我们设计了一种新型的强化学习代理(RL) ，它可以针对基于 GNN 的技术产生对抗性的例子，即电路。我们克服了与有效性、可伸缩性和通用性相关的三个挑战，设计了一个有效的 RL 代理。我们针对四类关键的硬件安全问题，即 IP 盗版、检测/本地化 HTs、逆向工程和硬件混淆，提出了五种基于 GNN 的技术。通过我们的方法，我们制造电路，欺骗所有 GNN 考虑在这项工作。例如，为了逃避 IP 盗版检测，我们生成对抗性盗版电路，以欺骗基于 GNN 的防御系统，将我们精心制作的电路归类为非盗版电路。对于攻击 HT 定位 GNN，我们的攻击产生 HT 感染的电路，欺骗所有测试电路的防御。对于所有类别的问题，我们都获得了相似的100% 成功率。

title: Explain to Question not to Justify
summary:
Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) is a young but very promising field
of research. Unfortunately, the progress in this field is currently slowed down
by divergent and incompatible goals. In this paper, we separate various threads
tangled within the area of XAI into two complementary cultures of
human/value-oriented explanations (BLUE XAI) and model/validation-oriented
explanations (RED XAI). We also argue that the area of RED XAI is currently
under-explored and hides great opportunities and potential for important
research necessary to ensure the safety of AI systems. We conclude this paper
by presenting promising challenges in this area.
translated: 可解释人工智能(XAI)是一个年轻但非常有前途的研究领域。不幸的是，这一领域的进展目前因目标不一致和不兼容而放缓。在本文中，我们将在 XAI 领域内纠缠的各种线索分解为两种互补的文化，即人/价值导向的解释(BLUE XAI)和模型/验证导向的解释(RED XAI)。我们还认为，RED XAI 领域目前尚未得到充分的开发，隐藏着巨大的机会和潜力，需要进行重要的研究，以确保人工智能系统的安全。我们在结束本文时提出了这一领域的有希望的挑战。

title:
Grover's oracle for the Shortest Vector Problem and its application in
  hybrid classical-quantum solvers
summary:
Finding the shortest vector in a lattice is a problem that is believed to be
hard both for classical and quantum computers. Many major post-quantum secure
cryptosystems base their security on the hardness of the Shortest Vector
Problem (SVP). Finding the best classical, quantum or hybrid classical-quantum
algorithms for SVP is necessary to select cryptosystem parameters that offer
sufficient level of security. Grover's search quantum algorithm provides a
generic quadratic speed-up, given access to an oracle implementing some
function which describes when a solution is found. In this paper we provide
concrete implementation of such an oracle for the SVP. We define the circuit,
and evaluate costs in terms of number of qubits, number of gates, depth and
T-quantum cost. We then analyze how to combine Grover's quantum search for
small SVP instances with state-of-the-art classical solvers that use well known
algorithms, such as the BKZ, where the former is used as a subroutine. This
could enable solving larger instances of SVP with higher probability than
classical state-of-the-art records, but still very far from posing any threat
to cryptosystems being considered for standardization. Depending on the
technology available, there is a spectrum of trade-offs in creating this
combination.
translated: 寻找格子中的最短向量是一个被认为对于经典计算机和量子计算机都很困难的问题。许多主要的后量子安全密码体制的安全性基于最短向量问题(SVP)的难度。为 SVP 寻找最佳的经典、量子或混合经典量子算法是选择能够提供足够安全级别的密码系统参数的必要条件。Grover 的搜索量子算法提供了一个通用的二次加速，给定了访问一个实现某个函数的 Oracle 的权限，该函数描述何时找到解决方案。在本文中，我们为 SVP 提供了这样一个 Oracle 的具体实现。我们定义了电路，并根据量子比特数、门数、深度和 T 量子成本来评估成本。然后，我们分析如何将 Grover 对小型 SVP 实例的量子搜索与使用众所周知的算法(如 BKZ)的最先进的经典求解器相结合，前者被用作子例程。这可以解决较大的 SVP 实例，其概率高于传统的最新记录，但仍然远远不能对正在考虑标准化的密码系统构成任何威胁。根据可用的技术，创建这种组合需要进行一系列的权衡。

title:
An Explainable Transformer-based Model for Phishing Email Detection: A
  Large Language Model Approach
summary:
Phishing email is a serious cyber threat that tries to deceive users by
sending false emails with the intention of stealing confidential information or
causing financial harm. Attackers, often posing as trustworthy entities,
exploit technological advancements and sophistication to make detection and
prevention of phishing more challenging. Despite extensive academic research,
phishing detection remains an ongoing and formidable challenge in the
cybersecurity landscape. Large Language Models (LLMs) and Masked Language
Models (MLMs) possess immense potential to offer innovative solutions to
address long-standing challenges. In this research paper, we present an
optimized, fine-tuned transformer-based DistilBERT model designed for the
detection of phishing emails. In the detection process, we work with a phishing
email dataset and utilize the preprocessing techniques to clean and solve the
imbalance class issues. Through our experiments, we found that our model
effectively achieves high accuracy, demonstrating its capability to perform
well. Finally, we demonstrate our fine-tuned model using Explainable-AI (XAI)
techniques such as Local Interpretable Model-Agnostic Explanations (LIME) and
Transformer Interpret to explain how our model makes predictions in the context
of text classification for phishing emails.
translated: 网络钓鱼电子邮件是一种严重的网络威胁，它试图通过发送虚假电子邮件欺骗用户，意图窃取机密信息或造成经济损失。攻击者经常伪装成值得信赖的实体，利用技术进步和先进性，使检测和防范网络钓鱼更具挑战性。尽管有广泛的学术研究，网络钓鱼检测仍然是网络安全领域一个持续存在的巨大挑战。大型语言模型(LLM)和掩码语言模型(MLM)具有巨大的潜力，可以提供创新的解决方案来应对长期存在的挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一个优化，微调变压器为基础的 DistilBERT 模型设计用于检测网络钓鱼电子邮件。在检测过程中，我们使用钓鱼电子邮件数据集，并利用预处理技术来清除和解决不平衡类问题。通过实验，我们发现我们的模型有效地达到了很高的精度，证明了它的性能良好。最后，我们使用可解释 AI (XAI)技术，例如局部可解释模型-不可知解释(LIME)和变压器解释，来演示我们的微调模型，以解释我们的模型如何在文本分类的上下文中对钓鱼邮件进行预测。

title: Large Language Models are Advanced Anonymizers
summary:
Recent work in privacy research on large language models has shown that they
achieve near human-level performance at inferring personal data from real-world
online texts. With consistently increasing model capabilities, existing text
anonymization methods are currently lacking behind regulatory requirements and
adversarial threats. This raises the question of how individuals can
effectively protect their personal data in sharing online texts. In this work,
we take two steps to answer this question: We first present a new setting for
evaluating anonymizations in the face of adversarial LLMs inferences, allowing
for a natural measurement of anonymization performance while remedying some of
the shortcomings of previous metrics. We then present our LLM-based adversarial
anonymization framework leveraging the strong inferential capabilities of LLMs
to inform our anonymization procedure. In our experimental evaluation, we show
on real-world and synthetic online texts how adversarial anonymization
outperforms current industry-grade anonymizers both in terms of the resulting
utility and privacy.
translated: 最近对大型语言模型的隐私研究表明，它们在从现实世界的在线文本推断个人数据方面取得了接近人类水平的表现。随着模型能力的不断提高，现有的文本匿名化方法在监管要求和对抗性威胁方面存在缺陷。这就提出了一个问题，即个人如何才能在分享在线文本时有效地保护自己的个人数据。在这项工作中，我们采取了两个步骤来回答这个问题: 我们首先提出了一个新的设置来评估匿名化在面对对手 LLM 推断时，允许一个自然的匿名化性能测量，同时纠正了一些先前指标的缺点。然后，我们提出了我们的基于 LLM 的对抗性匿名化框架，利用 LLM 的强大推理能力来通知我们的匿名化程序。在我们的实验评估中，我们在现实世界和合成在线文本上展示了对抗性匿名在效用和隐私方面如何优于现有的工业级匿名。

title:
An Empirical Study on Oculus Virtual Reality Applications: Security and
  Privacy Perspectives
summary:
Although Virtual Reality (VR) has accelerated its prevalent adoption in
emerging metaverse applications, it is not a fundamentally new technology. On
one hand, most VR operating systems (OS) are based on off-the-shelf mobile OS.
As a result, VR apps also inherit privacy and security deficiencies from
conventional mobile apps. On the other hand, in contrast to conventional mobile
apps, VR apps can achieve immersive experience via diverse VR devices, such as
head-mounted displays, body sensors, and controllers though achieving this
requires the extensive collection of privacy-sensitive human biometrics.
Moreover, VR apps have been typically implemented by 3D gaming engines (e.g.,
Unity), which also contain intrinsic security vulnerabilities. Inappropriate
use of these technologies may incur privacy leaks and security vulnerabilities
although these issues have not received significant attention compared to the
proliferation of diverse VR apps. In this paper, we develop a security and
privacy assessment tool, namely the VR-SP detector for VR apps. The VR-SP
detector has integrated program static analysis tools and privacy-policy
analysis methods. Using the VR-SP detector, we conduct a comprehensive
empirical study on 500 popular VR apps. We obtain the original apps from the
popular Oculus and SideQuest app stores and extract APK files via the Meta
Oculus Quest 2 device. We evaluate security vulnerabilities and privacy data
leaks of these VR apps by VR app analysis, taint analysis, and privacy-policy
analysis. We find that a number of security vulnerabilities and privacy leaks
widely exist in VR apps. Moreover, our results also reveal conflicting
representations in the privacy policies of these apps and inconsistencies of
the actual data collection with the privacy-policy statements of the apps.
Based on these findings, we make suggestions for the future development of VR
apps.
translated: 尽管虚拟现实(VR)已经加速了它在新兴元宇宙应用中的普遍应用，但它并不是一项全新的技术。一方面，大多数 VR 操作系统都是基于现成的移动操作系统。因此，虚拟现实应用程序也继承了传统移动应用程序的隐私和安全缺陷。另一方面，与传统的移动应用程序不同，虚拟现实应用程序可以通过不同的虚拟现实设备获得身临其境的体验，如头戴式显示器、身体传感器和控制器，尽管实现这一点需要广泛收集对隐私敏感的人类生物特征。此外，虚拟现实应用程序通常由3D 游戏引擎(例如 Unity)实现，这些引擎也包含内在的安全漏洞。不恰当地使用这些技术可能会导致隐私泄露和安全漏洞，尽管与各种虚拟现实应用程序的扩散相比，这些问题还没有得到重视。本文针对虚拟现实应用程序开发了一种安全隐私评估工具—— VR-SP 检测器。VR-SP 检测器集成了程序静态分析工具和隐私策略分析方法。使用 VR-SP 检测器，对500个流行的 VR 应用程序进行了全面的实证研究。我们从流行的 Oculus 和 SideQuest 应用程序商店获得原始应用程序，并通过 Meta Oculus Quest 2设备提取 APK 文件。我们通过 VR 应用程序分析、污染分析和隐私策略分析来评估这些 VR 应用程序的安全漏洞和隐私数据泄漏。我们发现虚拟现实应用程序中普遍存在大量的安全漏洞和隐私泄漏。此外，我们的研究结果还揭示了这些应用程序的隐私政策中相互矛盾的表述，以及实际数据收集与应用程序的隐私政策声明的不一致。基于这些发现，我们对虚拟现实应用的未来发展提出了建议。

title: Pseudorandom unitaries with non-adaptive security
summary:
Pseudorandom unitaries (PRUs) are ensembles of efficiently implementable
unitary operators that cannot be distinguished from Haar random unitaries by
any quantum polynomial-time algorithm with query access to the unitary. We
present a simple PRU construction that is a concatenation of a random Clifford
unitary, a pseudorandom binary phase operator, and a pseudorandom permutation
operator. We prove that this PRU construction is secure against non-adaptive
distinguishers assuming the existence of quantum-secure one-way functions. This
means that no efficient quantum query algorithm that is allowed a single
application of $U^{\otimes \mathrm{poly}(n)}$ can distinguish whether an
$n$-qubit unitary $U$ was drawn from the Haar measure or our PRU ensemble. We
conjecture that our PRU construction remains secure against adaptive
distinguishers, i.e. secure against distinguishers that can query the unitary
polynomially many times in sequence, not just in parallel.
translated: 伪随机酉算子(PRU)是一类可有效实现的酉算子的集合，它与 Haar 随机酉算子无法通过任何量子多项式时间算法来区分。我们提出了一个简单的 PRU 构造，它是一个随机 Clifford 酉算子、一个伪随机二元相位算子和一个伪随机置换算子的串联。我们证明了这种 PRU 结构在假设存在量子安全单向函数的情况下对非自适应区分器是安全的。这意味着任何允许单个应用程序 $U ^ { otimes mathrm { poly}(n)} $的有效量子查询算法都不能区分 $n $- qubit 幺正 U $是从 Haar 测度还是我们的 PRU 集成中提取的。我们推测，我们的 PRU 构造仍然可以安全地对抗自适应区分器，即安全地对抗可以按顺序多次查询酉多项式，而不仅仅是并行地查询酉多项式的区分器。

title: Federated Complex Qeury Answering
summary:
Complex logical query answering is a challenging task in knowledge graphs
(KGs) that has been widely studied. The ability to perform complex logical
reasoning is essential and supports various graph reasoning-based downstream
tasks, such as search engines. Recent approaches are proposed to represent KG
entities and logical queries into embedding vectors and find answers to logical
queries from the KGs. However, existing proposed methods mainly focus on
querying a single KG and cannot be applied to multiple graphs. In addition,
directly sharing KGs with sensitive information may incur privacy risks, making
it impractical to share and construct an aggregated KG for reasoning to
retrieve query answers. Thus, it remains unknown how to answer queries on
multi-source KGs. An entity can be involved in various knowledge graphs and
reasoning on multiple KGs and answering complex queries on multi-source KGs is
important in discovering knowledge cross graphs. Fortunately, federated
learning is utilized in knowledge graphs to collaboratively learn
representations with privacy preserved. Federated knowledge graph embeddings
enrich the relations in knowledge graphs to improve the representation quality.
However, these methods only focus on one-hop relations and cannot perform
complex reasoning tasks. In this paper, we apply federated learning to complex
query-answering tasks to reason over multi-source knowledge graphs while
preserving privacy. We propose a Federated Complex Query Answering framework
(FedCQA), to reason over multi-source KGs avoiding sensitive raw data
transmission to protect privacy. We conduct extensive experiments on three
real-world datasets and evaluate retrieval performance on various types of
complex queries.
translated: 复杂逻辑查询回答是知识图中一个具有挑战性的问题，已经得到了广泛的研究。执行复杂逻辑推理的能力是必不可少的，并支持各种基于图形推理的下游任务，如搜索引擎。最近提出了将 KG 实体和逻辑查询表示为嵌入向量，并从 KG 中找到逻辑查询的答案的方法。然而，现有的方法主要集中在查询一个 KG，不能应用于多个图。此外，直接共享含有敏感信息的幼稚园可能会带来隐私风险，因此不可能共享和构造一个聚合的幼稚园来进行推理以检索查询答案。因此，仍然不知道如何回答对多源 KG 的查询。一个实体可以参与多个 KG 上的各种知识图和推理，回答多源 KG 上的复杂查询对于发现知识交叉图非常重要。幸运的是，联邦学习在知识图中被用来协作学习保护隐私的表示。联邦知识图嵌入丰富了知识图的关系，提高了知识图的表示质量。然而，这些方法只能处理单跳关系，不能完成复杂的推理任务。本文将联邦学习应用于复杂的查询回答任务，在保护隐私的前提下对多源知识图进行推理。我们提出了一个联邦复杂查询回答框架(fedCQA) ，以推理多源幼稚园，避免敏感的原始数据传输，以保护隐私。我们对三个真实世界的数据集进行了广泛的实验，并评估了各种类型的复杂查询的检索性能。

title:
Enhancing SCADA Security: Developing a Host-Based Intrusion Detection
  System to Safeguard Against Cyberattacks
summary:
With the increasing reliance of smart grids on correctly functioning SCADA
systems and their vulnerability to cyberattacks, there is a pressing need for
effective security measures. SCADA systems are prone to cyberattacks, posing
risks to critical infrastructure. As there is a lack of host-based intrusion
detection systems specifically designed for the stable nature of SCADA systems,
the objective of this work is to propose a host-based intrusion detection
system tailored for SCADA systems in smart grids. The proposed system utilizes
USB device identification, flagging, and process memory scanning to monitor and
detect anomalies in SCADA systems, providing enhanced security measures.
Evaluation in three different scenarios demonstrates the tool's effectiveness
in detecting and disabling malware. The proposed approach effectively
identifies potential threats and enhances the security of SCADA systems in
smart grids, providing a promising solution to protect against cyberattacks.
translated: 随着智能电网越来越依赖于正常运行的 SCADA 系统及其易受网络攻击的脆弱性，迫切需要采取有效的安全措施。SCADA 系统容易受到网络攻击，给关键基础设施带来风险。由于缺乏专为 SCADA 系统的稳定性而设计的基于主机的入侵检测系统，因此本研究的目的是提出一种适用于智能电网中的 SCADA 系统的基于主机的入侵检测入侵预防系统。该系统利用 USB 设备识别、标记和进程内存扫描来监视和检测 SCADA 系统中的异常，提供了增强的安全措施。在三个不同场景中的评估证明了该工具在检测和禁用恶意软件方面的有效性。提议的方法有效地识别了潜在的威胁，加强了智能电网中 SCADA 系统的安全性，为防范网络攻击提供了一个有希望的解决方案。

title:
{A New Hope}: Contextual Privacy Policies for Mobile Applications and An
  Approach Toward Automated Generation
summary:
Privacy policies have emerged as the predominant approach to conveying
privacy notices to mobile application users. In an effort to enhance both
readability and user engagement, the concept of contextual privacy policies
(CPPs) has been proposed by researchers. The aim of CPPs is to fragment privacy
policies into concise snippets, displaying them only within the corresponding
contexts within the application's graphical user interfaces (GUIs). In this
paper, we first formulate CPP in mobile application scenario, and then present
a novel multimodal framework, named SeePrivacy, specifically designed to
automatically generate CPPs for mobile applications. This method uniquely
integrates vision-based GUI understanding with privacy policy analysis,
achieving 0.88 precision and 0.90 recall to detect contexts, as well as 0.98
precision and 0.96 recall in extracting corresponding policy segments. A human
evaluation shows that 77% of the extracted privacy policy segments were
perceived as well-aligned with the detected contexts. These findings suggest
that SeePrivacy could serve as a significant tool for bolstering user
interaction with, and understanding of, privacy policies. Furthermore, our
solution has the potential to make privacy notices more accessible and
inclusive, thus appealing to a broader demographic. A demonstration of our work
can be accessed at https://cpp4app.github.io/SeePrivacy/
translated: 隐私政策已经成为向移动应用程序用户传递隐私通知的主要方法。为了提高可读性和用户参与度，研究人员提出了上下文隐私策略(CPP)的概念。CPP 的目的是将隐私策略分割成简洁的片段，仅在应用程序的图形用户界面(GUI)中的相应上下文中显示它们。在本文中，我们首先在移动应用场景中描述了 CPP，然后提出了一个新的多模态框架 SeePrivacy，专门为移动应用程序自动生成 CPP 而设计。该方法将基于视觉的图形用户界面理解和隐私策略分析独特地结合起来，实现了0.88精度和0.90召回率的上下文检测，以及0.98精度和0.96召回率的相应策略片段提取。人工评估显示，提取的隐私策略片段中有77% 被认为与检测到的上下文保持良好的一致性。这些发现表明，SeePrivacy 可以作为一个重要的工具来支持用户与隐私政策的互动和理解。此外，我们的解决方案有可能使隐私通知更容易获取和包容，从而吸引更广泛的人群。我们的作品展示可在 https://cpp4app.github.io/seeprivacy/查阅

title:
Federated Learning on Transcriptomic Data: Model Quality and Performance
  Trade-Offs
summary:
Machine learning on large-scale genomic or transcriptomic data is important
for many novel health applications. For example, precision medicine tailors
medical treatments to patients on the basis of individual biomarkers, cellular
and molecular states, etc. However, the data required is sensitive, voluminous,
heterogeneous, and typically distributed across locations where dedicated
machine learning hardware is not available. Due to privacy and regulatory
reasons, it is also problematic to aggregate all data at a trusted third
party.Federated learning is a promising solution to this dilemma, because it
enables decentralized, collaborative machine learning without exchanging raw
data. In this paper, we perform comparative experiments with the federated
learning frameworks TensorFlow Federated and Flower. Our test case is the
training of disease prognosis and cell type classification models. We train the
models with distributed transcriptomic data, considering both data
heterogeneity and architectural heterogeneity. We measure model quality,
robustness against privacy-enhancing noise, computational performance and
resource overhead. Each of the federated learning frameworks has different
strengths. However, our experiments confirm that both frameworks can readily
build models on transcriptomic data, without transferring personal raw data to
a third party with abundant computational resources.
translated: 大规模基因组或转录组数据的机器学习对于许多新的健康应用是重要的。例如，精准医学会根据个别生物标记、细胞和分子状态等，为病人量身定制治疗方法。然而，所需的数据是敏感的、大量的、异构的，并且通常分布在没有专用机器学习硬件的地方。由于隐私和监管方面的原因，在可信的第三方聚合所有数据也是有问题的。联合学习是解决这一难题的一个有前途的解决方案，因为它可以实现分散的、协作的机器学习，而无需交换原始数据。在本文中，我们使用 TensorFlow Federated 和 Flower 联邦学习框架进行了对比实验。我们的测试案例是疾病预后和细胞类型分类模型的训练。我们用分布式转录组数据训练模型，同时考虑数据异质性和结构异质性。我们衡量模型质量，对隐私增强噪声的鲁棒性，计算性能和资源开销。每个联合学习框架都有不同的优势。然而，我们的实验证实，这两个框架可以很容易地在转录组数据上建立模型，而不需要将个人原始数据传输给具有丰富计算资源的第三方。

title: Closed-Form Bounds for DP-SGD against Record-level Inference
summary:
Machine learning models trained with differentially-private (DP) algorithms
such as DP-SGD enjoy resilience against a wide range of privacy attacks.
Although it is possible to derive bounds for some attacks based solely on an
$(\varepsilon,\delta)$-DP guarantee, meaningful bounds require a small enough
privacy budget (i.e., injecting a large amount of noise), which results in a
large loss in utility. This paper presents a new approach to evaluate the
privacy of machine learning models against specific record-level threats, such
as membership and attribute inference, without the indirection through DP. We
focus on the popular DP-SGD algorithm, and derive simple closed-form bounds.
Our proofs model DP-SGD as an information theoretic channel whose inputs are
the secrets that an attacker wants to infer (e.g., membership of a data record)
and whose outputs are the intermediate model parameters produced by iterative
optimization. We obtain bounds for membership inference that match
state-of-the-art techniques, whilst being orders of magnitude faster to
compute. Additionally, we present a novel data-dependent bound against
attribute inference. Our results provide a direct, interpretable, and practical
way to evaluate the privacy of trained models against specific inference
threats without sacrificing utility.
translated: 使用差分私有(DP)算法(如 DP-SGD)训练的机器学习模型具有抵御各种隐私攻击的能力。尽管仅仅基于 $(varepsilon，delta) $- DP 保证可以得到一些攻击的界限，但是有意义的界限需要一个足够小的隐私预算(例如，注入大量噪音) ，这会导致大量的效用损失。本文提出了一种新的机器学习模型隐私性评估方法，该方法不需要通过 DP 来间接评估机器学习模型对特定记录级威胁(如隶属度和属性推断)的隐私性。本文重点研究了流行的 DP-SGD 算法，得到了简单的闭式边界。我们的证明模型 DP-SGD 作为一个信息理论通道，其输入是攻击者想要推断的秘密(例如，数据记录的成员关系) ，其输出是通过迭代优化产生的中间模型参数。我们获得了与最先进技术相匹配的成员推断的界限，同时数量级计算速度也更快。此外，我们提出了一个新的数据相关的界限对属性推断。我们的结果提供了一个直接的，可解释的，实用的方法来评估训练有素的模型对特定的推理威胁的隐私，而不牺牲效用。

title:
Exploring Emerging Trends in 5G Malicious Traffic Analysis and
  Incremental Learning Intrusion Detection Strategies
summary:
The popularity of 5G networks poses a huge challenge for malicious traffic
detection technology. The reason for this is that as the use of 5G technology
increases, so does the risk of malicious traffic activity on 5G networks.
Malicious traffic activity in 5G networks not only has the potential to disrupt
communication services, but also to compromise sensitive data. This can have
serious consequences for individuals and organizations. In this paper, we first
provide an in-depth study of 5G technology and 5G security. Next we analyze and
discuss the latest malicious traffic detection under AI and their applicability
to 5G networks, and compare the various traffic detection aspects addressed by
SOTA. The SOTA in 5G traffic detection is also analyzed. Next, we propose seven
criteria for traffic monitoring datasets to confirm their suitability for
future traffic detection studies. Finally, we present three major issues that
need to be addressed for traffic detection in 5G environment. The concept of
incremental learning techniques is proposed and applied in the experiments, and
the experimental results prove to be able to solve the three problems to some
extent.
translated: 5G 网络的普及对恶意流量检测技术提出了巨大的挑战。原因是随着5G 技术的使用增加，5G 网络上的恶意流量活动的风险也随之增加。5G 网络中的恶意流量活动不仅有可能破坏通信服务，而且还会危及敏感数据。这可能对个人和组织产生严重的后果。本文首先对5G 技术和5G 安全进行了深入的研究。接下来分析和讨论了人工智能环境下最新的恶意流量检测技术及其在5G 网络中的适用性，并对 SOTA 提出的各种流量检测方法进行了比较。分析了5G 流量检测中的 SOTA 技术。接下来，我们提出了七个交通监测数据集的标准，以确认它们是否适合未来的交通检测研究。最后，我们提出了在5G 环境下流量检测需要解决的三个主要问题。在线机机器学习技术的概念被提出并应用于实验中，实验结果证明能够在一定程度上解决这三个问题。

title: Homomorphic Encryption Based on Post-Quantum Cryptography
summary:
With the development of Shor's algorithm, some nondeterministic polynomial
(NP) time problems (e.g. prime factorization problems and discrete logarithm
problems) may be solved in polynomial time. In recent years, although some
homomorphic encryption algorithms have been proposed based on prime
factorization problems, the algorithms may be cracked by quantum computing
attacks. Therefore, this study proposes a post-quantum cryptography (PQC)-based
homomorphic encryption method which includes the homomorphic encryption
function based on a code-based cryptography method for avoiding quantum
computing attacks. Subsection 3.2 proposes mathematical models to prove the
feasibility of the proposed method, and Subsection 3.3 gives calculation
examples to present the detailed steps of the proposed method. In experimental
environments, the mainstream cryptography methods (i.e. RSA cryptography and
elliptic curve cryptography (ECC)) have been compared, and the results show
that the encryption time and decryption time of the proposed method are shorter
than other cryptography methods. Furthermore, the proposed method is designed
based on a non-negative matrix factorization problem (i.e. a NP problem) for
resisting quantum computing attacks.
translated: 随着肖尔算法的发展，一些 NP (NP)时间问题(如整数分解问题和离散对数问题)可以在多项式时间内求解。近年来，尽管一些同态加密算法是基于整数分解问题提出的，但这些算法可能会被量子计算攻击破解。因此，本研究提出一种基于后量子密码学(PQC)的同态加密方法，其中包括基于密码学方法的同态加密功能，以避免量子计算攻击。第3.2节提出了数学模型来证明该方法的可行性，第3.3节给出了计算实例来说明该方法的具体步骤。在实验环境中，我们比较了主流的加密方法(即 RSA 加密法和椭圆曲线密码学加密法(ECC)) ，结果显示该方法的加密时间和解密时间均较其他加密方法为短。此外，该方法是基于一个抗量子计算攻击的非负矩阵分解问题(即 NP 问题)而设计的。

title:
ModSRAM: Algorithm-Hardware Co-Design for Large Number Modular
  Multiplication in SRAM
summary:
Elliptic curve cryptography (ECC) is widely used in security applications
such as public key cryptography (PKC) and zero-knowledge proofs (ZKP). ECC is
composed of modular arithmetic, where modular multiplication takes most of the
processing time. Computational complexity and memory constraints of ECC limit
the performance. Therefore, hardware acceleration on ECC is an active field of
research. Processing-in-memory (PIM) is a promising approach to tackle this
problem. In this work, we design ModSRAM, the first 8T SRAM PIM architecture to
compute large-number modular multiplication efficiently. In addition, we
propose R4CSA-LUT, a new algorithm that reduces the cycles for an interleaved
algorithm and eliminates carry propagation for addition based on look-up tables
(LUT). ModSRAM is co-designed with R4CSA-LUT to support modular multiplication
and data reuse in memory with 52% cycle reduction compared to prior works with
only 32% area overhead.
translated: 椭圆曲线密码学密码体制(ECC)广泛应用于公开密码匙加密(PKC)及零知识证明(ZkP)等保安应用。ECC 由同余关系组成，其中模乘占用了大部分处理时间。ECC 的计算复杂度和内存约束限制了性能。因此，对 ECC 的硬件加速研究是一个非常活跃的研究领域。内存处理(Processing-in-memory，PIM)是解决这一问题的一种有前途的方法。在这项工作中，我们设计了 ModSRAM，第一个8T SRAM 的 PIM 架构来有效地计算大数模乘。此外，我们还提出了 R4CSA-LUT 算法，该算法减少了交织算法的周期，消除了基于查找表(LUT)的进位传播。ModSRAM 与 R4CSA-LUT 共同设计，以支持模块化乘法和内存中的数据重用，与之前只有32% 的面积开销的工作相比，周期减少了52% 。

title:
QuantTM: Business-Centric Threat Quantification for Risk Management and
  Cyber Resilience
summary:
Threat modeling has emerged as a key process for understanding relevant
threats within businesses. However, understanding the importance of threat
events is rarely driven by the business incorporating the system. Furthermore,
prioritization of threat events often occurs based on abstract and qualitative
scoring. While such scores enable prioritization, they do not allow the results
to be easily interpreted by decision-makers. This can hinder downstream
activities, such as discussing security investments and a security control's
economic applicability. This article introduces QuantTM, an approach that
incorporates views from operational and strategic business representatives to
collect threat information during the threat modeling process to measure
potential financial loss incurred by a specific threat event. It empowers the
analysis of threats' impacts and the applicability of security controls, thus
supporting the threat analysis and prioritization from an economic perspective.
QuantTM comprises an overarching process for data collection and aggregation
and a method for business impact analysis. The performance and feasibility of
the QuantTM approach are demonstrated in a real-world case study conducted in a
Swiss SME to analyze the impacts of threats and economic benefits of security
controls. Secondly, it is shown that employing business impact analysis is
feasible and that the supporting prototype exhibits great usability.
translated: 威胁建模已经成为理解业务中相关威胁的关键过程。然而，理解威胁事件的重要性很少是由合并系统的业务驱动的。此外，威胁事件的优先级往往基于抽象和定性评分。虽然这样的分数可以进行优先排序，但它们不允许决策者轻易地解释结果。这可能会阻碍下游活动，如讨论安全投资和安全控制的经济适用性。本文介绍了 QuantTM，这种方法结合了来自运营和战略业务代表的视图，在威胁建模过程中收集威胁信息，以度量特定威胁事件引起的潜在财务损失。它授权分析威胁的影响和安全控制的适用性，从而从经济角度支持威胁分析和优先级排序。QuantTM 包括用于数据收集和聚合的总体流程和用于业务影响分析的方法。QuantTM 方法的性能和可行性在一个瑞士中小企业进行的实际案例研究中得到了证明，该研究旨在分析安全控制的威胁和经济效益的影响。其次，证明了采用业务影响分析的方法是可行的，支撑原型具有很强的可用性。

title: Selective disclosure of claims from multiple digital credentials
summary:
Digital credentials represent a cornerstone of digital identity on the
Internet. To achieve privacy, certain functionalities in credentials should be
implemented. One is selective disclosure, which allows users to disclose only
the claims or attributes they want. This paper presents a novel approach to
selective disclosure that combines Merkle hash trees and Boneh-Lynn-Shacham
(BLS) signatures. Combining these approaches, we achieve selective disclosure
of claims in a single credential and creation of a verifiable presentation
containing selectively disclosed claims from multiple credentials signed by
different parties. Besides selective disclosure, we enable issuing credentials
signed by multiple issuers using this approach.
translated: 数字证书是互联网上数字身份的基石。为了实现隐私，应该实现凭据中的某些功能。一种是选择性披露，允许用户只披露他们想要的声明或属性。本文提出了一种结合 Merkle 哈希树和 BLS 签名的选择性信息披露方法。结合这些方法，我们实现了在单个凭证中选择性地披露索赔，并创建了一个可验证的表示，其中包含来自不同当事方签署的多个凭证的选择性披露的索赔。除了选择性公开之外，我们还允许使用这种方法发放由多个发行人签名的凭证。

title: Prime+Retouch: When Cache is Locked and Leaked
summary:
Caches on the modern commodity CPUs have become one of the major sources of
side-channel leakages and been abused as a new attack vector. To thwart the
cache-based side-channel attacks, two types of countermeasures have been
proposed: detection-based ones that limit the amount of microarchitectural
traces an attacker can leave, and cache prefetching-and-locking techniques that
claim to prevent such leakage by disallowing evictions on sensitive data. In
this paper, we present the Prime+Retouch attack that completely bypasses these
defense schemes by accurately inferring the cache activities with the metadata
of the cache replacement policy. Prime+Retouch has three noticeable properties:
1) it incurs no eviction on the victim's data, allowing us to bypass the two
known mitigation schemes, 2) it requires minimal synchronization of only one
memory access to the attacker's pre-primed cache lines, and 3) it leaks data
via non-shared memory, yet because underlying eviction metadata is shared.
  We demonstrate Prime+Retouch in two architectures: predominant Intel x86 and
emerging Apple M1. We elucidate how Prime+Retouch can break the T-table
implementation of AES with robust cache side-channel mitigations such as Cloak,
under both normal and SGX-protected environments. We also manifest feasibility
of the Prime+Retouch attack on the M1 platform imposing more restrictions where
the precise measurement tools such as core clock cycle timer and performance
counters are inaccessible to the attacker. Furthermore, we first demystify
undisclosed cache architecture and its eviction policy of L1 data cache on
Apple M1 architecture. We also devise a user-space noise-free cache monitoring
tool by repurposing Intel TSX.
translated: 现代商品 CPU 上的缓存已经成为边通道泄漏的主要来源之一，并被滥用作为一种新的攻击载体。为了阻止基于缓存的边通道攻击，提出了两种类型的对策: 基于检测的对策，限制攻击者可以留下的微架构痕迹的数量; 缓存预取和锁定技术，声称通过禁止对敏感数据的驱逐来防止这种泄漏。在本文中，我们提出的 Prime + Retouch 攻击，完全绕过这些防御方案，准确地推断缓存活动与缓存替换策略的元数据。Prime + Retouch 有三个值得注意的属性: 1)它不会对受害者的数据进行驱逐，允许我们绕过两个已知的缓解方案; 2)它只需要对攻击者的预启动缓存线路的一个内存访问进行最小限度的同步; 3)它通过非共享内存泄露数据，但是因为底层驱逐元数据是共享的。我们在两种架构中演示 Prime + Retouch: 占主导地位的 Intel x86和新兴的 Apple M1。我们阐明了 Prime + Retouch 如何在正常和 SGX 保护的环境下，通过强大的缓存侧通道缓解(如 Cloak)来破坏 AES 的 T 表实现。我们还证明了在 M1平台上采用 Prime + Retouch 攻击的可行性，这种攻击在精确测量工具如核心时钟周期计时器和性能计数器无法被攻击者访问的情况下施加了更多的限制。此外，我们首先揭示了未公开的缓存架构及其在苹果 M1架构上的 L1数据缓存驱逐策略。我们还设计了一个用户空间无噪音缓存监控工具重新利用英特尔 TSX。

title:
On the Usability of Next-Generation Authentication: A Study on Eye
  Movement and Brainwave-based Mechanisms
summary:
Passwords remain a widely-used authentication mechanism, despite their
well-known security and usability limitations. To improve on this situation,
next-generation authentication mechanisms, based on behavioral biometric
factors such as eye movement and brainwave have emerged. However, their
usability remains relatively under-explored. To fill this gap, we conducted an
empirical user study (n=32 participants) to evaluate three brain-based and
three eye-based authentication mechanisms, using both qualitative and
quantitative methods. Our findings show good overall usability according to the
System Usability Scale for both categories of mechanisms, with average SUS
scores in the range of 78.6-79.6 and the best mechanisms rated with an
"excellent" score. Participants particularly identified brainwave
authentication as more secure yet more privacy-invasive and effort-intensive
compared to eye movement authentication. However, the significant number of
neutral responses indicates participants' need for more detailed information
about the security and privacy implications of these authentication methods.
Building on the collected evidence, we identify three key areas for
improvement: privacy, authentication interface design, and verification time.
We offer recommendations for designers and developers to improve the usability
and security of next-generation authentication mechanisms.
translated: 尽管密码的安全性和可用性有着众所周知的局限性，但它仍然是一种广泛使用的身份验证机制。为了改善这种情况，基于眼球运动和脑电波等行为生物特征的下一代认证机制已经出现。然而，它们的可用性仍然相对缺乏探索。为了填补这一空白，我们进行了一项实证用户研究(n = 32名参与者) ，使用定性和定量方法评估三种基于大脑和三种基于眼睛的认证机制。我们的研究结果显示，根据系统可用性量表，两类机制的整体可用性都很好，平均 SUS 分数在78.6-79.6之间，最好的机制评分为“优秀”。与眼动认证相比，参与者特别认为脑电波认证更安全、更侵犯隐私、更耗费精力。然而，大量的中性响应表明，参与者需要更多关于这些身份验证方法的安全性和隐私影响的详细信息。在收集到的证据的基础上，我们确定了三个需要改进的关键领域: 隐私、身份验证接口设计和验证时间。我们为设计人员和开发人员提供改进下一代身份验证机制的可用性和安全性的建议。

title:
A Blockchain-Enabled Framework of UAV Coordination for Post-Disaster
  Networks
summary:
Emergency communication is critical but challenging after natural disasters
when ground infrastructure is devastated. Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) offer
enormous potential for agile relief coordination in these scenarios. However,
effectively leveraging UAV fleets poses additional challenges around security,
privacy, and efficient collaboration across response agencies. This paper
presents a robust blockchain-enabled framework to address these challenges by
integrating a consortium blockchain model, smart contracts, and cryptographic
techniques to securely coordinate UAV fleets for disaster response.
Specifically, we make two key contributions: a consortium blockchain
architecture for secure and private multi-agency coordination; and an optimized
consensus protocol balancing efficiency and fault tolerance using a delegated
proof of stake practical byzantine fault tolerance (DPoS-PBFT). Comprehensive
simulations showcase the framework's ability to enhance transparency,
automation, scalability, and cyber-attack resilience for UAV coordination in
post-disaster networks.
translated: 应急通信至关重要，但在地面基础设施遭到破坏的自然灾害之后，这种通信具有挑战性。无人驾驶飞行器(UAV)为这些情况下的敏捷救援协调提供了巨大的潜力。然而，有效地利用无人机机队在安全、隐私和跨响应机构的高效协作方面提出了额外的挑战。本文提出了一个健壮的区块链功能框架，以解决这些挑战，通过集成一个联盟的区块链模型，智能合同和密码技术，以安全协调无人机舰队的灾害响应。具体来说，我们做出了两个关键贡献: 一个是用于安全和私有多机构协调的联盟区块链架构; 另一个是使用权限实用拜占庭将军问题(dpoS-PBFT)的委托证明来平衡效率和容错性的优化共识协议。综合模拟展示了该框架增强灾后网络中无人机协调的透明度、自动化、可扩展性和网络攻击韧性的能力。

title:
How (un)ethical are instruction-centric responses of LLMs? Unveiling the
  vulnerabilities of safety guardrails to harmful queries
summary:
In this study, we tackle a growing concern around the safety and ethical use
of large language models (LLMs). Despite their potential, these models can be
tricked into producing harmful or unethical content through various
sophisticated methods, including 'jailbreaking' techniques and targeted
manipulation. Our work zeroes in on a specific issue: to what extent LLMs can
be led astray by asking them to generate responses that are instruction-centric
such as a pseudocode, a program or a software snippet as opposed to vanilla
text. To investigate this question, we introduce TechHazardQA, a dataset
containing complex queries which should be answered in both text and
instruction-centric formats (e.g., pseudocodes), aimed at identifying triggers
for unethical responses. We query a series of LLMs -- Llama-2-13b, Llama-2-7b,
Mistral-V2 and Mistral 8X7B -- and ask them to generate both text and
instruction-centric responses. For evaluation we report the harmfulness score
metric as well as judgements from GPT-4 and humans. Overall, we observe that
asking LLMs to produce instruction-centric responses enhances the unethical
response generation by ~2-38% across the models. As an additional objective, we
investigate the impact of model editing using the ROME technique, which further
increases the propensity for generating undesirable content. In particular,
asking edited LLMs to generate instruction-centric responses further increases
the unethical response generation by ~3-16% across the different models.
translated: 在这项研究中，我们解决了越来越多的关注安全和伦理使用大型语言模型(LLM)。尽管这些模型具有潜力，但它们可能被骗，通过各种复杂的方法，包括“越狱”技术和有针对性的操纵，制造出有害或不道德的内容。我们的工作集中在一个特定的问题上: 在多大程度上 LLM 可以通过要求它们生成以指令为中心的响应(如伪代码、程序或软件片段，而不是普通的文本)而误入歧途。为了研究这个问题，我们引入了 TechHazardQA，一个包含复杂查询的数据集，应该以文本和以指令为中心的格式(例如，伪代码)进行回答，旨在识别不道德反应的触发因素。我们查询一系列 LLM —— Llama-2-13b、 Llama-2-7b、 Mistral-V2和 Mistral 8X7B ——并要求它们同时生成以文本和指令为中心的响应。为了评估，我们报告了危害性评分指标以及来自 GPT-4和人类的判断。总的来说，我们观察到，要求 LLM 产生以教学为中心的反应，在整个模型中增强了约2-38% 的不道德反应的产生。作为一个额外的目标，我们调查使用 ROME 技术的模型编辑的影响，这进一步增加了生成不需要的内容的倾向。特别是，要求编辑后的 LLM 产生以教学为中心的反应，在不同的模型中进一步增加了约3-16% 的不道德反应的产生。

title:
SoK: What don't we know? Understanding Security Vulnerabilities in
  SNARKs
summary:
Zero-knowledge proofs (ZKPs) have evolved from being a theoretical concept
providing privacy and verifiability to having practical, real-world
implementations, with SNARKs (Succinct Non-Interactive Argument of Knowledge)
emerging as one of the most significant innovations. Prior work has mainly
focused on designing more efficient SNARK systems and providing security proofs
for them. Many think of SNARKs as "just math," implying that what is proven to
be correct and secure is correct in practice. In contrast, this paper focuses
on assessing end-to-end security properties of real-life SNARK implementations.
We start by building foundations with a system model and by establishing threat
models and defining adversarial roles for systems that use SNARKs. Our study
encompasses an extensive analysis of 141 actual vulnerabilities in SNARK
implementations, providing a detailed taxonomy to aid developers and security
researchers in understanding the security threats in systems employing SNARKs.
Finally, we evaluate existing defense mechanisms and offer recommendations for
enhancing the security of SNARK-based systems, paving the way for more robust
and reliable implementations in the future.
translated: 零知识证明(ZKP)已经从一个提供隐私和可验证性的理论概念演变为具有实际的、现实世界的实现，SNARKs (简洁的非交互式知识论证)成为最重要的创新之一。先前的工作主要集中在设计更有效的 SNARK 系统，并为它们提供安全证明。许多人认为 SNARKs“只是数学问题”，意味着在实践中被证明是正确和安全的东西是正确的。相比之下，本文侧重于评估实际 SNARK 实现的端到端安全性能。我们首先通过系统模型建立基础，然后建立威胁模型，并为使用 SNARK 的系统定义对手角色。我们的研究包括对 SNARK 实现中的141个实际漏洞的广泛分析，提供了详细的分类，以帮助开发人员和安全研究人员理解使用 SNARK 的系统中的安全威胁。最后，我们对现有的防御机制进行了评估，并为提高基于 SNARK 的系统的安全性提出了建议，为未来更加健壮和可靠的实现铺平了道路。

title: Trustworthy confidential virtual machines for the masses
summary:
Confidential computing alleviates the concerns of distrustful customers by
removing the cloud provider from their trusted computing base and resolves
their disincentive to migrate their workloads to the cloud. This is facilitated
by new hardware extensions, like AMD's SEV Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP),
which can run a whole virtual machine with confidentiality and integrity
protection against a potentially malicious hypervisor owned by an untrusted
cloud provider. However, the assurance of such protection to either the service
providers deploying sensitive workloads or the end-users passing sensitive data
to services requires sending proof to the interested parties. Service providers
can retrieve such proof by performing remote attestation while end-users have
typically no means to acquire this proof or validate its correctness and
therefore have to rely on the trustworthiness of the service providers. In this
paper, we present Revelio, an approach that features two main contributions: i)
it allows confidential virtual machine (VM)-based workloads to be designed and
deployed in a way that disallows any tampering even by the service providers
and ii) it empowers users to easily validate their integrity. In particular, we
focus on web-facing workloads, protect them leveraging SEV-SNP, and enable
end-users to remotely attest them seamlessly each time a new web session is
established. To highlight the benefits of Revelio, we discuss how a standalone
stateful VM that hosts an open-source collaboration office suite can be secured
and present a replicated protocol proxy that enables commodity users to
securely access the Internet Computer, a decentralized blockchain
infrastructure.
translated: 保密计算通过将云提供商从其可信计算基础上移除，缓解了不信任客户的顾虑，并解决了他们不愿将工作负载迁移到云的问题。这得益于新的硬件扩展，比如 AMD 的 SEV 安全嵌套分页(SEV-SNP) ，它可以运行一个完整的虚拟机，对不可信的云提供商拥有的潜在恶意虚拟机监控程序提供机密性和完整性保护。然而，要保证对部署敏感工作负载的服务提供者或向服务传递敏感数据的最终用户提供这种保护，就需要向有关各方发送证明。服务提供者可以通过执行远程认证来检索此类证明，而最终用户通常无法获得此类证明或验证其正确性，因此必须依赖于服务提供者的可信度。在本文中，我们展示了一种方法，它有两个主要的贡献: i)它允许机密的基于虚拟机(VM)的工作负载被设计和部署，不允许任何篡改，甚至由服务提供商和 ii)它使用户能够轻松地验证他们的完整性。特别是，我们关注面向 Web 的工作负载，利用 SEV-SNP 保护它们，并使最终用户能够在每次建立新的 Web 会话时无缝地远程测试它们。为了突出 Revelio 的好处，我们讨论了如何保护一个独立的有状态虚拟机，该虚拟机拥有一个开源协作办公套件，并提供一个复制的协议代理，使商品用户能够安全地访问互联网计算机，一个分散的区块链基础设施。

title:
Adversarial Robustness of Deep Learning-based Malware Detectors via
  (De)Randomized Smoothing
summary:
Deep learning-based malware detectors have been shown to be susceptible to
adversarial malware examples, i.e. malware examples that have been deliberately
manipulated in order to avoid detection. In light of the vulnerability of deep
learning detectors to subtle input file modifications, we propose a practical
defense against adversarial malware examples inspired by (de)randomized
smoothing. In this work, we reduce the chances of sampling adversarial content
injected by malware authors by selecting correlated subsets of bytes, rather
than using Gaussian noise to randomize inputs like in the Computer Vision (CV)
domain. During training, our ablation-based smoothing scheme trains a base
classifier to make classifications on a subset of contiguous bytes or chunk of
bytes. At test time, a large number of chunks are then classified by a base
classifier and the consensus among these classifications is then reported as
the final prediction. We propose two strategies to determine the location of
the chunks used for classification: (1) randomly selecting the locations of the
chunks and (2) selecting contiguous adjacent chunks. To showcase the
effectiveness of our approach, we have trained two classifiers with our
chunk-based ablation schemes on the BODMAS dataset. Our findings reveal that
the chunk-based smoothing classifiers exhibit greater resilience against
adversarial malware examples generated with state-of-the-are evasion attacks,
outperforming a non-smoothed classifier and a randomized smoothing-based
classifier by a great margin.
translated: 基于深度学习的恶意软件探测器已被证明易受敌对恶意软件例子的影响，即为了避免被发现而故意操纵的恶意软件例子。鉴于深度学习检测器对微妙的输入文件修改的脆弱性，我们提出了一个实用的防御对手恶意软件的例子启发(去)随机平滑。在这项工作中，我们通过选择相关的字节子集来减少恶意软件作者注入的敌对内容的抽样机会，而不是像计算机视觉(CV)领域那样使用高斯噪声来随机化输入。在训练过程中，我们的基于消融的平滑方案训练一个基本分类器来对连续字节或字节块的子集进行分类。在测试时，大量的块被基本分类器分类，这些分类之间的一致性被报告为最终的预测。我们提出了两种策略来确定用于分类的块的位置: (1)随机选择块的位置和(2)选择相邻的块。为了展示我们的方法的有效性，我们在 BODMAS 数据集上用基于块的消融方案训练了两个分类器。我们的研究结果表明，基于块的平滑分类器表现出更大的弹性，对抗由国家的规避攻击产生的敌对恶意软件例子，表现优于非平滑分类器和随机平滑基于分类器的很大一部分。

title: On the composable security of weak coin flipping
summary:
Weak coin flipping is a cryptographic primitive in which two mutually
distrustful parties generate a shared random bit to agree on a winner via
remote communication. While a stand-alone secure weak coin flipping protocol
can be constructed from noiseless communication channels, its composability has
not been explored. In this work, we demonstrate that no weak coin flipping
protocol can be abstracted into a black box resource with composable security.
Despite this, we also establish the overall stand-alone security of weak coin
flipping protocols under sequential composition.
translated: 弱抛硬币是一种加密原语，其中两个互不信任的双方通过远程通信生成一个共享的随机位来确定赢家。虽然可以从无噪声通信信道构造独立的安全弱抛硬币协议，但其可组合性尚未得到研究。在这项工作中，我们证明了没有弱硬币翻转协议可以抽象成一个具有可组合安全性的黑盒资源。尽管如此，我们还建立了序列组合下的弱抛硬币协议的整体独立安全性。

title:
BSPA: Exploring Black-box Stealthy Prompt Attacks against Image
  Generators
summary:
Extremely large image generators offer significant transformative potential
across diverse sectors. It allows users to design specific prompts to generate
realistic images through some black-box APIs. However, some studies reveal that
image generators are notably susceptible to attacks and generate Not Suitable
For Work (NSFW) contents by manually designed toxin texts, especially
imperceptible to human observers. We urgently need a multitude of universal and
transferable prompts to improve the safety of image generators, especially
black-box-released APIs. Nevertheless, they are constrained by labor-intensive
design processes and heavily reliant on the quality of the given instructions.
To achieve this, we introduce a black-box stealthy prompt attack (BSPA) that
adopts a retriever to simulate attacks from API users. It can effectively
harness filter scores to tune the retrieval space of sensitive words for
matching the input prompts, thereby crafting stealthy prompts tailored for
image generators. Significantly, this approach is model-agnostic and requires
no internal access to the model's features, ensuring its applicability to a
wide range of image generators. Building on BSPA, we have constructed an
automated prompt tool and a comprehensive prompt attack dataset (NSFWeval).
Extensive experiments demonstrate that BSPA effectively explores the security
vulnerabilities in a variety of state-of-the-art available black-box models,
including Stable Diffusion XL, Midjourney, and DALL-E 2/3. Furthermore, we
develop a resilient text filter and offer targeted recommendations to ensure
the security of image generators against prompt attacks in the future.
translated: 超大型图像生成器在不同领域提供了巨大的变革潜力。它允许用户设计特定的提示，通过一些黑盒 API 生成逼真的图像。然而，一些研究表明，图像生成器特别容易受到攻击，并通过手工设计的毒素文本生成不适合工作的内容，尤其是人类观察者无法察觉的内容。我们迫切需要大量通用和可转移的提示，以提高图像生成器的安全性，特别是黑盒发布的 API。然而，它们受到劳动密集型设计过程的限制，并严重依赖于给定指令的质量。为了实现这一点，我们引入了一种黑盒隐形提示攻击(BSPA) ，它采用了一个检索器来模拟来自 API 用户的攻击。它可以有效地利用过滤分数来调整敏感词的检索空间，以匹配输入提示，从而为图像生成器量身定制隐形提示。值得注意的是，这种方法是模型无关的，不需要内部访问模型的特性，确保其适用于广泛的图像生成器。在 BSPA 的基础上，我们构建了一个自动提示工具和一个全面的提示攻击数据集(NSFWeval)。大量的实验表明，BSPA 有效地探索了各种最先进的可用黑匣子模型的安全漏洞，包括稳定扩散 XL、 Midjourney 和 DALL-E 2/3。此外，我们开发了一个弹性文本过滤器，并提供有针对性的建议，以确保图像生成器的安全，以防止在未来的迅速攻击。

title: SAND: Decoupling Sanitization from Fuzzing for Low Overhead
summary:
Sanitizers provide robust test oracles for various software vulnerabilities.
Fuzzing on sanitizer-enabled programs has been the best practice to find
software bugs. Since sanitizers need to heavily instrument a target program to
insert run-time checks, sanitizer-enabled programs have much higher overhead
compared to normally built programs. In this paper, we present SAND, a new
fuzzing framework that decouples sanitization from the fuzzing loop. SAND
performs fuzzing on a normally built program and only invokes sanitizer-enabled
programs when input is shown to be interesting. Since most of the generated
inputs are not interesting, i.e., not bug-triggering, SAND allows most of the
fuzzing time to be spent on the normally built program. To identify interesting
inputs, we introduce execution pattern for a practical execution analysis on
the normally built program. We realize SAND on top of AFL++ and evaluate it on
12 real-world programs. Our extensive evaluation highlights its effectiveness:
on a period of 24 hours, compared to fuzzing on ASan/UBSan-enabled and
MSan-enabled programs, SAND respectively achieves 2.6x and 15x throughput and
detects 51% and 242% more bugs.
translated: 消毒器为各种软件漏洞提供了强大的测试预言。对启用消毒程序进行模糊处理是发现软件错误的最佳实践。由于消毒程序需要大量地插入目标程序来插入运行时检查，因此与正常构建的程序相比，启用消毒程序的程序具有更高的开销。在本文中，我们提出了一个新的模糊框架 SAND，它将消毒从模糊循环中解耦出来。SAND 对正常构建的程序执行 fuzzing，并且只有当输入显示为有趣时才调用启用了消毒程序的程序。由于大多数生成的输入不感兴趣，即不触发 bug，因此 SAND 允许大多数模糊时间花在正常构建的程序上。为了识别感兴趣的输入，我们引入执行模式，对通常构建的程序进行实际的执行分析。我们在 AFL + + 之上实现了 SAND，并在12个现实世界的程序上对其进行了评估。我们的广泛评估突出了它的有效性: 在24小时内，与 ASan/UBSan 和 MSan 支持的程序的模糊处理相比，SAND 分别达到2.6倍和15倍的吞吐量，并检测到51% 和242% 的更多错误。

title:
Improving behavior based authentication against adversarial attack using
  XAI
summary:
In recent years, machine learning models, especially deep neural networks,
have been widely used for classification tasks in the security domain. However,
these models have been shown to be vulnerable to adversarial manipulation:
small changes learned by an adversarial attack model, when applied to the
input, can cause significant changes in the output. Most research on
adversarial attacks and corresponding defense methods focuses only on scenarios
where adversarial samples are directly generated by the attack model. In this
study, we explore a more practical scenario in behavior-based authentication,
where adversarial samples are collected from the attacker. The generated
adversarial samples from the model are replicated by attackers with a certain
level of discrepancy. We propose an eXplainable AI (XAI) based defense strategy
against adversarial attacks in such scenarios. A feature selector, trained with
our method, can be used as a filter in front of the original authenticator. It
filters out features that are more vulnerable to adversarial attacks or
irrelevant to authentication, while retaining features that are more robust.
Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate that our XAI based defense
strategy is effective against adversarial attacks and outperforms other defense
strategies, such as adversarial training and defensive distillation.
translated: 近年来，机器学习模型，尤其是深层神经网络，已经广泛应用于安全领域的分类任务。然而，这些模型已被证明容易受到对抗性操纵: 对抗性攻击模型所学到的微小变化，当应用于输入时，可能会导致输出的重大变化。大多数关于对抗性攻击和相应防御方法的研究只集中在攻击模型直接生成对抗性样本的场景中。在这项研究中，我们探索了一个更加实际的基于行为的身份验证场景，即从攻击者那里收集对手样本。由模型生成的对抗样本被攻击者复制，但存在一定程度的差异。在这种情况下，我们提出了一种基于可解释 AI (XAI)的对抗敌对攻击的防御策略。用我们的方法训练的特征选择器可以用作原始认证器前的过滤器。它过滤掉那些更容易受到对手攻击或与身份验证无关的特性，同时保留那些更健壮的特性。通过综合实验，我们证明了我们的基于 XAI 的防御策略是有效的对抗敌对攻击，并优于其他防御策略，如对抗性训练和防御精馏。

title:
Analysis of Embeddings Learned by End-to-End Machine Learning Eye
  Movement-driven Biometrics Pipeline
summary:
This paper expands on the foundational concept of temporal persistence in
biometric systems, specifically focusing on the domain of eye movement
biometrics facilitated by machine learning. Unlike previous studies that
primarily focused on developing biometric authentication systems, our research
delves into the embeddings learned by these systems, particularly examining
their temporal persistence, reliability, and biometric efficacy in response to
varying input data. Utilizing two publicly available eye-movement datasets, we
employed the state-of-the-art Eye Know You Too machine learning pipeline for
our analysis. We aim to validate whether the machine learning-derived
embeddings in eye movement biometrics mirror the temporal persistence observed
in traditional biometrics. Our methodology involved conducting extensive
experiments to assess how different lengths and qualities of input data
influence the performance of eye movement biometrics more specifically how it
impacts the learned embeddings. We also explored the reliability and
consistency of the embeddings under varying data conditions. Three key metrics
(kendall's coefficient of concordance, intercorrelations, and equal error rate)
were employed to quantitatively evaluate our findings. The results reveal while
data length significantly impacts the stability of the learned embeddings,
however, the intercorrelations among embeddings show minimal effect.
translated: 本文阐述了生物识别系统中时间持久性的基本概念，特别是机器学习促进的眼动生物识别领域。与之前主要关注于开发生物计量学系统的研究不同，我们的研究深入探讨了这些系统所学到的嵌入，特别是检查它们对不同输入数据的时间持久性、可靠性和生物识别功效。利用两个公开可用的眼动数据集，我们采用了最先进的眼睛知道你也机器学习管道进行分析。我们的目的是验证机器学习衍生的嵌入在眼动生物识别中是否反映了在传统生物识别中观察到的时间持久性。我们的方法包括进行广泛的实验，以评估不同长度和质量的输入数据如何影响眼动生物特征的表现，更具体地说，它如何影响学习嵌入。我们还探讨了在不同的数据条件下嵌入的可靠性和一致性。三个关键指标(肯德尔的一致性系数，相互关系和等误差率)被用来定量评估我们的发现。结果表明，虽然数据长度显著影响学习嵌入的稳定性，但嵌入之间的相关性影响很小。

title:
Investigating Deep Watermark Security: An Adversarial Transferability
  Perspective
summary:
The rise of generative neural networks has triggered an increased demand for
intellectual property (IP) protection in generated content. Deep watermarking
techniques, recognized for their flexibility in IP protection, have garnered
significant attention. However, the surge in adversarial transferable attacks
poses unprecedented challenges to the security of deep watermarking
techniques-an area currently lacking systematic investigation. This study fills
this gap by introducing two effective transferable attackers to assess the
vulnerability of deep watermarks against erasure and tampering risks.
Specifically, we initially define the concept of local sample density,
utilizing it to deduce theorems on the consistency of model outputs. Upon
discovering that perturbing samples towards high sample density regions (HSDR)
of the target class enhances targeted adversarial transferability, we propose
the Easy Sample Selection (ESS) mechanism and the Easy Sample Matching Attack
(ESMA) method. Additionally, we propose the Bottleneck Enhanced Mixup (BEM)
that integrates information bottleneck theory to reduce the generator's
dependence on irrelevant noise. Experiments show a significant enhancement in
the success rate of targeted transfer attacks for both ESMA and BEM-ESMA
methods. We further conduct a comprehensive evaluation using ESMA and BEM-ESMA
as measurements, considering model architecture and watermark encoding length,
and achieve some impressive findings.
translated: 生成神经网络的兴起引发了对生成内容中知识产权(IP)保护的需求增加。深度水印技术因其在知识产权保护方面的灵活性而受到重视。然而，对抗性可转移攻击的激增对深度水印技术的安全性提出了前所未有的挑战，而深度水印技术目前缺乏系统的研究。该研究通过引入两个有效的可转移攻击来评估深水印对于删除和篡改风险的脆弱性，从而填补了这一空白。具体来说，我们首先定义了局部样本密度的概念，利用它来推导关于模型输出一致性的定理。在发现将样本扰动到目标类的高样本密度区(HSDR)增强了目标对手的可转移性后，我们提出了简单样本选择(ESS)机制和简单样本匹配攻击(ESMA)方法。此外，我们提出了瓶颈增强混合(BEM) ，结合信息瓶颈理论，以减少发电机对无关噪声的依赖。实验结果表明，ESMA 和 BEM-ESMA 方法在目标转移攻击的成功率方面都有显著的提高。我们进一步以 ESMA 和 BEM-ESMA 作为度量标准，综合考虑模型结构和水印编码长度，进行了全面的评估，并取得了一些令人印象深刻的结果。

title: Communication Optimal Unbalanced Private Set Union
summary:
We consider the private set union (PSU) problem, where two parties each hold
a private set of elements, and they want one of the parties (the receiver) to
learn the union of the two sets and nothing else. Our protocols are targeted
for the unbalanced case where the receiver's set size is larger than the
sender's set size, with the goal of minimizing the costs for the sender both in
terms of communication volume and local computation time. This setting is
motivated by applications where the receiver has significantly more data (input
set size) and computational resources than the sender which might be realized
on a small, low-power device. Asymptotically, we achieve communication cost
linear in the sender's (smaller) set size, and computation costs for sender and
receiver which are nearly-linear in their respective set sizes. To our
knowledge, ours is the first algorithm to achieve nearly-linear communication
and computation for PSU in this unbalanced setting. Our protocols utilize fully
homomorphic encryption (FHE) and, optionally, linearly homomorphic encryption
(LHE) to perform the necessary computations while preserving privacy. The
underlying computations are based on univariate polynomial arithmetic realized
within homomorphic encryption, namely fast multiplication, modular reduction,
and multi-point evaluation. These asymptotically fast HE polynomial arithmetic
algorithms may be of independent interest.
translated: 我们考虑私有集合并集(PSU)问题，其中双方各持有一个私有元素集，并且他们希望其中一方(接收方)学习两个集合的并集，而不是其他任何东西。我们的协议针对的是接收方的集合大于发送方的集合大小的不平衡情况，目标是使发送方在通信量和本地计算时间方面的成本最小化。这种设置的动机是应用程序，其中接收器有显着更多的数据(输入集大小)和计算资源比发送器可能实现在一个小型，低功耗设备。在渐近性上，我们得到了发送方(较小)集合大小的通信成本线性化，以及发送方和接收方各自集合大小的近似线性化的计算成本。据我们所知，我们的算法是第一个实现近线性通信和计算的 PSU 在这种不平衡的设置。我们的协议利用完全同态加密(FHE)和可选的线性同态加密(LHE)来执行必要的计算，同时保护隐私。基本的计算是基于在同态加密内实现的单变量多项式算法，即快速乘法、模数约简和多点计算。这些渐近快速的 HE 多项式算法可能是独立的兴趣。

title: Decentralized Federated Unlearning on Blockchain
summary:
Blockchained Federated Learning (FL) has been gaining traction for ensuring
the integrity and traceability of FL processes. Blockchained FL involves
participants training models locally with their data and subsequently
publishing the models on the blockchain, forming a Directed Acyclic Graph
(DAG)-like inheritance structure that represents the model relationship.
However, this particular DAG-based structure presents challenges in updating
models with sensitive data, due to the complexity and overhead involved. To
address this, we propose Blockchained Federated Unlearning (BlockFUL), a
generic framework that redesigns the blockchain structure using Chameleon Hash
(CH) technology to mitigate the complexity of model updating, thereby reducing
the computational and consensus costs of unlearning tasks.Furthermore, BlockFUL
supports various federated unlearning methods, ensuring the integrity and
traceability of model updates, whether conducted in parallel or serial. We
conduct a comprehensive study of two typical unlearning methods, gradient
ascent and re-training, demonstrating the efficient unlearning workflow in
these two categories with minimal CH and block update operations. Additionally,
we compare the computation and communication costs of these methods.
translated: 区块链联邦学习(Blockchain Federated Learning，FL)在确保 FL 过程的完整性和可追溯性方面获得了越来越多的关注。区块链 FL 包括参与者用他们的数据在本地训练模型，然后在区块链上发布模型，形成一个类似有向无环图(DAG)的继承结构，代表模型关系。然而，这种特殊的基于 DAG 的结构由于所涉及的复杂性和开销，在用敏感数据更新模型方面提出了挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了区块链联邦学习(BlockFUL) ，这是一个使用 Chameleon Hash (CH)技术重新设计区块链结构的通用框架，以减轻模型更新的复杂性，从而降低忘记任务的计算和共识成本。此外，BlockFUL 支持各种联邦忘记学习方法，确保模型更新的完整性和可跟踪性，无论是并行还是串行进行。我们对梯度上升和再训练这两种典型的去学习方法进行了全面的研究，证明了这两种方法在最小 CH 和块更新操作的情况下都能有效地去学习工作流。此外，我们还比较了这些方法的计算和通信成本。

title: Card-Based Overwriting Protocol for Equality Function and Applications
summary:
Research in the area of secure multi-party computation with an unconventional
method of using a physical deck of playing cards began in 1989 when den Boar
proposed a protocol to compute the logical AND function using five cards. Since
then, the area has gained interest from many researchers and several card-based
protocols to compute various functions have been developed. In this paper, we
propose a card-based protocol called the overwriting protocol that can securely
compute the $k$-candidate $n$-variable equality function $f: \{0,1,\ldots
