,k-1\}^n \rightarrow \{0,1\}$. We also apply the technique used in this
protocol to compute other similar functions.
translated: 安全多方计算领域的研究开始于1989年，当时登博尔提出了一个协议，用五张卡片来计算逻辑 AND 函数。从那时起，这一领域就引起了许多研究人员的兴趣，并开发了几种基于卡片的计算各种函数的协议。本文提出了一种基于卡片的覆盖协议，该协议可以安全地计算 $k $- 候选 $n $- 变量等式函数 $f: {0,1，ldot，k-1} ^ n 右箭头{0,1} $。我们还应用该协议中使用的技术来计算其他类似的函数。

title:
Honeybee: Decentralized Peer Sampling with Verifiable Random Walks for
  Blockchain Data Sharding
summary:
Data sharding - in which block data is sharded without sharding compute - is
at the present the favored approach for scaling Ethereum. A key challenge
toward implementing data sharding is verifying whether the entirety of a
block's data is available in the network (across its shards). A central
technique proposed to conduct this verification uses erasure coded blocks and
is called data availability sampling (DAS). While the high-level protocol
details of DAS has been well discussed in the community, discussions around how
such a protocol will be implemented at the peer-to-peer layer are lacking. We
identify random sampling of nodes as a fundamental primitive necessary to carry
out DAS and present Honeybee, a decentralized algorithm for sampling node that
uses verifiable random walks. Honeybee is secure against attacks even in the
presence of a large number of Byzantine nodes (e.g., 50% of the network). We
evaluate Honeybee through experiments and show that the quality of sampling
achieved by Honeybee is significantly better compared to the state-of-the-art.
Our proposed algorithm has implications for DAS functions in both full nodes
and light nodes.
translated: 数据分片-其中块数据分片没有分片计算-是目前最受欢迎的方法，以太扩展。实现数据分片的一个关键挑战是验证整个块的数据是否在网络中(通过它的分片)可用。提出的进行此验证的核心技术使用擦除编码块，称为数据可用性采样(DAS)。虽然 DAS 的高级协议细节在社区中得到了很好的讨论，但是关于如何在对等层实现这样一个协议的讨论仍然缺乏。将节点的随机采样作为 DAS 的基本原语，提出了一种基于可验证随机游动的分散式采样节点算法蜜蜂。即使存在大量拜占庭式节点(例如，网络的50%) ，蜜蜂也能抵御攻击。我们通过实验对蜜蜂进行了评估，结果表明，蜜蜂取得的采样质量明显优于最先进的采样质量。我们提出的算法对于全节点和光节点的 DAS 功能都有一定的启发作用。

title: Attacking LLM Watermarks by Exploiting Their Strengths
summary:
Advances in generative models have made it possible for AI-generated text,
code, and images to mirror human-generated content in many applications.
Watermarking, a technique that aims to embed information in the output of a
model to verify its source, is useful for mitigating misuse of such
AI-generated content. However, existing watermarking schemes remain
surprisingly susceptible to attack. In particular, we show that desirable
properties shared by existing LLM watermarking systems such as quality
preservation, robustness, and public detection APIs can in turn make these
systems vulnerable to various attacks. We rigorously study potential attacks in
terms of common watermark design choices, and propose best practices and
defenses for mitigation -- establishing a set of practical guidelines for
embedding and detection of LLM watermarks.
translated: 生成模型的进步使得人工智能生成的文本、代码和图像能够在许多应用程序中反映人类生成的内容。水印是一种将信息嵌入到模型输出中以验证其来源的技术，对于减少人工智能生成内容的滥用非常有用。然而，现有的水印方案仍然令人惊讶地容易受到攻击。特别地，我们展示了现有 LLM 水印系统所共享的理想特性，例如质量保持、鲁棒性和公共检测 API，反过来可以使这些系统容易受到各种攻击。我们从公共水印设计选择的角度严格研究潜在的攻击，并提出最佳实践和防御措施来缓解攻击——建立一套实用的 LLM 水印嵌入和检测指南。

title:
chainBoost: A Secure Performance Booster for Blockchain-based Resource
  Markets
summary:
Cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology provide an innovative model for
reshaping digital services. Driven by the movement toward Web 3.0, recent
systems started to provide distributed services, such as computation
outsourcing or file storage, on top of the currency exchange medium. By
allowing anyone to join and collect cryptocurrency payments for serving others,
these systems create decentralized markets for trading digital resources. Yet,
there is still a big gap between the promise of these markets and their
practical viability. Existing initiatives are still early-stage and have
already encountered security and efficiency obstacles. At the same time,
existing work around promising ideas, specifically sidechains, fall short in
exploiting their full potential in addressing these problems.
  To bridge this gap, we propose chainBoost, a secure performance booster for
decentralized resource markets. It expedites service related operations,
reduces the blockchain size, and supports flexible service-payment exchange
modalities at low overhead. At its core, chainBoost employs a sidechain, that
has a (security and semantic) mutual-dependence with the mainchain, to which
the system offloads heavy/frequent operations. To enable it, we develop a novel
sidechain architecture composed of temporary and permanent blocks, a block
suppression mechanism to prune the sidechain, a syncing protocol to permit
arbitrary data exchange between the two chains, and an autorecovery protocol to
support robustness and resilience. We analyze the security of chainBoost, and
implement a proof-of-concept prototype for a distributed file storage market as
a use case. For a market handling around 2000 transactions per round, our
experiments show up to 11x improvement in throughput and 94\% reduction in
confirmation time. They also show that chainBoost can reduce the main
blockchain size by around 90%.
translated: 加密货币和区块链技术为重塑数字服务提供了一种创新模式。在 Web 3.0的推动下，最近的系统开始在货币交换媒介之上提供分布式服务，比如计算外包或文件存储。通过允许任何人加入并收集为他人服务的加密货币支付，这些系统创建了分散的数字资源交易市场。然而，这些市场的前景与其实际可行性之间仍存在巨大差距。现有举措仍处于早期阶段，已经遇到安全和效率方面的障碍。与此同时，围绕有希望的想法，特别是侧链的现有工作，在充分发挥其潜力解决这些问题方面存在不足。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了 chainBoost，一个分散资源市场的安全性能助推器。它加快了服务相关的业务，减少区块链的大小，并支持灵活的服务支付交换模式在低开销。在其核心，chainBoost 使用了一个侧链，它与主链具有(安全性和语义)相互依赖性，系统可以将繁重/频繁的操作卸载到这个侧链上。为了实现这一点，我们开发了一种由临时和永久块组成的新型侧链体系结构，用于修剪侧链的块抑制机制，允许两个链之间任意数据交换的同步协议，以及支持健壮性和弹性的自动恢复协议。我们分析了 chainBoost 的安全性，并以一个分布式文件存储市场为例，实现了一个概念验证原型。对于每轮处理约2000个交易的市场，我们的实验显示吞吐量提高了11倍，确认时间减少了94% 。他们还表明，chainBoost 可以减少约90% 的主要区块链大小。

title: Exploring the Market Dynamics of Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs)
summary:
Staking has emerged as a crucial concept following Ethereum's transition to
Proof-of-Stake consensus. The introduction of Liquid Staking Derivatives (LSDs)
has effectively addressed the illiquidity issue associated with solo staking,
gaining significant market attention. This paper analyzes the LSD market
dynamics from the perspectives of both liquidity takers (LTs) and liquidity
providers (LPs). We first quantify the price discrepancy between the LSD
primary and secondary markets. Then we investigate and empirically measure how
LTs can leverage such discrepancy to exploit arbitrage opportunities, unveiling
the potential barriers to LSD arbitrages. In addition, we evaluate the
financial profit and losses experienced by LPs who supply LSDs for liquidity
provision. Our findings reveal that 66% LSD liquidity provision positions yield
an Annual Percentage Rate (APR) lower than simply holding the corresponding
LSDs.
translated: 股权已经出现作为一个关键的概念以太坊的过渡到股权证明的共识。液体投资衍生产品(LSD)的推出有效地解决了与单独投资相关的流动性不足问题，引起了市场的广泛关注。本文从流动性接受者(LTs)和流动性提供者(LPs)两个角度分析了 LSD 市场的动态变化。我们首先量化 LSD 一级市场和二级市场之间的价格差异。然后，我们调查和实证测量如何利用这种差异利用套利机会，揭示潜在的障碍 LSD 套利。此外，我们还评估了为提供流动性而提供 LSD 的有限合伙人所经历的财务损益。我们的研究结果显示，66% 的 LSD 流动性提供头寸产生的年度百分比率(APR)低于仅仅持有相应的 LSD。

title:
On Central Primitives for Quantum Cryptography with Classical
  Communication
summary:
Recent work has introduced the "Quantum-Computation Classical-Communication"
(QCCC) (Chung et. al.) setting for cryptography. There has been some evidence
that One Way Puzzles (OWPuzz) are the natural central cryptographic primitive
for this setting (Khurana and Tomer). For a primitive to be considered central
it should have several characteristics. It should be well behaved (which for
this paper we will think of as having amplification, combiners, and universal
constructions); it should be implied by a wide variety of other primitives; and
it should be equivalent to some class of useful primitives. We present
combiners, correctness and security amplification, and a universal construction
for OWPuzz. Our proof of security amplification uses a new and cleaner version
construction of EFI from OWPuzz (in comparison to the result of Khurana and
Tomer) that generalizes to weak OWPuzz and is the most technically involved
section of the paper. It was previously known that OWPuzz are implied by other
primitives of interest including commitments, symmetric key encryption, one way
state generators (OWSG), and therefore pseudorandom states (PRS). However we
are able to rule out OWPuzz's equivalence to many of these primitives by
showing a black box separation between general OWPuzz and a restricted class of
OWPuzz (those with efficient verification, which we call EV-OWPuzz). We then
show that EV-OWPuzz are also implied by most of these primitives, which
separates them from OWPuzz as well. This separation also separates extending
PRS from highly compressing PRS answering an open question of Ananth et. al.
translated: 最近的工作介绍了“量子计算经典通信”(QCCC)(Chung et。密码学设置。已经有一些证据表明，One Way Puzzles (OWPuzz)是这种设置(Khurana 和 Tomer)的天然中央加密原语。对于一个被认为是中心的原语，它应该具有几个特征。它应该具有良好的行为(在本文中，我们认为它具有放大器、合成器和通用结构) ; 它应该由各种各样的其他原语所暗示; 它应该等同于某类有用的原语。我们提出了组合器、正确性和安全放大，以及 OWPuzz 的通用结构。我们的安全放大的证明使用了一个新的和更简洁的版本从 OWPuzz 的 EFI 结构(相对于 Khurana 和 Tomer 的结果) ，这个结构概括为弱 OWPuzz，是论文中技术最复杂的部分。之前已经知道，OWPuzz 隐含在其他感兴趣的原语中，包括承诺、对称密钥加密、单向状态生成器(OWSG)以及伪随机状态(PRS)。然而，我们可以通过显示一般 OWPuzz 和一个受限类 OWPuzz (有效验证的类，我们称之为 EV-OWPuzz)之间的黑盒分离，排除 OWPuzz 与许多这些原语的等价性。然后，我们展示 EV-OWPuzz 也隐含在大多数这些原语中，这也将它们与 OWPuzz 区分开来。这种分离还将扩展 PRS 与高度压缩 PRS 分离开来，以回答 Ananth 等人的一个开放问题。Al.

title:
SoK: Cryptocurrency Wallets -- A Security Review and Classification
  based on Authentication Factors
summary:
In this work, we review existing cryptocurrency wallet solutions with regard
to authentication methods and factors from the user's point of view. In
particular, we distinguish between authentication factors that are verified
against the blockchain and the ones verified locally (or against a centralized
party). With this in mind, we define notions for $k-factor$ authentication
against the blockchain and $k-factor$ authentication against the authentication
factors. Based on these notions, we propose a classification of authentication
schemes. We extend our classification to accommodate the threshold signatures
and signing transactions by centralized parties (such as exchanges or
co-signing services). Finally, we apply our classification to existing wallet
solutions, which we compare based on various security and key-management
features.
translated: 在这项工作中，我们回顾了现有的加密货币钱包解决方案的认证方法和因素从用户的角度来看。特别是，我们区分了根据区块链验证的身份验证因子和在本地(或针对集中的一方)验证的身份验证因子。考虑到这一点，我们定义了针对区块链的 $k-factor $身份验证和针对身份验证因子的 $k-factor $身份验证的概念。基于这些概念，我们提出了一种认证方案的分类。我们扩展了我们的分类，以适应门限签名和由集中的各方(如交换机或共同签名服务)签署的事务。最后，我们将我们的分类应用于现有的钱包解决方案，并根据不同的安全性和密钥管理特性进行比较。

title:
Securing OPEN-RAN Equipment Using Blockchain-Based Supply Chain
  Verification
summary:
The disaggregated and multi-vendor nature of OPEN-RAN networks introduces new
supply chain security risks, making equipment authenticity and integrity
crucial challenges. Robust solutions are needed to mitigate vulnerabilities in
manufacturing and integration. This paper puts forth a novel blockchain-based
approach to secure OPEN-RAN equipment through its lifecycle. By combining
firmware authentication codes, a permissioned blockchain ledger, and equipment
node validators, we architect a tamper-resistant ecosystem to track provenance.
The outlined design, while conceptual, establishes a foundation and roadmap for
future realization. Through careful implementation planning, development of
core components like firmware signed hashes and smart contracts, and rigorous
performance evaluation, this paper can evolve from concept to practice. There
is a vivid potential to make OPEN-RAN supply chains corner to corner secure,
igniting further research and real-world deployment.
translated: OPEN-RAN 网络的分解和多供应商性质引入了新的供应链安全风险，使得设备的真实性和完整性成为至关重要的挑战。需要强有力的解决方案来减轻制造和集成中的脆弱性。提出了一种基于区块链的 OPEN-RAN 设备生命周期安全保护方法。通过结合固件身份验证代码、授权区块链分类账和设备节点验证器，我们构建了一个防篡改的生态系统来跟踪来源。概述的设计虽然是概念性的，但为将来的实现奠定了基础和路线图。通过仔细的实施计划，开发核心组件，如固件签署的哈希和智能合同，以及严格的性能评估，本文可以从概念演变到实践。OPEN-RAN 供应链具有生动的潜力，可以使其从一个角落到另一个角落变得安全，从而引发进一步的研究和现实世界的部署。

title:
Complexity Assessment of Analog Security Primitives Using the Disentropy
  of Autocorrelation
summary:
The study of regularity in signals can be of great importance, typically in
medicine to analyse electrocardiogram (ECG) or electromyography (EMG) signals,
but also in climate studies, finance or security. In this work we focus on
security primitives such as Physical Unclonable Functions (PUFs) or
Pseudo-Random Number Generators (PRNGs). Such primitives must have a high level
of complexity or entropy in their responses to guarantee enough security for
their applications. There are several ways of assessing the complexity of their
responses, especially in the binary domain. With the development of analog PUFs
such as optical (photonic) PUFs, it would be useful to be able to assess their
complexity in the analog domain when designing them, for example, before
converting analog signals into binary. In this numerical study, we decided to
explore the potential of the disentropy of autocorrelation as a measure of
complexity for security primitives as PUFs or PRNGs with analog output or
responses. We compare this metric to others used to assess regularities in
analog signals such as Approximate Entropy (ApEn) and Fuzzy Entropy (FuzEn). We
show that the disentropy of autocorrelation is able to differentiate between
well-known PRNGs and non-optimised or bad PRNGs in the analog and binary domain
with a better contrast than ApEn and FuzEn. Next, we show that the disentropy
of autocorrelation is able to detect small patterns injected in PUFs responses
and then we applied it to photonic PUFs simulations.
translated: 研究信号的规律性可能非常重要，通常在医学上用于分析心电图(ECG)或肌电图(EMG)信号，但在气候研究、金融或安全领域也是如此。在这项工作中，我们集中在安全原语，如物理不可克隆函数(PUF)或伪随机数生成器(PRNG)。这样的原语在响应中必须具有高度的复杂性或熵，以保证其应用程序具有足够的安全性。有几种方法可以评估它们响应的复杂性，特别是在二进制领域。随着光学(光子) PUF 等模拟 PUF 的发展，例如，在将模拟信号转换为二进制信号之前，能够在模拟领域评估它们的复杂性将是非常有用的。在这个数值研究中，我们决定探索潜在的自相关不熵作为衡量复杂性的安全基元如 PUF 或 PRNG 与模拟输出或响应。我们将这个度量与其他用于评估模拟信号规律性的度量进行比较，如近似熵(ApEn)和模糊熵(FuzEn)。结果表明，自相关的不熵能够在模拟和二进制域中区分已知的 PRNG 和非优化或劣化的 PRNG，其对比度优于 ApEn 和 FuzEn。接下来，我们证明了自相关的不熵能够检测注入到 PUF 响应中的小模式，然后我们将其应用到光子 PUF 模拟中。

title:
A Holistic Approach for Bitcoin Confirmation Times & Optimal Fee
  Selection
summary:
Bitcoin is currently subject to a significant pay-for-speed trade-off. This
is caused by lengthy and highly variable transaction confirmation times,
especially during times of congestion. Users can reduce their transaction
confirmation times by increasing their transaction fee. In this paper, based on
the inner workings of Bitcoin, we propose a model-based approach (based on the
Cram\'er-Lundberg model) that can be used to determine the optimal fee, via,
for example, the mean or quantiles, and models accurately the confirmation time
distribution for a given fee. The proposed model is highly suitable as it
arises as the limiting model for the mempool process (that tracks the
unconfirmed transactions), which we rigorously show via a fluid limit and we
extend this to the diffusion limit (an approximation of the Cram\'er-Lundberg
model for fast computations in highly congested instances). We also propose
methods (incorporating the real-time data) to estimate the model parameters,
thereby combining model and data-driven approaches. The model-based approach is
validated on real-world data and the resulting transaction fees outperform, in
most instances, the data-driven ones.
translated: 比特币目前面临着一个重大的速度付费交易。这是由冗长和高度可变的交易确认时间造成的，特别是在拥塞时期。用户可以通过增加交易费用来减少交易确认时间。本文基于比特币的内部运行机制，提出了一种基于模型的方法(基于克拉姆-伦德伯格模型) ，通过比特币的均值或分位数来确定比特币的最优费用，并对给定费用的确认时间分布进行精确建模。建议的模型是非常适合的，因为它出现作为内存池过程(跟踪未确认的事务)的限制模型，我们通过流体限制严格显示，并将其扩展到扩散限制(在高度拥挤的情况下用于快速计算的克拉姆-伦德伯格模型的近似值)。我们还提出了方法(结合实时数据)估计模型参数，从而结合模型和数据驱动的方法。基于模型的方法在真实世界的数据上得到了验证，并且由此产生的交易费用在大多数情况下优于数据驱动的交易费用。

title: Model X-ray:Detect Backdoored Models via Decision Boundary
summary:
Deep neural networks (DNNs) have revolutionized various industries, leading
to the rise of Machine Learning as a Service (MLaaS). In this paradigm,
well-trained models are typically deployed through APIs. However, DNNs are
susceptible to backdoor attacks, which pose significant risks to their
applications. This vulnerability necessitates a method for users to ascertain
whether an API is compromised before usage. Although many backdoor detection
methods have been developed, they often operate under the assumption that the
defender has access to specific information such as details of the attack, soft
predictions from the model API, and even the knowledge of the model parameters,
limiting their practicality in MLaaS scenarios. To address it, in this paper,
we begin by presenting an intriguing observation: the decision boundary of the
backdoored model exhibits a greater degree of closeness than that of the clean
model. Simultaneously, if only one single label is infected, a larger portion
of the regions will be dominated by the attacked label. Building upon this
observation, we propose Model X-ray, a novel backdoor detection approach for
MLaaS through the analysis of decision boundaries. Model X-ray can not only
identify whether the target API is infected by backdoor attacks but also
determine the target attacked label under the all-to-one attack strategy.
Importantly, it accomplishes this solely by the hard prediction of clean
inputs, regardless of any assumptions about attacks and prior knowledge of the
training details of the model. Extensive experiments demonstrated that Model
X-ray can be effective for MLaaS across diverse backdoor attacks, datasets, and
architectures.
translated: 深度神经网络(DNN)已经彻底改变了各个行业，导致了机器学习即服务(MLaaS)的兴起。在这个范例中，训练有素的模型通常通过 API 部署。然而，DNN 很容易受到后门攻击，这对它们的应用程序构成重大风险。这个漏洞使得用户需要一个方法来确定一个 API 在使用之前是否受到了损害。虽然许多后门检测方法已经被开发出来，但是它们通常是在这样的假设下运行的: 防御者可以访问特定的信息，比如攻击的细节，来自模型 API 的软预测，甚至是模型参数的知识，这限制了它们在 MLaaS 场景中的实用性。为了解决这个问题，在本文中，我们首先展示了一个有趣的观察结果: 后门模型的决策边界比干净模型表现出更大程度的亲密性。同时，如果只有一个单独的标签被感染，那么大部分的区域将被攻击的标签所控制。在此基础上，通过对决策边界的分析，我们提出了一种新的 MLaaS 后门检测方法——模型 X 射线。X 射线模型不仅能够识别目标 API 是否受到后门攻击的影响，而且能够在一对一攻击策略下确定目标攻击的标签。重要的是，它完全通过对干净输入的硬预测来实现这一点，而不考虑对攻击的任何假设以及对模型的训练细节的事先知识。大量的实验表明，模型 X 射线可以有效的 MLaaS 跨不同的后门攻击，数据集和架构。

title:
PureLottery: Fair and Bias-Resistant Leader Election with a Novel
  Single-Elimination Tournament Algorithm
summary:
Leader Election (LE) is crucial in distributed systems and blockchain
technology, ensuring one participant acts as the leader. Traditional LE methods
often depend on distributed random number generation (RNG), facing issues like
vulnerability to manipulation, lack of fairness, and the need for complex
procedures such as verifiable delay functions (VDFs) and publicly-verifiable
secret sharing (PVSS). This Bachelor's thesis presents a novel approach to
randomized LE, leveraging a game-theoretic assumption that participants, aiming
to be chosen as leaders, will naturally avoid actions that diminish their
chances. This perspective simplifies LE by eliminating the need for
decentralized RNG. Introducing PureLottery, inspired by single-elimination
sports tournaments, this method offers a fair, bias-resistant, and efficient LE
solution for blockchain environments. It operates on the principle of two
participants competing in each match, rendering collusion efforts useless.
PureLottery stands out for its low computational and communication complexity,
suitable for smart contract implementation. It provides strong game-theoretic
incentives for honesty and is robust against adversaries, ensuring no increase
in election chances through dishonesty. The protocol guarantees that each
honest player has at least a 1/n chance of winning, irrespective of adversary
manipulation among the other n-1 participants. PureLottery can also address
related problems like participant ranking, electing multiple leaders, and
leader aversion, showcasing its versatility across various applications,
including lotteries and blockchain protocols. An open-source implementation is
made available for public use.
translated: 领导者选举(LE)是分布式系统和区块链技术的关键，确保一个参与者充当领导者。传统的随机数生成方法往往依赖于分布式随机数生成(RNG) ，面临操作易受攻击、缺乏公平性以及可验证延迟函数(VDF)和可公开验证秘密共享(PVSS)等复杂过程的需求等问题。这个学士的论文提出了一个随机化 LE 的新方法，利用一个博弈论假设，即参与者，旨在被选为领导者，将自然而然地避免减少他们的机会的行动。这个透视图通过消除分散 RNG 的需要来简化 LE。受到单淘汰体育锦标赛的启发，引入 PureLotters，该方法为区块链环境提供了一种公平、抗偏、高效的 LE 解决方案。它的运作原则是两个参与者在每场比赛中竞争，使串通的努力没有用处。PureLottle 以其较低的计算和通信复杂度而脱颖而出，适合于智能契约的实现。它为诚实提供了强有力的博弈论激励，并能有力地对抗对手，确保不会因为不诚实而增加选举机会。该协议保证每个诚实的玩家至少有1/n 的机会获胜，而不考虑其他 n-1参与者中的对手操纵。PureLotters 还可以解决相关问题，如参与者排名、选举多个领导者和领导者厌恶，展示其在各种应用程序中的多功能性，包括彩票和区块链协议。一个开放源码的实现被提供给公众使用。

title:
Robustness-Congruent Adversarial Training for Secure Machine Learning
  Model Updates
summary:
Machine-learning models demand for periodic updates to improve their average
accuracy, exploiting novel architectures and additional data. However, a
newly-updated model may commit mistakes that the previous model did not make.
Such misclassifications are referred to as negative flips, and experienced by
users as a regression of performance. In this work, we show that this problem
also affects robustness to adversarial examples, thereby hindering the
development of secure model update practices. In particular, when updating a
model to improve its adversarial robustness, some previously-ineffective
adversarial examples may become misclassified, causing a regression in the
perceived security of the system. We propose a novel technique, named
robustness-congruent adversarial training, to address this issue. It amounts to
fine-tuning a model with adversarial training, while constraining it to retain
higher robustness on the adversarial examples that were correctly classified
before the update. We show that our algorithm and, more generally, learning
with non-regression constraints, provides a theoretically-grounded framework to
train consistent estimators. Our experiments on robust models for computer
vision confirm that (i) both accuracy and robustness, even if improved after
model update, can be affected by negative flips, and (ii) our
robustness-congruent adversarial training can mitigate the problem,
outperforming competing baseline methods.
translated: 机器学习模型需要定期更新，以提高其平均精度，利用新的架构和额外的数据。但是，新更新的模型可能会犯以前的模型没有犯的错误。这种错误分类被称为负翻转，用户体验到的是性能的回归。在这项工作中，我们表明，这个问题也影响了对抗性的例子的鲁棒性，从而阻碍了安全模型更新实践的发展。特别是，当更新模型以提高其对抗性的稳健性时，一些以前无效的对抗性例子可能会被错误分类，导致系统感知安全性的倒退。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种新的技术，称为鲁棒性一致对抗训练。这相当于通过对抗性训练对模型进行微调，同时限制其对在更新之前正确分类的对抗性示例保持更高的稳健性。我们表明，我们的算法，更一般地说，学习与非回归约束，提供了一个理论基础的框架，以训练一致性估计。我们对计算机视觉稳健模型的实验证实，(i)即使在模型更新后得到改善，也可能受到负翻转的影响，以及(ii)我们的稳健性一致对抗性训练可以缓解问题，优于竞争性基线方法。

title: Towards an Enforceable GDPR Specification
summary:
While Privacy by Design (PbD) is prescribed by modern privacy regulations
such as the EU's GDPR, achieving PbD in real software systems is a notoriously
difficult task. One emerging technique to realize PbD is Runtime enforcement
(RE), in which an enforcer, loaded with a specification of a system's privacy
requirements, observes the actions performed by the system and instructs it to
perform actions that will ensure compliance with these requirements at all
times. To be able to use RE techniques for PbD, privacy regulations first need
to be translated into an enforceable specification. In this paper, we report on
our ongoing work in formalizing the GDPR. We first present a set of
requirements and an iterative methodology for creating enforceable formal
specifications of legal provisions. Then, we report on a preliminary case study
in which we used our methodology to derive an enforceable specification of part
of the GDPR. Our case study suggests that our methodology can be effectively
used to develop accurate enforceable specifications.
translated: 尽管现代隐私法规(如欧盟的 GDPR)规定了设计隐私(Privacy by Design，PbD) ，但在真实的软件系统中实现 PbD 却是一项众所周知的艰巨任务。实现 PbD 的一种新兴技术是运行时执行(Runtime strong，RE) ，在这种技术中，执行者负载了系统隐私需求的规范，观察系统执行的操作，并指示它执行确保始终遵守这些需求的操作。为了能够对 PbD 使用 RE 技术，首先需要将隐私条例转化为可执行的规范。在这篇文章中，我们报告了我们正在进行的正式 GDPR 的工作。我们首先提出一组要求和一个迭代方法，用于创建可执行的法律条文的正式规范。然后，我们报告了一个初步的案例研究，其中，我们使用我们的方法，得出了一个可执行的规范的 GDPR 的一部分。我们的案例研究表明，我们的方法可以有效地用于开发准确的可执行规范。

title:
Model Predictive Control with adaptive resilience for Denial-of-Service
  Attacks mitigation on a Regulated Dam
summary:
In recent years, SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) systems
have increasingly become the target of cyber attacks. SCADAs are no longer
isolated, as web-based applications expose strategic infrastructures to the
outside world connection. In a cyber-warfare context, we propose a Model
Predictive Control (MPC) architecture with adaptive resilience, capable of
guaranteeing control performance in normal operating conditions and driving
towards resilience against DoS (controller-actuator) attacks when needed. Since
the attackers' goal is typically to maximize the system damage, we assume they
solve an adversarial optimal control problem. An adaptive resilience factor is
then designed as a function of the intensity function of a Hawkes process, a
point process model estimating the occurrence of random events in time, trained
on a moving window to estimate the return time of the next attack. We
demonstrate the resulting MPC strategy's effectiveness in 2 attack scenarios on
a real system with actual data, the regulated Olginate dam of Lake Como.
translated: 近年来，SCADA (数据采集与监控系统)系统日益成为网络攻击的目标。SCADA 不再是孤立的，因为基于 Web 的应用程序将战略基础设施暴露给外部世界的连接。在网络战背景下，我们提出了一种具有自适应弹性的模型预估计控制(MPC)架构，该架构能够保证在正常操作条件下的控制性能，并在需要时推动对 DoS (控制器-执行器)攻击的弹性。由于攻击者的目标通常是最大化系统的破坏，我们假设他们解决了一个对抗性的最优控制问题。然后设计一个自适应弹性因子作为 Hawkes 过程强度函数的函数，该过程是一个估计随机事件发生时间的点过程模型，在一个移动窗口上训练以估计下一次攻击的返回时间。我们用实际数据证明了所得到的 MPC 策略在两种攻击场景下对真实系统的有效性，即科摩湖奥尔金纳特调节大坝。

title: Smishing Dataset I: Phishing SMS Dataset from Smishtank.com
summary:
While smishing (SMS Phishing) attacks have risen to become one of the most
common types of social engineering attacks, there is a lack of relevant
smishing datasets. One of the biggest challenges in the domain of smishing
prevention is the availability of fresh smishing datasets. Additionally, as
time persists, smishing campaigns are shut down and the crucial information
related to the attack are lost. With the changing nature of smishing attacks, a
consistent flow of new smishing examples is needed by both researchers and
engineers to create effective defenses. In this paper, we present the
community-sourced smishing datasets from the smishtank.com. It provides a
wealth of information relevant to combating smishing attacks through the
breakdown and analysis of smishing samples at the point of submission. In the
contribution of our work, we provide a corpus of 1090 smishing samples that
have been publicly submitted through the site. Each message includes
information relating to the sender, message body, and any brands referenced in
the message. Additionally, when a URL is found, we provide additional
information on the domain, VirusTotal results, and a characterization of the
URL. Through the open access of fresh smishing data, we empower academia and
industries to create robust defenses against this evolving threat.
translated: 虽然 SMS 钓鱼攻击已经成为最常见的社会工程攻击类型之一，但缺乏相关的 SMS 钓鱼数据集。破碎预防领域的最大挑战之一是新的破碎数据集的可用性。此外，随着时间的推移，攻击行动被关闭，与攻击相关的关键信息也会丢失。随着破碎攻击性质的不断变化，研究人员和工程师都需要持续不断的新的破碎实例来建立有效的防御。在本文中，我们介绍了来自 smishtank.com 的社区来源的破碎数据集。它通过在提交地点分解和分析破碎样品，提供了与打击破碎攻击有关的大量信息。在我们的工作贡献，我们提供了一个1090已经通过该网站公开提交的粉碎样品语料库。每条消息都包含与发件人、消息正文和消息中引用的任何品牌有关的信息。此外，当找到一个 URL 时，我们会提供关于域名、 VirusTotal 结果和 URL 角色塑造的额外信息。通过开放获取最新的破碎数据，我们授权学术界和工业界建立强有力的防御措施来应对这一不断演变的威胁。

title:
DevPhish: Exploring Social Engineering in Software Supply Chain Attacks
  on Developers
summary:
The Software Supply Chain (SSC) has captured considerable attention from
attackers seeking to infiltrate systems and undermine organizations. There is
evidence indicating that adversaries utilize Social Engineering (SocE)
techniques specifically aimed at software developers. That is, they interact
with developers at critical steps in the Software Development Life Cycle
(SDLC), such as accessing Github repositories, incorporating code dependencies,
and obtaining approval for Pull Requests (PR) to introduce malicious code. This
paper aims to comprehensively explore the existing and emerging SocE tactics
employed by adversaries to trick Software Engineers (SWEs) into delivering
malicious software. By analyzing a diverse range of resources, which encompass
established academic literature and real-world incidents, the paper
systematically presents an overview of these manipulative strategies within the
realm of the SSC. Such insights prove highly beneficial for threat modeling and
security gap analysis.
translated: 软件供应链(SSC)已经引起了攻击者的极大关注，他们试图渗透到系统中并破坏组织。有证据表明，对手利用专门针对软件开发人员的社会工程(SocialEngineering，SocE)技术。也就是说，他们在软件开发生命周期(SDLC)的关键步骤中与开发人员进行交互，比如访问 Github 存储库，合并代码依赖关系，以及获得引入恶意代码的“拉请求”(Pull Request，PR)批准。本文旨在全面探讨现有的和新兴的 SocE 策略，以欺骗软件工程师(SWE)提供恶意软件的对手。通过分析各种各样的资源，其中包括已建立的学术文献和现实世界的事件，本文系统地提出了这些操纵策略在 SSC 领域的概述。这些见解证明对威胁建模和安全缺口分析非常有益。

title:
TrustRate: A Decentralized Platform for Hijack-Resistant Anonymous
  Reviews
summary:
Reviews and ratings by users form a central component in several widely used
products today (e.g., product reviews, ratings of online content, etc.), but
today's platforms for managing such reviews are ad-hoc and vulnerable to
various forms of tampering and hijack by fake reviews either by bots or
motivated paid workers. We define a new metric called 'hijack-resistance' for
such review platforms, and then present TrustRate, an end-to-end decentralized,
hijack-resistant platform for authentic, anonymous, tamper-proof reviews. With
a prototype implementation and evaluation at the scale of thousands of nodes,
we demonstrate the efficacy and performance of our platform, towards a new
paradigm for building products based on trusted reviews by end users without
having to trust a single organization that manages the reviews.
translated: 用户的评论和评级是当今几个广泛使用的产品的核心组成部分(例如，产品评论、在线内容评级等) ，但是今天管理这些评论的平台是临时性的，容易受到各种形式的篡改和劫持，这些篡改或者来自机器人，或者来自受激励的付费员工。我们为这样的评论平台定义了一个新的度量，称为“劫持抗性”，然后提出 TrustRate，一个端到端分散的、抗劫持的平台，用于真实的、匿名的、防篡改的评论。通过数千个节点规模的原型实现和评估，我们展示了我们平台的功效和性能，朝向一个新的范式，即构建基于最终用户可信评论的产品，而不必信任管理评论的单一组织。

title:
Token-based Vehicular Security System (TVSS): Scalable, Secure,
  Low-latency Public Key Infrastructure for Connected Vehicles
summary:
Connected and Autonomous vehicles stand to drastically improve the safety and
efficiency of the transportation system in the near future while also reducing
pollution. These systems leverage communication to coordinate among vehicles
and infrastructure in service of a number of safety and efficiency driver
assist and even fully autonomous applications. Attackers can compromise these
systems in a number of ways including by falsifying communication messages,
making it critical to support security mechanisms that can operate and scale in
dynamic scenarios. Towards this end, we present TVSS, a new VPKI system which
improves drastically over prior work in the area (including over SCMS; the US
department of transportation standard for VPKI). TVSS leverages the idea of
unforgeable tokens to enable rapid verification at the road side units (RSUs),
which are part of the road infrastructure at the edge of the network. This edge
based solution enables agile authentication by avoiding the need for back-end
servers during the potentially short contact time between a moving vehicle and
the infrastructure. It also results in several security advantages: (1)
Scalable Revocation: it greatly simplifies the revocation problem, a difficult
problem in large scale certificate systems; and (2) Faster Refresh: Vehicles
interact more frequently with the system to refresh their credentials,
improving the privacy of the system. We provide a construction of the system
and formally prove its security. Field experiments on a test-bed we develop
consisting of on-board units (OBUs) and RSUs shows substantial reduction in the
latency of refreshing credentials compared to SCMS, allowing the system to work
even with smaller window of connectivity when vehicles are moving at higher
speeds. Notably, we are able to execute the bottleneck operation of our scheme
with a stationary RSU while traveling at highway speeds .
translated: 在不久的将来，联网和自动驾驶汽车将大幅度提高交通系统的安全性和效率，同时减少污染。这些系统利用通信在车辆和基础设施之间进行协调，为一些安全和高效的驾驶员辅助服务，甚至是完全自主的应用程序提供服务。攻击者可以通过多种方式破坏这些系统，包括伪造通信消息，这使得支持能够在动态场景中运行和扩展的安全机制变得至关重要。为此，我们提出了 TVSS，一个新的 VPKI 系统，它大大改善了以前在该领域的工作(包括通过 SCMS; 美国运输部门的 VPKI 标准)。TVSS 利用不可伪造令牌的思想，在路边单元(RSU)上实现快速验证，RSU 是网络边缘道路基础设施的一部分。这种基于边缘的解决方案通过避免在移动车辆与基础设施之间可能很短的接触时间内对后端服务器的需求，实现了敏捷身份验证。它还带来了几个安全优势: (1)可伸缩的撤销: 它极大地简化了撤销问题，这是大规模证书系统中的一个难题; (2)更快的刷新: 车辆更频繁地与系统交互以刷新它们的凭证，提高了系统的隐私性。我们提供了一个系统的结构，并正式证明了其安全性。在我们开发的由车载单元(OBU)和 RSU 组成的实验台上进行的现场实验显示，与 SCMS 相比，刷新凭证的延迟大大降低，这使得该系统在车辆以更高速度行驶时，即使连接窗口较小也能工作。值得注意的是，我们能够执行我们的方案的瓶颈操作与一个固定的 RSU，而在高速公路上行驶。

title:
Living-off-The-Land Reverse-Shell Detection by Informed Data
  Augmentation
summary:
The living-off-the-land (LOTL) offensive methodologies rely on the
perpetration of malicious actions through chains of commands executed by
legitimate applications, identifiable exclusively by analysis of system logs.
LOTL techniques are well hidden inside the stream of events generated by common
legitimate activities, moreover threat actors often camouflage activity through
obfuscation, making them particularly difficult to detect without incurring in
plenty of false alarms, even using machine learning. To improve the performance
of models in such an harsh environment, we propose an augmentation framework to
enhance and diversify the presence of LOTL malicious activity inside legitimate
logs. Guided by threat intelligence, we generate a dataset by injecting attack
templates known to be employed in the wild, further enriched by malleable
patterns of legitimate activities to replicate the behavior of evasive threat
actors. We conduct an extensive ablation study to understand which models
better handle our augmented dataset, also manipulated to mimic the presence of
model-agnostic evasion and poisoning attacks. Our results suggest that
augmentation is needed to maintain high-predictive capabilities, robustness to
attack is achieved through specific hardening techniques like adversarial
training, and it is possible to deploy near-real-time models with almost-zero
false alarms.
translated: LOTL 攻击方法依赖于通过合法应用程序执行的命令链实施恶意行为，这些命令完全可以通过分析系统日志来识别。LOTL 技术很好地隐藏在由普通合法活动产生的事件流中，而且威胁行为者经常通过模糊处理来掩饰活动，使得它们特别难以被发现而不引起大量的虚假警报，甚至使用机器学习。为了提高模型在这种恶劣环境下的性能，我们提出了一个增强框架，以增强合法日志中 LOTL 恶意活动的存在并使其多样化。在威胁情报的指导下，我们通过注入已知在野外使用的攻击模板来生成数据集，进一步通过合法活动的可塑模式来复制规避威胁行为者的行为。我们进行了广泛的消融研究，以了解哪些模型更好地处理我们的增强数据集，也操纵模拟模型不可知的逃避和中毒攻击的存在。我们的研究结果表明，需要增强来保持高预测能力，通过特定的强化技术(如对抗性训练)来实现对攻击的鲁棒性，并且可以部署几乎零误报的近实时模型。

title:
Quantification and Modeling of Broken Links Prevalence in Hyper Traffic
  Websites Homepages
summary:
Broken links in websites external resources pose a serious threat to
cybersecurity and the credibility of websites. They can be hijacked to
eavesdrop user traffic or to inject malicious software. In this paper, we
present the first result of an ongoing research. We focus on the prevalence of
broken links in external resources on home pages of the most visited websites
in the world. The analysis was conducted on the top 88 000 homepages extracted
from the Majestic Million rankings. 35,2% of them have at least one broken
link. We also identify the common causes of these broken links and highlight
improper implementation of testing phases to prevent such errors. We provide a
formal model for the distribution of external links. At the next research step,
we are exploring the potential impact on privacy of broken links by analyzing
inherited traffic of purchasable expired domains.
translated: 网站链接中断外部资源对网络安全和网站信誉构成严重威胁。它们可以被劫持来窃听用户流量或注入恶意软件。在本文中，我们提出了一个正在进行的研究的第一个结果。我们关注的是世界上访问量最大的网站主页上外部资源中断链接的普遍性。这项分析是对从“威严百万”排行榜中提取的前8.8万个网页进行的。35.2% 的人至少有一个链接断了。我们还确定了这些中断链接的常见原因，并强调了测试阶段的不当实现，以防止出现此类错误。我们为外部环节的分布提供了一个形式化的模型。在下一个研究步骤中，我们将通过分析可购买的过期域名的继承流量来探索破碎链接对隐私的潜在影响。

title: Catastrophic Overfitting: A Potential Blessing in Disguise
summary:
Fast Adversarial Training (FAT) has gained increasing attention within the
research community owing to its efficacy in improving adversarial robustness.
Particularly noteworthy is the challenge posed by catastrophic overfitting (CO)
in this field. Although existing FAT approaches have made strides in mitigating
CO, the ascent of adversarial robustness occurs with a non-negligible decline
in classification accuracy on clean samples. To tackle this issue, we initially
employ the feature activation differences between clean and adversarial
examples to analyze the underlying causes of CO. Intriguingly, our findings
reveal that CO can be attributed to the feature coverage induced by a few
specific pathways. By intentionally manipulating feature activation differences
in these pathways with well-designed regularization terms, we can effectively
mitigate and induce CO, providing further evidence for this observation.
Notably, models trained stably with these terms exhibit superior performance
compared to prior FAT work. On this basis, we harness CO to achieve `attack
obfuscation', aiming to bolster model performance. Consequently, the models
suffering from CO can attain optimal classification accuracy on both clean and
adversarial data when adding random noise to inputs during evaluation. We also
validate their robustness against transferred adversarial examples and the
necessity of inducing CO to improve robustness. Hence, CO may not be a problem
that has to be solved.
translated: 快速对抗性训练(FAT)因其在提高对抗性稳健性方面的有效性而在研究界得到越来越多的关注。特别值得注意的是灾难性过拟合(CO)在这个领域所带来的挑战。尽管现有的 FAT 方法在减少 CO 方面取得了长足的进展，但是对抗稳健性的提高伴随着清洁样本分类准确性的不可忽视的下降。为了解决这个问题，我们首先使用清洁和敌对示例之间的特征激活差异来分析 CO 的根本原因。有趣的是，我们的研究结果表明 CO 可以归因于由一些特定途径引起的特征覆盖。通过有意识地利用设计良好的正则化条件操纵这些通路中的特征激活差异，我们可以有效地减轻和诱导 CO，为这一观察提供进一步的证据。值得注意的是，与以前的 FAT 工作相比，用这些术语稳定训练的模型表现出更好的性能。在此基础上，利用 CO 实现“攻击模糊化”，以提高模型性能。因此，在评估过程中，在输入中加入随机噪声，使得受 CO 影响的模型在干净数据和对抗数据上都能获得最佳的分类精度。我们还验证了它们对转移的对手例子的鲁棒性，以及诱导 CO 以提高鲁棒性的必要性。因此，一氧化碳可能不是一个需要解决的问题。

title:
VulMCI : Code Splicing-based Pixel-row Oversampling for More Continuous
  Vulnerability Image Generation
summary:
In recent years, the rapid development of deep learning technology has
brought new prospects to the field of vulnerability detection. Many
vulnerability detection methods involve converting source code into images for
detection, yet they often overlook the quality of the generated images. Due to
the fact that vulnerability images lack clear and continuous contours, unlike
images used in object detection, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) tend to
lose semantic information during the convolution and pooling processes.
Therefore, this paper proposes a pixel row oversampling method based on code
line concatenation to generate more continuous code features, addressing the
issue of discontinuity in code image coloration.Building upon these
contributions, we propose the vulnerability detection system VulMCI and conduct
tests on the SARD and NVD datasets. Experimental results demonstrate that
VulMCI outperforms seven state-of-the-art vulnerability detectors (namely
Checkmarx, FlawFinder, RATS, VulDeePecker, SySeVR, VulCNN, and Devign).
Compared to other image-based methods, VulMCI shows improvements in various
metrics, including a 2.877\% increase in True Positive Rate (TPR), a 5.446\%
increase in True Negative Rate (TNR), and a 5.91\% increase in Accuracy (ACC).
On the NVD real-world dataset, VulMCI achieves an average accuracy of 5.162\%,
confirming its value in practical vulnerability detection applications.
translated: 近年来，深度学习技术的迅猛发展为脆弱性检测领域带来了新的发展前景。许多漏洞检测方法都涉及到将源代码转换成图像以便检测，但是它们往往忽略了所生成图像的质量。由于脆弱性图像缺乏清晰连续的轮廓，不像目标检测中使用的图像，卷积神经网络(cnn)在卷积和合并过程中往往会失去语义信息。为此，本文提出了一种基于代码行级联的像素行过采样方法，以生成更多的连续代码特征，解决代码图像着色中的不连续性问题。在此基础上，我们提出了漏洞检测系统 VulMCI，并对 SARD 和 NVD 数据集进行了测试。实验结果表明，VulMCI 的性能优于七种最先进的漏洞检测器(即 Checkmarx、 FlawFinder、 RATS、 VulDeePecker、 SySeVR、 VulCNN 和 Design)。与其他基于图像的方法相比，VulMCI 显示了各种指标的改进，包括真正正面率(TPR)增加2.877% ，真正负面率(TNR)增加5.446% ，准确性(ACC)增加5.91% 。在 NVD 实际数据集上，VulMCI 的平均准确率达到了5.162% ，证实了它在实际漏洞检测应用中的价值。

title:
Modeling and Analysis of Crypto-Backed Over-Collateralized Stable
  Derivatives in DeFi
summary:
In decentralized finance (DeFi), stablecoins like DAI are designed to offer a
stable value amidst the fluctuating nature of cryptocurrencies. We examine the
class of crypto-backed stable derivatives, with a focus on mechanisms for price
stabilization, which is exemplified by the well-known stablecoin DAI from
MakerDAO. For simplicity, we focus on a single-collateral setting. We introduce
a belief parameter to the simulation model of DAI in a previous work (DAISIM),
reflecting market sentiments about the value and stability of DAI, and show
that it better matches the expected behavior when this parameter is set to a
sufficiently high value. We also propose a simple mathematical model of DAI
price to explain its stability and dependency on ETH price. Finally, we analyze
possible risk factors associated with these stable derivatives to provide
valuable insights for stakeholders in the DeFi ecosystem.
translated: 在分散金融(DeFi)中，像 DAI 这样的稳定币被设计为在加密货币的波动性中提供一个稳定的价值。我们研究了一类密码支持的稳定衍生产品，重点是价格稳定的机制，这是著名的稳定币 DAI 从 MakerDAO 的例子。为了简单起见，我们关注于单一抵押品设置。本文在前人研究的 DAI 仿真模型(DAISIM)中引入了一个信念参数，反映了市场对 DAI 的价值和稳定性的看法，并表明当该参数设置到一个足够高的值时，它能更好地匹配预期行为。我们还提出了一个简单的 DAI 价格数学模型来解释其稳定性和对 ETH 价格的依赖性。最后，我们分析了与这些稳定的衍生产品相关的可能的风险因素，为 DeFi 生态系统中的利益相关者提供有价值的见解。

title: Differentially Private Worst-group Risk Minimization
summary:
We initiate a systematic study of worst-group risk minimization under
$(\epsilon, \delta)$-differential privacy (DP). The goal is to privately find a
model that approximately minimizes the maximal risk across $p$ sub-populations
(groups) with different distributions, where each group distribution is
accessed via a sample oracle. We first present a new algorithm that achieves
excess worst-group population risk of $\tilde{O}(\frac{p\sqrt{d}}{K\epsilon} +
\sqrt{\frac{p}{K}})$, where $K$ is the total number of samples drawn from all
groups and $d$ is the problem dimension. Our rate is nearly optimal when each
distribution is observed via a fixed-size dataset of size $K/p$. Our result is
based on a new stability-based analysis for the generalization error. In
particular, we show that $\Delta$-uniform argument stability implies
$\tilde{O}(\Delta + \frac{1}{\sqrt{n}})$ generalization error w.r.t. the
worst-group risk, where $n$ is the number of samples drawn from each sample
oracle. Next, we propose an algorithmic framework for worst-group population
risk minimization using any DP online convex optimization algorithm as a
subroutine. Hence, we give another excess risk bound of $\tilde{O}\left(
\sqrt{\frac{d^{1/2}}{\epsilon K}} +\sqrt{\frac{p}{K\epsilon^2}} \right)$.
Assuming the typical setting of $\epsilon=\Theta(1)$, this bound is more
favorable than our first bound in a certain range of $p$ as a function of $K$
and $d$. Finally, we study differentially private worst-group empirical risk
minimization in the offline setting, where each group distribution is observed
by a fixed-size dataset. We present a new algorithm with nearly optimal excess
risk of $\tilde{O}(\frac{p\sqrt{d}}{K\epsilon})$.
translated: 我们开始了一个系统的研究最坏的组风险最小化在 $(epsilon，delta) $- 差分隐私(DP)。我们的目标是私下找到一个模型，在不同分布的 $p $子群体(组)中，大致最小化最大风险，其中每个组分布通过一个样本预言器访问。本文首先提出了一种新的算法，该算法实现了最坏群体的超额种群风险为 $tilde { O }(frac { p sqrt { d }{ K ε }} + sqrt { frac { p }{ K }}) $，其中 $K $是从所有群体中抽取的样本总数，$d $是问题维数。当通过大小为 $K/p $的固定大小的数据集观察每个分布时，我们的速率几乎是最优的。我们的结果是基于对泛化误差的新的基于稳定性的分析。特别地，我们证明了 $Delta $- 统一参数的稳定性意味着 $tilde { O }(Delta + frac {1}{ sqrt { n }}) $的最坏群体风险，其中 $n $是从每个样本预言中抽取的样本泛化误差。接下来，我们提出了一个算法框架，使用任何 DP 在线凸优化算法作为子例程来最小化最坏群体的人口风险。因此，我们给出了 $tilde { O }左(sqrt { frac { d ^ {1/2}}{ epsilon K }}} + sqrt { frac { p }{ K epsilon ^ 2}}}右) $的另一个超额风险界。假设典型的设置为 $epsilon = Θ (1) $，这个界比我们在 $p $的一定范围内作为 $K $和 $d $的函数的第一个界更有利。最后，我们研究了离线环境下的差异私人最差群体经验风险最小化问题，其中每个群体的分布都通过一个固定大小的数据集来观察。本文提出了一种新的近似最优超额风险的算法，该算法的风险值为 $tilde { O }(frac { p sqrt { d }}{ K epsilon }) $。

title:
SoK: Exploring the Potential of Large Language Models for Improving
  Digital Forensic Investigation Efficiency
summary:
The growing number of cases requiring digital forensic analysis raises
concerns about law enforcement's ability to conduct investigations promptly.
Consequently, this systemisation of knowledge paper delves into the potential
and effectiveness of integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) into digital
forensic investigation to address these challenges. A thorough literature
review is undertaken, encompassing existing digital forensic models, tools,
LLMs, deep learning techniques, and the utilisation of LLMs in investigations.
The review identifies current challenges within existing digital forensic
processes and explores both the obstacles and possibilities of incorporating
LLMs. In conclusion, the study asserts that the adoption of LLMs in digital
forensics, with appropriate constraints, holds the potential to enhance
investigation efficiency, improve traceability, and alleviate technical and
judicial barriers faced by law enforcement entities.
translated: 越来越多的案件需要数字法医分析，这引发了人们对执法部门迅速展开调查能力的担忧。因此，这篇系统化的知识论文深入研究了将大语言模型(LLM)集成到数字法医学调查中的潜力和有效性，以应对这些挑战。进行了一个彻底的文献回顾，包括现有的数字法医模型，工具，LLM，深度学习技术，以及 LLM 在调查中的应用。审查确定了现有数字法医程序中的当前挑战，并探讨了纳入有限法医措施的障碍和可能性。研究总结指出，在适当的限制下，在数位鑑识采用法定最低限度标准，有可能提高调查效率、改善可追溯性，以及减轻执法机构面对的技术和司法障碍。

title: Watermark Stealing in Large Language Models
summary:
LLM watermarking has attracted attention as a promising way to detect
AI-generated content, with some works suggesting that current schemes may
already be fit for deployment. In this work we dispute this claim, identifying
watermark stealing (WS) as a fundamental vulnerability of these schemes. We
show that querying the API of the watermarked LLM to approximately
reverse-engineer a watermark enables practical spoofing attacks, as suggested
in prior work, but also greatly boosts scrubbing attacks, which was previously
unnoticed. We are the first to propose an automated WS algorithm and use it in
the first comprehensive study of spoofing and scrubbing in realistic settings.
We show that for under $50 an attacker can both spoof and scrub
state-of-the-art schemes previously considered safe, with average success rate
of over 80%. Our findings challenge common beliefs about LLM watermarking,
stressing the need for more robust schemes. We make all our code and additional
examples available at https://watermark-stealing.org.
translated: LLM 水印作为一种检测 AI 生成内容的有前途的方法已经引起了人们的关注，一些研究表明目前的方案可能已经适合于部署。在这项工作中，我们争论这一主张，确定水印窃取(WS)作为一个根本性的漏洞，这些方案。我们展示了通过查询水印 LLM 的 API 对水印进行近似反向工程可以实现实际的欺骗攻击，正如之前的工作中所建议的那样，但是也可以极大地提高擦除攻击，这是以前没有注意到的。我们是第一个提出自动化 WS 算法并将其用于第一个在现实环境中全面研究欺骗和擦除的人。我们展示了低于50美元的攻击者可以欺骗和擦洗国家的最先进的方案以前认为是安全的，平均成功率超过80% 。我们的研究结果挑战了关于 LLM 水印的普遍看法，强调需要更加健壮的方案。我们把所有的代码和附加示例都放在 https://watermark-stealing.org 上。

title:
Unraveling Adversarial Examples against Speaker Identification --
  Techniques for Attack Detection and Victim Model Classification
summary:
Adversarial examples have proven to threaten speaker identification systems,
and several countermeasures against them have been proposed. In this paper, we
propose a method to detect the presence of adversarial examples, i.e., a binary
classifier distinguishing between benign and adversarial examples. We build
upon and extend previous work on attack type classification by exploring new
architectures. Additionally, we introduce a method for identifying the victim
model on which the adversarial attack is carried out. To achieve this, we
generate a new dataset containing multiple attacks performed against various
victim models. We achieve an AUC of 0.982 for attack detection, with no more
than a 0.03 drop in performance for unknown attacks. Our attack classification
accuracy (excluding benign) reaches 86.48% across eight attack types using our
LightResNet34 architecture, while our victim model classification accuracy
reaches 72.28% across four victim models.
translated: 威胁说话人识别系统的敌对实例已经被证明，并提出了几种对付它们的对策。在本文中，我们提出了一种检测对抗性例子存在性的方法，即区分良性和对抗性例子的二进制分类器。通过探索新的体系结构，我们构建并扩展了以前关于攻击类型分类的工作。此外，我们还介绍了一种识别被害人模型的方法。为此，我们生成一个新的数据集，其中包含针对各种受害者模型执行的多种攻击。对于攻击检测，我们实现了0.982的 AUC，对于未知攻击，性能下降不超过0.03。使用 LightResNet34架构，我们的攻击分类准确率(不包括良性)在8种攻击类型中达到86.48% ，而受害者模型分类准确率在4种受害者模型中达到72.28% 。

title: Verification of Neural Networks' Global Robustness
summary:
Neural networks are successful in various applications but are also
susceptible to adversarial attacks. To show the safety of network classifiers,
many verifiers have been introduced to reason about the local robustness of a
given input to a given perturbation. While successful, local robustness cannot
generalize to unseen inputs. Several works analyze global robustness
properties, however, neither can provide a precise guarantee about the cases
where a network classifier does not change its classification. In this work, we
propose a new global robustness property for classifiers aiming at finding the
minimal globally robust bound, which naturally extends the popular local
robustness property for classifiers. We introduce VHAGaR, an anytime verifier
for computing this bound. VHAGaR relies on three main ideas: encoding the
problem as a mixed-integer programming and pruning the search space by
identifying dependencies stemming from the perturbation or network computation
and generalizing adversarial attacks to unknown inputs. We evaluate VHAGaR on
several datasets and classifiers and show that, given a three hour timeout, the
average gap between the lower and upper bound on the minimal globally robust
bound computed by VHAGaR is 1.9, while the gap of an existing global robustness
verifier is 154.7. Moreover, VHAGaR is 130.6x faster than this verifier. Our
results further indicate that leveraging dependencies and adversarial attacks
makes VHAGaR 78.6x faster.
translated: 神经网络在各种应用中都很成功，但是也容易受到对手的攻击。为了说明网络分类器的安全性，引入了许多验证器来判断给定输入对给定扰动的局部鲁棒性。虽然成功了，但局部鲁棒性不能推广到不可见的输入。有些文献分析了网络分类器的全局鲁棒性，但是对于网络分类器不改变分类的情况，两者都不能提供精确的保证。本文提出了一种新的分类器全局鲁棒性属性，旨在寻找最小的全局鲁棒界，自然而然地扩展了分类器常用的局部鲁棒性属性。我们介绍了 VHAGaR，一个计算这个界的随时验证器。VHAGaR 依赖于三个主要思想: 将问题编码为混合整数规划，通过识别由扰动或网络计算产生的依赖关系来裁剪搜索空间，并将对抗性攻击推广到未知输入。我们在几个数据集和分类器上评估 VHAGaR，结果显示，给定3小时超时，VHAGaR 计算的最小全局鲁棒界限的下限和上限之间的平均差距为1.9，而现有全局鲁棒性验证器的差距为154.7。此外，VHAGaR 比这个验证器快130.6倍。我们的研究结果进一步表明，利用依赖性和对抗性攻击使 VHAGaR 78.6倍更快。

title: Attacks Against Mobility Prediction in 5G Networks
summary:
The $5^{th}$ generation of mobile networks introduces a new Network Function
(NF) that was not present in previous generations, namely the Network Data
Analytics Function (NWDAF). Its primary objective is to provide advanced
analytics services to various entities within the network and also towards
external application services in the 5G ecosystem. One of the key use cases of
NWDAF is mobility trajectory prediction, which aims to accurately support
efficient mobility management of User Equipment (UE) in the network by
allocating ``just in time'' necessary network resources. In this paper, we show
that there are potential mobility attacks that can compromise the accuracy of
these predictions. In a semi-realistic scenario with 10,000 subscribers, we
demonstrate that an adversary equipped with the ability to hijack cellular
mobile devices and clone them can significantly reduce the prediction accuracy
from 75\% to 40\% using just 100 adversarial UEs. While a defense mechanism
largely depends on the attack and the mobility types in a particular area, we
prove that a basic KMeans clustering is effective in distinguishing legitimate
and adversarial UEs.
translated: 第五代移动网络引入了一个新的网络函数(NF) ，这是前几代移动网络所没有的，即网络数据分析函数(NWDAF)。其主要目标是向网络内各实体提供先进的分析服务，并向5G 生态系统中的外部应用服务提供先进的分析服务。NWDAF 的其中一个主要用例是移动轨迹预测，目的是透过分配「适时」的网络资源，准确地支援网络内有效的用户设备移动性管理。在本文中，我们表明，有潜在的移动性攻击，可以损害这些预测的准确性。在一个有10,000个用户的半现实情况下，我们证明，一个配备有能力劫持蜂窝移动设备并克隆它们的对手可以使用仅仅100个对手 UEs 将预测准确性从75% 显着降低到40% 。虽然防御机制在很大程度上取决于攻击和特定区域的移动类型，但是我们证明了基本的 KMeans 集群能够有效地区分合法的和敌对的 UE。

title: Machine learning for modular multiplication
summary:
Motivated by cryptographic applications, we investigate two machine learning
approaches to modular multiplication: namely circular regression and a
sequence-to-sequence transformer model. The limited success of both methods
demonstrated in our results gives evidence for the hardness of tasks involving
modular multiplication upon which cryptosystems are based.
translated: 受密码学应用的启发，我们研究了模乘的两种机器学习方法: 循环回归和序列-序列变换模型。在我们的结果中证明的两种方法的有限的成功证明了任务的硬度涉及模乘，密码系统的基础上。

title: Trained Random Forests Completely Reveal your Dataset
summary:
We introduce an optimization-based reconstruction attack capable of
completely or near-completely reconstructing a dataset utilized for training a
random forest. Notably, our approach relies solely on information readily
available in commonly used libraries such as scikit-learn. To achieve this, we
formulate the reconstruction problem as a combinatorial problem under a maximum
likelihood objective. We demonstrate that this problem is NP-hard, though
solvable at scale using constraint programming -- an approach rooted in
constraint propagation and solution-domain reduction. Through an extensive
computational investigation, we demonstrate that random forests trained without
bootstrap aggregation but with feature randomization are susceptible to a
complete reconstruction. This holds true even with a small number of trees.
Even with bootstrap aggregation, the majority of the data can also be
reconstructed. These findings underscore a critical vulnerability inherent in
widely adopted ensemble methods, warranting attention and mitigation. Although
the potential for such reconstruction attacks has been discussed in privacy
research, our study provides clear empirical evidence of their practicability.
translated: 我们引入了一种基于优化的重建攻击，它能够完全或近乎完全地重建用于训练随机森林的数据集。值得注意的是，我们的方法完全依赖于常用库(如 scikit-learn)中随时可用的信息。为了达到这个目的，我们将重建问题表述为一个最大似然目标下的组合问题。我们证明了这个问题是 NP 难的，尽管可以通过约束编程来解决——一种植根于约束传播和解域缩减的方法。通过一个广泛的计算研究，我们证明了随机森林训练没有自举聚集，但特征随机易于完全重建。即使只有少量的树木也是如此。即使使用引导聚合，也可以重新构造大多数数据。这些发现强调了广泛采用的集合方法所固有的一个严重的脆弱性，值得注意和减轻。虽然隐私研究中已经讨论过这种重建攻击的可能性，但我们的研究为这种攻击的可行性提供了明确的经验证明。

title: PRSA: Prompt Reverse Stealing Attacks against Large Language Models
summary:
Prompt, recognized as crucial intellectual property, enables large language
models (LLMs) to perform specific tasks without the need of fine-tuning,
underscoring their escalating importance. With the rise of prompt-based
services, such as prompt marketplaces and LLM applications, providers often
display prompts' capabilities through input-output examples to attract users.
However, this paradigm raises a pivotal security concern: does the exposure of
input-output pairs pose the risk of potential prompt leakage, infringing on the
intellectual property rights of the developers? To our knowledge, this problem
still has not been comprehensively explored yet. To remedy this gap, in this
paper, we perform the first in depth exploration and propose a novel attack
framework for reverse-stealing prompts against commercial LLMs, namely PRSA.
The main idea of PRSA is that by analyzing the critical features of the
input-output pairs, we mimic and gradually infer (steal) the target prompts. In
detail, PRSA mainly consists of two key phases: prompt mutation and prompt
pruning. In the mutation phase, we propose a prompt attention algorithm based
on differential feedback to capture these critical features for effectively
inferring the target prompts. In the prompt pruning phase, we identify and mask
the words dependent on specific inputs, enabling the prompts to accommodate
diverse inputs for generalization. Through extensive evaluation, we verify that
PRSA poses a severe threat in real world scenarios. We have reported these
findings to prompt service providers and actively collaborate with them to take
protective measures for prompt copyright.
translated: 迅速，被认为是至关重要的知识产权，使大型语言模型(LLM)能够执行特定的任务而不需要进行微调，突出了它们不断升级的重要性。随着快速市场和 LLM 应用等基于提示的服务的兴起，提供商往往通过输入输出示例来展示提示的功能，以吸引用户。然而，这一范例引起了一个关键的安全问题: 投入产出对的暴露是否构成潜在的即时泄漏风险，侵犯开发商的知识产权？据我们所知，这个问题还没有得到全面的探讨。为了弥补这一缺陷，本文首先进行了深入的研究，提出了一种针对商业 LLM 的反向窃取提示的攻击框架，即 PRSA。PRSA 的主要思想是通过分析输入输出对的关键特征，模拟并逐步推断目标提示。具体而言，PRSA 主要包括两个关键阶段: 即时突变和及时修剪。在变异阶段，我们提出了一种基于差分反馈的提示注意算法来捕捉这些关键特征，从而有效地推断出目标提示。在提示修剪阶段，我们识别并屏蔽依赖于特定输入的单词，使提示符能够容纳不同的输入以便进行泛化。通过广泛的评估，我们验证了 PRSA 在现实世界情景中构成的严重威胁。我们报告了这些发现，以促进服务提供商，并积极与他们合作，以采取保护措施，促进版权。

title:
Rahmani Sort: A Novel Variant of Insertion Sort Algorithm with O(nlogn)
  Complexity
summary:
Various decision support systems are available that implement Data Mining and
Data Warehousing techniques for diving into the sea of data for getting useful
patterns of knowledge (pearls). Classification, regression, clustering, and
many other algorithms are used to enhance the precision and accuracy of the
decision process. So, there is scope for increasing the response time of the
decision process, especially in mission-critical operations. If data are
ordered with suitable and efficient sorting operation, the response time of the
decision process can be minimized. Insertion sort is much more suitable for
such applications due to its simple and straight logic along with its dynamic
nature suitable for list implementation. But it is slower than merge sort and
quick sort. The main reasons this is slow: firstly, a sequential search is used
to find the actual position of the next key element into the sorted left
subarray and secondly, shifting of elements is required by one position towards
the right for accommodating the newly inserted element. Therefore, I propose a
new algorithm by using a novel technique of binary search mechanism for finding
the sorted location of the next key item into the previously sorted left
subarray much quicker than the conventional insertion sort algorithm.
Performance measurement in terms of the actual running time of the new
algorithm has been compared with those of other conventional sorting algorithms
apart from the insertion sort. The results obtained on various sample data show
that the new algorithm is better in performance than the conventional insertion
sort and merge sort algorithms.
translated: 可以使用各种决策支持系统来实现数据挖掘和数据仓库技术，以便潜入数据海洋中获取有用的知识模式(珍珠)。分类、回归、聚类和许多其他算法被用来增强决策过程的准确与精密。因此，增加决策过程的响应时间是有余地的，特别是在关键任务的操作中。如果对数据进行排序，并进行适当有效的排序操作，则可以使决策过程的响应时间最小化。插入排序由于其简单直接的逻辑以及适合列表实现的动态特性而更适合这类应用程序。但它比合并排序和快速排序慢。这样做的主要原因是: 首先，使用一个线性搜索来确定下一个关键元素在排序后的左侧子数组中的实际位置; 其次，为了容纳新插入的元素，需要将元素向右移动一个位置。因此，本文提出了一种新的二进制搜索算法，该算法比传统的插入排序算法更快地找到已排序的左侧子阵中下一个关键项的排序位置。在实际运行时间方面的性能测量，新算法已经与其他传统的排序算法进行了比较，除了插入排序。对不同样本数据的实验结果表明，该算法比传统的插入排序和合并排序算法具有更好的性能。

title:
Security and Privacy Enhancing in Blockchain-based IoT Environments via
  Anonym Auditing
summary:
The integration of blockchain technology in Internet of Things (IoT)
environments is a revolutionary step towards ensuring robust security and
enhanced privacy. This paper delves into the unique challenges and solutions
associated with securing blockchain-based IoT systems, with a specific focus on
anonymous auditing to reinforce privacy and security. We propose a novel
framework that combines the decentralized nature of blockchain with advanced
security protocols tailored for IoT contexts. Central to our approach is the
implementation of anonymization techniques in auditing processes, ensuring user
privacy while maintaining the integrity and transparency of blockchain
transactions. We outline the architecture of blockchain in IoT environments,
emphasizing the workflow and specific security mechanisms employed.
Additionally, we introduce a security protocol that integrates
privacy-enhancing tools and anonymous auditing methods, including the use of
advanced cryptographic techniques for anonymity. This study also includes a
comparative analysis of our proposed framework against existing models in the
domain. Our work aims to provide a comprehensive blueprint for enhancing
security and privacy in blockchain-based IoT environments, paving the way for
more secure and private digital ecosystems.
translated: 物联网环境中区块链技术的集成是确保强大安全性和增强隐私性的革命性步骤。本文深入研究了与基于区块链的物联网系统安全相关的独特挑战和解决方案，特别侧重于加强隐私和安全的匿名审计。我们提出了一个新的框架，结合区块链的分散性质与先进的安全协议定制的物联网环境。我们的方法的核心是在审计过程中实现匿名化技术，确保用户隐私，同时保持区块链事务的完整性和透明度。我们概述了物联网环境中区块链的体系结构，强调了所采用的工作流和具体的安全机制。此外，我们还介绍了一个集成了隐私增强工具和匿名审计方法的安全协议，包括使用高级的匿名加密技术。本研究还包括对我们提出的框架与该领域现有模型的比较分析。我们的工作旨在为基于区块链的物联网环境中提高安全性和隐私性提供一个全面的蓝图，为更加安全和私有的数字生态系统铺平道路。

title: The legacy of Bletchley Park on UK mathematics
summary:
The second world war saw a major influx of mathematical talent into the areas
of cryptanalysis and cryptography. This was particularly true at the UK's
Government Codes and Cypher School (GCCS) at Bletchley Park. The success of
introducing mathematical thinking into activities previously dominated by
linguists is well-studied, but the reciprocal question of how the cryptologic
effort affected the field of mathematics has been less investigated. Although
their cryptologic achievements are not as celebrated as those of Turing, Tutte
and Welchman, Bletchley Park's effort was supplemented by more eminent
mathematicians, and those who would achieve eminence and provide leadership and
direction for mathematical research in the United Kingdom. Amongst their number
were Ian Cassels, Sandy Green, Philip Hall, Max Newman and Henry Whitehead.
This paper considers how the experience of these and other mathematicians at
Bletchley Park may have informed and influenced the mathematics that was
produced in their post-war careers.
translated: 第二次世界大战期间，大量数学人才涌入密码分析和密码学领域。在 Bletchley Park 的英国政府代码与密码学校(GCCS) ，情况尤其如此。将数学思维引入以前由语言学家主导的活动的成功已经得到了充分的研究，但是密码学努力如何影响数学领域这一相互关联的问题却很少得到研究。尽管他们的密码学成就没有图灵、塔特和韦尔奇曼那样受到赞誉，但布莱切利公园的努力得到了更多杰出数学家的支持，以及那些在英国取得卓越成就并为数学研究提供领导和指导的人的支持。他们中有伊恩 · 卡塞尔、桑迪 · 格林、菲利普 · 霍尔、马克斯 · 纽曼和亨利 · 怀特海德。这篇文章考虑了这些数学家以及 Bletchley Park 的其他数学家的经历可能对他们战后职业生涯中产生的数学产生了怎样的影响。

title:
A Photonic Physically Unclonable Function's Resilience to
  Multiple-Valued Machine Learning Attacks
summary:
Physically unclonable functions (PUFs) identify integrated circuits using
nonlinearly-related challenge-response pairs (CRPs). Ideally, the relationship
between challenges and corresponding responses is unpredictable, even if a
subset of CRPs is known. Previous work developed a photonic PUF offering
improved security compared to non-optical counterparts. Here, we investigate
this PUF's susceptibility to Multiple-Valued-Logic-based machine learning
attacks. We find that approximately 1,000 CRPs are necessary to train models
that predict response bits better than random chance. Given the significant
challenge of acquiring a vast number of CRPs from a photonic PUF, our results
demonstrate photonic PUF resilience against such attacks.
translated: 物理不可克隆函数(PUF)使用非线性相关的挑战-响应对(CRP)识别集成电路。理想情况下，挑战和相应反应之间的关系是不可预测的，即使 CRP 的一个子集是已知的。先前的工作开发了一种光子 PUF，与非光学对应物相比，它提供了更好的安全性。在这里，我们研究这个 PUF 对基于多值逻辑的机器学习攻击的敏感性。我们发现大约1000个 CRP 对于训练预测响应比特优于随机概率的模型是必要的。考虑到从光子 PUF 获取大量 CRP 的重大挑战，我们的结果表明光子 PUF 对这种攻击具有弹性。

title:
Characterizing Ethereum Upgradable Smart Contracts and Their Security
  Implications
summary:
Upgradeable smart contracts (USCs) have been widely adopted to enable
modifying deployed smart contracts. While USCs bring great flexibility to
developers, improper usage might introduce new security issues, potentially
allowing attackers to hijack USCs and their users. In this paper, we conduct a
large-scale measurement study to characterize USCs and their security
implications in the wild. We summarize six commonly used USC patterns and
develop a tool, USCDetector, to identify USCs without needing source code.
Particularly, USCDetector collects various information such as bytecode and
transaction information to construct upgrade chains for USCs and disclose
potentially vulnerable ones. We evaluate USCDetector using verified smart
contracts (i.e., with source code) as ground truth and show that USCDetector
can achieve high accuracy with a precision of 96.26%. We then use USCDetector
to conduct a large-scale study on Ethereum, covering a total of 60,251,064
smart contracts. USCDetecor constructs 10,218 upgrade chains and discloses
multiple real-world USCs with potential security issues.
translated: 可升级智能契约(USC)已被广泛采用，以便修改已部署的智能契约。虽然 USC 为开发人员带来了很大的灵活性，但是不当的使用可能会引入新的安全问题，潜在地允许攻击者劫持 USC 及其用户。在本文中，我们进行了一个大规模的测量研究，以表征 USC 及其在野外的安全意义。我们总结了六种常用的 USC 模式，并开发了一个工具 USCDetector，它可以在不需要源代码的情况下识别 USC。特别是，USCDetector 收集各种信息，如字节码和事务信息，为 USC 构建升级链，并披露潜在的脆弱信息。我们使用经过验证的智能合同(即源代码)作为地面真实度来评估 USC 探测器，结果表明 USC 探测器可以达到96.26% 的高精度。然后，我们使用 USCDetector 对以太坊进行大规模研究，共涉及60,251,064份智能合同。USCDetecor 构建了10,218个升级链，并公开了存在潜在安全问题的多个现实世界的 USC。

title: Employing LLMs for Incident Response Planning and Review
summary:
Incident Response Planning (IRP) is essential for effective cybersecurity
management, requiring detailed documentation (or playbooks) to guide security
personnel during incidents. Yet, creating comprehensive IRPs is often hindered
by challenges such as complex systems, high turnover rates, and legacy
technologies lacking documentation. This paper argues that, despite these
obstacles, the development, review, and refinement of IRPs can be significantly
enhanced through the utilization of Large Language Models (LLMs) like ChatGPT.
By leveraging LLMs for tasks such as drafting initial plans, suggesting best
practices, and identifying documentation gaps, organizations can overcome
resource constraints and improve their readiness for cybersecurity incidents.
We discuss the potential of LLMs to streamline IRP processes, while also
considering the limitations and the need for human oversight in ensuring the
accuracy and relevance of generated content. Our findings contribute to the
cybersecurity field by demonstrating a novel approach to enhancing IRP with AI
technologies, offering practical insights for organizations seeking to bolster
their incident response capabilities.
translated: 事故应变计划(IRP)对于有效的网络安全管理是必不可少的，需要详细的文档(或剧本)来指导安全人员在事故发生期间。然而，创建全面的 IRP 常常受到诸如复杂系统、高周转率和缺乏文档的遗留技术等挑战的阻碍。本文认为，尽管存在这些障碍，但是通过使用大型语言模型(LLM) ，如 ChatGPT，可以显著提高 IRP 的开发、评审和改进。通过利用 LLM 完成起草初始计划、提出最佳实践建议以及确定文档差距等任务，组织可以克服资源限制并提高其应对网络安全事件的准备状态。我们讨论 LLM 在简化 IRP 流程方面的潜力，同时也考虑到在确保生成内容的准确性和相关性方面的局限性和人为监督的必要性。我们的研究结果为网络安全领域做出了贡献，展示了一种利用人工智能技术加强 IRP 的新方法，为寻求加强其事件应对能力的组织提供了实用的见解。

title:
Defending Against Data Reconstruction Attacks in Federated Learning: An
  Information Theory Approach
summary:
Federated Learning (FL) trains a black-box and high-dimensional model among
different clients by exchanging parameters instead of direct data sharing,
which mitigates the privacy leak incurred by machine learning. However, FL
still suffers from membership inference attacks (MIA) or data reconstruction
attacks (DRA). In particular, an attacker can extract the information from
local datasets by constructing DRA, which cannot be effectively throttled by
existing techniques, e.g., Differential Privacy (DP).
  In this paper, we aim to ensure a strong privacy guarantee for FL under DRA.
We prove that reconstruction errors under DRA are constrained by the
information acquired by an attacker, which means that constraining the
transmitted information can effectively throttle DRA. To quantify the
information leakage incurred by FL, we establish a channel model, which depends
on the upper bound of joint mutual information between the local dataset and
multiple transmitted parameters. Moreover, the channel model indicates that the
transmitted information can be constrained through data space operation, which
can improve training efficiency and the model accuracy under constrained
information. According to the channel model, we propose algorithms to constrain
the information transmitted in a single round of local training. With a limited
number of training rounds, the algorithms ensure that the total amount of
transmitted information is limited. Furthermore, our channel model can be
applied to various privacy-enhancing techniques (such as DP) to enhance privacy
guarantees against DRA. Extensive experiments with real-world datasets validate
the effectiveness of our methods.
translated: 联邦学习通过交换参数代替直接数据共享，在不同客户端之间建立一个黑盒高维模型，减少了机器学习引起的隐私泄漏。然而，FL 仍然遭受成员推理攻击(MIA)或数据重构攻击(DRA)。特别是，攻击者可以通过构建 DRA 从本地数据集中提取信息，而现有的技术(如差分隐私(DP))无法有效地抑制 DRA。在本文中，我们的目标是确保一个强大的隐私保证 FL 在 DRA 下。我们证明了 DRA 下的重构错误受到攻击者获得的信息的约束，这意味着约束传输的信息可以有效地抑制 DRA。为了量化 FL 引起的信息泄露，我们建立了一个信道模型，该模型依赖于本地数据集和多个传输参数之间的联合互信息的上界。此外，信道模型表明，通过数据空间操作可以对传输的信息进行约束，从而提高了在约束信息下的训练效率和模型精度。根据信道模型，提出了局部训练中约束信息传输的算法。该算法通过有限的训练周期，确保传输的信息总量是有限的。此外，我们的信道模型可以应用于各种隐私增强技术(如 DP) ，以增强针对 DRA 的隐私保护。大量的实验与真实世界的数据集验证了我们的方法的有效性。

title:
Inexact Unlearning Needs More Careful Evaluations to Avoid a False Sense
  of Privacy
summary:
The high cost of model training makes it increasingly desirable to develop
techniques for unlearning. These techniques seek to remove the influence of a
training example without having to retrain the model from scratch. Intuitively,
once a model has unlearned, an adversary that interacts with the model should
no longer be able to tell whether the unlearned example was included in the
model's training set or not. In the privacy literature, this is known as
membership inference. In this work, we discuss adaptations of Membership
Inference Attacks (MIAs) to the setting of unlearning (leading to their
``U-MIA'' counterparts). We propose a categorization of existing U-MIAs into
``population U-MIAs'', where the same attacker is instantiated for all
examples, and ``per-example U-MIAs'', where a dedicated attacker is
instantiated for each example. We show that the latter category, wherein the
attacker tailors its membership prediction to each example under attack, is
significantly stronger. Indeed, our results show that the commonly used U-MIAs
in the unlearning literature overestimate the privacy protection afforded by
existing unlearning techniques on both vision and language models. Our
investigation reveals a large variance in the vulnerability of different
examples to per-example U-MIAs. In fact, several unlearning algorithms lead to
a reduced vulnerability for some, but not all, examples that we wish to
unlearn, at the expense of increasing it for other examples. Notably, we find
that the privacy protection for the remaining training examples may worsen as a
consequence of unlearning. We also discuss the fundamental difficulty of
equally protecting all examples using existing unlearning schemes, due to the
different rates at which examples are unlearned. We demonstrate that naive
attempts at tailoring unlearning stopping criteria to different examples fail
to alleviate these issues.
translated: 模型培训的高成本使得开发忘却学习的技术变得越来越可取。这些技术试图消除训练示例的影响，而不必从头开始重新训练模型。直观地说，一旦一个模型失去学习能力，与该模型交互的对手就不再能够判断该失去学习能力的例子是否包含在该模型的训练集中。在隐私文献中，这被称为成员推断。在这项工作中，我们讨论适应成员推理攻击(MIAs)的设置忘却(导致他们的“ U-MIA”对应物)。我们建议将现有的 U-MIA 分为“人口 U-MIA”(为所有示例实例化相同的攻击者)和“每个示例 U-MIA”(为每个示例实例化专门的攻击者)。我们展示了后一种类别，其中攻击者根据受到攻击的每个示例调整其成员资格预测，这种类别明显更强。实际上，我们的研究结果表明，在非学习文献中常用的 U-MIA 高估了现有的非学习技术在视觉和语言模型上提供的隐私保护。我们的研究揭示了不同实例对单个实例 U-MIA 的脆弱性存在很大的差异。事实上，一些忘记算法可以减少我们希望忘记的一些示例(但不是全部)的漏洞，代价是增加其他示例的漏洞。值得注意的是，我们发现，其余的训练例子的隐私保护可能会因为忘记而恶化。我们还讨论了基本的困难，平等地保护所有的例子使用现有的忘记方案，由于不同的比率，例子是忘记。我们证明，根据不同的例子调整非学习停止标准的幼稚尝试未能缓解这些问题。

title:
Efficient Algorithm Level Error Detection for Number-Theoretic Transform
  Assessed on FPGAs
summary:
Polynomial multiplication stands out as a highly demanding arithmetic process
in the development of post-quantum cryptosystems. The importance of
number-theoretic transform (NTT) extends beyond post-quantum cryptosystems,
proving valuable in enhancing existing security protocols such as digital
signature schemes and hash functions. Due to the potential for errors to
significantly disrupt the operation of secure, cryptographically-protected
systems, compromising data integrity, and safeguarding against side-channel
attacks initiated through faults it is essential to incorporate mitigating
error detection schemes. This paper introduces algorithm level fault detection
schemes in NTT multiplication, representing a significant enhancement compared
to previous research. We evaluate this through the simulation of a fault model,
ensuring that the conducted assessments accurately mirror the obtained results.
Consequently, we attain a notably comprehensive coverage of errors. Finally, we
assess the performance of our efficient error detection scheme on FPGAs to
showcase its implementation and resource requirements. Through implementation
of our error detection approach on Xilinx/AMD Zynq Ultrascale+ and Artix-7, we
achieve a comparable throughput with just a 9% increase in area and 13%
increase in latency compared to the original hardware implementations.
translated: 多项式乘法是后量子密码体制发展过程中一个要求很高的算术过程。数论变换(NTT)的重要性已经超越了后量子密码体制，在增强现有的安全协议(如数字签名方案和哈希函数)方面证明了它的价值。由于错误有可能严重破坏安全的、加密保护的系统的运行，损害数据完整性，并防止通过故障发起的侧信道攻击，因此必须采用减轻错误检测方案。本文介绍了 NTT 乘法中的算法级故障检测方案，与以往的研究相比有了显著的提高。我们通过一个故障模型的模拟来评估这一点，确保所进行的评估准确地反映所得到的结果。因此，我们获得了一个显着的全面的错误覆盖。最后，我们在 FPGA 上评估了我们有效的错误检测方案的性能，以展示其实现和资源需求。通过在 Xilinx/AMD Zynq supercale + 和 Artix-7上实现我们的错误检测方法，与原始硬件实现相比，我们只增加了9% 的面积和13% 的延迟，实现了可比的吞吐量。

title: Evault for legal records
summary:
Innovative solution for addressing the challenges in the legal records
management system through a blockchain-based eVault platform. Our objective is
to create a secure, transparent, and accessible ecosystem that caters to the
needs of all stakeholders, including lawyers, judges, clients, and registrars.
First and foremost, our solution is built on a robust blockchain platform like
Ethereum harnessing the power of smart contracts to manage access, permissions,
and transactions effectively. This ensures the utmost security and transparency
in every interaction within the system. To make our eVault system
user-friendly, we've developed intuitive interfaces for all stakeholders.
Lawyers, judges, clients, and even registrars can effortlessly upload and
retrieve legal documents, track changes, and share information within the
platform. But that's not all; we've gone a step further by incorporating a
document creation and saving feature within our app and website. This feature
allows users to generate and securely store legal documents, streamlining the
entire documentation process.
translated: 通过基于区块链的 eVault 平台应对法律记录管理系统挑战的创新解决方案。我们的目标是创建一个安全、透明和可访问的生态系统，满足所有利益相关者的需求，包括律师、法官、客户和注册人员。首先，我们的解决方案是建立在一个健壮的区块链平台上的，比如 Etherum，它利用智能契约的力量来有效地管理访问、权限和事务。这确保了系统内每个交互的最大安全性和透明度。为了使我们的 eVault 系统对用户友好，我们为所有涉众开发了直观的界面。律师、法官、客户，甚至登记员都可以轻松地上传和检索法律文件，跟踪变化，并在平台内共享信息。但这还不是全部; 我们已经更进一步，在我们的应用程序和网站中加入了文档创建和保存功能。这个特性允许用户生成和安全地存储法律文档，简化了整个文档处理过程。

title:
d-DSE: Distinct Dynamic Searchable Encryption Resisting Volume Leakage
  in Encrypted Databases
summary:
Dynamic Searchable Encryption (DSE) has emerged as a solution to efficiently
handle and protect large-scale data storage in encrypted databases (EDBs).
Volume leakage poses a significant threat, as it enables adversaries to
reconstruct search queries and potentially compromise the security and privacy
of data. Padding strategies are common countermeasures for the leakage, but
they significantly increase storage and communication costs. In this work, we
develop a new perspective to handle volume leakage. We start with distinct
search and further explore a new concept called \textit{distinct} DSE
(\textit{d}-DSE).
  We also define new security notions, in particular Distinct with
Volume-Hiding security, as well as forward and backward privacy, for the new
concept. Based on \textit{d}-DSE, we construct the \textit{d}-DSE designed EDB
with related constructions for distinct keyword (d-KW-\textit{d}DSE), keyword
(KW-\textit{d}DSE), and join queries (JOIN-\textit{d}DSE) and update queries in
encrypted databases. We instantiate a concrete scheme \textsf{BF-SRE},
employing Symmetric Revocable Encryption. We conduct extensive experiments on
real-world datasets, such as Crime, Wikipedia, and Enron, for performance
evaluation. The results demonstrate that our scheme is practical in data search
and with comparable computational performance to the SOTA DSE scheme
(\textsf{MITRA}*, \textsf{AURA}) and padding strategies (\textsf{SEAL},
\textsf{ShieldDB}). Furthermore, our proposal sharply reduces the communication
cost as compared to padding strategies, with roughly 6.36 to 53.14x advantage
for search queries.
translated: 动态可搜索加密(DSE)已经成为一种有效处理和保护加密数据库(EDB)中大规模数据存储的解决方案。容量泄漏构成重大威胁，因为它使对手能够重建搜索查询，并可能损害数据的安全性和隐私性。填充策略是防止泄漏的常用对策，但它们会显著增加存储和通信成本。在这项工作中，我们开发了一个新的角度来处理体积泄漏。我们从不同的搜索开始，进一步探索一个新的概念，称为 textit { different } DSE (textit { d }-DSE)。我们还为这个新概念定义了新的安全性概念，特别是区分卷隐藏安全性以及向前和向后隐私。在文本{ d }-DSE 的基础上，构造了文本{ d }-DSE 设计的数据库，并对不同的关键字(d-KW-textit { d } DSE)、关键字(KW-textit { d } DSE)、连接查询(JOIN-textit { d } DSE)和加密数据库中的更新查询进行了相关构造。我们实例化了一个具体的方案 textsf { BF-SRE } ，采用对称可撤消加密。我们在真实世界的数据集上进行广泛的实验，比如犯罪、维基百科和安然，以进行性能评估。实验结果表明，该方案在数据搜索方面是可行的，其计算性能与 SOTA DSE 方案(textsf { MITRA } * ，textsf { AURA })和填充策略(textsf { SEAL } ，textsf { ShieldDB })相当。此外，与填充策略相比，我们的提议大大降低了通信成本，搜索查询的优势大约为6.36到53.14倍。

title:
Robust Federated Learning Mitigates Client-side Training Data
  Distribution Inference Attacks
summary:
Recent studies have revealed that federated learning (FL), once considered
secure due to clients not sharing their private data with the server, is
vulnerable to attacks such as client-side training data distribution inference,
where a malicious client can recreate the victim's data. While various
countermeasures exist, they are not practical, often assuming server access to
some training data or knowledge of label distribution before the attack.
  In this work, we bridge the gap by proposing InferGuard, a novel
Byzantine-robust aggregation rule aimed at defending against client-side
training data distribution inference attacks. In our proposed InferGuard, the
server first calculates the coordinate-wise median of all the model updates it
receives. A client's model update is considered malicious if it significantly
deviates from the computed median update. We conduct a thorough evaluation of
our proposed InferGuard on five benchmark datasets and perform a comparison
with ten baseline methods. The results of our experiments indicate that our
defense mechanism is highly effective in protecting against client-side
training data distribution inference attacks, even against strong adaptive
attacks. Furthermore, our method substantially outperforms the baseline methods
in various practical FL scenarios.
translated: 最近的研究表明，联邦学习(FL) ，一度被认为是安全的，因为客户端不与服务器共享他们的私人数据，容易受到攻击，如客户端训练数据分布推断，其中一个恶意的客户端可以重建受害者的数据。虽然存在各种对策，但它们并不实用，通常假设服务器在攻击之前访问一些训练数据或标签分发的知识。在这项工作中，我们通过提出一种新的拜占庭-鲁棒聚合规则，旨在防御客户端训练数据分布推理攻击，从而弥补了差距。在我们提出的“狱警”中，服务器首先计算它接收到的所有模型更新的坐标中值。如果客户端的模型更新严重偏离计算出的中位数更新，则该更新被认为是恶意的。我们进行了一个彻底的评估，我们提出了五个基准数据集的推论，并与十个基准方法进行了比较。实验结果表明，该防御机制能够有效地抵御客户端的训练数据分布推理攻击，甚至能够抵御强自适应攻击。此外，我们的方法在各种实际 FL 场景中大大优于基线方法。

title: Design of Stochastic Quantizers for Privacy Preservation
summary:
In this paper, we examine the role of stochastic quantizers for privacy
preservation. We first employ a static stochastic quantizer and investigate its
corresponding privacy-preserving properties. Specifically, we demonstrate that
a sufficiently large quantization step guarantees $(0, \delta)$ differential
privacy. Additionally, the degradation of control performance caused by
quantization is evaluated as the tracking error of output regulation. These two
analyses characterize the trade-off between privacy and control performance,
determined by the quantization step. This insight enables us to use
quantization intentionally as a means to achieve the seemingly conflicting two
goals of maintaining control performance and preserving privacy at the same
time; towards this end, we further investigate a dynamic stochastic quantizer.
Under a stability assumption, the dynamic stochastic quantizer can enhance
privacy, more than the static one, while achieving the same control
performance. We further handle the unstable case by additionally applying input
Gaussian noise.
translated: 本文研究了随机量化器在隐私保护中的作用。我们首先采用静态随机量化器，并研究其相应的隐私保护性质。具体来说，我们证明了一个足够大量化步骤可以保证 $(0，delta) $差分隐私。另外，将量化引起的控制性能下降作为输出调节的跟踪误差进行了评估。这两个分析描述了隐私权和控制性能之间的权衡，由量化步骤决定。这种洞察力使我们能够有意地使用量化作为一种手段来实现看似矛盾的两个目标，即同时保持控制性能和保护隐私; 为此，我们进一步研究了一个动态随机量化器。在稳定性假设下，动态随机量化器可以比静态量化器更好地保护隐私，同时获得相同的控制性能。我们进一步处理不稳定的情况，另外应用输入高斯噪声。

title:
Mitigating Label Flipping Attacks in Malicious URL Detectors Using
  Ensemble Trees
summary:
