translated: 本文主要研究利用稀疏表示技术改进单类支持向量机(OC-SVM)的无监督异常检测。由于字典学习(Dictionary Learning，DL)最近成为揭示隐藏稀疏数据模式的常用分析技术，我们的方法利用这种洞察力赋予无监督检测更多的模式发现和维度控制。我们引入了一个新的异常检测模型，它将 OC-SVM 和 DL 残差函数统一为一个单一的复合目标，然后通过 K-SVD 型迭代算法求解。针对新的组合模型，明确地导出了交替 K-SVD 迭代的一种封闭形式，并讨论了实际可行的方案。标准的 DL 模型适用于字典对学习(Dictionary Pair Learning，DPL)环境，在这种环境中，通常的稀疏约束会自然消除。最后，我们将这两个目标扩展到允许使用内核函数的更一般的设置。给出了算法的经验收敛性质，并对算法的参数化进行了深入分析，同时与现有算法进行了比较，验证了算法的数值性能。

title:
From Theory to Comprehension: A Comparative Study of Differential
  Privacy and $k$-Anonymity
summary:
The notion of $\varepsilon$-differential privacy is a widely used concept of
providing quantifiable privacy to individuals. However, it is unclear how to
explain the level of privacy protection provided by a differential privacy
mechanism with a set $\varepsilon$. In this study, we focus on users'
comprehension of the privacy protection provided by a differential privacy
mechanism. To do so, we study three variants of explaining the privacy
protection provided by differential privacy: (1) the original mathematical
definition; (2) $\varepsilon$ translated into a specific privacy risk; and (3)
an explanation using the randomized response technique. We compare users'
comprehension of privacy protection employing these explanatory models with
their comprehension of privacy protection of $k$-anonymity as baseline
comprehensibility. Our findings suggest that participants' comprehension of
differential privacy protection is enhanced by the privacy risk model and the
randomized response-based model. Moreover, our results confirm our intuition
that privacy protection provided by $k$-anonymity is more comprehensible.
translated: $varepsilon $- 差分隐私是一个被广泛使用的概念，它为个人提供可量化的隐私。然而，目前还不清楚如何解释一个设置了 $varepsilon $的差分隐私机制所提供的隐私保护水平。在这项研究中，我们集中探讨使用者对差分隐私机制所提供的私隐保障的理解。为了做到这一点，我们研究了解释差分隐私提供的隐私保护的三种变体: (1)最初的数学定义; (2) $varepsilon $转化为特定的隐私风险; (3)使用随机化回答技术的解释。我们比较了使用这些解释性模型的用户对隐私保护的理解和使用 $k $- 匿名作为基线可理解性的用户对隐私保护的理解。我们的研究结果表明，参与者对差分隐私保护的理解可以通过隐私风险模型和随机回应模型得到加强。此外，我们的研究结果证实了我们的直觉，即 $k $- 匿名提供的隐私保护是更容易理解的。

title:
Case Study: Neural Network Malware Detection Verification for Feature
  and Image Datasets
summary:
Malware, or software designed with harmful intent, is an ever-evolving threat
that can have drastic effects on both individuals and institutions. Neural
network malware classification systems are key tools for combating these
threats but are vulnerable to adversarial machine learning attacks. These
attacks perturb input data to cause misclassification, bypassing protective
systems. Existing defenses often rely on enhancing the training process,
thereby increasing the model's robustness to these perturbations, which is
quantified using verification. While training improvements are necessary, we
propose focusing on the verification process used to evaluate improvements to
training. As such, we present a case study that evaluates a novel verification
domain that will help to ensure tangible safeguards against adversaries and
provide a more reliable means of evaluating the robustness and effectiveness of
anti-malware systems. To do so, we describe malware classification and two
types of common malware datasets (feature and image datasets), demonstrate the
certified robustness accuracy of malware classifiers using the Neural Network
Verification (NNV) and Neural Network Enumeration (nnenum) tools, and outline
the challenges and future considerations necessary for the improvement and
refinement of the verification of malware classification. By evaluating this
novel domain as a case study, we hope to increase its visibility, encourage
further research and scrutiny, and ultimately enhance the resilience of digital
systems against malicious attacks.
translated: 恶意软件，或设计有害意图的软件，是一个不断发展的威胁，可以对个人和机构产生巨大的影响。神经网络恶意软件分类系统是对付这些威胁的关键工具，但易受敌对机器学习攻击。这些攻击扰乱输入数据，造成错误分类，绕过保护系统。现有的防御通常依赖于增强训练过程，从而增加模型对这些扰动的鲁棒性，这是使用验证进行量化的。虽然培训改进是必要的，但我们建议侧重于用于评估培训改进情况的核查程序。因此，我们提出了一个案例研究，评估一个新的核查领域，这将有助于确保对抗对手的切实保障，并提供一个更可靠的手段来评估反恶意软件系统的健壮性和有效性。为此，我们描述了恶意软件分类和两种常见的恶意软件数据集(特征和图像数据集) ，使用神经网络验证(NNV)和神经网络枚举(nnenum)工具证明了恶意软件分类器的鲁棒性准确性，并概述了改进和完善恶意软件分类验证所需的挑战和未来的考虑。通过评估这个新领域作为一个案例研究，我们希望提高其可见性，鼓励进一步的研究和审查，并最终提高数字系统对恶意攻击的弹性。

title:
AI-Enabled System for Efficient and Effective Cyber Incident Detection
  and Response in Cloud Environments
summary:
The escalating sophistication and volume of cyber threats in cloud
environments necessitate a paradigm shift in strategies. Recognising the need
for an automated and precise response to cyber threats, this research explores
the application of AI and ML and proposes an AI-powered cyber incident response
system for cloud environments. This system, encompassing Network Traffic
Classification, Web Intrusion Detection, and post-incident Malware Analysis
(built as a Flask application), achieves seamless integration across platforms
like Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure. The findings from this research
highlight the effectiveness of the Random Forest model, achieving an accuracy
of 90% for the Network Traffic Classifier and 96% for the Malware Analysis Dual
Model application. Our research highlights the strengths of AI-powered cyber
security. The Random Forest model excels at classifying cyber threats, offering
an efficient and robust solution. Deep learning models significantly improve
accuracy, and their resource demands can be managed using cloud-based TPUs and
GPUs. Cloud environments themselves provide a perfect platform for hosting
these AI/ML systems, while container technology ensures both efficiency and
scalability. These findings demonstrate the contribution of the AI-led system
in guaranteeing a robust and scalable cyber incident response solution in the
cloud.
translated: 云环境中不断升级的网络威胁的复杂程度和数量需要战略的范式转变。认识到对网络威胁的自动化和精确响应的必要性，本研究探索了人工智能和机器学习的应用，并提出了一个以人工智能为动力的云环境网络事件响应系统。该系统包括网络流量分类、网络入侵检测和事件后恶意软件分析(作为 Flask 应用程序构建) ，实现了跨 Google Cloud 和 Microsoft Azure 等平台的无缝集成。研究结果突出了随机森林模型的有效性，对网络流量分类器的准确率达到90% ，对恶意软件分析双模型应用的准确率达到96% 。我们的研究强调了人工智能驱动的网络安全的优势。随机森林模型擅长于对网络威胁进行分类，提供了一个有效和健壮的解决方案。深度学习模型显著提高了准确性，并且它们的资源需求可以使用基于云的 TPU 和 GPU 进行管理。云环境本身为托管这些 AI/ML 系统提供了一个完美的平台，而容器技术确保了效率和可伸缩性。这些发现证明了人工智能主导的系统在保证云端的强大和可扩展的网络事件响应解决方案方面的贡献。

title: Hook-in Privacy Techniques for gRPC-based Microservice Communication
summary:
gRPC is at the heart of modern distributed system architectures. Based on
HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, it provides highly performant, standardized, and
polyglot communication across loosely coupled microservices and is increasingly
preferred over REST- or GraphQL-based service APIs in practice. Despite its
widespread adoption, gRPC lacks any advanced privacy techniques beyond
transport encryption and basic token-based authentication. Such advanced
techniques are, however, increasingly important for fulfilling regulatory
requirements. For instance, anonymizing or otherwise minimizing (personal) data
before responding to requests, or pre-processing data based on the purpose of
the access may be crucial in certain usecases. In this paper, we therefore
propose a novel approach for integrating such advanced privacy techniques into
the gRPC framework in a practically viable way. Specifically, we present a
general approach along with a working prototype that implements privacy
techniques, such as data minimization and purpose limitation, in a
configurable, extensible, and gRPC-native way utilizing a gRPC interceptor. We
also showcase how to integrate this contribution into a realistic example of a
food delivery use case. Alongside these implementations, a preliminary
performance evaluation shows practical applicability with reasonable overheads.
Altogether, we present a viable solution for integrating advanced privacy
techniques into real-world gRPC-based microservice architectures, thereby
facilitating regulatory compliance ``by design''.
translated: GRPC 是现代分布式系统架构的核心。基于 HTTP/2和协议缓冲，它在松散耦合的微服务之间提供了高性能、标准化和多语言的通信，并且在实践中越来越优于基于 REST 或 GraphQL 的服务 API。尽管 gRPC 被广泛采用，但除了传输加密和基于令牌的认证之外，它缺乏任何先进的隐私技术。然而，这种先进的技术对于满足监管要求越来越重要。例如，在响应请求之前匿名或以其他方式最小化(个人)数据，或基于访问目的预处理数据在某些用例中可能是至关重要的。因此，在本文中，我们提出了一种新的方法，以实际可行的方式将这种先进的隐私技术集成到 gRPC 框架中。具体来说，我们提出了一种通用的方法和一个工作原型，该原型利用 gRPC 拦截器以可配置、可扩展和 gRPC 本机的方式实现隐私技术，例如数据最小化和用途限制。我们还展示了如何将这一贡献集成到一个食品配送用例的现实例子中。除了这些实现，初步的性能评估显示了实际的适用性和合理的开销。总之，我们提出了一个可行的解决方案，将先进的隐私技术集成到现实世界的基于 gRPC 的微服务架构，从而促进守规的“设计”。

title: Best-of-Venom: Attacking RLHF by Injecting Poisoned Preference Data
summary:
Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) is a popular method for
aligning Language Models (LM) with human values and preferences. RLHF requires
a large number of preference pairs as training data, which are often used in
both the Supervised Fine-Tuning and Reward Model training, and therefore
publicly available datasets are commonly used. In this work, we study to what
extent a malicious actor can manipulate the LMs generations by poisoning the
preferences, i.e., injecting poisonous preference pairs into these datasets and
the RLHF training process. We propose strategies to build poisonous preference
pairs and test their performance by poisoning two widely used preference
datasets. Our results show that preference poisoning is highly effective: by
injecting a small amount of poisonous data (1-5% of the original dataset), we
can effectively manipulate the LM to generate a target entity in a target
sentiment (positive or negative). The findings from our experiments also shed
light on strategies to defend against the preference poisoning attack.
translated: 人类反馈的强化学习是一种将语言模型与人类价值观和偏好联系起来的流行方法。RLHF 需要大量的偏好对作为训练数据，这些数据经常被用于监督微调和奖励模型训练，因此公开可用的数据集是常用的。在这项工作中，我们研究在什么程度上恶意行为者可以操纵的 LM 代中毒的偏好，即注入有毒的偏好对到这些数据集和 RLHF 训练过程。我们提出了建立有毒偏好对的策略，并通过毒害两个广泛使用的偏好数据集来测试它们的性能。我们的研究结果表明，偏好中毒是非常有效的: 通过注入少量有毒数据(原始数据集的1-5%) ，我们可以有效地操纵 LM 以在目标情绪(正面或负面)中生成目标实体。我们的实验结果也阐明了抵御偏好中毒攻击的策略。

title: Simplifying MBA Expression Using E-Graphs
summary:
Code obfuscation involves the addition of meaningless code or the
complication of existing code in order to make a program difficult to reverse
engineer. In recent years, MBA (Mixed Boolean Arithmetic) obfuscation has been
applied to virus and malware code to impede expert analysis. Among the various
obfuscation techniques, Mixed Boolean Arithmetic (MBA) obfuscation is
considered the most challenging to decipher using existing code deobfuscation
techniques. In this paper, we have attempted to simplify the MBA expression. We
use an e-graph data structure to efficiently hold multiple expressions of the
same semantics to systematically rewrite terms and find simpler expressions.
The preliminary experimental result shows that our e-graph based MBA
deobfuscation approach works faster with reasonable performance than other
approaches do.
translated: 代码混淆包括添加无意义的代码或现有代码的复杂性，以使程序难以逆向工程。近年来，MBA (混合布尔算法)模糊处理已被应用于病毒和恶意代码，以阻碍专家分析。在各种模糊处理技术中，混合布尔算法(MBA)模糊处理被认为是使用现有的代码解模糊处理技术最具挑战性的。在本文中，我们试图简化 MBA 的表达式。我们使用一个电子图数据结构来有效地保存相同语义的多个表达式，从而系统地重写术语并找到更简单的表达式。初步实验结果表明，本文提出的基于电子图的 MBA 解模糊方法比其他方法具有更快的解模糊速度和更好的解模糊性能。

title: SoK: Gradient Leakage in Federated Learning
summary:
Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training among multiple
clients without raw data exposure. However, recent studies have shown that
clients' private training data can be reconstructed from the gradients they
share in FL, known as gradient inversion attacks (GIAs). While GIAs have
demonstrated effectiveness under \emph{ideal settings and auxiliary
assumptions}, their actual efficacy against \emph{practical FL systems} remains
under-explored. To address this gap, we conduct a comprehensive study on GIAs
in this work. We start with a survey of GIAs that establishes a milestone to
trace their evolution and develops a systematization to uncover their inherent
threats. Specifically, we categorize the auxiliary assumptions used by existing
GIAs based on their practical accessibility to potential adversaries. To
facilitate deeper analysis, we highlight the challenges that GIAs face in
practical FL systems from three perspectives: \textit{local training},
\textit{model}, and \textit{post-processing}. We then perform extensive
theoretical and empirical evaluations of state-of-the-art GIAs across diverse
settings, utilizing eight datasets and thirteen models. Our findings indicate
that GIAs have inherent limitations when reconstructing data under practical
local training settings. Furthermore, their efficacy is sensitive to the
trained model, and even simple post-processing measures applied to gradients
can be effective defenses. Overall, our work provides crucial insights into the
limited effectiveness of GIAs in practical FL systems. By rectifying prior
misconceptions, we hope to inspire more accurate and realistic investigations
on this topic.
translated: 联合学习(FL)能够在不暴露原始数据的情况下在多个客户之间进行协作模型培训。然而，最近的研究表明，客户的私人训练数据可以重建他们共享的梯度在外语，被称为梯度反演攻击(GIA)。尽管 GIA 已经在理想设置和辅助假设下证明了其有效性，但它们对实际 FL 系统的实际有效性仍然没有得到充分的探索。为了弥补这一差距，我们在这项工作中对 GIA 进行了全面的研究。我们首先对 GIA 进行调查，确立一个里程碑，以追踪其演变，并发展一个系统化，以揭示其内在威胁。具体来说，我们根据现有 GIA 对潜在对手的实际可及性，对其使用的辅助假设进行分类。为了便于更深入的分析，我们从三个角度强调了 GIA 在实际外语系统中面临的挑战: texttit { local training }、 texttit { model }和 texttit { post-process }。然后，我们利用8个数据集和十三个模型，在不同的环境下对最先进的 gia 进行广泛的理论和实证评估。我们的研究结果表明，GIA 在实际的局部训练环境下重建数据时存在固有的局限性。此外，他们的效率是敏感的训练模型，甚至简单的后处理措施适用于梯度可以有效的防御。总的来说，我们的工作为 GIA 在实际 FL 系统中的有限效率提供了重要的见解。通过纠正以往的错误观念，我们希望能够激发对这一主题更加准确和现实的调查。

title:
Optimal Controller Realizations against False Data Injections in
  Cooperative Driving
summary:
To enhance the robustness of cooperative driving to cyberattacks, we study a
controller-oriented approach to mitigate the effect of a class of False-Data
Injection (FDI) attacks. By reformulating a given dynamic Cooperative Adaptive
Cruise Control (CACC) scheme (the base controller), we recognize that the base
controller can be represented by a class of new but equivalent controllers
(base controller realizations) that exhibits the same platooning behavior with
varying robustness in the presence of attacks. We propose a prescriptive
synthesis framework where the base controller and the system dynamics are
written in new coordinates via an invertible coordinate transformation on the
controller state. Because the input-output behavior is invariant under
coordinate transformations, the input-output behavior is unaffected (so
controller realizations do not change the system's closed-loop performance).
However, each base controller realization may require a different combination
of sensors. To this end, we obtain the optimal combination of sensors that
minimizes the effect of FDI attacks by solving a Linear Matrix Inequality
(LMI), while quantifying the FDI's attack impact through reachability analysis.
Through simulation studies, we demonstrate that this approach enhances the
robustness of cooperative driving, without relying on a detection scheme and
maintaining all system properties.
translated: 为了提高协同驱动对网络攻击的鲁棒性，本文研究了一种面向控制器的方法来缓解一类虚假数据注入(FDI)攻击的影响。通过重新构造给定的动态协同自适应巡航控制(CACC)方案(基本控制器) ，我们认识到基本控制器可以用一类新的但等价的控制器(基本控制器实现)来表示，这类控制器在攻击存在的情况下表现出相同的排队行为和不同的鲁棒性。我们提出了一个规定的综合框架，其中的基础控制器和系统动力学是写在新的坐标通过可逆坐标变换的控制器状态。因为输入输出行为在坐标变换下是不变的，所以输入输出行为不受影响(所以控制器的实现不会改变系统的闭环性能)。但是，每个基本控制器的实现可能需要不同的传感器组合。为达到这个目的，我们通过求解一个线性矩阵不等式(LMI)来获得最佳的传感器组合，从而最小化外国直接投资攻击的影响，同时通过可达性分析来量化外国直接投资的攻击影响。通过仿真研究表明，该方法在不依赖检测方案和保持所有系统特性的情况下，提高了协同驱动的鲁棒性。

title:
Certified PEFTSmoothing: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Randomized
  Smoothing
summary:
Randomized smoothing is the primary certified robustness method for accessing
the robustness of deep learning models to adversarial perturbations in the
l2-norm, by adding isotropic Gaussian noise to the input image and returning
the majority votes over the base classifier. Theoretically, it provides a
certified norm bound, ensuring predictions of adversarial examples are stable
within this bound. A notable constraint limiting widespread adoption is the
necessity to retrain base models entirely from scratch to attain a robust
version. This is because the base model fails to learn the noise-augmented data
distribution to give an accurate vote. One intuitive way to overcome this
challenge is to involve a custom-trained denoiser to eliminate the noise.
However, this approach is inefficient and sub-optimal. Inspired by recent large
model training procedures, we explore an alternative way named PEFTSmoothing to
adapt the base model to learn the Gaussian noise-augmented data with
Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods in both white-box and black-box
settings. Extensive results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of
PEFTSmoothing, which allow us to certify over 98% accuracy for ViT on CIFAR-10,
20% higher than SoTA denoised smoothing, and over 61% accuracy on ImageNet
which is 30% higher than CNN-based denoiser and comparable to the
Diffusion-based denoiser.
translated: 随机平滑是通过在输入图像中加入各向同性高斯噪声并返回基本分类器上的大多数选票来获得深度学习模型对12范数的对抗性扰动的鲁棒性的主要经过验证的鲁棒性方法。理论上，它提供了一个认证的范数界限，确保对抗性例子的预测在这个界限内是稳定的。限制广泛采用的一个显著约束是，必须从头开始重新训练基本模型，以获得一个健壮的版本。这是因为基本模型没有学习噪声增强的数据分布来给出一个准确的投票。克服这一挑战的一个直观的方法是使用一个定制训练的去噪器来消除噪声。然而，这种方法是低效的和次优的。受最近大型模型训练程序的启发，我们探索了一种替代方法，即 PEFT 平滑法，以适应基本模型学习高斯噪声增强数据的参数有效微调(PEFT)方法在白盒和黑盒设置。大量的结果证明了 PEFTSmoothing 的有效性和效率，这使我们能够证明 CIFAR-10上 ViT 的准确性超过98% ，比 SoTA 去噪平滑高20% ，在 ImageNet 上超过61% 的准确性比基于 CNN 的去噪器高30% ，与基于漫射的去噪器相当。

title: Reflected Search Poisoning for Illicit Promotion
summary:
As an emerging black hat search engine optimization (SEO) technique,
reflected search poisoning (RSP) allows a miscreant to free-ride the reputation
of high-ranking websites, poisoning search engines with illicit promotion texts
(IPTs) in an efficient and stealthy manner, while avoiding the burden of
continuous website compromise as required by traditional promotion infections.
However, little is known about the security implications of RSP, e.g., what
illicit promotion campaigns are being distributed by RSP, and to what extent
regular search users can be exposed to illicit promotion texts distributed by
RSP. In this study, we conduct the first security study on RSP-based illicit
promotion, which is made possible through an end-to-end methodology for
capturing, analyzing, and infiltrating IPTs. As a result, IPTs distributed via
RSP are found to be large-scale, continuously growing, and diverse in both
illicit categories and natural languages. Particularly, we have identified over
11 million distinct IPTs belonging to 14 different illicit categories, with
typical examples including drug trading, data theft, counterfeit goods, and
hacking services. Also, the underlying RSP cases have abused tens of thousands
of high-ranking websites, as well as extensively poisoning all four popular
search engines we studied, especially Google Search and Bing. Furthermore, it
is observed that benign search users are being exposed to IPTs at a concerning
extent. To facilitate interaction with potential customers (victim search
users), miscreants tend to embed various types of contacts in IPTs, especially
instant messaging accounts. Further infiltration of these IPT contacts reveals
that the underlying illicit campaigns are operated on a large scale. All these
findings highlight the negative security implications of IPTs and RSPs, and
thus call for more efforts to mitigate RSP-driven illicit promotion.
translated: 作为一种新兴的黑帽搜索引擎优化技术，反射式搜索中毒(RSP)允许恶棍搭上高排名网站的名声，以高效和隐秘的方式用非法推广文本(IPTs)毒害搜索引擎，同时避免了传统推广感染所要求的持续网站妥协的负担。然而，对于区域搜索引擎的安全影响知之甚少，例如，区域搜索引擎正在分发哪些非法促销活动，以及经常搜索用户在多大程度上可能接触到区域搜索引擎分发的非法促销文本。在这项研究中，我们对基于 RSP 的非法促销进行了首次安全性研究，这是通过一种端到端的方法来捕获、分析和渗透 IPT。因此，通过 RSP 分发的 IPT 被发现是大规模的，不断增长的，并且在非法类别和自然语言上都是多样化的。特别是，我们已经确定超过1100万不同的 IPT 属于14个不同的非法类别，典型的例子包括毒品交易，数据盗窃，假冒商品和黑客服务。此外，潜在的 RSP 案件已经滥用了成千上万的高排名网站，并广泛毒害了我们研究的所有四个流行的搜索引擎，特别是谷歌搜索和必应。此外，据观察，良性搜索用户正在接触 IPT 的程度令人担忧。为了促进与潜在客户(受害者搜索用户)的互动，歹徒往往会在 IPTs 中嵌入各种类型的联系人，尤其是即时通讯账户。进一步渗透投资和技术小组的这些联系表明，潜在的非法活动是大规模进行的。所有这些调查结果都突出表明了信息和通信技术及区域规划对安全的负面影响，因此需要作出更多努力，减少由区域规划驱动的非法宣传。

title: Automated Attack Synthesis for Constant Product Market Makers
summary:
Decentralized Finance enables many novel applications that were impossible in
traditional finances. However, it also introduces new types of vulnerabilities,
such as composability bugs. The composability bugs refer to issues that lead to
erroneous behaviors when multiple smart contracts operate together. One typical
example of composability bugs is those between token contracts and Constant
Product Market Makers (CPMM), the most widely used model for Decentralized
Exchanges. Since 2022, 23 exploits of such kind have resulted in a total loss
of 2.2M USD. BlockSec, a smart contract auditing company, once reported that
138 exploits of such kind occurred just in February 2023. We propose
CPMM-Exploiter, which automatically detects and generates end-to-end exploits
for CPMM composability bugs. Generating such end-to-end exploits is challenging
due to the large search space of multiple contracts and various fees involved
with financial services. To tackle this, we investigated real-world exploits
regarding these vulnerabilities and identified that they arise due to violating
two safety invariants. Based on this observation, we implemented
CPMM-Exploiter, a new grammar-based fuzzer targeting the detection of these
bugs. CPMM-Exploiter uses fuzzing to find transactions that break the
invariants. It then refines these transactions to make them profitable for the
attacker. We evaluated CPMM-Exploiter on two real-world exploit datasets.
CPMM-Exploiter obtained recalls of 0.91 and 0.89, respectively, while five
baselines achieved maximum recalls of 0.36 and 0.58, respectively. We further
evaluated CPMM-Exploiter by running it on the latest blocks of the Ethereum and
Binance networks. It successfully generated 18 new exploits, which can result
in 12.9K USD profit in total.
translated: 分散式金融使许多新颖的应用程序在传统金融中不可能实现。但是，它也引入了新类型的漏洞，比如可组合性错误。可组合性错误指的是当多个智能契约一起操作时导致错误行为的问题。可组合性错误的一个典型例子是令牌契约和固定产品市场庄家(Constant Product Market Makers，CPMM)之间的错误，CPMM 是分散交易所最广泛使用的模型。自2022.23年以来，这种类型的开发已经造成了220万美元的总损失。聪明的合同审计公司 BlockSec 曾报告说，仅在2023年2月就发生了138次此类漏洞。我们提出了 CPMM 开发程序，它自动检测并生成针对 CPMM 可组合性错误的端到端开发程序。由于搜索空间巨大，涉及多个合同和金融服务的各种费用，生成这种端到端的利用是具有挑战性的。为了解决这个问题，我们调查了关于这些漏洞的实际漏洞，并确定它们是由于违反了两个安全不变量而产生的。在此基础上，我们实现了一个新的基于语法的模糊检测器 CPMM-Developiter，目标是检测这些错误。CPMM-剥削程序使用 fuzzing 查找打破不变量的事务。然后对这些事务进行细化，使其对攻击者有利可图。我们在两个实际的开发数据集上评估了 CPMM 开发器。CPMM-剥削者得到的召回分别为0.91和0.89，而五个基线得到的最大召回分别为0.36和0.58。我们通过在以太网和比宁斯网络的最新块上运行它，进一步评估了 CPMM-剥削者。它成功地产生了18个新的利用，可以导致12.9 K 美元的利润总额。

title: Software-based Security Framework for Edge and Mobile IoT
summary:
With the proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices, ensuring secure
communications has become imperative. Due to their low cost and embedded
nature, many of these devices operate with computational and energy
constraints, neglecting the potential security vulnerabilities that they may
bring. This work-in-progress is focused on designing secure communication among
remote servers and embedded IoT devices to balance security robustness and
energy efficiency. The proposed approach uses lightweight cryptography,
optimizing device performance and security without overburdening their limited
resources. Our architecture stands out for integrating Edge servers and a
central Name Server, allowing secure and decentralized authentication and
efficient connection transitions between different Edge servers. This
architecture enhances the scalability of the IoT network and reduces the load
on each server, distributing the responsibility for authentication and key
management.
translated: 随着物联网(IoT)设备的普及，确保安全通信已成为当务之急。由于其低成本和嵌入式性质，许多这些设备在运行时受到计算和能量的限制，忽略了它们可能带来的潜在安全漏洞。这项工作的进展重点是设计安全通信之间的远程服务器和嵌入式物联网设备，以平衡安全健壮性和能源效率。该方法采用轻量级密码体制，在不增加有限资源负担的情况下优化设备性能和安全性。我们的体系结构集成了 Edge 服务器和中央 Name Server，允许在不同 Edge 服务器之间进行安全和分散的身份验证以及高效的连接转换。该体系结构增强了物联网的可扩展性，减轻了每台服务器的负载，分散了认证和密钥管理的责任。

title:
pfl-research: simulation framework for accelerating research in Private
  Federated Learning
summary:
Federated learning (FL) is an emerging machine learning (ML) training
paradigm where clients own their data and collaborate to train a global model,
without revealing any data to the server and other participants. Researchers
commonly perform experiments in a simulation environment to quickly iterate on
ideas. However, existing open-source tools do not offer the efficiency required
to simulate FL on larger and more realistic FL datasets. We introduce
pfl-research, a fast, modular, and easy-to-use Python framework for simulating
FL. It supports TensorFlow, PyTorch, and non-neural network models, and is
tightly integrated with state-of-the-art privacy algorithms. We study the speed
of open-source FL frameworks and show that pfl-research is 7-72$\times$ faster
than alternative open-source frameworks on common cross-device setups. Such
speedup will significantly boost the productivity of the FL research community
and enable testing hypotheses on realistic FL datasets that were previously too
resource intensive. We release a suite of benchmarks that evaluates an
algorithm's overall performance on a diverse set of realistic scenarios. The
code is available on GitHub at https://github.com/apple/pfl-research.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)是一种新兴的机器学习(ML)训练模式，客户拥有自己的数据并协作训练一个全局模型，而不向服务器和其他参与者透露任何数据。研究人员通常在模拟环境中进行实验，以快速迭代想法。然而，现有的开源工具并不能提供在更大和更真实的 FL 数据集上模拟 FL 所需的效率。我们将介绍 pfl-research，这是一个用于模拟 FL 的快速、模块化且易于使用的 Python 框架。它支持 TensorFlow、 PyTorch 和非神经网络模型，并与最先进的隐私算法紧密集成。我们研究了开源 FL 框架的速度，发现在常见的跨设备设置上，pfl-research 比其他开源框架快7-72美元。这样的加速将显著地提高 FL 研究社区的生产力，并能够在以前资源过于密集的现实 FL 数据集上测试假设。我们发布了一套基准测试，用于评估算法在一组不同的现实场景中的整体性能。该代码可以在 gitHub 上 https://GitHub.com/apple/pfl-research 获得。

title: Take a Look at it! Rethinking How to Evaluate Language Model Jailbreak
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have become increasingly integrated with various
applications. To ensure that LLMs do not generate unsafe responses, they are
aligned with safeguards that specify what content is restricted. However, such
alignment can be bypassed to produce prohibited content using a technique
commonly referred to as jailbreak. Different systems have been proposed to
perform the jailbreak automatically. These systems rely on evaluation methods
to determine whether a jailbreak attempt is successful. However, our analysis
reveals that current jailbreak evaluation methods have two limitations. (1)
Their objectives lack clarity and do not align with the goal of identifying
unsafe responses. (2) They oversimplify the jailbreak result as a binary
outcome, successful or not.
  In this paper, we propose three metrics, safeguard violation,
informativeness, and relative truthfulness, to evaluate language model
jailbreak. Additionally, we demonstrate how these metrics correlate with the
goal of different malicious actors. To compute these metrics, we introduce a
multifaceted approach that extends the natural language generation evaluation
method after preprocessing the response. We evaluate our metrics on a benchmark
dataset produced from three malicious intent datasets and three jailbreak
systems. The benchmark dataset is labeled by three annotators. We compare our
multifaceted approach with three existing jailbreak evaluation methods.
Experiments demonstrate that our multifaceted evaluation outperforms existing
methods, with F1 scores improving on average by 17% compared to existing
baselines. Our findings motivate the need to move away from the binary view of
the jailbreak problem and incorporate a more comprehensive evaluation to ensure
the safety of the language model.
translated: 大型语言模型(LLM)已经越来越多地与各种应用程序集成。为了确保 LLM 不会生成不安全的响应，它们与指定哪些内容受到限制的保护措施保持一致。然而，可以绕过这种对齐，使用通常称为越狱的技术生成禁止的内容。人们提出了不同的系统来自动执行越狱。这些系统依靠评估方法来确定越狱企图是否成功。然而，我们的分析表明，目前的越狱评估方法有两个局限性。(1)其目标不明确，与识别不安全应对措施的目标不一致。(2)他们过分简化了越狱结果作为一个二元结果，成功与否。本文提出了三个评价语言模型越狱的指标: 保障违规、信息性和相对真实性。此外，我们还演示了这些指标如何与不同恶意参与者的目标相关联。为了计算这些指标，我们引入了一个多方面的方法，扩展了自然语言生成评估方法后，预处理的响应。我们在一个基准数据集上评估我们的指标，这个基准数据集由三个恶意意图数据集和三个越狱系统产生。基准数据集由三个注释器标记。我们比较了我们的多方面的方法与三个现有的越狱评估方法。实验表明，我们的多方面评价优于现有的方法，与现有的基线相比，F1分数平均提高了17% 。我们的研究结果激发了需要摆脱二元视角的越狱问题，并纳入一个更全面的评估，以确保语言模型的安全。

title:
Assessing the Understandability and Acceptance of Attack-Defense Trees
  for Modelling Security Requirements
summary:
Context and Motivation Attack-Defense Trees (ADTs) are a graphical notation
used to model and assess security requirements. ADTs are widely popular, as
they can facilitate communication between different stakeholders involved in
system security evaluation, and they are formal enough to be verified, e.g.,
with model checkers. Question/Problem While the quality of this notation has
been primarily assessed quantitatively, its understandability has never been
evaluated despite being mentioned as a key factor for its success. Principal
idea/Results In this paper, we conduct an experiment with 25 human subjects to
assess the understandability and user acceptance of the ADT notation. The study
focuses on performance-based variables and perception-based variables, with the
aim of evaluating the relationship between these measures and how they might
impact the practical use of the notation. The results confirm a good level of
understandability of ADTs. Participants consider them useful, and they show
intention to use them. Contribution This is the first study empirically
supporting the understandability of ADTs, thereby contributing to the theory of
security requirements engineering.
translated: 上下文和动机攻击防御树(ADTs)是一种用于建模和评估安全需求的图形符号。ADT 广受欢迎，因为它们可以促进参与系统安全评估的不同利益相关者之间的交流，并且它们足够正式，可以进行验证，例如，使用模型检查器。问题/问题虽然这种表示法的质量主要是定量评估的，但它的可理解性从来没有被评估过，尽管它被认为是成功的关键因素。主要观点/结果在本文中，我们对25个人进行了实验，以评估 ADT 符号的可理解性和用户接受程度。这项研究的重点是基于绩效的变量和基于感知的变量，目的是评估这些措施之间的关系，以及它们如何可能影响符号的实际使用。研究结果证实了 ADT 具有良好的可理解性。参与者认为它们是有用的，并且表现出使用它们的意图。这是第一个通过经验支持 ADT 可理解性的研究，从而为安全需求工程理论做出了贡献。

title: Towards Robust Domain Generation Algorithm Classification
summary:
In this work, we conduct a comprehensive study on the robustness of domain
generation algorithm (DGA) classifiers. We implement 32 white-box attacks, 19
of which are very effective and induce a false-negative rate (FNR) of $\approx$
100\% on unhardened classifiers. To defend the classifiers, we evaluate
different hardening approaches and propose a novel training scheme that
leverages adversarial latent space vectors and discretized adversarial domains
to significantly improve robustness. In our study, we highlight a pitfall to
avoid when hardening classifiers and uncover training biases that can be easily
exploited by attackers to bypass detection, but which can be mitigated by
adversarial training (AT). In our study, we do not observe any trade-off
between robustness and performance, on the contrary, hardening improves a
classifier's detection performance for known and unknown DGAs. We implement all
attacks and defenses discussed in this paper as a standalone library, which we
make publicly available to facilitate hardening of DGA classifiers:
https://gitlab.com/rwth-itsec/robust-dga-detection
translated: 本文对领域生成算法(DGA)分类器的鲁棒性进行了全面的研究。我们实现了32个白盒攻击，其中19个非常有效，并且在未加固的分类器上引入了大约 $100% 的假阴性率(FNR)。为了保护分类器，我们评估了不同的硬化方法，并提出了一种新的训练方案，利用对抗性潜在空间向量和离散对抗域来显著提高鲁棒性。在我们的研究中，我们强调了当加强分类器和发现训练偏差时要避免的一个陷阱，这些训练偏差很容易被攻击者利用来绕过检测，但是可以通过对抗性训练(AT)来减轻。在我们的研究中，我们没有观察到鲁棒性和性能之间的任何权衡，相反，硬化改善了分类器对已知和未知 DGA 的检测性能。我们将本文讨论的所有攻击和防御作为一个独立库来实现，我们公开这个库以便于强化 DGA 分类器:  https://gitlab.com/rwth-itsec/robust-DGA-detection

title:
Aggressive or Imperceptible, or Both: Network Pruning Assisted Hybrid
  Byzantines in Federated Learning
summary:
Federated learning (FL) has been introduced to enable a large number of
clients, possibly mobile devices, to collaborate on generating a generalized
machine learning model thanks to utilizing a larger number of local samples
without sharing to offer certain privacy to collaborating clients. However, due
to the participation of a large number of clients, it is often difficult to
profile and verify each client, which leads to a security threat that malicious
participants may hamper the accuracy of the trained model by conveying poisoned
models during the training. Hence, the aggregation framework at the parameter
server also needs to minimize the detrimental effects of these malicious
clients. A plethora of attack and defence strategies have been analyzed in the
literature. However, often the Byzantine problem is analyzed solely from the
outlier detection perspective, being oblivious to the topology of neural
networks (NNs).
  In the scope of this work, we argue that by extracting certain side
information specific to the NN topology, one can design stronger attacks.
Hence, inspired by the sparse neural networks, we introduce a hybrid sparse
Byzantine attack that is composed of two parts: one exhibiting a sparse nature
and attacking only certain NN locations with higher sensitivity, and the other
being more silent but accumulating over time, where each ideally targets a
different type of defence mechanism, and together they form a strong but
imperceptible attack. Finally, we show through extensive simulations that the
proposed hybrid Byzantine attack is effective against 8 different defence
methods.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)的引入使得大量的客户(可能是移动设备)能够协作生成一个通用的机器学习模型，因为它利用了大量的本地样本，而不是共享，从而为协作的客户提供某种隐私。然而，由于有大量客户参与，往往难以对每个客户进行侧写和核实，从而造成安全威胁，恶意参与者可能在培训期间传送有毒模型，从而妨碍培训模型的准确性。因此，参数服务器上的聚合框架还需要最小化这些恶意客户机的有害影响。文献中分析了大量的进攻和防守策略。然而，拜占庭问题往往只从异常检测的角度进行分析，而忽略了神经网络的拓扑结构。在这项工作的范围内，我们认为通过提取特定于神经网络拓扑的某些侧信息，可以设计更强的攻击。因此，受稀疏神经网络的启发，我们引入了一种混合稀疏拜占庭攻击，它由两部分组成: 一部分表现出稀疏的特性，只攻击某些具有更高灵敏度的神经网络位置，另一部分更加沉默，但随着时间的推移不断积累，每个理想的目标都是不同类型的防御机制，它们一起形成一个强大但不易察觉的攻击。最后，我们通过大量的仿真表明，所提出的混合拜占庭攻击对8种不同的防御方法是有效的。

title: Privacy-preserving Scanpath Comparison for Pervasive Eye Tracking
summary:
As eye tracking becomes pervasive with screen-based devices and head-mounted
displays, privacy concerns regarding eye-tracking data have escalated. While
state-of-the-art approaches for privacy-preserving eye tracking mostly involve
differential privacy and empirical data manipulations, previous research has
not focused on methods for scanpaths. We introduce a novel privacy-preserving
scanpath comparison protocol designed for the widely used Needleman-Wunsch
algorithm, a generalized version of the edit distance algorithm. Particularly,
by incorporating the Paillier homomorphic encryption scheme, our protocol
ensures that no private information is revealed. Furthermore, we introduce a
random processing strategy and a multi-layered masking method to obfuscate the
values while preserving the original order of encrypted editing operation
costs. This minimizes communication overhead, requiring a single communication
round for each iteration of the Needleman-Wunsch process. We demonstrate the
efficiency and applicability of our protocol on three publicly available
datasets with comprehensive computational performance analyses and make our
source code publicly accessible.
translated: 随着基于屏幕的设备和头戴式显示器的普及，关于眼球跟踪数据的隐私问题已经升级。虽然最先进的保护隐私的眼球追踪方法大多涉及差分隐私和经验数据处理，但以前的研究并没有关注扫描路径的方法。我们介绍了一种新的保护隐私的扫描路径比较协议，该协议是针对目前广泛使用的 Needleman-Wunsch 算法而设计的，是编辑距离算法的一个通用版本。特别是，通过结合 Paillier 同态加密计划，我们的协议确保不会泄露私人信息。此外，我们还引入了一种随机处理策略和多层掩蔽方法，在保持加密编辑操作代价的原始顺序的同时，对数据进行模糊处理。这最小化了通信开销，需要针对 Needleman-Wunsch 流程的每次迭代进行一轮通信。我们通过全面的计算性能分析证明了我们的协议在三个公开可用数据集上的有效性和适用性，并使我们的源代码公开可访问。

title: FLEX: FLEXible Federated Learning Framework
summary:
In the realm of Artificial Intelligence (AI), the need for privacy and
security in data processing has become paramount. As AI applications continue
to expand, the collection and handling of sensitive data raise concerns about
individual privacy protection. Federated Learning (FL) emerges as a promising
solution to address these challenges by enabling decentralized model training
on local devices, thus preserving data privacy. This paper introduces FLEX: a
FLEXible Federated Learning Framework designed to provide maximum flexibility
in FL research experiments. By offering customizable features for data
distribution, privacy parameters, and communication strategies, FLEX empowers
researchers to innovate and develop novel FL techniques. The framework also
includes libraries for specific FL implementations including: (1) anomalies,
(2) blockchain, (3) adversarial attacks and defences, (4) natural language
processing and (5) decision trees, enhancing its versatility and applicability
in various domains. Overall, FLEX represents a significant advancement in FL
research, facilitating the development of robust and efficient FL applications.
translated: 在人工智能(AI)领域，数据处理中对隐私和安全的需求已经变得至关重要。随着人工智能应用的不断扩大，敏感数据的收集和处理引起了人们对个人隐私保护的关注。联邦学习(FL)通过在本地设备上实现分散的模型训练，从而保护数据隐私，成为解决这些挑战的一种有前途的解决方案。本文介绍了 FLEX: 一个 FLEXible 联邦学习框架，旨在提供最大的灵活性，在外语研究实验。通过为数据分发、隐私参数和通信策略提供可定制的特性，FLEX 赋予研究人员创新和发展新型 FL 技术的权力。该框架还包括用于特定 FL 实现的库，包括: (1)异常，(2)区块链，(3)对抗性攻击和防御，(4)自然语言处理和(5)决策树，增强了其在各个领域的通用性和适用性。总的来说，FLEX 代表了外语研究的重大进步，促进了强大和高效的外语应用的发展。

title:
S-box Security Analysis of NIST Lightweight Cryptography Candidates: A
  Critical Empirical Study
summary:
In the resource-constrained world of the digital landscape, lightweight
cryptography plays a critical role in safeguarding information and ensuring the
security of various systems, devices, and communication channels. Its efficient
and resource-friendly nature makes it the ideal solution for applications where
computational power is limited. In response to the growing need for
platform-specific implementations, NIST issued a call for standardization of
Lightweight cryptography algorithms in 2018. Ascon emerged as the winner of
this competition. NIST initially established general evaluation criteria for a
standard lightweight scheme including security strength, mitigation against
side-channel and fault-injection attacks, and implementation efficiency. To
verify the security claims, evaluating the individual components used in any
cryptographic algorithm is a crucial step. The quality of a substitution box
(S-box) significantly impacts the overall security of a cryptographic
primitive. This paper analyzes the S-boxes of six finalists in the NIST
Lightweight Cryptography (LWC) standardization process. We evaluate them based
on well-established cryptographic properties. Our analysis explores how these
properties influence the S-boxes' resistance against known cryptanalytic
attacks and potential implementation-specific vulnerabilities, thus reflecting
on their compliance with NIST's security requirements.
translated: 在资源受限的数字世界中，轻量级密码学在保护信息和确保各种系统、设备和通信渠道的安全方面发挥着关键作用。它的高效和资源友好性质使其成为计算能力有限的应用程序的理想解决方案。为了满足对特定于平台的实现日益增长的需求，NIST 在2018年发出了轻量级加密算法标准化的呼吁。阿斯康成为了这次比赛的冠军。NIST 初步建立了一个标准轻量级方案的通用评估标准，包括安全强度、对侧信道和故障注入攻击的缓解以及实现效率。为了验证安全声明，评估任何加密算法中使用的单个组件是至关重要的一步。S盒的质素会严重影响密码原语的整体安全性。本文分析了 NIST 轻量级密码学(LWC)标准化过程中六个决赛选手的 S 盒。我们根据已建立的密码特性对它们进行评估。我们的分析探讨了这些属性如何影响 S-box 对已知密码分析攻击和潜在实现特定漏洞的抵抗力，从而反映了它们是否符合 NIST 的安全需求。

title:
Is Your AI Truly Yours? Leveraging Blockchain for Copyrights,
  Provenance, and Lineage
summary:
As Artificial Intelligence (AI) integrates into diverse areas, particularly
in content generation, ensuring rightful ownership and ethical use becomes
paramount. AI service providers are expected to prioritize responsibly sourcing
training data and obtaining licenses from data owners. However, existing
studies primarily center on safeguarding static copyrights, which simply treats
metadata/datasets as non-fungible items with transferable/trading capabilities,
neglecting the dynamic nature of training procedures that can shape an ongoing
trajectory.
  In this paper, we present \textsc{IBis}, a blockchain-based framework
tailored for AI model training workflows. \textsc{IBis} integrates on-chain
registries for datasets, licenses and models, alongside off-chain signing
services to facilitate collaboration among multiple participants. Our framework
addresses concerns regarding data and model provenance and copyright
compliance. \textsc{IBis} enables iterative model retraining and fine-tuning,
and offers flexible license checks and renewals. Further, \textsc{IBis}
provides APIs designed for seamless integration with existing contract
management software, minimizing disruptions to established model training
processes. We implement \textsc{IBis} using Daml on the Canton blockchain.
Evaluation results showcase the feasibility and scalability of \textsc{IBis}
across varying numbers of users, datasets, models, and licenses.
translated: 随着人工智能(AI)融入多个领域，特别是在内容生成方面，确保合法的所有权和合乎道德的使用变得至关重要。人工智能服务提供商应优先考虑负责任地采购培训数据并从数据所有者那里获得许可证。然而，现有的研究主要集中在保护静态版权上，这些研究仅仅将元数据/数据集视为具有可转移/交易能力的不可替代的项目，而忽视了可以形成正在进行的轨迹的培训程序的动态性质。在本文中，我们提出了 textsc { IBis } ，一个基于区块链的框架，专为人工智能模型培训工作流程。Textsc { IBis }集成了用于数据集、许可证和模型的链上注册中心，以及脱链签名服务，以促进多个参与者之间的协作。我们的框架解决了有关数据和模型来源以及版权遵从性的问题。Textsc { IBis }支持迭代模型再训练和微调，并提供灵活的许可证检查和更新。此外，textsc { IBis }提供了旨在与现有合同管理软件无缝集成的 API，最大限度地减少了对已建立的模型培训过程的干扰。我们在 Canton 区块链上使用 Daml 实现 textsc { IBis }。评估结果展示了 textsc { IBis }在不同数量的用户、数据集、模型和许可证中的可行性和可伸缩性。

title: Remote Scheduler Contention Attacks
summary:
In this paper, we investigate unexplored aspects of scheduler contention: We
systematically study the leakage of all scheduler queues on AMD Zen 3 and show
that all queues leak. We mount the first scheduler contention attacks on Zen 4,
with a novel measurement method evoking an out-of-order race condition, more
precise than the state of the art. We demonstrate the first inter-keystroke
timing attacks based on scheduler contention, with an F1 score of $\geq$ 99.5 %
and a standard deviation below 4 ms from the ground truth. Our end-to-end
JavaScript attack transmits across Firefox instances, bypassing cross-origin
policies and site isolation, with 891.9 bit/s (Zen 3) and 940.7 bit/s (Zen 4).
translated: 在本文中，我们研究了调度器争用的未探索的方面: 我们系统地研究了 AMD Zen 3上所有调度器队列的泄漏，发现所有队列都是泄漏的。我们对 Zen 4发起了第一次调度器争用攻击，使用了一种新的测量方法，引发了一种无序的竞争状态，比最先进的技术更精确。我们展示了第一个基于调度器竞争的击键间定时攻击，F1得分 $geq $99.5% ，标准差低于4 ms。我们的端到端 JavaScript 攻击通过 Firefox 实例传输，绕过跨源策略和站点隔离，891.9位/秒(Zen 3)和940.7位/秒(Zen 4)。

title:
Non-Degenerate One-Time Pad and the integrity of perfectly secret
  messages
summary:
We present a new construction of a One Time Pad (OTP) with inherent diffusive
properties and a redundancy injection mechanism that benefits from them. The
construction is based on interpreting the plaintext and key as members of a
permutation group in the Lehmer code representation after conversion to
factoradic. The so constructed OTP translates any perturbation of the
ciphertext to an unpredictable, metrically large random perturbation of the
plaintext. This allows us to provide unconditional integrity assurance without
extra key material. The redundancy is injected using Foata's "pun": the reading
of the one-line representation as the cyclic one; we call this Pseudo Foata
Injection. We obtain algorithms of quadratic complexity that implement both
mechanisms.
translated: 我们提出了一个具有固有扩散特性的一次性衬垫(OTP)的新结构和一个从中受益的冗余注入机制。这个结构是基于将明文和密钥转换为 factoradial 之后，将其解释为 Lehmer 代码表示中的置换群成员。这样构造的 OTP 将密文的任何扰动转换为明文的不可预测的、度量上大的随机扰动。这使我们能够提供无条件的完整性保证，而不需要额外的关键材料。冗余是使用 Foata 的“双关语”注入的: 将单行表示作为循环表示读取; 我们称之为伪 Foata 注入。我们得到了实现这两种机制的二次复杂度算法。

title: Beyond Random Inputs: A Novel ML-Based Hardware Fuzzing
summary:
Modern computing systems heavily rely on hardware as the root of trust.
However, their increasing complexity has given rise to security-critical
vulnerabilities that cross-layer at-tacks can exploit. Traditional hardware
vulnerability detection methods, such as random regression and formal
verification, have limitations. Random regression, while scalable, is slow in
exploring hardware, and formal verification techniques are often concerned with
manual effort and state explosions. Hardware fuzzing has emerged as an
effective approach to exploring and detecting security vulnerabilities in
large-scale designs like modern processors. They outperform traditional methods
regarding coverage, scalability, and efficiency. However, state-of-the-art
fuzzers struggle to achieve comprehensive coverage of intricate hardware
designs within a practical timeframe, often falling short of a 70% coverage
threshold. We propose a novel ML-based hardware fuzzer, ChatFuzz, to address
this challenge. Ourapproach leverages LLMs like ChatGPT to understand processor
language, focusing on machine codes and generating assembly code sequences. RL
is integrated to guide the input generation process by rewarding the inputs
using code coverage metrics. We use the open-source RISCV-based RocketCore
processor as our testbed. ChatFuzz achieves condition coverage rate of 75% in
just 52 minutes compared to a state-of-the-art fuzzer, which requires a lengthy
30-hour window to reach a similar condition coverage. Furthermore, our fuzzer
can attain 80% coverage when provided with a limited pool of 10 simulation
instances/licenses within a 130-hour window. During this time, it conducted a
total of 199K test cases, of which 6K produced discrepancies with the
processor's golden model. Our analysis identified more than 10 unique
mismatches, including two new bugs in the RocketCore and discrepancies from the
RISC-V ISA Simulator.
translated: 现代计算系统严重依赖硬件作为信任的根源。然而，它们日益增长的复杂性导致了跨层攻击可以利用的安全关键漏洞。传统的硬件漏洞检测方法，例如随机回归和形式验证检测，都有局限性。随机回归虽然可扩展，但在探索硬件方面速度缓慢，而且形式验证技术通常涉及手工操作和状态爆炸。在现代处理器等大规模设计中，硬件模糊化已经成为探索和检测安全漏洞的一种有效方法。它们在覆盖率、可伸缩性和效率方面优于传统方法。然而，最先进的模糊控制器很难在一个实际的时间范围内实现复杂硬件设计的全面覆盖，往往达不到70% 的覆盖率阈值。我们提出了一种新颖的基于机器学习的硬件模糊器 ChatFuzz 来解决这个问题。我们的方法利用像 ChatGPT 这样的 LLM 来理解处理器语言，重点是机器代码和生成汇编代码序列。RL 是集成的，通过使用代码覆盖度量来奖励输入，从而指导输入生成过程。我们使用基于 RISCV 的开源 RocketCore 处理器作为测试平台。ChatFuzz 在52分钟内达到了75% 的条件覆盖率，而最先进的模糊控制器需要长达30小时的时间才能达到类似的条件覆盖率。此外，当在130小时的窗口内提供有限的10个模拟实例/许可时，我们的模糊器可以达到80% 的覆盖率。在此期间，它进行了总共199K 的测试用例，其中6K 与处理器的黄金模型产生了差异。我们的分析确定了10多个独特的不匹配，包括两个新的错误在火箭核心和差异从 RISC-V ISA 模拟器。

title: Enc2DB: A Hybrid and Adaptive Encrypted Query Processing Framework
summary:
As cloud computing gains traction, data owners are outsourcing their data to
cloud service providers (CSPs) for Database Service (DBaaS), bringing in a
deviation of data ownership and usage, and intensifying privacy concerns,
especially with potential breaches by hackers or CSP insiders. To address that,
encrypted database services propose encrypting every tuple and query statement
before submitting to the CSP, ensuring data confidentiality when the CSP is
honest-but-curious, or even compromised. Existing solutions either employ
property preserving cryptography schemes, which can perform certain operations
over ciphertext without decrypting the data over the CSP, or utilize trusted
execution environment (TEE) to safeguard data and computations from the CSP.
Based on these efforts, we introduce Enc2DB, a novel secure database system,
following a hybrid strategy on PostgreSQL and openGauss. We present a
micro-benchmarking test and self-adaptive mode switch strategy that can
dynamically choose the best execution path (cryptography or TEE) to answer a
given query. Besides, we also design and implement a ciphertext index
compatible with native cost model and query optimizers to accelerate query
processing. Empirical study over TPC-C test justifies that Enc2DB outperforms
pure TEE and cryptography solutions, and our ciphertext index implementation
also outperforms the state-of-the-art cryptographic-based system.
translated: 随着云计算越来越受欢迎，数据所有者正将他们的数据外包给云服务提供商(CSP)的数据库服务(DBaaS) ，带来了数据所有权和使用的偏差，并加剧了对隐私的担忧，尤其是在黑客或 CSP 内部人员可能破坏数据的情况下。为了解决这个问题，加密的数据库服务建议在提交给 CSP 之前对每个元组和查询语句进行加密，在 CSP 诚实但好奇，甚至受到威胁时确保数据机密性。现有的解决方案要么采用保留属性的加密方案，可以在不通过 CSP 解密数据的情况下对加密文本执行某些操作，要么利用可信执行环境(TEE)来保护来自 CSP 的数据和计算。在这些努力的基础上，我们介绍了一个新的安全数据库系统 Enc2DB，它采用了 PostgreSQL 和 openGauss 的混合策略。我们提出了一个微基准测试和自适应模式切换策略，可以动态地选择最佳执行路径(密码学或 TEE)来回答给定的查询。此外，我们还设计并实现了一个兼容本地代价模型和查询优化器的密文索引，以加快查询处理速度。通过对 TPC-C 测试的实证研究，证明了 Enc2DB 的性能优于纯 TEE 和加密解决方案，我们的密文索引实现也优于最先进的基于加密的系统。

title: Security Assessment of the LG Cryptosystem
summary:
The LG cryptosystem is a public-key encryption scheme in the rank metric
using the recent family of $\lambdav-$Gabidulin codes and introduced in 2019 by
Lau and Tan. In this paper, we present a cryptanalysis showing that the
security of several parameters of the scheme have been overestimated. We also
show the existence of some weak keys allowing an attacker to find in polynomial
time an alternative private key.
translated: LG 加密系统是使用最新的 $lambdav-$Gabidulin 密码的公钥加密方案，由 Lau 和 Tan 于2019年引入。在本文中，我们提出了一个密码分析表明，该方案的几个参数的安全性被高估。我们还证明了一些弱密钥的存在，允许攻击者在多项式时间内找到一个替代的私钥。

title: Disguised Copyright Infringement of Latent Diffusion Model
summary:
Copyright infringement may occur when a generative model produces samples
substantially similar to some copyrighted data that it had access to during the
training phase. The notion of access usually refers to including copyrighted
samples directly in the training dataset, which one may inspect to identify an
infringement. We argue that such visual auditing largely overlooks a concealed
copyright infringement, where one constructs a disguise that looks drastically
different from the copyrighted sample yet still induces the effect of training
Latent Diffusion Models on it. Such disguises only require indirect access to
the copyrighted material and cannot be visually distinguished, thus easily
circumventing the current auditing tools. In this paper, we provide a better
understanding of such disguised copyright infringement by uncovering the
disguises generation algorithm, the revelation of the disguises, and
importantly, how to detect them to augment the existing toolbox. Additionally,
we introduce a broader notion of acknowledgment for comprehending such indirect
access.
translated: 当盗版生成模型生产的样本与它在培训阶段获得的某些版权数据大致相似时，就可能发生这种情况。访问的概念通常是指包括版权样本直接在训练数据集，人们可以检查，以确定侵权。我们认为，这种视觉审计在很大程度上忽略了隐藏的盗版，即一个人构建的伪装，看起来与版权样本截然不同，但仍然会诱发培训潜在扩散模型的效果。这种伪装只需要间接查阅受版权保护的材料，无法在视觉上加以区分，因此很容易绕过目前的审计工具。在本文中，我们通过揭示伪装生成算法、揭示伪装，以及重要的是如何检测这些伪装来增强现有的工具箱，从而更好地理解这些伪装的盗版。此外，我们还引入了一个更广泛的确认概念来理解这种间接访问。

title: SoK: Trusting Self-Sovereign Identity
summary:
Digital identity is evolving from centralized systems to a decentralized
approach known as Self-Sovereign Identity (SSI). SSI empowers individuals to
control their digital identities, eliminating reliance on third-party data
custodians and reducing the risk of data breaches. However, the concept of
trust in SSI remains complex and fragmented. This paper systematically analyzes
trust in SSI in light of its components and threats posed by various actors in
the system. As a result, we derive three distinct trust models that capture the
threats and mitigations identified across SSI literature and implementations.
Our work provides a foundational framework for future SSI research and
development, including a comprehensive catalogue of SSI components and design
requirements for trust, shortcomings in existing SSI systems and areas for
further exploration.
translated: 数字身份正在从集中式系统演变为一种被称为自主身份(SSI)的分散式方法。SSI 使个人能够控制自己的数字身份，消除对第三方数据保管人的依赖，减少数据泄露的风险。然而，SSI 中的信任概念仍然是复杂和分散的。本文根据 SSI 的组成部分以及系统中各种角色所构成的威胁，对 SSI 中的信任进行了系统的分析。因此，我们得到了三个截然不同的信任模型，它们捕获了在 SSI 文献和实现中确定的威胁和缓解措施。我们的工作为今后的 SSI 研究和开发提供了一个基础框架，包括 SSI 组件的全面目录和信任的设计要求、现有 SSI 系统的缺陷和需要进一步探索的领域。

title:
Poisoning Prevention in Federated Learning and Differential Privacy via
  Stateful Proofs of Execution
summary:
The rise in IoT-driven distributed data analytics, coupled with increasing
privacy concerns, has led to a demand for effective privacy-preserving and
federated data collection/model training mechanisms. In response, approaches
such as Federated Learning (FL) and Local Differential Privacy (LDP) have been
proposed and attracted much attention over the past few years. However, they
still share the common limitation of being vulnerable to poisoning attacks
wherein adversaries compromising edge devices feed forged (a.k.a. poisoned)
data to aggregation back-ends, undermining the integrity of FL/LDP results.
  In this work, we propose a system-level approach to remedy this issue based
on a novel security notion of Proofs of Stateful Execution (PoSX) for
IoT/embedded devices' software. To realize the PoSX concept, we design SLAPP: a
System-Level Approach for Poisoning Prevention. SLAPP leverages commodity
security features of embedded devices - in particular ARM TrustZoneM security
extensions - to verifiably bind raw sensed data to their correct usage as part
of FL/LDP edge device routines. As a consequence, it offers robust security
guarantees against poisoning. Our evaluation, based on real-world prototypes
featuring multiple cryptographic primitives and data collection schemes,
showcases SLAPP's security and low overhead.
translated: IoT-driven 分布式数据分析的兴起，加上对隐私的担忧日益加剧，导致了对有效保护隐私和联邦数据收集/模型培训机制的需求。作为回应，联邦学习(FL)和本地差分隐私(lDP)等方法已经被提出，并在过去几年中引起了广泛的关注。然而，他们仍然共享易受中毒攻击的共同限制，其中损害边缘设备的对手提供伪造(又称中毒)数据到聚合后端，破坏 FL/LDP 结果的完整性。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个系统级的方法来解决这个问题的基础上，一个新的安全概念的状态执行证明(PoSX)的物联网/嵌入式设备的软件。为了实现 PoSX 的概念，我们设计了 SLAPP: 一种系统级的中毒预防方法。SLAPP 利用嵌入式设备的商业安全特性——特别是 ARM TrustZoneM 安全扩展——可验证地将原始感应数据绑定到它们的正确使用，作为 FL/LDP 边缘设备例程的一部分。因此，它提供了防止中毒的强有力的安全保障。我们的评估基于具有多个密码原语和数据收集方案的真实世界原型，展示了 SLAPP 的安全性和低开销。

title: How to Craft Backdoors with Unlabeled Data Alone?
summary:
Relying only on unlabeled data, Self-supervised learning (SSL) can learn rich
features in an economical and scalable way. As the drive-horse for building
foundation models, SSL has received a lot of attention recently with wide
applications, which also raises security concerns where backdoor attack is a
major type of threat: if the released dataset is maliciously poisoned,
backdoored SSL models can behave badly when triggers are injected to test
samples. The goal of this work is to investigate this potential risk. We notice
that existing backdoors all require a considerable amount of \emph{labeled}
data that may not be available for SSL. To circumvent this limitation, we
explore a more restrictive setting called no-label backdoors, where we only
have access to the unlabeled data alone, where the key challenge is how to
select the proper poison set without using label information. We propose two
strategies for poison selection: clustering-based selection using pseudolabels,
and contrastive selection derived from the mutual information principle.
Experiments on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet-100 show that both no-label backdoors are
effective on many SSL methods and outperform random poisoning by a large
margin. Code will be available at https://github.com/PKU-ML/nlb.
translated: 自监督学习(SSL)只依赖于未标记的数据，可以以一种经济和可扩展的方式学习丰富的特征。作为建立基础模型的驱动器，SSL 最近受到了广泛的应用，这也引起了安全方面的担忧，后门攻击是一个主要类型的威胁: 如果发布的数据集被恶意中毒，后门 SSL 模型可能表现糟糕时，触发器注入测试样品。这项工作的目标是调查这种潜在的风险。我们注意到，现有的后门都需要大量可能不适用于 SSL 的 emph { label }数据。为了规避这个限制，我们探索了一种更具限制性的设置，称为无标签后门，在这种设置中，我们只能访问未标签的数据，关键的挑战是如何在不使用标签信息的情况下选择合适的毒集。我们提出了两种毒物选择策略: 基于伪标签的聚类选择和基于互信息原理的对比选择。在 CIFAR-10和 ImageNet-100上进行的实验表明，无标签后门对许多 SSL 方法都是有效的，其性能大大优于随机中毒。密码将在 https://github.com/pku-ml/nlb 公布。

title:
Atlas-X Equity Financing: Unlocking New Methods to Securely Obfuscate
  Axe Inventory Data Based on Differential Privacy
summary:
Banks publish daily a list of available securities/assets (axe list) to
selected clients to help them effectively locate Long (buy) or Short (sell)
trades at reduced financing rates. This reduces costs for the bank, as the list
aggregates the bank's internal firm inventory per asset for all clients of long
as well as short trades. However, this is somewhat problematic: (1) the bank's
inventory is revealed; (2) trades of clients who contribute to the aggregated
list, particularly those deemed large, are revealed to other clients. Clients
conducting sizable trades with the bank and possessing a portion of the
aggregated asset exceeding $50\%$ are considered to be concentrated clients.
This could potentially reveal a trading concentrated client's activity to their
competitors, thus providing an unfair advantage over the market.
  Atlas-X Axe Obfuscation, powered by new differential private methods, enables
a bank to obfuscate its published axe list on a daily basis while under
continual observation, thus maintaining an acceptable inventory Profit and Loss
(P&L) cost pertaining to the noisy obfuscated axe list while reducing the
clients' trading activity leakage. Our main differential private innovation is
a differential private aggregator for streams (time series data) of both
positive and negative integers under continual observation.
  For the last two years, Atlas-X system has been live in production across
three major regions-USA, Europe, and Asia-at J.P. Morgan, a major financial
institution, facilitating significant profitability. To our knowledge, it is
the first differential privacy solution to be deployed in the financial sector.
We also report benchmarks of our algorithm based on (anonymous) real and
synthetic data to showcase the quality of our obfuscation and its success in
production.
translated: 银行每天向选定的客户公布可用证券/资产清单，以帮助他们以较低的融资利率有效地确定多头(买入)或空头(卖出)交易。这降低了银行的成本，因为该清单汇总了银行的内部公司存货每资产的所有客户的长期和短期交易。然而，这是有点问题的: (1)银行的库存被披露; (2)交易的客户谁贡献的汇总名单，特别是那些被认为是大，被披露给其他客户。与银行进行大额交易并拥有总资产超过50% 的部分的客户被认为是集中客户。这可能会向竞争对手透露一个交易集中的客户的活动，从而提供一个不公平的市场优势。Atlas-X Axe 模糊处理，采用新的差分私有方法，使银行能够在持续观察的情况下，每天模糊其公布的斧子清单，从而维持可接受的库存损益(P & L)成本，与噪音模糊斧子清单有关，同时减少客户的交易活动泄漏。我们的主要差分私有创新是一个差分私有聚合器的流(时间序列数据)的正整数和负整数在连续的观察。在过去的两年中，Atlas-X 系统已经在美国、欧洲和亚洲这三个主要地区的大型金融机构摩根大通公司投入生产，促进了显著的盈利能力。据我们所知，这是首个应用于金融业的差分隐私解决方案。我们还报告了基于(匿名)真实和合成数据的算法的基准测试，以展示我们的模糊处理的质量及其在生产中的成功。

title: A Measurement of Genuine Tor Traces for Realistic Website Fingerprinting
summary:
Website fingerprinting (WF) is a dangerous attack on web privacy because it
enables an adversary to predict the website a user is visiting, despite the use
of encryption, VPNs, or anonymizing networks such as Tor. Previous WF work
almost exclusively uses synthetic datasets to evaluate the performance and
estimate the feasibility of WF attacks despite evidence that synthetic data
misrepresents the real world. In this paper we present GTT23, the first WF
dataset of genuine Tor traces, which we obtain through a large-scale
measurement of the Tor network. GTT23 represents real Tor user behavior better
than any existing WF dataset, is larger than any existing WF dataset by at
least an order of magnitude, and will help ground the future study of realistic
WF attacks and defenses. In a detailed evaluation, we survey 25 WF datasets
published over the last 15 years and compare their characteristics to those of
GTT23. We discover common deficiencies of synthetic datasets that make them
inferior to GTT23 for drawing meaningful conclusions about the effectiveness of
WF attacks directed at real Tor users. We have made GTT23 available to promote
reproducible research and to help inspire new directions for future work.
translated: 网站指纹识别(WF)是一种对网络隐私的危险攻击，因为它使对手能够预测用户正在访问的网站，尽管使用了加密、 VPN 或匿名网络，如 Tor。尽管有证据表明合成数据歪曲了现实世界，但以前的 WF 工作几乎完全使用合成数据集来评估性能和估计 WF 攻击的可行性。本文提出了 GTT23，第一个真正的 Tor 轨迹的 WF 数据集，这是我们通过对 Tor 网络的大规模测量获得的。GTT23代表了真实的 Tor 用户行为，比任何现有的 WF 数据集都要好，比任何现有的 WF 数据集都要大至少一个数量级，并且将有助于未来研究真实的 WF 攻击和防御。在一个详细的评估中，我们调查了过去15年中发表的25个 WF 数据集，并将其特征与 GTT23数据集进行了比较。我们发现了合成数据集的共同缺陷，使得它们不如 GTT23，从而得出了针对真实 Tor 用户的 WF 攻击的有效性的有意义的结论。我们已经提供了 GTT23，以促进可重复的研究，并帮助激发未来工作的新方向。

title: LeapFrog: The Rowhammer Instruction Skip Attack
summary:
Since its inception, Rowhammer exploits have rapidly evolved into
increasingly sophisticated threats not only compromising data integrity but
also the control flow integrity of victim processes. Nevertheless, it remains a
challenge for an attacker to identify vulnerable targets (i.e., Rowhammer
gadgets), understand the outcome of the attempted fault, and formulate an
attack that yields useful results.
  In this paper, we present a new type of Rowhammer gadget, called a LeapFrog
gadget, which, when present in the victim code, allows an adversary to subvert
code execution to bypass a critical piece of code (e.g., authentication check
logic, encryption rounds, padding in security protocols). The Leapfrog gadget
manifests when the victim code stores the Program Counter (PC) value in the
user or kernel stack (e.g., a return address during a function call) which,
when tampered with, re-positions the return address to a location that bypasses
a security-critical code pattern.
  This research also presents a systematic process to identify Leapfrog
gadgets. This methodology enables the automated detection of susceptible
targets and the determination of optimal attack parameters. We first showcase
this new attack vector through a practical demonstration on a TLS handshake
client/server scenario, successfully inducing an instruction skip in a client
application. We then demonstrate the attack on real-world code found in the
wild, implementing an attack on OpenSSL.
  Our findings extend the impact of Rowhammer attacks on control flow and
contribute to the development of more robust defenses against these
increasingly sophisticated threats.
translated: 自成立以来，RowHammer 漏洞已迅速演变成日益复杂的威胁，不仅损害了数据完整性，而且损害了受害者进程的控制流完整性。尽管如此，对于攻击者来说，识别易受攻击的目标(例如 RowHammer 小工具)、理解未遂错误的结果并制定出能产生有用结果的攻击仍然是一个挑战。在本文中，我们提出了一种新型的 RowHammer 小工具，称为 LeapFrog 小工具，当它出现在受害者代码中时，允许对手通过破坏代码执行来绕过一段关键的代码(例如，身份验证检查逻辑、加密轮、安全协议中的填充)。当受害者代码将 Program Counter (PC)值存储在用户或内核堆栈(例如，函数调用期间的返回地址)中时，跳蛙小工具就会显示出来，当被篡改时，返回地址会重新定位到绕过安全关键代码模式的位置。这项研究也提出了一个系统的过程，以确定跳蛙小工具。该方法实现了对易受攻击目标的自动检测和最佳攻击参数的确定。我们首先通过 TLS 握手客户机/服务器场景的实际演示来展示这个新的攻击向量，成功地在客户机应用程序中引入了指令跳跃。然后，我们演示在野外发现的对现实世界代码的攻击，实现对 OpenSSL 的攻击。我们的研究结果扩大了 Rowhammer 攻击对控制流的影响，并有助于开发更强大的防御措施，以应对这些日益复杂的威胁。

title: Backdoor Contrastive Learning via Bi-level Trigger Optimization
summary:
Contrastive Learning (CL) has attracted enormous attention due to its
remarkable capability in unsupervised representation learning. However, recent
works have revealed the vulnerability of CL to backdoor attacks: the feature
extractor could be misled to embed backdoored data close to an attack target
class, thus fooling the downstream predictor to misclassify it as the target.
Existing attacks usually adopt a fixed trigger pattern and poison the training
set with trigger-injected data, hoping for the feature extractor to learn the
association between trigger and target class. However, we find that such fixed
trigger design fails to effectively associate trigger-injected data with target
class in the embedding space due to special CL mechanisms, leading to a limited
attack success rate (ASR). This phenomenon motivates us to find a better
backdoor trigger design tailored for CL framework. In this paper, we propose a
bi-level optimization approach to achieve this goal, where the inner
optimization simulates the CL dynamics of a surrogate victim, and the outer
optimization enforces the backdoor trigger to stay close to the target
throughout the surrogate CL procedure. Extensive experiments show that our
attack can achieve a higher attack success rate (e.g., $99\%$ ASR on
ImageNet-100) with a very low poisoning rate ($1\%$). Besides, our attack can
effectively evade existing state-of-the-art defenses. Code is available at:
https://github.com/SWY666/SSL-backdoor-BLTO.
translated: 对比学习(CL)因其在无监督表征学习中的突出优势而受到广泛关注。然而，最近的工作已经揭示了 CL 对后门攻击的脆弱性: 特征提取器可能被误导以嵌入靠近攻击目标类的后门数据，从而愚弄下游预测器将其错误分类为目标。现有的攻击通常采用固定的触发器模式，利用触发器注入的数据毒害训练集，希望特征提取器能够了解触发器与目标类之间的关系。然而，我们发现这种固定的触发器设计由于特殊的 CL 机制而不能有效地将触发器注入的数据与嵌入空间中的目标类关联起来，从而导致了有限的攻击成功率(ASR)。这种现象促使我们寻找一种更好的后门触发器设计来适应 CL 框架。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了一种双层优化方法，其中内部优化模拟了代理受害者的 CL 动力学，外部优化强制后门触发器在整个代理 CL 过程中保持接近目标。大量的实验表明，我们的攻击可以获得更高的攻击成功率(例如，在 ImageNet-100上 $99% $ASR) ，而且中毒率非常低($1% $)。此外，我们的攻击可以有效地避开现有的最先进的防御系统。密码可于以下 https://github.com/swy666/ssl-backdoor-blto 索取:。

title:
Protected QR Code-based Anti-counterfeit System for Pharmaceutical
  Manufacturing
summary:
The pharmaceutical manufacturing faces critical challenges due to the global
threat of counterfeit drugs. This paper proposes a new approach of protected QR
codes to secure unique product information for safeguarding the pharmaceutical
supply chain. The proposed solution integrates secure QR code generation and
encrypted data transmission to establish a comprehensive anti-counterfeit
ecosystem. The protected QR codes encapsulate product information that cannot
be identified using traditional QR code scanners which protect the information
against replication and tampering. The system is developed with scalability in
mind, which can be easily implemented without introducing any additional
modification in the traditional supply chain.
translated: 由于假药的全球威胁，制药业面临着严峻的挑战。本文提出了一种保护二维码的新方法来保护唯一的产品信息，以保障药品供应链的安全。建议的解决方案集成了安全的二维码生成和加密数据传输，以建立一个全面的防伪生态系统。受保护的二维码封装的产品信息，无法识别使用传统的二维码扫描器，保护信息免受复制和篡改。开发该系统时考虑到了可伸缩性，这种可伸缩性可以很容易地实现，而不需要对传统供应链进行任何额外的修改。

title: Illicit Promotion on Twitter
summary:
In this paper, we present an extensive study of the promotion of illicit
goods and services on Twitter, a popular online social network(OSN). This study
is made possible through the design and implementation of multiple novel tools
for detecting and analyzing illicit promotion activities as well as their
underlying campaigns. As the results, we observe that illicit promotion is
prevalent on Twitter, along with noticeable existence on other three popular
OSNs including Youtube, Facebook, and TikTok. Particularly, 12 million distinct
posts of illicit promotion (PIPs) have been observed on the Twitter platform,
which are widely distributed in 5 major natural languages and 10 categories of
illicit goods and services, e.g., drugs, data leakage, gambling, and weapon
sales. What are also observed are 580K Twitter accounts publishing PIPs as well
as 37K distinct instant messaging (IM) accounts that are embedded in PIPs and
serve as next hops of communication, which strongly indicates that the
campaigns underpinning PIPs are also of a large scale. Also, an arms race
between Twitter and illicit promotion operators is also observed. On one hand,
Twitter is observed to conduct content moderation in a continuous manner and
almost 80% PIPs will get gradually unpublished within six months since posted.
However, in the meantime, miscreants adopt various evasion tactics to
masquerade their PIPs, which renders more than 90% PIPs keeping hidden from the
detection radar for two months or longer.
translated: 在这篇论文中，我们提出了一个广泛的研究，促进非法商品和服务在 Twitter，一个流行的在线社交网络(OSN)。这项研究之所以成为可能，是因为设计和实施了多种新的工具，用于侦查和分析非法促销活动及其背后的运动。作为结果，我们观察到非法推广普遍存在于 Twitter 上，以及明显存在于其他三个流行的 OSNs，包括 Youtube，Facebook 和 TikTok。特别是，在 Twitter 平台上观察到1200万条不同的非法推广帖子，这些帖子以5种主要的自然语言和10种非法商品和服务广泛分布，例如毒品、数据泄露、赌博和武器销售。我们还观察到580k 发布 PIP 的 Twitter 帐户和37k 嵌入 PIP 的独立即时通讯(IM)帐户，这些帐户作为下一个通信跳跃，这有力地表明支持 PIP 的活动也是大规模的。此外，Twitter 和非法推广运营商之间的军备竞赛也被观察到。一方面，据观察，Twitter 以持续的方式进行内容审查，将近80% 的 PIP 将在发布后的六个月内逐渐停止发布。然而，与此同时，歹徒采取各种规避策略来伪装他们的 PIP，这使得90% 以上的 PIP 在两个月或更长的时间内隐藏在探测雷达之外。

title:
AnnoCTR: A Dataset for Detecting and Linking Entities, Tactics, and
  Techniques in Cyber Threat Reports
summary:
Monitoring the threat landscape to be aware of actual or potential attacks is
of utmost importance to cybersecurity professionals. Information about cyber
threats is typically distributed using natural language reports. Natural
language processing can help with managing this large amount of unstructured
information, yet to date, the topic has received little attention. With this
paper, we present AnnoCTR, a new CC-BY-SA-licensed dataset of cyber threat
reports. The reports have been annotated by a domain expert with named
entities, temporal expressions, and cybersecurity-specific concepts including
implicitly mentioned techniques and tactics. Entities and concepts are linked
to Wikipedia and the MITRE ATT&CK knowledge base, the most widely-used taxonomy
for classifying types of attacks. Prior datasets linking to MITRE ATT&CK either
provide a single label per document or annotate sentences out-of-context; our
dataset annotates entire documents in a much finer-grained way. In an
experimental study, we model the annotations of our dataset using
state-of-the-art neural models. In our few-shot scenario, we find that for
identifying the MITRE ATT&CK concepts that are mentioned explicitly or
implicitly in a text, concept descriptions from MITRE ATT&CK are an effective
source for training data augmentation.
translated: 监测威胁情况以了解实际或潜在的攻击对网络安全专业人员至关重要。关于网络威胁的信息通常使用自然语言报告进行分发。自然语言处理可以帮助管理大量的非结构化信息，但是到目前为止，这个主题还没有引起足够的重视。在本文中，我们提出了 AnnoCTR，一个新的 CC-BY-SA 许可的网络威胁报告数据集。这些报告已由一位领域专家注释，其中包括命名实体、时间表达式和网络安全特定概念，包括隐含提到的技术和策略。实体和概念链接到 Wikipedia 和 MITRE ATT & CK 知识库，这是用于对攻击类型进行分类的最广泛使用的分类法。先前的数据集链接到 MITRE ATT & CK 要么提供一个单一的标签每个文档或注释句子脱离上下文; 我们的数据集注释整个文档在一个更细粒度的方式。在一个实验研究中，我们使用最先进的神经模型对数据集的注释进行建模。在我们的短镜头场景中，我们发现，为了识别文本中明确或隐含提到的 MITRE ATT & CK 概念，来自 MITRE ATT & CK 的概念描述是培训数据增强的有效来源。

title:
Opportunistic Sensor-Based Multi-Factor Authentication in and for the
  Internet of Things
summary:
Communication between connected objects often requires secure and reliable
authentication mechanisms. These mechanisms are essential for verifying the
identities of objects and preventing unauthorized access. The IoT offers
several advantages and opportunities that are not necessarily found in other
domains. For instance, IoT sensors collect real-time data about their
environment and other objects which contain valuable information that, if used,
can reinforce authentication. In this paper, we propose a novel idea for
building opportunistic sensor-based authentication factors between IoT objects
by leveraging the sensors already present in the systems where they interact.
We claim that sensors can be utilized to build factors that reinforce
object-to-object authentication mechanisms. Through the integration of these
opportunistic sensor-based authentication factors into multi-factor
authentication mechanisms, authentication in IoT can achieve a higher level of
security. We provide illustrative experiments on two types of vehicles : mobile
robots and cars.
translated: 连接对象之间的通信通常需要安全可靠的身份验证机制。这些机制对于验证对象的身份和防止未经授权的访问至关重要。物联网提供了一些其他领域所没有的优势和机会。例如，物联网传感器收集有关其环境和其他对象的实时数据，其中包含有价值的信息，如果使用，可以加强认证。在本文中，我们提出了一个新的想法，通过利用传感器已经存在于物联网对象之间的交互系统中，建立机会主义的基于传感器的认证因子。我们声称传感器可以用来构建加强对象对对象身份验证机制的因素。透过把这些机会主义的基于传感器的认证因素整合到双重身份验证机制中，物联网的认证可以达到更高的安全水平。我们提供了两种类型的车辆: 移动机器人和汽车的说明性实验。

title:
Dealing with Subject Similarity in Differential Morphing Attack
  Detection
summary:
The advent of morphing attacks has posed significant security concerns for
automated Face Recognition systems, raising the pressing need for robust and
effective Morphing Attack Detection (MAD) methods able to effectively address
this issue. In this paper, we focus on Differential MAD (D-MAD), where a
trusted live capture, usually representing the criminal, is compared with the
document image to classify it as morphed or bona fide. We show these approaches
based on identity features are effective when the morphed image and the live
one are sufficiently diverse; unfortunately, the effectiveness is significantly
reduced when the same approaches are applied to look-alike subjects or in all
those cases when the similarity between the two compared images is high (e.g.
comparison between the morphed image and the accomplice). Therefore, in this
paper, we propose ACIdA, a modular D-MAD system, consisting of a module for the
attempt type classification, and two modules for the identity and artifacts
analysis on input images. Successfully addressing this task would allow
broadening the D-MAD applications including, for instance, the document
enrollment stage, which currently relies entirely on human evaluation, thus
limiting the possibility of releasing ID documents with manipulated images, as
well as the automated gates to detect both accomplices and criminals. An
extensive cross-dataset experimental evaluation conducted on the introduced
scenario shows that ACIdA achieves state-of-the-art results, outperforming
literature competitors, while maintaining good performance in traditional D-MAD
benchmarks.
translated: 变形攻击的出现给自动人脸识别系统带来了严重的安全隐患，迫切需要有效的变形攻击检测(MAD)方法来有效地解决这一问题。本文主要研究差分 MAD (D-MAD)技术，将通常代表犯罪分子的可信实时捕获与文档图像进行比较，将其归类为变形的或真实的。我们展示了这些基于身份特征的方法在变形图像和实际图像足够多样化的情况下是有效的; 不幸的是，当相同的方法应用于相似的对象时，或者在所有这些情况下，当两个比较图像之间的相似性很高时(例如变形图像和共犯之间的比较) ，有效性显着降低。因此，本文提出了一个模块化的 D-MAD 系统 ACIdA，它由一个尝试类型分类模块和两个输入图像识别和伪影分析模块组成。成功地解决这一任务将允许扩大 D-MAD 应用程序，例如，文件登记阶段，目前完全依赖于人的评估，从而限制了释放带有被操纵图像的 ID 文件的可能性，以及自动门来检测共犯和罪犯。对所介绍的场景进行了广泛的跨数据集实验评估，结果表明 ACIdA 在保持传统 D-MAD 基准测试良好性能的同时，取得了最先进的结果，优于文献竞争对手。

title:
Fragile Model Watermark for integrity protection: leveraging boundary
  volatility and sensitive sample-pairing
summary:
Neural networks have increasingly influenced people's lives. Ensuring the
faithful deployment of neural networks as designed by their model owners is
crucial, as they may be susceptible to various malicious or unintentional
modifications, such as backdooring and poisoning attacks. Fragile model
watermarks aim to prevent unexpected tampering that could lead DNN models to
make incorrect decisions. They ensure the detection of any tampering with the
model as sensitively as possible.However, prior watermarking methods suffered
from inefficient sample generation and insufficient sensitivity, limiting their
practical applicability. Our approach employs a sample-pairing technique,
placing the model boundaries between pairs of samples, while simultaneously
maximizing logits. This ensures that the model's decision results of sensitive
samples change as much as possible and the Top-1 labels easily alter regardless
of the direction it moves.
translated: 神经网络越来越多地影响着人们的生活。确保神经网络的忠实部署由其模型所有者设计是至关重要的，因为它们可能容易受到各种恶意或无意的修改，如后门和中毒攻击。脆弱模型水印的目的是防止意外篡改，可能导致 DNN 模型作出不正确的决定。它们确保尽可能敏感地检测到任何篡改模型的行为。然而，现有的水印方法存在样本生成效率低、灵敏度不足等问题，限制了其实际应用。我们的方法采用了样本配对技术，将模型边界放置在样本对之间，同时使 logit 最大化。这样可以确保模型对敏感样品的决策结果尽可能多地改变，而且不管其移动的方向如何，Top-1标签都可以轻松地改变。

title: Differentially Private Reinforcement Learning with Self-Play
summary:
We study the problem of multi-agent reinforcement learning (multi-agent RL)
with differential privacy (DP) constraints. This is well-motivated by various
real-world applications involving sensitive data, where it is critical to
protect users' private information. We first extend the definitions of Joint DP
(JDP) and Local DP (LDP) to two-player zero-sum episodic Markov Games, where
both definitions ensure trajectory-wise privacy protection. Then we design a
provably efficient algorithm based on optimistic Nash value iteration and
privatization of Bernstein-type bonuses. The algorithm is able to satisfy JDP
and LDP requirements when instantiated with appropriate privacy mechanisms.
Furthermore, for both notions of DP, our regret bound generalizes the best
known result under the single-agent RL case, while our regret could also reduce
to the best known result for multi-agent RL without privacy constraints. To the
best of our knowledge, these are the first line of results towards
understanding trajectory-wise privacy protection in multi-agent RL.
translated: 我们研究了带有强化学习约束(DP)的多主体差分隐私(multi-agent RL)问题。这是由各种涉及敏感数据的现实应用程序推动的，在这些应用程序中，保护用户的私人信息至关重要。我们首先将联合 DP (JDP)和局部 DP (LDP)的定义扩展到两人零和情节马尔可夫对策，这两种定义都保证了轨迹方向的隐私保护。然后，我们设计了一个基于乐观纳什值迭代和伯恩斯坦型奖金私有化的可证有效算法。当使用适当的隐私机制进行实例化时，该算法能够满足 JDP 和 LDP 的需求。此外，对于 DP 的两个概念，我们的遗憾界推广了单代理 RL 情况下的最佳已知结果，而我们的遗憾界也可以减少到没有隐私约束的多代理 RL 情况下的最佳已知结果。据我们所知，这些是理解多代理 RL 中的轨迹式隐私保护的第一步结果。

title:
FCert: Certifiably Robust Few-Shot Classification in the Era of
  Foundation Models
summary:
Few-shot classification with foundation models (e.g., CLIP, DINOv2, PaLM-2)
enables users to build an accurate classifier with a few labeled training
samples (called support samples) for a classification task. However, an
attacker could perform data poisoning attacks by manipulating some support
samples such that the classifier makes the attacker-desired, arbitrary
prediction for a testing input. Empirical defenses cannot provide formal
robustness guarantees, leading to a cat-and-mouse game between the attacker and
defender. Existing certified defenses are designed for traditional supervised
learning, resulting in sub-optimal performance when extended to few-shot
classification. In our work, we propose FCert, the first certified defense
against data poisoning attacks to few-shot classification. We show our FCert
provably predicts the same label for a testing input under arbitrary data
poisoning attacks when the total number of poisoned support samples is bounded.
We perform extensive experiments on benchmark few-shot classification datasets
with foundation models released by OpenAI, Meta, and Google in both vision and
text domains. Our experimental results show our FCert: 1) maintains
classification accuracy without attacks, 2) outperforms existing
state-of-the-art certified defenses for data poisoning attacks, and 3) is
efficient and general.
translated: 使用基础模型(例如 CLIP、 DINOV2、 PaLM-2)的少镜头分类使用户能够使用一些标记的训练样本(称为支持样本)为一个分类任务构建一个准确的分类器。然而，攻击者可以通过操纵一些支持样本来执行数据中毒攻击，这样分类器就可以对测试输入进行攻击者想要的任意预测。经验防御不能提供正式的健壮性保证，导致攻击者和防御者之间的猫捉老鼠游戏。现有的认证防御系统是为传统的监督式学习设计的，当扩展到少投分类时，会导致性能欠佳。在我们的工作中，我们提出了 FCert，第一个针对数据中毒攻击的认证防御分类。我们展示了当中毒支持样本的总数是有界的时候，我们的 FCert 可证明地为任意数据中毒攻击下的测试输入预测相同的标签。我们使用 OpenAI、 Meta 和 Google 在视觉和文本领域发布的基础模型，对基准少镜头分类数据集进行了广泛的实验。我们的实验结果表明，我们的 FCert: 1)在没有攻击的情况下保持分类的准确性，2)在数据中毒攻击方面优于现有的最先进的认证防御，3)是高效和通用的。

title:
Online Safety Analysis for LLMs: a Benchmark, an Assessment, and a Path
  Forward
summary:
While Large Language Models (LLMs) have seen widespread applications across
numerous fields, their limited interpretability poses concerns regarding their
safe operations from multiple aspects, e.g., truthfulness, robustness, and
fairness. Recent research has started developing quality assurance methods for
LLMs, introducing techniques such as offline detector-based or uncertainty
estimation methods. However, these approaches predominantly concentrate on
post-generation analysis, leaving the online safety analysis for LLMs during
the generation phase an unexplored area. To bridge this gap, we conduct in this
work a comprehensive evaluation of the effectiveness of existing online safety
analysis methods on LLMs. We begin with a pilot study that validates the
feasibility of detecting unsafe outputs in the early generation process.
Following this, we establish the first publicly available benchmark of online
safety analysis for LLMs, including a broad spectrum of methods, models, tasks,
datasets, and evaluation metrics. Utilizing this benchmark, we extensively
analyze the performance of state-of-the-art online safety analysis methods on
both open-source and closed-source LLMs. This analysis reveals the strengths
and weaknesses of individual methods and offers valuable insights into
selecting the most appropriate method based on specific application scenarios
and task requirements. Furthermore, we also explore the potential of using
hybridization methods, i.e., combining multiple methods to derive a collective
safety conclusion, to enhance the efficacy of online safety analysis for LLMs.
Our findings indicate a promising direction for the development of innovative
and trustworthy quality assurance methodologies for LLMs, facilitating their
reliable deployments across diverse domains.
translated: 虽然大语言模型(LLM)已经在许多领域得到了广泛的应用，但是它们有限的可解释性从多个方面(如真实性、鲁棒性和公平性)引起了人们对其安全操作的关注。最近的研究已经开始为 LLM 开发质量保证方法，引入离线检测器或不确定性评估方法等技术。然而，这些方法主要集中在生成后分析，使在线安全性分析生成阶段的 LLM 一个未探索的领域。为了弥补这一差距，我们在这项工作中对现有的 LLM 在线安全分析方法的有效性进行了全面的评估。我们从一个试点研究开始，验证在早期生成过程中检测不安全输出的可行性。接下来，我们建立了第一个公开可用的 LLM 在线安全分析基准，包括广泛的方法、模型、任务、数据集和评估指标。利用这个基准，我们广泛地分析了最先进的在线安全分析方法在开源和闭源 LLM 上的性能。该分析揭示了个别方法的优缺点，并提供了基于具体应用场景和任务需求选择最合适的方法的宝贵见解。此外，我们还探讨了使用杂交方法的潜力，即结合多种方法得出集体安全性结论，以提高 LLM 在线安全性分析的有效性。我们的研究结果为开发创新和可信赖的 LLM 质量保证方法提供了一个有希望的方向，促进了它们在不同领域的可靠部署。

title: Manifest V3 Unveiled: Navigating the New Era of Browser Extensions
summary:
Introduced over a decade ago, Chrome extensions now exceed 200,000 in number.
In 2020, Google announced a shift in extension development with Manifest
Version 3 (V3), aiming to replace the previous Version 2 (V2) by January 2023.
This deadline was later extended to January 2025. The company's decision is
grounded in enhancing three main pillars: privacy, security, and performance.
This paper presents a comprehensive analysis of the Manifest V3 ecosystem. We
start by investigating the adoption rate of V3, detailing the percentage of
adoption from its announcement up until 2024. Our findings indicate, prior to
the 2023 pause, less than 5% of all extensions had transitioned to V3, despite
the looming deadline for the complete removal of V2, while currently nine out
of ten new extensions are being uploaded in Manifest V3. Furthermore, we
compare the security and privacy enhancements between V2 and V3 and we evaluate
the improved security attributable to V3's safer APIs, examining how certain
