translated: 为了解决分散系统中数据完整性的关键问题，本文深入研究了区块链和物联网(IoT)技术中的关键技术——默克尔树(Merkle Tree)的数据伪造概率。尽管它们被广泛使用，但是对这些结构中数据安全的概率方面的全面理解仍然是目前研究中的一个空白。我们的研究旨在通过建立一个理论框架来计算数据伪造的可能性，同时考虑基于 Merkle 路径长度和 hash 长度的各种情况，从而弥补这一差距。研究从推导证伪概率的精确公式发展到适用于散列长度显著较大情况的近似公式。实验验证了理论模型的正确性，探索了不同散列长度和 Merkle 路径长度的仿真方法。结果表明，随着散列长度的增加，伪造概率下降，并与较长的 Merkle 路径成反比关系。数值分析量化了精确概率和近似概率之间的差异，强调了有效应用近似概率的条件。这项工作为优化 Merkle 树结构提供了重要的见解，以支持区块链和物联网系统的安全性，实现计算效率和数据完整性之间的平衡。

title: Preserving Nature's Ledger: Blockchains in Biodiversity Conservation
summary:
In the contemporary era, biodiversity conservation emerges as a paramount
challenge, necessitating innovative approaches to monitoring, preserving, and
enhancing the natural world. This paper explores the integration of blockchain
technology in biodiversity conservation, offering a novel perspective on how
digital resilience can be built within ecological contexts. Blockchain, with
its decentralized and immutable ledger and tokenization affordances, presents a
groundbreaking solution for the accurate monitoring and tracking of
environmental assets, thereby addressing the critical need for transparency and
trust in conservation efforts. Unlike previous more theoretical approaches, by
addressing the research question of how blockchain supports digital resilience
in biodiversity conservation, this study presents a grounded framework that
justifies which blockchain features are essential to decipher specific data
contribution and data leveraging processes in an effort to protect our planet's
biodiversity, while boosting potential economic benefits for all actors
involved, from local farmers, to hardware vendors and artificial intelligence
experts, to investors and regular users, volunteers and donors.
translated: 在当代，生物多样性保护作为一个最重要的挑战出现，需要创新的方法来监测，保存和加强自然世界。本文探讨了区块链技术在生物多样性保护中的整合，为如何在生态环境中建立数字复原力提供了一个新的视角。区块链以其分散和不变的分类账和标记功能，为准确监测和跟踪环境资产提供了一个开创性的解决方案，从而满足了对保护工作的透明度和信任的迫切需要。与以前更多的理论方法不同，通过解决区块链如何支持生物多样性保护中的数字弹性的研究问题，这项研究提供了一个基础框架，证明哪些区块链特征对于破译特定的数据贡献和数据利用过程至关重要，以努力保护我们星球的生物多样性，同时提高所有参与者的潜在经济效益，从当地农民，到硬件供应商和人工智能专家，到投资者和常规用户，志愿者和捐助者。

title:
E-Vote Your Conscience: Perceptions of Coercion and Vote Buying, and the
  Usability of Fake Credentials in Online Voting
summary:
Online voting is attractive for convenience and accessibility, but is more
susceptible to voter coercion and vote buying than in-person voting. One
mitigation is to give voters fake voting credentials that they can yield to a
coercer. Fake credentials appear identical to real ones, but cast votes that
are silently omitted from the final tally. An important unanswered question is
how ordinary voters perceive such a mitigation: whether they could understand
and use fake credentials, and whether the coercion risks justify the costs of
mitigation. We present the first systematic study of these questions, involving
150 diverse individuals in Boston, Massachusetts. All participants "registered"
and "voted" in a mock election: 120 were exposed to coercion resistance via
fake credentials, the rest forming a control group. Of the 120 participants
exposed to fake credentials, 96% understood their use. 53% reported that they
would create fake credentials in a real-world voting scenario, given the
opportunity. 10% mistakenly voted with a fake credential, however. 22% reported
either personal experience with or direct knowledge of coercion or vote-buying
incidents. These latter participants rated the coercion-resistant system
essentially as trustworthy as in-person voting via hand-marked paper ballots.
Of the 150 total participants to use the system, 87% successfully created their
credentials without assistance; 83% both successfully created and properly used
their credentials. Participants give a System Usability Scale score of 70.4,
which is slightly above the industry's average score of 68. Our findings appear
to support the importance of the coercion problem in general, and the promise
of fake credentials as a possible mitigation, but user error rates remain an
important usability challenge for future work.
translated: 网上投票因其方便易用而颇具吸引力，但与亲身投票相比，网上投票更容易受到选民胁迫和购买选票的影响。一个缓解措施是给选民提供虚假的投票凭证，让他们屈服于胁迫。假凭证看起来和真凭证一模一样，但是投票却被默默地从最终计票中遗漏了。一个尚未得到解答的重要问题是，普通选民如何看待这种缓解措施: 他们是否能够理解和使用假证书，以及这种胁迫风险是否证明缓解措施的成本是合理的。我们提出了这些问题的第一个系统研究，涉及150个不同的个人在波士顿，马萨诸塞州。所有参与者在模拟选举中“登记”并“投票”: 120名参与者通过伪造证书遭到强制抵抗，其余参与者组成对照组。在120名接触到假证件的参与者中，96% 的人理解它们的用途。53% 的受访者表示，如果有机会，他们会在现实世界的投票场景中伪造证书。然而，10% 的人错误地用假证书投票。22% 的受访者表示有亲身经历或直接了解胁迫或贿选事件。这些后来的参与者认为，抵制胁迫的制度基本上与通过手写选票进行的面对面投票一样可信。在使用该系统的总共150名参与者中，87% 的人在没有帮助的情况下成功地创建了他们的凭证; 83% 的人成功地创建并正确地使用了他们的凭证。参与者给出的系统可用性量表得分为70.4，略高于行业平均得分68。我们的研究结果似乎支持强制问题的重要性，并承诺假凭证作为一种可能的缓解措施，但用户错误率仍然是未来工作的一个重要的可用性挑战。

title:
Using Real-world Bug Bounty Programs in Secure Coding Course: Experience
  Report
summary:
To keep up with the growing number of cyber-attacks and associated threats,
there is an ever-increasing demand for cybersecurity professionals and new
methods and technologies. Training new cybersecurity professionals is a
challenging task due to the broad scope of the area. One particular field where
there is a shortage of experts is Ethical Hacking. Due to its complexity, it
often faces educational constraints. Recognizing these challenges, we propose a
solution: integrating a real-world bug bounty programme into cybersecurity
curriculum. This innovative approach aims to fill the gap in practical
cybersecurity education and also brings additional positive benefits. To
evaluate our idea, we include the proposed solution to a secure coding course
for IT-oriented faculty. We let students choose to participate in a bug bounty
programme as an option for the semester assignment in a secure coding course.
We then collected responses from the students to evaluate the outcomes
(improved skills, reported vulnerabilities, a better relationship with
security, etc.). Evaluation of the assignment showed that students enjoyed
solving such real-world problems, could find real vulnerabilities, and that it
helped raise their skills and cybersecurity awareness. Participation in real
bug bounty programmes also positively affects the security level of the tested
products. We also discuss the potential risks of this approach and how to
mitigate them.
translated: 为了跟上网络攻击和相关威胁日益增多的趋势，人们对网络安全专业人员和新的方法和技术的需求日益增加。由于该领域范围广泛，培训新的网络安全专业人员是一项具有挑战性的任务。缺乏专家的一个特殊领域是道德黑客。由于其复杂性，它往往面临教育的限制。认识到这些挑战，我们提出了一个解决方案: 将现实世界的昆虫奖励计划纳入网络安全课程。这一创新办法旨在填补实用网络安全教育的空白，并带来额外的积极效益。为了评估我们的想法，我们包括提议的解决方案，为 IT 导向的教师安全编码课程。我们让学生选择参加一个错误奖励计划作为一个选择，学期作业在一个安全的编码课程。然后我们收集学生的反馈来评估结果(提高技能，报告脆弱性，与安全的关系更好，等等)。对作业的评估表明，学生喜欢解决这些现实世界的问题，能够找到真正的弱点，而且这有助于提高他们的技能和网络安全意识。参与实际漏洞奖励计划也对测试产品的安全水平产生积极影响。我们还讨论了这种方法的潜在风险以及如何减轻这些风险。

title: RedactBuster: Entity Type Recognition from Redacted Documents
summary:
The widespread exchange of digital documents in various domains has resulted
in abundant private information being shared. This proliferation necessitates
redaction techniques to protect sensitive content and user privacy. While
numerous redaction methods exist, their effectiveness varies, with some proving
more robust than others. As such, the literature proposes several
deanonymization techniques, raising awareness of potential privacy threats.
However, while none of these methods are successful against the most effective
redaction techniques, these attacks only focus on the anonymized tokens and
ignore the sentence context.
  In this paper, we propose RedactBuster, the first deanonymization model using
sentence context to perform Named Entity Recognition on reacted text. Our
methodology leverages fine-tuned state-of-the-art Transformers and Deep
Learning models to determine the anonymized entity types in a document. We test
RedactBuster against the most effective redaction technique and evaluate it
using the publicly available Text Anonymization Benchmark (TAB). Our results
show accuracy values up to 0.985 regardless of the document nature or entity
type. In raising awareness of this privacy issue, we propose a countermeasure
we call character evasion that helps strengthen the secrecy of sensitive
information. Furthermore, we make our model and testbed open-source to aid
researchers and practitioners in evaluating the resilience of novel redaction
techniques and enhancing document privacy.
translated: 数字文件在各个领域的广泛交流导致了大量私人信息的共享。这种扩散需要编校技术来保护敏感内容和用户隐私。尽管存在许多编校方法，但它们的有效性各不相同，有些方法被证明比其他方法更强大。因此，文献提出了几种去匿名化技术，提高了对潜在隐私威胁的认识。然而，虽然这些方法都不能成功地对付最有效的编校技术，但是这些攻击只关注匿名标记，而忽略了句子上下文。本文提出了第一个利用句子上下文对反应文本进行命名实体识别的去匿名化模型 RedactBuster。我们的方法利用最先进的变形金刚和深度学习模型来确定文档中的匿名实体类型。我们针对最有效的编校技术测试 RedactBuster，并使用公开可用的文本匿名基准(TAB)对其进行评估。我们的结果显示，无论文档性质或实体类型如何，精确度值都高达0.985。为了提高人们对这个隐私问题的认识，我们提出了一个对策，我们称之为字符规避，它有助于加强敏感信息的保密性。此外，我们使我们的模型和测试平台开源，以帮助研究人员和从业人员评估新的编校技术的弹性和增强文档隐私。

title: Private Agent-Based Modeling
summary:
The practical utility of agent-based models in decision-making relies on
their capacity to accurately replicate populations while seamlessly integrating
real-world data streams. Yet, the incorporation of such data poses significant
challenges due to privacy concerns. To address this issue, we introduce a
paradigm for private agent-based modeling wherein the simulation, calibration,
and analysis of agent-based models can be achieved without centralizing the
agents attributes or interactions. The key insight is to leverage techniques
from secure multi-party computation to design protocols for decentralized
computation in agent-based models. This ensures the confidentiality of the
simulated agents without compromising on simulation accuracy. We showcase our
protocols on a case study with an epidemiological simulation comprising over
150,000 agents. We believe this is a critical step towards deploying
agent-based models to real-world applications.
translated: 基于代理的模型在决策中的实际效用依赖于它们在无缝整合现实世界数据流的同时精确复制人口的能力。然而，由于隐私问题，这些数据的合并带来了巨大的挑战。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一个基于私有代理的建模范例，其中基于代理的模型的模拟、校准和分析可以在不集中代理属性或交互的情况下实现。关键的见解是利用从安全多方计算到设计协议的技术，在基于代理的模型中进行分散计算。这保证了模拟代理的机密性，同时又不影响模拟的准确性。我们展示我们的协议在一个案例研究与流行病学模拟包括超过150,000代理人。我们相信这是将基于代理的模型部署到实际应用程序的关键一步。

title:
Physical Backdoor Attack can Jeopardize Driving with
  Vision-Large-Language Models
summary:
Vision-Large-Language-models(VLMs) have great application prospects in
autonomous driving. Despite the ability of VLMs to comprehend and make
decisions in complex scenarios, their integration into safety-critical
autonomous driving systems poses serious security risks. In this paper, we
propose BadVLMDriver, the first backdoor attack against VLMs for autonomous
driving that can be launched in practice using physical objects. Unlike
existing backdoor attacks against VLMs that rely on digital modifications,
BadVLMDriver uses common physical items, such as a red balloon, to induce
unsafe actions like sudden acceleration, highlighting a significant real-world
threat to autonomous vehicle safety. To execute BadVLMDriver, we develop an
automated pipeline utilizing natural language instructions to generate backdoor
training samples with embedded malicious behaviors. This approach allows for
flexible trigger and behavior selection, enhancing the stealth and practicality
of the attack in diverse scenarios. We conduct extensive experiments to
evaluate BadVLMDriver for two representative VLMs, five different trigger
objects, and two types of malicious backdoor behaviors. BadVLMDriver achieves a
92% attack success rate in inducing a sudden acceleration when coming across a
pedestrian holding a red balloon. Thus, BadVLMDriver not only demonstrates a
critical security risk but also emphasizes the urgent need for developing
robust defense mechanisms to protect against such vulnerabilities in autonomous
driving technologies.
translated: 视觉大语言模型(VLM)在自主驾驶中具有广阔的应用前景。尽管 VLM 能够理解复杂场景并做出决策，但是将它们集成到安全至关重要的自主驾驶系统中会带来严重的安全风险。在本文中，我们提出了 BadVLMDriver，第一个针对自主驾驶的 VLM 的后门攻击，可以在实践中使用物理对象发射。与现有的依赖于数字修改的 VLMs 后门攻击不同，BadvlMDriver 使用常见的物理项，比如红气球，来诱导突然加速等不安全的行为，突出了现实世界对无人机安全的重大威胁。为了执行 BadVLMDriver，我们开发了一个自动管道，利用自然语言指令生成具有嵌入式恶意行为的后门训练样本。这种方法允许灵活的触发器和行为选择，增强了不同场景中攻击的隐蔽性和实用性。我们进行了广泛的实验来评估 BadVLMDriver 的两个代表性的 VLM，五个不同的触发器对象，和两种类型的恶意后门行为。BadVLMDriver 实现了92% 的攻击成功率，在遇到手持红色气球的行人时诱导突然加速。因此，BadVLMDriver 不仅展示了一个关键的安全风险，而且还强调了开发强大的防御机制以防止自动驾驶技术中的此类漏洞的迫切需要。

title: The Power of Words: Generating PowerShell Attacks from Natural Language
summary:
As the Windows OS stands out as one of the most targeted systems, the
PowerShell language has become a key tool for malicious actors and
cybersecurity professionals (e.g., for penetration testing). This work explores
an uncharted domain in AI code generation by automatically generating offensive
PowerShell code from natural language descriptions using Neural Machine
Translation (NMT). For training and evaluation purposes, we propose two novel
datasets with PowerShell code samples, one with manually curated descriptions
in natural language and another code-only dataset for reinforcing the training.
We present an extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art NMT models and analyze
the generated code both statically and dynamically. Results indicate that
tuning NMT using our dataset is effective at generating offensive PowerShell
code. Comparative analysis against the most widely used LLM service ChatGPT
reveals the specialized strengths of our fine-tuned models.
translated: 由于 Windows 操作系统是目标最明确的系统之一，PowerShell 语言已经成为恶意行为者和网络安全专业人员的关键工具(例如，渗透测试)。这项工作探索了人工智能代码生成的一个未知领域，通过使用神经机器翻译(NMT)从自然语言描述自动生成进攻性 PowerShell 代码。为了训练和评估的目的，我们提出了两个新的数据集与 PowerShell 代码样本，一个手动策划的描述在自然语言和另一个只有代码的数据集，以加强训练。我们提出了一个广泛的评估状态的最先进的 NMT 模型和分析静态和动态生成的代码。结果表明，使用我们的数据集调优 NMT 可以有效地生成进攻性 PowerShell 代码。通过与最广泛使用的 LLM 服务 ChatGPT 进行比较分析，可以发现我们微调模型的专门优势。

title: Physical Layer Authentication Using Information Reconciliation
summary:
User authentication in future wireless communication networks is expected to
become more complicated due to their large scale and heterogeneity.
Furthermore, the computational complexity of classical cryptographic approaches
based on public key distribution can be a limiting factor for using in simple,
low-end Internet of things (IoT) devices. This paper proposes physical layer
authentication (PLA) expected to complement existing traditional approaches,
e.g., in multi-factor authentication protocols. The precision and consistency
of PLA is impacted because of random variations of wireless channel
realizations between different time slots, which can impair authentication
performance. In order to address this, a method based on error-correcting codes
in the form of reconciliation is considered in this work. In particular, we
adopt distributed source coding (Slepian-Wolf) reconciliation using polar codes
to reconcile channel measurements spread in time. Hypothesis testing is then
applied to the reconciled vectors to accept or reject the device as
authenticated. Simulation results show that the proposed PLA using
reconciliation outperforms prior schemes even in low signal-to-noise ratio
scenarios.
translated: 未来无线通信网络的用户认证由于其规模大、异构性强等特点，有望变得更加复杂。此外，基于公钥分布的经典密码方法的计算复杂性可能是在简单的低端物联网(IoT)设备中使用的一个限制因素。本文提出物理层认证(PLA)可以补充现有的传统方法，例如双重身份验证协议。由于无线信道实现在不同时隙之间的随机变化会影响 PLA 的精度和一致性，从而影响认证性能。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种基于纠错码的协调方法。特别是，我们采用分布式信源编码(Slepian-Wolf)协调，使用极性编码协调信道测量的时间传播。然后，假设检验被应用到协调的向量，以接受或拒绝经过身份验证的设备。仿真结果表明，即使在低信噪比情况下，使用和解的 PLA 方案也优于先前的方案。

title: Nyon Unchained: Forensic Analysis of Bosch's eBike Board Computers
summary:
Modern eBike on-board computers are basically small PCs that not only offer
motor control, navigation, and performance monitoring, but also store lots of
sensitive user data. The Bosch Nyon series of board computers are cutting-edge
devices from one of the market leaders in the eBike business, which is why they
are especially interesting for forensics. Therefore, we conducted an in-depth
forensic analysis of the two available Nyon models released in 2014 and 2021.
On a first-generation Nyon device, Telnet access could be established by
abusing a design flaw in the update procedure, which allowed the acquisition of
relevant data without risking damage to the hardware. Besides the user's
personal information, the data analysis revealed databases containing user
activities, including timestamps and GPS coordinates. Furthermore, it was
possible to forge the data on the device and transfer it to Bosch's servers to
be persisted across their online service and smartphone app. On a current
second-generation Nyon device, no software-based access could be obtained. For
this reason, more intrusive hardware-based options were considered, and the
data could be extracted via chip-off eventually. Despite encryption, the user
data could be accessed and evaluated. Besides location and user information,
the newer model holds even more forensically relevant data, such as nearby
Bluetooth devices.
translated: 现代电动自行车车载计算机基本上是小型个人电脑，不仅提供电机控制，导航和性能监测，但也存储大量敏感的用户数据。博世尼翁(Bosch Nyon)系列电路板计算机是电子自行车行业领先市场之一的尖端设备，这就是为什么它们对取证特别有趣。因此，我们对2014年和2021年推出的两款尼翁车型进行了深入的鉴证分析。在第一代尼翁设备上，Telnet 可以通过滥用更新程序中的一个设计缺陷来建立访问，这个缺陷允许获取相关数据，而不会对硬件造成损害。除了用户的个人信息，数据分析还揭示了包含用户活动的数据库，包括时间戳和 GPS 坐标。此外，还可以伪造设备上的数据，并将其转移到博世的服务器上，以便通过博世的在线服务和智能手机应用程序进行持久化。在目前的第二代尼翁设备上，无法获得基于软件的访问。由于这个原因，考虑了更多的基于硬件的侵入性选项，并且最终可以通过切片来提取数据。尽管有加密，用户数据仍然可以被访问和评估。除了位置和用户信息之外，新的模型还保存了更多法医学上相关的数据，比如附近的蓝牙设备。

title:
Ransomware Detection and Classification Using Random Forest: A Case
  Study with the UGRansome2024 Dataset
summary:
Cybersecurity faces challenges in identifying and mitigating ransomware,
which is important for protecting critical infrastructures. The absence of
datasets for distinguishing normal versus abnormal network behaviour hinders
the development of proactive detection strategies against ransomware. An
obstacle in proactive prevention methods is the absence of comprehensive
datasets for contrasting normal versus abnormal network behaviours. The dataset
enabling such contrasts would significantly expedite threat anomaly mitigation.
In this study, we introduce UGRansome2024, an optimised dataset for ransomware
detection in network traffic. This dataset is derived from the UGRansome data
using an intuitionistic feature engineering approach that considers only
relevant patterns in network behaviour analysis. The study presents an analysis
of ransomware detection using the UGRansome2024 dataset and the Random Forest
algorithm. Through encoding and feature relevance determination, the Random
Forest achieved a classification accuracy of 96% and effectively identified
unusual ransomware transactions. Findings indicate that certain ransomware
variants, such as those utilising Encrypt Decrypt Algorithms (EDA) and Globe
ransomware, have the highest financial impact. These insights have significant
implications for real-world cybersecurity practices, highlighting the
importance of machine learning in ransomware detection and mitigation. Further
research is recommended to expand datasets, explore alternative detection
methods, and address limitations in current approaches.
translated: 网络安全在识别和缓解勒索软件方面面临挑战，而勒索软件对于保护关键基础设施至关重要。缺乏用于区分正常和异常网络行为的数据集阻碍了对勒索软件的主动检测策略的发展。主动预防方法的一个障碍是缺乏对比正常和异常网络行为的综合数据集。启用这种对比的数据集将大大加快威胁异常缓解。在这项研究中，我们介绍了一个优化的数据集 UGRansome2024，用于网络流量中的勒索软件检测。该数据集来源于 UGRansome 数据，使用直观的特征工程方法，只考虑网络行为分析中的相关模式。该研究使用 UGRansom2024数据集和随机森林算法对勒索软件检测进行了分析。通过编码和特征相关性确定，随机森林的分类准确率达到96% ，并有效地识别异常勒索软件事务。研究结果表明，某些勒索软件变种，如使用加密解密算法(EDA)和全球勒索软件，有最高的财务影响。这些见解对现实世界的网络安全实践具有重要意义，突出了机器学习在勒索软件检测和缓解中的重要性。建议进一步研究扩大数据集，探索替代检测方法，并解决当前方法的局限性。

title:
Migrating Software Systems towards Post-Quantum-Cryptography -- A
  Systematic Literature Review
summary:
Networks such as the Internet are essential for our connected world. Quantum
computing poses a threat to this heterogeneous infrastructure since it
threatens fundamental security mechanisms. Therefore, a migration to
post-quantum-cryptography (PQC) is necessary for networks and their components.
At the moment, there is little knowledge on how such migrations should be
structured and implemented in practice. Our systematic literature review
addresses migration approaches for IP networks towards PQC. It surveys papers
about the migration process and exemplary real-world software system
migrations. On the process side, we found that terminology, migration steps,
and roles are not defined precisely or consistently across the literature.
Still, we identified four major phases and appropriate substeps which we
matched with also emerging archetypes of roles. In terms of real-world
migrations, we see that reports used several different PQC implementations and
hybrid solutions for migrations of systems belonging to a wide range of system
types. Across all papers we noticed three major challenges for adopters:
missing experience of PQC and a high realization effort, concerns about the
security of the upcoming system, and finally, high complexity. Our findings
indicate that recent standardization efforts already push quantum-safe
networking forward. However, the literature is still not in consensus about
definitions and best practices. Implementations are mostly experimental and not
necessarily practical, leading to an overall chaotic situation. To better grasp
this fast moving field of (applied) research, our systematic literature review
provides a comprehensive overview of its current state and serves as a starting
point for delving into the matter of PQC migration.
translated: 像互联网这样的网络对于我们连接的世界是必不可少的。量子计算对这种异构的基础设施构成了威胁，因为它威胁到了基本的安全机制。因此，对于网络及其组件来说，向后量子密码学(PQC)的迁移是必要的。目前，对于如何在实践中构建和实现这种迁移知之甚少。我们的系统文献综述讨论了 IP 网络向 PQC 的迁移方法。它调查了关于迁移过程和典型的现实世界软件系统迁移的论文。在过程方面，我们发现术语、迁移步骤和角色在文献中没有精确或一致地定义。尽管如此，我们还是确定了四个主要阶段和适当的子步骤，并将其与新出现的角色原型相匹配。在真实世界的迁移方面，我们看到报告使用了几种不同的 PQC 实现和混合解决方案来迁移属于广泛系统类型的系统。在所有的论文中，我们都注意到了采用者面临的三个主要挑战: 缺少 PQC 经验和高实现努力，对即将到来的系统的安全性的担忧，以及最后，高复杂性。我们的研究结果表明，最近的标准化工作已经推动量子安全网络向前发展。然而，文献仍然没有达成一致的定义和最佳做法。实现大多是实验性的，不一定实用，导致整体的混乱局面。为了更好地把握这个快速发展的(应用)研究领域，我们的系统文献综述提供了一个全面的概述其现状，并作为一个起点深入研究 PQC 迁移的问题。

title:
LSP Framework: A Compensatory Model for Defeating Trigger Reverse
  Engineering via Label Smoothing Poisoning
summary:
Deep neural networks are vulnerable to backdoor attacks. Among the existing
backdoor defense methods, trigger reverse engineering based approaches, which
reconstruct the backdoor triggers via optimizations, are the most versatile and
effective ones compared to other types of methods. In this paper, we summarize
and construct a generic paradigm for the typical trigger reverse engineering
process. Based on this paradigm, we propose a new perspective to defeat trigger
reverse engineering by manipulating the classification confidence of backdoor
samples. To determine the specific modifications of classification confidence,
we propose a compensatory model to compute the lower bound of the modification.
With proper modifications, the backdoor attack can easily bypass the trigger
reverse engineering based methods. To achieve this objective, we propose a
Label Smoothing Poisoning (LSP) framework, which leverages label smoothing to
specifically manipulate the classification confidences of backdoor samples.
Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed work can defeat the
state-of-the-art trigger reverse engineering based methods, and possess good
compatibility with a variety of existing backdoor attacks.
translated: 深层神经网络容易受到后门攻击。在现有的后门防御方法中，基于触发逆向工程的方法(通过优化重建后门触发)比其他类型的方法更加通用和有效。在这篇文章中，我们总结并构建了一个典型的触发逆向工程过程的通用范例。基于这个范式，我们提出了一个新的视角，通过操纵后门样本的分类置信度来消除触发逆向工程。为了确定分类置信度的具体修正，我们提出了一个补偿模型来计算修正的下限。经过适当的修改，后门攻击可以很容易地绕过基于触发逆向工程的方法。为了实现这一目标，我们提出了一个标签平滑中毒(LSP)框架，该框架利用标签平滑来具体操作后门样本的分类置信度。大量的实验表明，提出的工作可以击败国家的最先进的触发逆向工程为基础的方法，并具有良好的兼容性与各种现有的后门攻击。

title:
Towards a decentralized data privacy protocol for self-sovereignty in
  the digital world
summary:
A typical user interacts with many digital services nowadays, providing these
services with their data. As of now, the management of privacy preferences is
service-centric: Users must manage their privacy preferences according to the
rules of each service provider, meaning that every provider offers its unique
mechanisms for users to control their privacy settings. However, managing
privacy preferences holistically (i.e., across multiple digital services) is
just impractical. In this vision paper, we propose a paradigm shift towards an
enriched user-centric approach for cross-service privacy preferences
management: the realization of a decentralized data privacy protocol.
translated: 当今，典型的用户与许多数字服务进行交互，为这些服务提供数据。到目前为止，隐私首选项的管理是以服务为中心的: 用户必须根据每个服务提供商的规则来管理他们的隐私首选项，这意味着每个服务提供商都为用户提供独特的机制来控制他们的隐私设置。然而，全面管理隐私偏好(即跨多个数字服务)是不切实际的。在这个愿景文件中，我们提出了一个范式转变，向一个丰富的用户为中心的方法跨服务隐私偏好管理: 实现一个分散的数据隐私协议。

title:
Poisoning Attacks on Federated Learning-based Wireless Traffic
  Prediction
summary:
Federated Learning (FL) offers a distributed framework to train a global
control model across multiple base stations without compromising the privacy of
their local network data. This makes it ideal for applications like wireless
traffic prediction (WTP), which plays a crucial role in optimizing network
resources, enabling proactive traffic flow management, and enhancing the
reliability of downstream communication-aided applications, such as IoT
devices, autonomous vehicles, and industrial automation systems. Despite its
promise, the security aspects of FL-based distributed wireless systems,
particularly in regression-based WTP problems, remain inadequately
investigated. In this paper, we introduce a novel fake traffic injection (FTI)
attack, designed to undermine the FL-based WTP system by injecting fabricated
traffic distributions with minimal knowledge. We further propose a defense
mechanism, termed global-local inconsistency detection (GLID), which
strategically removes abnormal model parameters that deviate beyond a specific
percentile range estimated through statistical methods in each dimension.
Extensive experimental evaluations, performed on real-world wireless traffic
datasets, demonstrate that both our attack and defense strategies significantly
outperform existing baselines.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)提供了一个分布式的框架来训练跨多个基站的全局控制模型，同时不损害其本地网络数据的隐私性。这使其成为无线流量预测(WTP)等应用程序的理想选择。 WTP 在优化网络资源、实现主动流量管理以及提高下游通信辅助应用程序(如物联网设备、自动驾驶汽车和工业自动化系统)的可靠性方面发挥着至关重要的作用。尽管它的承诺，基于 FL 的分布式无线系统的安全方面，特别是在基于回归的 WTP 问题，仍然没有充分的研究。本文介绍了一种新的虚假流量注入(FTI)攻击方法，该方法利用最小知识注入虚假流量分布来破坏基于 FL 的 WTP 系统。我们进一步提出了一种防御机制，称为全局-局部不一致性检测(GLID) ，它有策略地去除异常模型参数，这些参数超出了通过每个维度的统计方法估计的特定百分点范围。在真实世界的无线流量数据集上进行的大量实验评估表明，我们的攻击和防御策略都明显优于现有的基线。

title:
Chain of trust: Unraveling the references among Common Criteria
  certified products
summary:
With 5394 security certificates of IT products and systems, the Common
Criteria for Information Technology Security Evaluation have bred an ecosystem
entangled with various kind of relations between the certified products. Yet,
the prevalence and nature of dependencies among Common Criteria certified
products remains largely unexplored. This study devises a novel method for
building the graph of references among the Common Criteria certified products,
determining the different contexts of references with a supervised
machine-learning algorithm, and measuring how often the references constitute
actual dependencies between the certified products. With the help of the
resulting reference graph, this work identifies just a dozen of certified
components that are relied on by at least 10% of the whole ecosystem -- making
them a prime target for malicious actors. The impact of their compromise is
assessed and potentially problematic references to archived products are
discussed.
translated: 信息技术产品和系统的安全认证共有5394份，《信息技术安全评估通用标准》孕育了一个与认证产品之间的各种关系纠缠在一起的生态系统。然而，通用标准认证产品之间的依赖关系的普遍性和性质在很大程度上仍然是未知的。本研究设计了一种新的方法来建立通用标准认证产品之间的参考文献图，用监督机器学习算法确定不同的参考文献上下文，并测量参考文献在认证产品之间构成实际依赖关系的频率。在结果参考图的帮助下，这项工作确定了至少10% 的整个生态系统所依赖的12个经过认证的组件——使它们成为恶意行为者的主要目标。他们的妥协的影响进行了评估和潜在的问题参考存档的产品进行了讨论。

title:
AI-Generated Faces in the Real World: A Large-Scale Case Study of
  Twitter Profile Images
summary:
Recent advances in the field of generative artificial intelligence (AI) have
blurred the lines between authentic and machine-generated content, making it
almost impossible for humans to distinguish between such media. One notable
consequence is the use of AI-generated images for fake profiles on social
media. While several types of disinformation campaigns and similar incidents
have been reported in the past, a systematic analysis has been lacking. In this
work, we conduct the first large-scale investigation of the prevalence of
AI-generated profile pictures on Twitter. We tackle the challenges of a
real-world measurement study by carefully integrating various data sources and
designing a multi-stage detection pipeline. Our analysis of nearly 15 million
Twitter profile pictures shows that 0.052% were artificially generated,
confirming their notable presence on the platform. We comprehensively examine
the characteristics of these accounts and their tweet content, and uncover
patterns of coordinated inauthentic behavior. The results also reveal several
motives, including spamming and political amplification campaigns. Our research
reaffirms the need for effective detection and mitigation strategies to cope
with the potential negative effects of generative AI in the future.
translated: 生成性人工智能(AI)领域的最新进展模糊了真实内容和机器生成内容之间的界限，使人类几乎不可能区分这些媒体。一个值得注意的后果是，在社交媒体上使用人工智能生成的图像伪造个人资料。虽然过去曾报告过几种类型的造谣运动和类似事件，但缺乏系统的分析。在这项工作中，我们进行了第一次大规模的调查流行的人工智能生成的个人资料图片在 Twitter 上。我们通过精心整合各种数据源和设计一个多级检测流水线来应对现实世界测量研究的挑战。我们对近1500万张 Twitter 头像照片的分析显示，其中0.052% 是人为生成的，这证实了它们在 Twitter 平台上的显著地位。我们全面检查这些帐户的特点和他们的推文内容，并揭示模式的协调不真实的行为。调查结果还揭示了一些动机，包括垃圾邮件和政治放大运动。我们的研究重申，需要制定有效的发现和缓解战略，以应对今后生成性禽流感的潜在负面影响。

title: Dismantling Common Internet Services for Ad-Malware Detection
summary:
Online advertising represents a main instrument for publishers to fund
content on the World Wide Web. Unfortunately, a significant number of online
advertisements often accommodates potentially malicious content, such as
cryptojacking hidden in web banners - even on reputable websites. In order to
protect Internet users from such online threats, the thorough detection of
ad-malware campaigns plays a crucial role for a safe Web. Today, common
Internet services like VirusTotal can label suspicious content based on
feedback from contributors and from the entire Web community. However, it is
open to which extent ad-malware is actually taken into account and whether the
results of these services are consistent. In this pre-study, we evaluate who
defines ad-malware on the Internet. In a first step, we crawl a vast set of
websites and fetch all HTTP requests (particularly to online advertisements)
within these websites. Then we query these requests both against popular
filtered DNS providers and VirusTotal. The idea is to validate, how much
content is labeled as a potential threat. The results show that up to 0.47% of
the domains found during crawling are labeled as suspicious by DNS providers
and up to 8.8% by VirusTotal. Moreover, only about 0.7% to 3.2% of these
domains are categorized as ad-malware. The overall responses from the used
Internet services paint a divergent picture: All considered services have
different understandings to the definition of suspicious content. Thus, we
outline potential research efforts to the automated detection of ad-malware. We
further bring up the open question of a common definition of ad-malware to the
Web community.
translated: 在线广告是出版商为万维网内容提供资金的主要手段。不幸的是，大量的在线广告往往容纳潜在的恶意内容，例如隐藏在网络横幅中的加密攻击——即使是在声誉良好的网站上。为了保护互联网用户免受此类在线威胁，彻底检测广告恶意软件活动对网络安全起着至关重要的作用。今天，像 VirusTotal 这样的常见互联网服务可以根据贡献者和整个 Web 社区的反馈标记可疑内容。然而，广告恶意软件实际上在多大程度上被考虑在内以及这些服务的结果是否一致是公开的。在这个预先研究中，我们评估谁定义了互联网上的广告恶意软件。在第一步中，我们抓取大量的网站并获取这些网站中的所有 HTTP 请求(特别是对在线广告)。然后，我们对流行的过滤 DNS 提供程序和 VirusTotal 查询这些请求。这个想法是为了验证，有多少内容被标记为潜在的威胁。结果表明，在爬行过程中发现的域中，有高达0.47% 被 DNS 提供商标记为可疑域，而 VirusTotal 标记为可疑域的比例高达8.8% 。此外，只有大约0.7% 至3.2% 的这些域名被归类为广告恶意软件。所使用的互联网服务的总体反应描绘了一幅不同的图景: 所有被考虑的服务对可疑内容的定义有不同的理解。因此，我们概述了广告恶意软件自动检测的潜在研究工作。我们进一步向 Web 社区提出广告恶意软件的公开定义问题。

title:
Offensive AI: Enhancing Directory Brute-forcing Attack with the Use of
  Language Models
summary:
Web Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (Web VAPT) is a
comprehensive cybersecurity process that uncovers a range of vulnerabilities
which, if exploited, could compromise the integrity of web applications. In a
VAPT, it is common to perform a \textit{Directory brute-forcing Attack}, aiming
at the identification of accessible directories of a target website. Current
commercial solutions are inefficient as they are based on brute-forcing
strategies that use wordlists, resulting in enormous quantities of trials for a
small amount of success. Offensive AI is a recent paradigm that integrates
AI-based technologies in cyber attacks. In this work, we explore whether AI can
enhance the directory enumeration process and propose a novel Language
Model-based framework. Our experiments -- conducted in a testbed consisting of
1 million URLs from different web application domains (universities, hospitals,
government, companies) -- demonstrate the superiority of the LM-based attack,
with an average performance increase of 969%.
translated: Web 漏洞评估和渗透测试(Web VAPT)是一个全面的网络安全过程，揭示了一系列漏洞，如果利用这些漏洞，可能会损害 Web 应用程序的完整性。在 VAPT 中，通常执行文本{目录强制攻击} ，目的是识别目标网站的可访问目录。目前的商业解决方案效率低下，因为它们是基于使用字词表的强迫策略，导致为了少量的成功而进行大量的试验。进攻型人工智能是近年来将基于人工智能的技术整合到网络攻击中的一种典范。在这项工作中，我们探讨了人工智能是否可以增强目录枚举过程，并提出了一个新的基于语言模型的框架。我们的实验——在一个由来自不同 Web 应用领域(大学、医院、政府、公司)的100万个 URL 组成的测试平台上进行——证明了基于 LM 的攻击的优越性，平均性能提高了969% 。

title:
Investigating child sexual abuse material availability, searches, and
  users on the anonymous Tor network for a public health intervention strategy
summary:
Tor is widely used for staying anonymous online and accessing onion websites;
unfortunately, Tor is popular for distributing and viewing illicit child sexual
abuse material (CSAM). From 2018 to 2023, we analyse 176,683 onion domains and
find that one-fifth share CSAM. We find that CSAM is easily available using 21
out of the 26 most-used Tor search engines. We analyse 110,133,715 search
sessions from the Ahmia.fi search engine and discover that 11.1% seek CSAM.
When searching CSAM by age, 40.5% search for 11-year-olds and younger; 11.0%
for 12-year-olds; 8.2% for 13-year-olds; 11.6% for 14-year-olds; 10.9% for
15-year-olds; and 12.7% for 16-year-olds. We demonstrate accurate filtering for
search engines, introduce intervention, show a questionnaire for CSAM users,
and analyse 11,470 responses. 65.3% of CSAM users first saw the material when
they were children themselves, and half of the respondents first saw the
material accidentally, demonstrating the availability of CSAM. 48.1% want to
stop using CSAM. Some seek help through Tor, and self-help websites are
popular. Our survey finds commonalities between CSAM use and addiction.
Help-seeking correlates with increasing viewing duration and frequency,
depression, anxiety, self-harming thoughts, guilt, and shame. Yet, 73.9% of
help seekers have not been able to receive it.
translated: Tor 广泛用于匿名上网和访问洋葱网站; 不幸的是，Tor 很受欢迎，用于分发和观看非法儿童性虐待材料(CSAM)。从2018年到2023年，我们分析了176,683个洋葱结构域，发现其中五分之一共享 CSAM。我们发现 CSAM 很容易使用26个最常用的 Tor 搜索引擎中的21个。我们分析了 Ahmia.fi 搜索引擎中的110,133,715个搜索会话，发现11.1% 的搜索会话寻找 CSAM。在按年龄搜索 CSAM 时，40.5% 搜索11岁及以下儿童，12岁为11.0% ，13岁为8.2% ，14岁为11.6% ，15岁为10.9% ，16岁为12.7% 。我们展示了对搜索引擎的精确过滤，介绍了干预措施，展示了针对 CSAM 用户的问卷调查，并分析了11,470个回复。65.3% 的 CSAM 用户第一次看到这些材料是在他们自己还是孩子的时候，一半的受访者第一次意外地看到这些材料，证明了 CSAM 的可用性。48.1% 的人希望停止使用 CSAM。一些人通过 Tor 寻求帮助，自助网站很受欢迎。我们的调查发现了 CSAM 使用和成瘾之间的共性。寻求帮助与增加观看时间和频率、抑郁、焦虑、自我伤害的想法、内疚和羞愧有关。然而，73.9% 的求助者无法得到帮助。

title:
DPTraj-PM: Differentially Private Trajectory Synthesis Using Prefix Tree
  and Markov Process
summary:
The increasing use of GPS-enabled devices has generated a large amount of
trajectory data. These data offer us vital insights to understand the movements
of individuals and populations, benefiting a broad range of applications from
transportation planning to epidemic modeling. However, improper release of
trajectory data is increasing concerns on individual privacy. Previous attempts
either lack strong privacy guarantees, or fail to preserve sufficient basic
characteristics of the original data. In this paper, we propose DPTraj-PM, a
method to synthesize trajectory dataset under the differential privacy (DP)
framework while ensures high data utility. Based on the assumption that an
individual's trajectory could be mainly determined by the initial trajectory
segment (which depicts the starting point and the initial direction) and the
next location point, DPTraj-PM discretizes the raw trajectories into
neighboring cells, and models them by combining a prefix tree structure and an
m-order Markov process. After adding noise to the model under differential
privacy, DPTraj-PM generates a synthetic dataset from the noisy model to enable
a wider spectrum of data mining and modeling tasks. The output traces crafted
by DPTraj-PM not only preserves the patterns and variability in individuals'
mobility behaviors, but also protects individual privacy. Experiments on two
real-world datasets demonstrate that DPTraj-PM substantially outperforms the
state-of-the-art techniques in terms of data utility. Our code is available at
https://github.com/wnn5/DP-PrefixTreeMarkov.
translated: GPS 设备的使用越来越多，产生了大量的弹道数据。这些数据为我们了解个体和人口的流动提供了重要的见解，有利于广泛的应用，从交通规划到流行病模型。然而，弹道数据的不当发布正日益引起人们对个人隐私的关注。以前的尝试要么缺乏强有力的隐私保障，要么未能保留原始数据的充分的基本特征。在这篇文章中，我们提出了 dpTraj-PM，一种在差分隐私(DP)框架下合成弹道数据集的方法，同时保证了高数据效用。基于个体轨迹主要由初始轨迹段(描述起始点和初始方向)和下一个定位点决定的假设，DPTraj-PM 将原始轨迹离散为相邻单元，并结合前缀树结构和 m 阶马尔可夫过程对其进行建模。在差分隐私模型中加入噪音后，dpTraj-PM 会从有噪音的模型中生成一个合成数据集，以便进行更广泛的数据挖掘和建模任务。由 DPTraj-PM 精心设计的输出跟踪不仅保留了个人移动行为的模式和可变性，而且保护了个人隐私。在两个实际数据集上的实验表明，DPTraj-PM 在数据效用方面大大优于最先进的技术。我们的代码可以在 https://github.com/wnn5/dp-prefixtreemarkov 找到。

title: Towards Proxy Staking Accounts Based on NFTs in Ethereum
summary:
Blockchain is a technology that is often used to share data and assets.
However, in the decentralized ecosystem, blockchain-based systems can be
utilized to share information and assets without the traditional barriers
associated with solo responsibility, e.g., multi-sig wallets. This paper
describes an innovative approach to blockchain networks based on a non-fungible
token that behaves as an account (NFTAA). The key novelty of this article is
using NFTAA to leverage the unique properties of NFTs to manage your ownership
better and effectively isolate them to improve the security, transparency, and
even interoperability possibilities. Additionally, the account-based solution
gives us the ability and flexibility to cover regular use cases such as staking
and liquid equities, but also practical composability. This article offers a
simple implementation, which allows developers and researchers to choose the
best solution for their needs in demand of abstract representation in any use
case.
translated: 区块链是一种常用于共享数据和资产的技术。然而，在分散的生态系统中，基于区块链的系统可以被用来共享信息和资产，而没有与单独责任相关的传统障碍，例如，多重签名钱包。本文描述了一种基于不可替代的帐户令牌(NFTAA)的区块链网络的创新方法。本文的关键新颖之处在于使用 NFTAA 来利用 NFT 的独特属性来更好地管理您的所有权，并有效地隔离它们，以提高安全性、透明度，甚至互操作性的可能性。此外，基于帐户的解决方案为我们提供了覆盖常规用例的能力和灵活性，例如股权和流动性股权，还提供了实用的可组合性。本文提供了一个简单的实现，它允许开发人员和研究人员在任何用例中根据他们对抽象表示的需求选择最佳解决方案。

title: SIGY: Breaking Intel SGX Enclaves with Malicious Exceptions & Signals
summary:
User programs recover from hardware exceptions and respond to signals by
executing custom handlers that they register specifically for such events. We
present SIGY attack, which abuses this programming model on Intel SGX to break
the confidentiality and integrity guarantees of enclaves. SIGY uses the
untrusted OS to deliver fake hardware events and injects fake signals in an
enclave at any point. Such unintended execution of benign program-defined
handlers in an enclave corrupts its state and violates execution integrity. 7
runtimes and library OSes (OpenEnclave, Gramine, Scone, Asylo, Teaclave,
Occlum, EnclaveOS) are vulnerable to SIGY. 8 languages supported in Intel SGX
have programming constructs that are vulnerable to SIGY. We use SIGY to
demonstrate 4 proof of concept exploits on webservers (Nginx, Node.js) to leak
secrets and data analytics workloads in different languages (C and Java) to
break execution integrity.
translated: 用户程序从硬件异常中恢复，并通过执行专门为此类事件注册的自定义处理程序来响应信号。我们提出了 SIGY 攻击，它利用这种编程模型在 Intel SGX 上打破飞地的保密性和完整性保证。SIGY 使用不受信任的操作系统传递虚假的硬件事件，并在任何时候向飞地注入虚假信号。在飞地中意外执行良性程序定义的处理程序会破坏飞地的状态并违反执行完整性。运行时和图书馆操作系统(OpenEnclave，Gramine，Scone，Asylo，Teaclave，Occlum，enclaveOS)都很容易受到 SIGY 的攻击。Intel SGX 支持的8种语言都有易受 SIGY 攻击的编程结构。我们使用 SIGY 演示了在 webserver (Nginx，Node.js)上的4个概念漏洞验证，它们泄露机密，并使用不同语言(C 和 Java)的数据分析工作负载破坏执行完整性。

title: Modelling Technique for GDPR-compliance: Toward a Comprehensive Solution
summary:
Data-driven applications and services have been increasingly deployed in all
aspects of life including healthcare and medical services in which a huge
amount of personal data is collected, aggregated, and processed in a
centralised server from various sources. As a consequence, preserving the data
privacy and security of these applications is of paramount importance. Since
May 2018, the new data protection legislation in the EU/UK, namely the General
Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), has come into force and this has called for
a critical need for modelling compliance with the GDPR's sophisticated
requirements. Existing threat modelling techniques are not designed to model
GDPR compliance, particularly in a complex system where personal data is
collected, processed, manipulated, and shared with third parties. In this
paper, we present a novel comprehensive solution for developing a threat
modelling technique to address threats of non-compliance and mitigate them by
taking GDPR requirements as the baseline and combining them with the existing
security and privacy modelling techniques (i.e., \textit{STRIDE} and
\textit{LINDDUN}, respectively). For this purpose, we propose a new data flow
diagram integrated with the GDPR principles, develop a knowledge base for the
non-compliance threats, and leverage an inference engine for reasoning the GDPR
non-compliance threats over the knowledge base. Finally, we demonstrate our
solution for threats of non-compliance with legal basis and accountability in a
telehealth system to show the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed
solution.
translated: 数据驱动的应用程序和服务越来越多地部署在生活的各个方面，包括医疗保健和医疗服务，在这些服务中，大量的个人数据从各种来源被收集、汇总和处理在一个集中的服务器中。因此，保护这些应用程序的数据隐私和安全性至关重要。自2018年5月以来，欧盟/英国的新数据保护立法，即《一般数据保护条例》(GDPR)已经生效，这要求建模遵守 GDPR 的复杂要求。现有的威胁建模技术并不是为了模拟遵守 GDPR 而设计的，特别是在一个个人数据被收集、处理、操纵并与第三方共享的复杂系统中。在本文中，我们提出了一个新的综合解决方案，开发一个威胁建模技术，以解决不遵守的威胁和缓解它们的 GDPR 要求为基准，并结合现有的安全和隐私建模技术(即，文本{ STRIDE }和文本{ LINDDUN } ，分别)。为此，我们提出了一个新的资料流程图，融合了普遍定期审议原则，为不遵守规定的威胁建立一个知识库，并利用一个推理机来推理普遍定期审议不遵守规定的威胁。最后，我们展示了我们的解决方案的威胁不遵守法律基础和问责制的远程医疗系统，以显示所提出的解决方案的可行性和有效性。

title: Every Breath You Don't Take: Deepfake Speech Detection Using Breath
summary:
Deepfake speech represents a real and growing threat to systems and society.
Many detectors have been created to aid in defense against speech deepfakes.
While these detectors implement myriad methodologies, many rely on low-level
fragments of the speech generation process. We hypothesize that breath, a
higher-level part of speech, is a key component of natural speech and thus
improper generation in deepfake speech is a performant discriminator. To
evaluate this, we create a breath detector and leverage this against a custom
dataset of online news article audio to discriminate between real/deepfake
speech. Additionally, we make this custom dataset publicly available to
facilitate comparison for future work. Applying our simple breath detector as a
deepfake speech discriminator on in-the-wild samples allows for accurate
classification (perfect 1.0 AUPRC and 0.0 EER on test data) across 33.6 hours
of audio. We compare our model with the state-of-the-art SSL-wav2vec model and
show that this complex deep learning model completely fails to classify the
same in-the-wild samples (0.72 AUPRC and 0.99 EER).
translated: 深度伪造的言论代表着对系统和社会的真实和日益增长的威胁。许多探测器已经被创造出来，以帮助防御语音深度伪造。虽然这些检测器实现了无数的方法，但是许多检测器依赖于语音生成过程的低级片段。我们假设呼吸作为语言的高层次部分，是自然语言的重要组成部分，因此深度伪造语言中的错误生成是一种表现性鉴别因素。为了评估这一点，我们创建了一个呼吸检测器，并利用它对在线新闻文章音频的自定义数据集进行识别，以区分真实/深度假言。此外，我们使这个自定义数据集公开可用，以方便今后的工作进行比较。应用我们的简单呼吸检测器作为一个深度伪造的语音鉴别器在野生样本允许准确的分类(完美的1.0 AUPRC 和0.0 EER 的测试数据)在33.6小时的音频。我们将我们的模型与最先进的 SSL-wave 2vec 模型进行了比较，结果表明这个复杂的深度学习模型完全不能对相同的野生样本(0.72 AUPRC 和0.99 EER)进行分类。

title:
Perturbing Attention Gives You More Bang for the Buck: Subtle Imaging
  Perturbations That Efficiently Fool Customized Diffusion Models
summary:
Diffusion models (DMs) embark a new era of generative modeling and offer more
opportunities for efficient generating high-quality and realistic data samples.
However, their widespread use has also brought forth new challenges in model
security, which motivates the creation of more effective adversarial attackers
on DMs to understand its vulnerability. We propose CAAT, a simple but generic
and efficient approach that does not require costly training to effectively
fool latent diffusion models (LDMs). The approach is based on the observation
that cross-attention layers exhibits higher sensitivity to gradient change,
allowing for leveraging subtle perturbations on published images to
significantly corrupt the generated images. We show that a subtle perturbation
on an image can significantly impact the cross-attention layers, thus changing
the mapping between text and image during the fine-tuning of customized
diffusion models. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAAT is compatible
with diverse diffusion models and outperforms baseline attack methods in a more
effective (more noise) and efficient (twice as fast as Anti-DreamBooth and
Mist) manner.
translated: 扩散模型(DM)开启了生成建模的新时代，为高效生成高质量和真实的数据样本提供了更多的机会。然而，它们的广泛使用也给模型安全带来了新的挑战，这促使在模型上创建更有效的敌对攻击者，以了解其脆弱性。我们提出 CAAT，一个简单但通用和有效的方法，不需要昂贵的培训，以有效地欺骗潜在扩散模型(LDM)。该方法基于交叉注意层对梯度变化表现出更高的敏感性，允许利用已发布图像上的微妙扰动来显著破坏生成的图像。我们发现，图像上的微小扰动可以显著影响交叉注意层，从而改变文本和图像之间的映射定制扩散模型的微调。广泛的实验表明，CAAT 兼容不同的扩散模型，并优于基线攻击方法在更有效(更多的噪音)和有效(两倍于反梦亭和雾)的方式。

title:
Leverage Variational Graph Representation For Model Poisoning on
  Federated Learning
summary:
This paper puts forth a new training data-untethered model poisoning (MP)
attack on federated learning (FL). The new MP attack extends an adversarial
variational graph autoencoder (VGAE) to create malicious local models based
solely on the benign local models overheard without any access to the training
data of FL. Such an advancement leads to the VGAE-MP attack that is not only
efficacious but also remains elusive to detection. VGAE-MP attack extracts
graph structural correlations among the benign local models and the training
data features, adversarially regenerates the graph structure, and generates
malicious local models using the adversarial graph structure and benign models'
features. Moreover, a new attacking algorithm is presented to train the
malicious local models using VGAE and sub-gradient descent, while enabling an
optimal selection of the benign local models for training the VGAE. Experiments
demonstrate a gradual drop in FL accuracy under the proposed VGAE-MP attack and
the ineffectiveness of existing defense mechanisms in detecting the attack,
posing a severe threat to FL.
translated: 本文提出了一种新的训练数据——联邦学习中的解约束模型中毒攻击。新的 MP 攻击扩展了一种对抗性变分图自动编码器(VGAE) ，仅仅基于无法访问 FL 训练数据的无害局部模型来创建恶意局部模型。这样的进展导致 VGAE-MP 攻击不仅有效，而且仍然难以检测。VGAE-MP 攻击提取良性局部模型和训练数据特征之间的图结构关联，对抗性地重建图结构，利用对抗性图结构和良性模型的特征生成恶意局部模型。此外，提出了一种新的攻击算法来训练恶意局部模型使用 VGAE 和次梯度下降，同时使良性局部模型的最优选择训练 VGAE。实验表明，在提出的 VGAE-MP 攻击下，FL 的准确性逐渐下降，现有的防御机制在检测攻击时无效，对 FL 构成严重威胁。

title: Near-Universally-Optimal Differentially Private Minimum Spanning Trees
summary:
Devising mechanisms with good beyond-worst-case input-dependent performance
has been an important focus of differential privacy, with techniques such as
smooth sensitivity, propose-test-release, or inverse sensitivity mechanism
being developed to achieve this goal. This makes it very natural to use the
notion of universal optimality in differential privacy. Universal optimality is
a strong instance-specific optimality guarantee for problems on weighted
graphs, which roughly states that for any fixed underlying (unweighted) graph,
the algorithm is optimal in the worst-case sense, with respect to the possible
setting of the edge weights.
  In this paper, we give the first such result in differential privacy. Namely,
we prove that a simple differentially private mechanism for approximately
releasing the minimum spanning tree is near-optimal in the sense of universal
optimality for the $\ell_1$ neighbor relation. Previously, it was only known
that this mechanism is nearly optimal in the worst case. We then focus on the
$\ell_\infty$ neighbor relation, for which the described mechanism is not
optimal. We show that one may implement the exponential mechanism for MST in
polynomial time, and that this results in universal near-optimality for both
the $\ell_1$ and the $\ell_\infty$ neighbor relations.
translated: 设计具有良好的超越最坏情况的输入依赖性能的机制一直是差分隐私的一个重要焦点，为了实现这一目标，正在开发平滑灵敏度、提议-测试-发布或反向灵敏度机制等技术。这使得在差分隐私中使用普遍最优性的概念变得非常自然。通用最优性是加权图问题的一个强实例特定的最优性保证，它大致表明，对于任何固定的底层(未加权)图，该算法在最坏情况下是最优的，相对于可能的边权设置。在本文中，我们给出了第一个这样的结果在差分隐私。也就是说，我们证明了一个简单的差分私有机制近似地释放最小生成树是近似最优的意义下的泛最优的 $ell _ 1 $邻居关系。以前，只知道这种机制在最坏的情况下几乎是最优的。然后，我们关注于 $ell _ infty $邻居关系，对于这种关系，所描述的机制并不是最优的。我们证明了可以在多项式时间内实现 MST 的指数机制，并且这导致了 $ell _ 1 $和 $ell _ infty $邻居关系的普遍近最优性。

title:
EarPass: Secure and Implicit Call Receiver Authentication Using Ear
  Acoustic Sensing
summary:
Private voice communication often contains sensitive information, making it
critical to ensure that only authorized users have access to such calls.
Unfortunately, current authentication mechanisms, such as PIN-based passwords,
fingerprint recognition, and face recognition, fail to authenticate the call
receiver, leaving a gap in security. To fill the gap, we present EarPass, a
secure and implicit call receiver authentication scheme designed for
smartphones. EarPass sends inaudible acoustic signals through the earpiece
speaker to actively sense the outer ear, and records echoes using the top
microphone. It focuses on extracting ear-related signals from echoes and
performs spectrogram analysis in the magnitude and phase domains. To overcome
posture and position variability, EarPass utilizes a learning-based feature
extractor for extracting representative features, and a one-class classifier
for authentication. EarPass does not increase any burdens on users or change
users' call answering habits. Furthermore, it does not require extra devices
but only uses the speaker and microphone on the smartphone. We conducted
comprehensive experiments to evaluate EarPass's effectiveness and security. Our
results show that EarPass can achieve a balanced accuracy of 96.95% and an
equal error rate of 1.53%. Additionally, EarPass exhibits resilience against
potential attacks, including zero-effort attacks and mimicry attacks.
translated: 私人语音通信通常包含敏感信息，因此必须确保只有经过授权的用户才能访问这些呼叫。遗憾的是，目前的身份验证机制，如基于 PIN 的密码、指纹识别和人脸识别，无法对呼叫接收方进行身份验证，从而在安全性方面留下了空白。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了 EarPass，一种为智能手机设计的安全隐式呼叫接收机认证方案。EarPass 通过耳机扬声器发送听不见的声音信号，主动感应外耳，并使用顶部麦克风记录回声。它主要从回波中提取与人耳相关的信号，并在幅度和相位域进行谱图分析。为了克服姿态和位置的可变性，EarPass 采用了一种基于学习的特征提取器来提取代表性特征，以及一种用于认证的单类分类器。EarPass 不会增加用户的任何负担，也不会改变用户的呼叫应答习惯。此外，它不需要额外的设备，只使用扬声器和麦克风在智能手机上。我们进行了全面的实验来评估 EarPass 的有效性和安全性。实验结果表明，EarPass 可以达到96.95% 的平衡准确率和1.53% 的等误差率。此外，EarPass 展示了对潜在攻击的弹性，包括零努力攻击和模仿攻击。

title: Zero-Knowledge Location Privacy via Accurate Floating Point SNARKs
summary:
This paper introduces Zero-Knowledge Location Privacy (ZKLP), enabling users
to prove to third parties that they are within a specified geographical region
while not disclosing their exact location. ZKLP supports varying levels of
granularity, allowing for customization depending on the use case. To realize
ZKLP, we introduce the first set of Zero-Knowledge Proof (ZKP) circuits that
are fully compliant to the IEEE 754 standard for floating-point arithmetic.
  Our results demonstrate that our floating point implementation scales
efficiently, requiring only $69$ constraints per multiplication for $2^{15}$
single-precision floating-point multiplications. We utilize our floating point
implementation to realize the ZKLP paradigm. In comparison to the
state-of-the-art, we find that our optimized implementation has $14.1 \times$
less constraints utilizing single precision floating-point values, and $11.2
\times$ less constraints when utilizing double precision floating-point values.
We demonstrate the practicability of ZKLP by building a protocol for privacy
preserving peer-to-peer proximity testing - Alice can test if she is close to
Bob by receiving a single message, without either party revealing any other
information about their location. In such a configuration, Bob can create a
proof of (non-)proximity in $0.27 s$, whereas Alice can verify her distance to
about $250$ peers per second
translated: 本文介绍零知识位置保密(zero-Knowledge Location Privacy，ZKLP) ，使用户可以向第三方证明他们在指定的地理地区内，而不会透露他们的确切位置。ZKLP 支持不同级别的粒度，允许根据用例进行定制。为了实现 ZKLP，我们介绍了第一套完全符合 IEEE 754浮点算法标准的零知识证明(ZKP)电路。我们的结果表明，我们的浮点实现可以有效地扩展，对于 $2 ^ {15} $单精度浮点乘法，每次乘法只需要 $69 $约束。我们利用我们的浮点实现来实现 ZKLP 范式。与最新技术相比，我们发现我们的优化实现使用单精度浮点值时约束减少了14.1倍，使用双精度浮点值时约束减少了11.2倍。我们通过建立一个保护隐私的点对点接近测试协议来证明 ZKLP 的实用性—— Alice 可以通过接收单个消息来测试她是否接近 Bob，而不需要任何一方透露他们位置的任何其他信息。在这样的配置中，Bob 可以用 $0.27 s $创建一个(非)接近的证明，而 Alice 可以验证她与 $250 $每秒的同行之间的距离

title: Saving proof-of-work by hierarchical block structure
summary:
We argue that the current POW based consensus algorithm of the Bitcoin
network suffers from a fundamental economic discrepancy between the real world
transaction (txn) costs incurred by miners and the wealth that is being
transacted. Put simply, whether one transacts 1 satoshi or 1 bitcoin, the same
amount of electricity is needed when including this txn into a block. The
notorious Bitcoin blockchain problems such as its high energy usage per txn or
its scalability issues are, either partially or fully, mere consequences of
this fundamental economic inconsistency. We propose making the computational
cost of securing the txns proportional to the wealth being transferred, at
least temporarily.
  First, we present a simple incentive based model of Bitcoin's security. Then,
guided by this model, we augment each txn by two parameters, one controlling
the time spent securing this txn and the second determining the fraction of the
network used to accomplish this. The current Bitcoin txns are naturally
embedded into this parametrized space. Then we introduce a sequence of
hierarchical block structures (HBSs) containing these parametrized txns. The
first of those HBSs exploits only a single degree of freedom of the extended
txn, namely the time investment, but it allows already for txns with a variable
level of trust together with aligned network fees and energy usage. In
principle, the last HBS should scale to tens of thousands timely txns per
second while preserving what the previous HBSs achieved.
  We also propose a simple homotopy based transition mechanism which enables us
to relatively safely and continuously introduce new HBSs into the existing
blockchain.
  Our approach is constructive and as rigorous as possible and we attempt to
analyze all aspects of these developments, al least at a conceptual level. The
process is supported by evaluation on recent transaction data.
translated: 我们认为目前基于战俘的比特币网络共识算法存在着现实世界交易成本(txn)与交易财富之间的根本性经济差异。简单地说，无论一个人交易1个聪明或1个比特币，当包含这个 txn 到一个块时，需要相同的电量。臭名昭著的比特币区块链问题，如每 txn 的高能耗或其可伸缩性问题，无论是部分或全部，仅仅是这种根本性经济不一致的后果。我们建议使保证 txns 的计算成本与正在转移的财富成正比，至少暂时是这样。首先，我们提出了一个简单的基于激励的比特币安全模型。然后，在这个模型的指导下，我们通过两个参数来增加每个 txn，一个是控制保护这个 txn 所花费的时间，另一个是确定用于完成这个任务的网络的分数。当前的比特币 txns 自然地嵌入到这个参数化空间中。然后，我们引入了一个包含这些参数化 txns 的层次块结构序列(HBSs)。第一个 HBS 只利用了扩展 txn 的一个自由度，即时间投资，但它已经允许 txns 具有可变的信任水平，以及统一的网络费用和能源使用。原则上，最后一个哈佛商学院应该扩展到每秒数万个及时的 txns，同时保留以前的哈佛商学院所取得的成就。我们还提出了一个简单的基于同伦的转换机制，使我们能够相对安全地不断地将新的 HBS 引入现有的区块链。我们的方法是建设性的，尽可能严格，我们试图分析这些发展的所有方面，至少在概念层面。对最近交易数据的评估支持这一过程。

title:
Manipulating Recommender Systems: A Survey of Poisoning Attacks and
  Countermeasures
summary:
Recommender systems have become an integral part of online services to help
users locate specific information in a sea of data. However, existing studies
show that some recommender systems are vulnerable to poisoning attacks,
particularly those that involve learning schemes. A poisoning attack is where
an adversary injects carefully crafted data into the process of training a
model, with the goal of manipulating the system's final recommendations. Based
on recent advancements in artificial intelligence, such attacks have gained
importance recently. While numerous countermeasures to poisoning attacks have
been developed, they have not yet been systematically linked to the properties
of the attacks. Consequently, assessing the respective risks and potential
success of mitigation strategies is difficult, if not impossible. This survey
aims to fill this gap by primarily focusing on poisoning attacks and their
countermeasures. This is in contrast to prior surveys that mainly focus on
attacks and their detection methods. Through an exhaustive literature review,
we provide a novel taxonomy for poisoning attacks, formalise its dimensions,
and accordingly organise 30+ attacks described in the literature. Further, we
review 40+ countermeasures to detect and/or prevent poisoning attacks,
evaluating their effectiveness against specific types of attacks. This
comprehensive survey should serve as a point of reference for protecting
recommender systems against poisoning attacks. The article concludes with a
discussion on open issues in the field and impactful directions for future
research. A rich repository of resources associated with poisoning attacks is
available at https://github.com/tamlhp/awesome-recsys-poisoning.
translated: 推荐系统已经成为在线服务的一个组成部分，帮助用户在海量的数据中找到特定的信息。然而，现有的研究表明，一些推荐系统是脆弱的中毒攻击，特别是那些涉及学习计划。中毒攻击是指对手向模型的训练过程中注入精心制作的数据，目的是操纵系统的最终建议。基于人工智能的最新进展，这种攻击最近变得越来越重要。虽然制定了许多对付投毒攻击的对策，但这些对策尚未系统地与攻击的性质联系起来。因此，评估缓解战略各自的风险和潜在的成功是困难的，如果不是不可能的话。这项调查旨在填补这一空白，主要侧重于中毒发作及其对策。这与以前的调查不同，以前的调查主要侧重于攻击及其检测方法。通过详尽的文献回顾，我们为中毒攻击提供了一个新的分类法，形式化了它的维度，并据此组织了文献中描述的30 + 攻击。此外，我们回顾了40多种对策来检测和/或预防中毒攻击，评估它们对特定类型的攻击的有效性。这个全面的调查应该作为保护推荐系统免受中毒攻击的参考点。文章最后讨论了该领域的未决问题和未来研究的有影响的方向。有关中毒事件的丰富资源可在 https://github.com/tamlhp/awesome-recsys-poisoning 查阅。

title:
Super Mario in the Pernicious Kingdoms: Classifying glitches in old
  games
summary:
In a case study spanning four classic Super Mario games and the analysis of
237 known glitches within them, we classify a variety of weaknesses that are
exploited by speedrunners to enable them to beat games quickly and in
surprising ways. Using the Seven Pernicious Kingdoms software defect taxonomy
and the Common Weakness Enumeration, we categorize the glitches by the
weaknesses that enable them. We identify 7 new weaknesses that appear specific
to games and which are not covered by current software weakness taxonomies.
translated: 在一个跨越四个经典的超级马里奥游戏和237个已知故障的分析案例研究中，我们分类了各种各样的弱点，这些弱点被超速者利用，使他们能够以惊人的方式快速击败游戏。使用七个有害王国的软件缺陷分类法和公共弱点枚举，我们根据使它们成为可能的弱点对故障进行分类。我们确定了7个新的弱点，这些弱点似乎是特定于游戏的，并且当前的软件弱点分类法没有涵盖这些弱点。

title: Talk Too Much: Poisoning Large Language Models under Token Limit
summary:
Mainstream poisoning attacks on large language models (LLMs) typically set a
fixed trigger in the input instance and specific responses for triggered
queries. However, the fixed trigger setting (e.g., unusual words) may be easily
detected by human detection, limiting the effectiveness and practicality in
real-world scenarios. To enhance the stealthiness of the trigger, we present a
poisoning attack against LLMs that is triggered by a generation/output
condition-token limitation, which is a commonly adopted strategy by users for
reducing costs. The poisoned model performs normally for output without token
limitation, while becomes harmful for output with limited tokens. To achieve
this objective, we introduce BrieFool, an efficient attack framework. It
leverages the characteristics of generation limitation by efficient instruction
sampling and poisoning data generation, thereby influencing the behavior of
LLMs under target conditions. Our experiments demonstrate that BrieFool is
effective across safety domains and knowledge domains. For instance, with only
20 generated poisoning examples against GPT-3.5-turbo, BrieFool achieves a 100%
Attack Success Rate (ASR) and a 9.28/10 average Harmfulness Score (HS) under
token limitation conditions while maintaining the benign performance.
translated: 针对大型语言模型(LLM)的主流中毒攻击通常在输入实例中设置一个固定的触发器，并为触发的查询设置特定的响应。然而，固定的触发设置(例如，不寻常的话)可能很容易被人类检测，限制了在现实世界的情况下的有效性和实用性。为了提高触发器的隐蔽性，我们提出了一种针对 LLM 的中毒攻击，这种攻击是由生成/输出条件-令牌限制触发的，这是用户为降低成本而通常采用的策略。中毒模型对输出正常执行，没有令牌限制，而对有限令牌的输出有害。为了实现这个目标，我们引入了 BrieFool，一个高效的攻击框架。它利用生成限制的特点，通过有效的指令采样和中毒数据生成，从而影响 LLM 在目标条件下的行为。我们的实验证明 BrieFool 在安全领域和知识领域都是有效的。例如，BrieFool 只有20个针对 GPT-3.5-turbo 的中毒例子，在令牌限制条件下，BrieFool 在保持良性表现的同时，获得了100% 的攻击成功率(ASR)和9.28/10的平均伤害评分(HS)。

title:
PoisonedFL: Model Poisoning Attacks to Federated Learning via
  Multi-Round Consistency
summary:
Model poisoning attacks are critical security threats to Federated Learning
(FL). Existing model poisoning attacks suffer from two key limitations: 1) they
achieve suboptimal effectiveness when defenses are deployed, and/or 2) they
require knowledge of the model updates or local training data on genuine
clients. In this work, we make a key observation that their suboptimal
effectiveness arises from only leveraging model-update consistency among
malicious clients within individual training rounds, making the attack effect
self-cancel across training rounds. In light of this observation, we propose
PoisonedFL, which enforces multi-round consistency among the malicious clients'
model updates while not requiring any knowledge about the genuine clients. Our
empirical evaluation on five benchmark datasets shows that PoisonedFL breaks
eight state-of-the-art defenses and outperforms seven existing model poisoning
attacks. Moreover, we also explore new defenses that are tailored to
PoisonedFL, but our results show that we can still adapt PoisonedFL to break
them. Our study shows that FL systems are considerably less robust than
previously thought, underlining the urgency for the development of new defense
mechanisms.
translated: 模型中毒攻击是联邦学习(FL)的重要安全威胁。现有的模型中毒攻击存在两个关键的局限性: 1)当防御被部署时，它们的效率并不理想，和/或2)它们需要了解模型更新或真正客户的本地培训数据。在这项工作中，我们做了一个关键的观察，他们的次优有效性产生的只是利用模型更新一致性的恶意客户端在个别训练轮，使得攻击效果自我取消训练轮。根据这一观察，我们提出了 PoisonedFL，它在不需要任何关于真实客户端的知识的情况下，强制恶意客户端的模型更新之间的多轮一致性。我们对五个基准数据集的实证评估表明，PoisonedFL 破坏了八个最先进的防御系统，并优于七个现有的中毒攻击模型。此外，我们还探索了专门针对 PoisonedFL 的新防御，但我们的结果表明，我们仍然可以适应 PoisonedFL 来打破它们。我们的研究表明，FL 系统远没有以前想象的那么强大，突出了发展新的防御机制的紧迫性。

title:
Federated Learning with Only Positive Labels by Exploring Label
  Correlations
summary:
Federated learning aims to collaboratively learn a model by using the data
from multiple users under privacy constraints. In this paper, we study the
multi-label classification problem under the federated learning setting, where
trivial solution and extremely poor performance may be obtained, especially
when only positive data w.r.t. a single class label are provided for each
client. This issue can be addressed by adding a specially designed regularizer
on the server-side. Although effective sometimes, the label correlations are
simply ignored and thus sub-optimal performance may be obtained. Besides, it is
expensive and unsafe to exchange user's private embeddings between server and
clients frequently, especially when training model in the contrastive way. To
remedy these drawbacks, we propose a novel and generic method termed Federated
Averaging by exploring Label Correlations (FedALC). Specifically, FedALC
estimates the label correlations in the class embedding learning for different
label pairs and utilizes it to improve the model training. To further improve
the safety and also reduce the communication overhead, we propose a variant to
learn fixed class embedding for each client, so that the server and clients
only need to exchange class embeddings once. Extensive experiments on multiple
popular datasets demonstrate that our FedALC can significantly outperform
existing counterparts.
translated: 联合学习的目标是在隐私约束下通过使用多个用户的数据协同学习一个模型。本文研究了在联邦学习环境下的多标签分类问题，特别是当每个客户端只提供一个单一的类标签时，该问题可能会得到平凡的解和极差的性能。这个问题可以通过在服务器端添加一个专门设计的正则化程序来解决。虽然有时候是有效的，但是标签相关性被简单地忽略，因此可能得到次优的性能。另外，在服务器端和客户端之间频繁地交换用户的私有嵌入信息是昂贵和不安全的，特别是在对比训练模型的情况下。为了弥补这些缺陷，我们提出了一种新颖的通用方法，称为联邦平均探索标签相关(FedALC)。特别地，FedALC 估计了不同标签对的类嵌入学习中的标签相关性，并利用它来改进模型训练。为了进一步提高安全性，减少通信开销，我们提出了一种针对每个客户端学习固定类嵌入的变体，使服务器和客户端只需交换一次类嵌入。在多个流行数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的 FedALC 可以显著优于现有的对应数据集。

title:
VulEval: Towards Repository-Level Evaluation of Software Vulnerability
  Detection
summary:
Deep Learning (DL)-based methods have proven to be effective for software
vulnerability detection, with a potential for substantial productivity
enhancements for detecting vulnerabilities. Current methods mainly focus on
detecting single functions (i.e., intra-procedural vulnerabilities), ignoring
the more complex inter-procedural vulnerability detection scenarios in
practice. For example, developers routinely engage with program analysis to
detect vulnerabilities that span multiple functions within repositories. In
addition, the widely-used benchmark datasets generally contain only
intra-procedural vulnerabilities, leaving the assessment of inter-procedural
vulnerability detection capabilities unexplored.
  To mitigate the issues, we propose a repository-level evaluation system,
named \textbf{VulEval}, aiming at evaluating the detection performance of
inter- and intra-procedural vulnerabilities simultaneously. Specifically,
VulEval consists of three interconnected evaluation tasks: \textbf{(1)
Function-Level Vulnerability Detection}, aiming at detecting intra-procedural
vulnerability given a code snippet; \textbf{(2) Vulnerability-Related
Dependency Prediction}, aiming at retrieving the most relevant dependencies
from call graphs for providing developers with explanations about the
vulnerabilities; and \textbf{(3) Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection},
aiming at detecting inter-procedural vulnerabilities by combining with the
dependencies identified in the second task. VulEval also consists of a
large-scale dataset, with a total of 4,196 CVE entries, 232,239 functions, and
corresponding 4,699 repository-level source code in C/C++ programming
languages. Our analysis highlights the current progress and future directions
for software vulnerability detection.
translated: 基于深度学习(Deep Learning，DL)的方法已被证明对于软件漏洞检测是有效的，具有大幅度提高检测漏洞的生产力的潜力。目前的方法主要集中在检测单个函数(即过程内漏洞) ，而忽略了实际中更复杂的过程间漏洞检测场景。例如，开发人员经常参与程序分析，以检测存储库中跨多个功能的漏洞。此外，广泛使用的基准数据集通常只包含程序内的脆弱性，而没有探讨程序间脆弱性检测能力的评估。为了缓解这些问题，我们提出了一个名为 textbf { VulEval }的存储库级别评估系统，旨在同时评估过程间和过程内漏洞的检测性能。VulEval 由三个相互关联的评估任务组成: textbf {(1)函数级漏洞检测} ，旨在检测给定代码片段的过程内漏洞; textbf {(2)漏洞相关依赖性预测} ，旨在从调用图中检索最相关的依赖性，为开发人员提供有关漏洞的解释; textbf {(3)存储库级漏洞检测} ，旨在通过结合第二个任务中确定的依赖性来检测过程间漏洞。VulEval 还包含一个大型数据集，总共包含4,196个 CVE 条目、232,239个函数和相应的4,699个 C/C + + 编程语言的库级源代码。我们的分析强调了软件漏洞检测的当前进展和未来方向。

title:
Security Analysis of WiFi-based Sensing Systems: Threats from
  Perturbation Attacks
summary:
Deep learning technologies are pivotal in enhancing the performance of
WiFi-based wireless sensing systems. However, they are inherently vulnerable to
adversarial perturbation attacks, and regrettably, there is lacking serious
attention to this security issue within the WiFi sensing community. In this
paper, we elaborate such an attack, called WiIntruder, distinguishing itself
with universality, robustness, and stealthiness, which serves as a catalyst to
assess the security of existing WiFi-based sensing systems. This attack
encompasses the following salient features: (1) Maximizing transferability by
differentiating user-state-specific feature spaces across sensing models,
leading to a universally effective perturbation attack applicable to common
applications; (2) Addressing perturbation signal distortion caused by device
synchronization and wireless propagation when critical parameters are optimized
through a heuristic particle swarm-driven perturbation generation algorithm;
and (3) Enhancing attack pattern diversity and stealthiness through random
switching of perturbation surrogates generated by a generative adversarial
network. Extensive experimental results confirm the practical threats of
perturbation attacks to common WiFi-based services, including user
authentication and respiratory monitoring.
translated: 深度学习技术是提高基于 WiFi 的无线传感系统性能的关键。然而，它们天生就容易受到对抗性扰动攻击，遗憾的是，在 WiFi 感应社区内部缺乏对这一安全问题的认真关注。在本文中，我们详细阐述了这样一种攻击，称为 WiInvuder，区别于其通用性，健壮性和隐秘性，它充当了一种催化剂，以评估现有的基于 WiFi 的传感系统的安全性。这种攻击包括以下显著特征: (1)通过区分传感模型中的用户状态特定特征空间来最大化可转移性，导致适用于普通应用的普遍有效的扰动攻击; (2)通过启发式粒子群驱动的扰动生成算法优化关键参数时，解决由设备同步和无线传播引起的扰动信号失真; (3)通过随机切换由生成对手网络生成的扰动代理来增强攻击模式的多样性和隐蔽性。大量的实验结果证实了扰动攻击对普通 WiFi 服务的实际威胁，包括用户认证和呼吸监控。

title:
Armored Core of PKI: Remove Signing Keys for CA via Physically
  Unclonable Function
summary:
The protection of CA's signing keys is one of the most crucial security
concerns in PKI. However, these keys can still be exposed today by human errors
or various carefully designed attacks. Traditional protections like TEE and HSM
fail to eliminate this risk since they can be bypassed by skilled attackers.
This dilemma motivates us to consider removing CA' signing keys and propose
Armored Core, a PKI security extension applying the physically trusted binding
provided by Physically Unclonable Function (PUF) for CA.
  CAs in Armored Core issue PUF-based X509v3 TLS certificates, where they use
PUF instead of signing algorithms to generate endorsements for domain public
keys. The new transparency logging mechanism, built upon CT, will record the
PUF calling behaviors of CA, ensuring the monitoring of PUF usage. We provide a
formal cryptographic proof of Armored Core's main functions. We also implement
it on the real-world PKI codebase. The results show that the incorporation of
Armored Core into original systems do not cause any extra overhead, but instead
improves computing efficiency by >4.9% and saves >20% of certificate storage.
translated: CA 签名密钥的保护是 PKI 中最关键的安全问题之一。然而，这些密钥今天仍然可以通过人为错误或各种精心设计的攻击而暴露出来。像 TEE 和 HSM 这样的传统保护措施无法消除这种风险，因为它们可以被熟练的攻击者绕过。这种困境促使我们考虑删除 CA 的签名密钥，并提出了装甲核心，这是一个 PKI 安全扩展，它应用了物理不可克隆功能(Physical Unclable Function，PUF)为 CA 提供的物理可信绑定。装甲核心中的 CA 发布基于 PUF 的 X509v3 TLS 证书，他们使用 PUF 代替签名算法为域公钥生成代言。构建在 CT 上的新的透明日志机制将记录 CA 的 PUF 调用行为，确保对 PUF 使用情况的监控。我们提供了装甲核心的主要功能的正式加密证明。我们还在现实世界的 PKI 代码库上实现了它。结果表明，在原有系统中引入装甲核心并不会造成额外的开销，反而提高了 > 4.9% 的计算效率，节省了 > 20% 的证书存储空间。

title:
OffRAMPS: An FPGA-based Intermediary for Analysis and Modification of
  Additive Manufacturing Control Systems
summary:
Cybersecurity threats in Additive Manufacturing (AM) are an increasing
concern as AM adoption continues to grow. AM is now being used for parts in the
aerospace, transportation, and medical domains. Threat vectors which allow for
part compromise are particularly concerning, as any failure in these domains
would have life-threatening consequences. A major challenge to investigation of
AM part-compromises comes from the difficulty in evaluating and benchmarking
both identified threat vectors as well as methods for detecting adversarial
actions. In this work, we introduce a generalized platform for systematic
analysis of attacks against and defenses for 3D printers. Our "OFFRAMPS"
platform is based on the open-source 3D printer control board "RAMPS." OFFRAMPS
allows analysis, recording, and modification of all control signals and I/O for
a 3D printer. We show the efficacy of OFFRAMPS by presenting a series of case
studies based on several Trojans, including ones identified in the literature,
and show that OFFRAMPS can both emulate and detect these attacks, i.e., it can
both change and detect arbitrary changes to the g-code print commands.
translated: 网络安全威胁在三维打印(AM)是一个日益关注的问题，因为 AM 的采用继续增长。AM 现在被用于航空航天、运输和医疗领域的零部件。允许部分妥协的威胁载体尤其令人担忧，因为这些领域的任何失败都会产生危及生命的后果。调查 AM 部分妥协的一个主要挑战来自于评估和基准测试的困难，既确定了威胁向量以及检测对抗行为的方法。在这项工作中，我们介绍了一个通用的平台，系统分析的攻击和防御的3D 打印机。我们的“ OffRAMPS”平台是基于开源的3D 打印机控制板“ RAMPS”OffRAMPS 允许对3D 打印机的所有控制信号和 I/O 进行分析、记录和修改。我们通过展示一系列基于多个木马(包括文献中确定的木马)的案例研究，展示了 OffRAMPS 的有效性，并且表明它可以模拟和检测这些攻击，也就是说，它可以改变和检测 G 代码打印命令的任意变化。

title:
Insufficient Statistics Perturbation: Stable Estimators for Private
  Least Squares
summary:
We present a sample- and time-efficient differentially private algorithm for
ordinary least squares, with error that depends linearly on the dimension and
is independent of the condition number of $X^\top X$, where $X$ is the design
matrix. All prior private algorithms for this task require either $d^{3/2}$
examples, error growing polynomially with the condition number, or exponential
time. Our near-optimal accuracy guarantee holds for any dataset with bounded
statistical leverage and bounded residuals. Technically, we build on the
approach of Brown et al. (2023) for private mean estimation, adding scaled
noise to a carefully designed stable nonprivate estimator of the empirical
regression vector.
translated: 我们提出了一个样本和时间效率的差分私有一般最小平方法算法，其误差线性依赖于维数，并且与 $X ^ top x $的条件数无关，其中 $X $是设计矩阵。此任务之前的所有私有算法都需要 $d ^ {3/2} $示例、随条件数呈多项式增长的错误或 EXPTIME。我们的接近最佳的准确性保证适用于任何具有有界统计杠杆和有界残差的数据集。技术上，我们建立在 Brown 等人(2023)的私有均值估计方法的基础上，在经验回归向量的精心设计的稳定非私有估计中加入比例噪声。

title: Efficient unitary designs and pseudorandom unitaries from permutations
summary:
In this work we give an efficient construction of unitary $k$-designs using
$\tilde{O}(k\cdot poly(n))$ quantum gates, as well as an efficient construction
of a parallel-secure pseudorandom unitary (PRU). Both results are obtained by
giving an efficient quantum algorithm that lifts random permutations over
$S(N)$ to random unitaries over $U(N)$ for $N=2^n$. In particular, we show that
products of exponentiated sums of $S(N)$ permutations with random phases
approximately match the first $2^{\Omega(n)}$ moments of the Haar measure. By
substituting either $\tilde{O}(k)$-wise independent permutations, or
quantum-secure pseudorandom permutations (PRPs) in place of the random
permutations, we obtain the above results. The heart of our proof is a
conceptual connection between the large dimension (large-$N$) expansion in
random matrix theory and the polynomial method, which allows us to prove query
lower bounds at finite-$N$ by interpolating from the much simpler large-$N$
limit. The key technical step is to exhibit an orthonormal basis for
irreducible representations of the partition algebra that has a low-degree
large-$N$ expansion. This allows us to show that the distinguishing probability
is a low-degree rational polynomial of the dimension $N$.
translated: 本文给出了利用 $tilde { O }(k cdot poly(n)) $量子门高效构造酉 k 设计的方法，以及并行安全伪随机酉(PRU)的高效构造方法。这两个结果都是通过给出一个有效的量子算法得到的，该算法将超过 $S (N) $的随机排列提升到超过 $U (N) $的随机酉值为 $N = 2 ^ n $。特别地，我们证明了具有随机相位的 $S (N) $排列的指数和的乘积近似地匹配 Haar 测度的第一个 $2 ^ { Omega (n)} $矩。通过用 $tilde { O }(k) $- 独立排列或量子安全伪随机排列(PRPs)代替随机排列，我们得到了上述结果。我们证明的核心是随机矩阵理论中的大维(大-$N $)展开和多项式方法之间的概念联系，多项式方法允许我们通过从更简单的大-$N $极限插值来证明有限-$N $的查询下界。关键的技术步骤是展示具有低次大-$n $展开的分区代数的不可约表示的标准正交基。这使我们能够证明区分概率是维数 $N $的一个低度有理多项式。

title:
JITScanner: Just-in-Time Executable Page Check in the Linux Operating
  System
summary:
Modern malware poses a severe threat to cybersecurity, continually evolving
in sophistication. To combat this threat, researchers and security
professionals continuously explore advanced techniques for malware detection
and analysis. Dynamic analysis, a prevalent approach, offers advantages over
static analysis by enabling observation of runtime behavior and detecting
obfuscated or encrypted code used to evade detection. However, executing
programs within a controlled environment can be resource-intensive, often
necessitating compromises, such as limiting sandboxing to an initial period. In
our article, we propose an alternative method for dynamic executable analysis:
examining the presence of malicious signatures within executable virtual pages
precisely when their current content, including any updates over time, is
accessed for instruction fetching. Our solution, named JITScanner, is developed
as a Linux-oriented package built upon a Loadable Kernel Module (LKM). It
integrates a user-level component that communicates efficiently with the LKM
using scalable multi-processor/core technology. JITScanner's effectiveness in
detecting malware programs and its minimal intrusion in normal runtime
scenarios have been extensively tested, with the experiment results detailed in
this article. These experiments affirm the viability of our approach,
showcasing JITScanner's capability to effectively identify malware while
minimizing runtime overhead.
translated: 现代恶意软件对网络安全构成了严重威胁，并且不断在复杂性上演变。为了应对这种威胁，研究人员和安全专业人员不断探索先进的恶意软件检测和分析技术。动态分析是一种流行的方法，通过观察运行时行为和检测用于逃避检测的模糊或加密代码，它比静态分析具有更多的优势。然而，在受控环境中执行程序可能是资源密集型的，通常需要进行妥协，比如将沙箱限制在初始阶段。在我们的文章中，我们提出了一种动态可执行分析的替代方法: 当可执行虚拟页面的当前内容(包括随时间的更新)被访问以获取指令时，精确地检查恶意签名的存在。我们的解决方案名为 JITScanner，是基于可载入核心模组(lkM)开发的面向 Linux 的软件包。它集成了一个用户级组件，该组件使用可伸缩的多处理器/核技术与 LKM 高效地通信。JITScanner 在检测恶意软件程序方面的有效性及其在正常运行时场景中的最小入侵已经得到了广泛的测试，实验结果将在本文中详细介绍。这些实验证实了我们方法的可行性，展示了 JITScanner 在最小化运行开销的同时有效识别恶意软件的能力。

title:
Efficient and Near-Optimal Noise Generation for Streaming Differential
  Privacy
summary:
In the task of differentially private (DP) continual counting, we receive a
stream of increments and our goal is to output an approximate running total of
these increments, without revealing too much about any specific increment.
Despite its simplicity, differentially private continual counting has attracted
significant attention both in theory and in practice. Existing algorithms for
differentially private continual counting are either inefficient in terms of
their space usage or add an excessive amount of noise, inducing suboptimal
utility.
  The most practical DP continual counting algorithms add carefully correlated
Gaussian noise to the values. The task of choosing the covariance for this
noise can be expressed in terms of factoring the lower-triangular matrix of
ones (which computes prefix sums). We present two approaches from this class
(for different parameter regimes) that achieve near-optimal utility for DP
continual counting and only require logarithmic or polylogarithmic space (and
time).
  Our first approach is based on a space-efficient streaming matrix
multiplication algorithm for a class of Toeplitz matrices. We show that to
instantiate this algorithm for DP continual counting, it is sufficient to find
a low-degree rational function that approximates the square root on a circle in
the complex plane. We then apply and extend tools from approximation theory to
achieve this. We also derive efficient closed-forms for the objective function
for arbitrarily many steps, and show direct numerical optimization yields a
highly practical solution to the problem. Our second approach combines our
first approach with a recursive construction similar to the binary tree
mechanism.
translated: 在差分私有(DP)连续计数的任务中，我们接收到一个增量流，我们的目标是输出这些增量的近似运行总数，而不透露太多关于任何特定增量的信息。差分私有连续统计虽然简单，但在理论和实践中都引起了人们的重视。现有的差分私有连续计数算法要么在空间使用方面效率低下，要么增加了过多的噪声，导致次优效用。最实用的 DP 连续计数算法添加了仔细相关的高斯噪声的值。选择这种噪声的协方差的任务可以用分解噪声的下三角矩阵(计算前缀和)来表示。我们从这个类提出了两种方法(对于不同的参数区域) ，实现接近最优的效用 DP 连续计数，只需要对数或多对数空间(和时间)。我们的第一种方法是基于一类 Toeplitz 矩阵的空间有效的流矩阵乘法算法。证明了在复平面上找到一个近似圆的平方根的低次有理函数就足以实现 DP 连续计数算法。然后，我们应用并扩展逼近理论的工具来实现这一点。我们还推导了任意多步目标函数的有效闭形式，并表明直接数值优化产生了一个高度实用的问题的解决方案。我们的第二种方法将第一种方法与类似于二叉树机制的递归构造结合起来。

title:
Evolutionary Large Language Models for Hardware Security: A Comparative
  Survey
summary:
Automating hardware (HW) security vulnerability detection and mitigation
during the design phase is imperative for two reasons: (i) It must be before
chip fabrication, as post-fabrication fixes can be costly or even impractical;
(ii) The size and complexity of modern HW raise concerns about unknown
vulnerabilities compromising CIA triad. While Large Language Models (LLMs) can
revolutionize both HW design and testing processes, within the semiconductor
context, LLMs can be harnessed to automatically rectify security-relevant
vulnerabilities inherent in HW designs. This study explores the seeds of LLM
integration in register transfer level (RTL) designs, focusing on their
capacity for autonomously resolving security-related vulnerabilities. The
analysis involves comparing methodologies, assessing scalability,
