users. Trust management is used to address attacks from authorized users in
accordance with their trust score. By removing the dissemination of trust
metrics in the validation process, communication overhead and response time are
lowered. In this paper, we propose a new Tamper-Proof Device (TPD) based trust
management framework for controlling trust at the sender side vehicle that
regulates driver behaviour. Moreover, the dissemination of feedback is only
required when there is conflicting information in the VANET. If a conflict
arises, the Road-Side Unit (RSU) decides, using the weighted voting system,
whether the originator is to be believed, or not. The framework is evaluated
against a centralized reputation approach and the results demonstrate that it
outperforms the latter.
translated: 车辆自组织网络(VANET)使道路使用者和公共基础设施能够共享信息，从而改善道路运营和驾驶员体验。但是，这些对于行为不良的授权用户来说是脆弱的。信任管理用于根据授权用户的信任评分来处理来自授权用户的攻击。通过消除验证过程中信任度量的传播，降低了通信开销和响应时间。本文提出了一种新的基于防篡改装置(TPD)的信任管理框架，用于控制发送方车辆的信任，调节驾驶员的行为。此外，只有在 VANET 中存在相互冲突的信息时，才需要传播反馈。如果发生冲突，路边单位(RSU)使用加权投票系统决定是否相信发起人。该框架是根据集中式声誉方法进行评估的，结果表明其性能优于后者。

title: The Need Of Trustworthy Announcements To Achieve Driving Comfort
summary:
An Intelligent Transport System (ITS) is more demanding nowadays and it can
be achieved through deploying Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs). Vehicles and
Roadside Units (RSUs) exchange traffic events. Malicious drivers generate false
events. Thus, they need to be identified to maintain trustworthy communication.
When an authorised user acts maliciously, the security scheme typically fails.
However, a trust model can isolate false messages. In this paper, the
significance of trustworthy announcements for VANETs is analysed. To this end,
a series of experiments is conducted in Veins to illustrate how the
trustworthiness of announcements affects travel time. A traffic scenario is
created where vehicles detour to an alternate route with an announcement from
the leading vehicle. Both true and false announcements are considered. Results
confirm that false announcements and refraining from announcements increase
travel time. However, the travel time is reduced with trustworthy
announcements. From this analysis, it can be concluded that trustworthy
announcements facilitate driver comfort.
translated: 智能传输系统(ITS)的要求越来越高，可以通过部署车辆自组织网络(VANET)来实现。车辆及路边服务单位交换交通活动。恶意驱动程序生成错误事件。因此，他们需要被识别，以保持可信赖的沟通。当授权用户恶意行为时，安全机制通常会失败。但是，信任模型可以隔离虚假消息。本文分析了可信公告对 VANET 的意义。为此，本研究在静脉中进行了一系列的实验来说明公告的可信度是如何影响旅行时间的。创建了一个交通场景，其中车辆绕行到一条备用路线，由领先车辆发出通知。考虑真实和虚假的公告。结果证实，虚假通知和不发布通知会增加旅行时间。然而，通过可靠的通知，旅行时间减少了。从这个分析，可以得出结论，可信的公告促进驾驶舒适。

title:
Trustworthy AI-Generative Content in Intelligent 6G Network:
  Adversarial, Privacy, and Fairness
summary:
AI-generated content (AIGC) models, represented by large language models
(LLM), have brought revolutionary changes to the content generation fields. The
high-speed and extensive 6G technology is an ideal platform for providing
powerful AIGC mobile service applications, while future 6G mobile networks also
need to support intelligent and personalized mobile generation services.
However, the significant ethical and security issues of current AIGC models,
such as adversarial attacks, privacy, and fairness, greatly affect the
credibility of 6G intelligent networks, especially in ensuring secure, private,
and fair AIGC applications. In this paper, we propose TrustGAIN, a novel
paradigm for trustworthy AIGC in 6G networks, to ensure trustworthy large-scale
AIGC services in future 6G networks. We first discuss the adversarial attacks
and privacy threats faced by AIGC systems in 6G networks, as well as the
corresponding protection issues. Subsequently, we emphasize the importance of
ensuring the unbiasedness and fairness of the mobile generative service in
future intelligent networks. In particular, we conduct a use case to
demonstrate that TrustGAIN can effectively guide the resistance against
malicious or generated false information. We believe that TrustGAIN is a
necessary paradigm for intelligent and trustworthy 6G networks to support AIGC
services, ensuring the security, privacy, and fairness of AIGC network
services.
translated: 以大型语言模型(LLM)为代表的 AI 生成内容(AIGC)模型给内容生成领域带来了革命性的变化。高速和广泛的6G 技术是提供强大的 AIGC 移动服务应用的理想平台，而未来的6G 移动网络也需要支持智能化和个性化的移动发电服务。然而，当前 AIGC 模型的重大伦理和安全问题，如对抗性攻击，隐私和公平，极大地影响了6G 智能网的可信度，特别是在确保安全，私有和公平的 AIGC 应用方面。本文提出了一种新的6G 网络可信 AIGC 范式 TrustGAIN，以确保未来6G 网络中大规模 AIGC 业务的可信性。首先讨论了 AIGC 系统在6G 网络中面临的对抗性攻击和隐私威胁，以及相应的保护问题。随后，我们强调了在未来智能网中保证移动生成业务的无偏性和公平性的重要性。特别是，我们进行了一个用例来证明 TrustGAIN 可以有效地指导抵抗恶意或生成的虚假信息。我们相信 TrustGAIN 是智能和可信6G 网络支持 AIGC 服务的必要范例，可以确保 AIGC 网络服务的安全性、隐私性和公平性。

title: Deep Multi-Task Learning for Malware Image Classification
summary:
Malicious software is a pernicious global problem. A novel multi-task
learning framework is proposed in this paper for malware image classification
for accurate and fast malware detection. We generate bitmap (BMP) and (PNG)
images from malware features, which we feed to a deep learning classifier. Our
state-of-the-art multi-task learning approach has been tested on a new dataset,
for which we have collected approximately 100,000 benign and malicious PE, APK,
Mach-o, and ELF examples. Experiments with seven tasks tested with 4 activation
functions, ReLU, LeakyReLU, PReLU, and ELU separately demonstrate that PReLU
gives the highest accuracy of more than 99.87% on all tasks. Our model can
effectively detect a variety of obfuscation methods like packing, encryption,
and instruction overlapping, strengthing the beneficial claims of our model, in
addition to achieving the state-of-art methods in terms of accuracy.
translated: 恶意软件是一个有害的全球性问题。本文提出了一种新的多任务学习框架，用于恶意软件图像分类，实现了准确、快速的恶意软件检测。我们生成位图(BMP)和(PNG)图像从恶意软件的特点，我们提供给一个深度学习分类器。我们最先进的多任务学习方法已经在一个新的数据集上进行了测试，为此我们收集了大约100,000个良性和恶性 PE、 APK、 Mach-o 和 ELF 例子。分别用4个激活函数(ReLU、 LeakyReLU、 PRELU 和 ELU)对7个任务进行了实验，结果表明，PRELU 对所有任务的准确率都达到了99.87% 以上。我们的模型可以有效地检测各种模糊方法，如打包、加密和指令重叠，加强了我们的模型的有益索赔，此外还实现了最先进的方法在准确性方面。

title:
Could It Be Generated? Towards Practical Analysis of Memorization in
  Text-To-Image Diffusion Models
summary:
The past few years have witnessed substantial advancement in text-guided
image generation powered by diffusion models. However, it was shown that
text-to-image diffusion models are vulnerable to training image memorization,
raising concerns on copyright infringement and privacy invasion. In this work,
we perform practical analysis of memorization in text-to-image diffusion
models. Targeting a set of images to protect, we conduct quantitive analysis on
them without need to collect any prompts. Specifically, we first formally
define the memorization of image and identify three necessary conditions of
memorization, respectively similarity, existence and probability. We then
reveal the correlation between the model's prediction error and image
replication. Based on the correlation, we propose to utilize inversion
techniques to verify the safety of target images against memorization and
measure the extent to which they are memorized. Model developers can utilize
our analysis method to discover memorized images or reliably claim safety
against memorization. Extensive experiments on the Stable Diffusion, a popular
open-source text-to-image diffusion model, demonstrate the effectiveness of our
analysis method.
translated: 在过去的几年中，扩散模型在文本导向图像生成方面取得了长足的进步。然而，研究表明文本到图像的扩散模型容易受到训练图像记忆的影响，从而引起了对盗版和隐私侵犯的关注。在这项工作中，我们在文本到图像的扩散模型中进行实际的记忆分析。针对一组需要保护的图像，我们不需要收集任何提示，就可以对它们进行定量分析。具体来说，我们首先对图像的记忆进行了形式化的定义，并确定了图像记忆的三个必要条件，即相似性、存在性和概率性。然后揭示了模型预测误差与图像复制之间的相关性。基于这种相关性，我们提出利用反演技术来验证目标图像对记忆的安全性，并测量目标图像对记忆的程度。模型开发人员可以利用我们的分析方法发现记忆图像或可靠地声称安全的记忆。稳定扩散(一种流行的开源文本到图像的扩散模型)的大量实验证明了我们的分析方法的有效性。

title:
High-Performance Privacy-Preserving Matrix Completion for Trajectory
  Recovery
summary:
Matrix completion has important applications in trajectory recovery and
mobile social networks. However, sending raw data containing personal,
sensitive information to cloud computing nodes may lead to privacy exposure
issue.The privacy-preserving matrix completion is a useful approach to perform
matrix completion while preserving privacy. In this paper, we propose a
high-performance method for privacy-preserving matrix completion. First,we use
a lightweight encryption scheme to encrypt the raw data and then perform matrix
completion using alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Then,the
complemented matrix is decrypted and compared with the original matrix to
calculate the error. This method has faster speed with higher accuracy. The
results of numerical experiments reveal that the proposed method is faster than
other algorithms.
translated: 矩阵补全在轨迹恢复和移动社交网络中有着重要的应用。然而，向云计算节点发送包含个人敏感信息的原始数据可能会导致隐私泄露问题。保密矩阵补全是一种在保密的同时完成矩阵补全的有效方法。本文提出了一种高性能的保密矩阵完备化方法。首先采用轻量级加密方案对原始数据进行加密，然后利用交替方向乘子法(ADMM)进行矩阵补全。然后对补矩阵进行解密，并与原矩阵进行比较，计算误差。该方法速度快，精度高。数值实验结果表明，该方法比其他算法更快。

title: Link Stealing Attacks Against Inductive Graph Neural Networks
summary:
A graph neural network (GNN) is a type of neural network that is specifically
designed to process graph-structured data. Typically, GNNs can be implemented
in two settings, including the transductive setting and the inductive setting.
In the transductive setting, the trained model can only predict the labels of
nodes that were observed at the training time. In the inductive setting, the
trained model can be generalized to new nodes/graphs. Due to its flexibility,
the inductive setting is the most popular GNN setting at the moment. Previous
work has shown that transductive GNNs are vulnerable to a series of privacy
attacks. However, a comprehensive privacy analysis of inductive GNN models is
still missing. This paper fills the gap by conducting a systematic privacy
analysis of inductive GNNs through the lens of link stealing attacks, one of
the most popular attacks that are specifically designed for GNNs. We propose
two types of link stealing attacks, i.e., posterior-only attacks and combined
attacks. We define threat models of the posterior-only attacks with respect to
node topology and the combined attacks by considering combinations of
posteriors, node attributes, and graph features. Extensive evaluation on six
real-world datasets demonstrates that inductive GNNs leak rich information that
enables link stealing attacks with advantageous properties. Even attacks with
no knowledge about graph structures can be effective. We also show that our
attacks are robust to different node similarities and different graph features.
As a counterpart, we investigate two possible defenses and discover they are
ineffective against our attacks, which calls for more effective defenses.
translated: 图形神经网络(GNN)是一种专门用于处理图形结构数据的神经网络。通常，GNN 可以在两种设置中实现，包括传导设置和归纳设置。在传导设置中，训练后的模型只能预测训练时观察到的节点的标记。在归纳设置中，训练后的模型可以推广到新的节点/图。由于其灵活性，感应设置是目前最流行的 GNN 设置。以前的工作已经表明，诱导性 GNN 容易受到一系列隐私攻击。然而，一个全面的隐私分析归纳 GNN 模型仍然缺乏。本文从链路窃取攻击的角度对归纳 GNN 进行了系统的隐私分析，从而填补了这一空白。我们提出了两种类型的链接窃取攻击，即仅后向攻击和联合攻击。我们通过考虑后验、节点属性和图形特征的组合，定义了仅后验攻击的关于节点拓扑和组合攻击的威胁模型。对六个真实世界数据集的广泛评估表明，归纳 GNN 泄漏丰富的信息，使链路窃取攻击具有有利的属性。即使是对图结构一无所知的攻击也是有效的。我们还证明了我们的攻击对不同的节点相似性和不同的图形特征具有鲁棒性。作为对应方，我们研究了两种可能的防御措施，发现它们对我们的攻击无效，这就需要更有效的防御措施。

title: Private Online Community Detection for Censored Block Models
summary:
We study the private online change detection problem for dynamic communities,
using a censored block model (CBM). Focusing on the notion of edge differential
privacy (DP), we seek to understand the fundamental tradeoffs between the
privacy budget, detection delay, and exact community recovery of community
labels. We establish the theoretical lower bound on the delay in detecting
changes privately and propose an algorithm capable of identifying changes in
the community structure, while maintaining user privacy. Further, we provide
theoretical guarantees for the effectiveness of our proposed method by showing
necessary and sufficient conditions on change detection and exact recovery
under edge DP. Simulation and real data examples are provided to validate the
proposed method.
translated: 我们研究了动态社区中的私人在线变化检测问题，使用了删除块模型(CBM)。聚焦于边缘差分隐私(DP)的概念，我们试图理解隐私预算、检测延迟和社区标签的精确社区恢复之间的基本权衡。我们建立了在私下检测变化的延迟的理论下限，并提出了一个算法，能够识别社区结构的变化，同时保持用户的隐私。此外，我们提供了理论上的保证，我们建议的方法的有效性，通过显示必要的和充分的条件下的变化检测和精确恢复的边缘 DP。通过仿真和实际数据验证了该方法的有效性。

title:
Privacy-Preserving Edge Federated Learning for Intelligent Mobile-Health
  Systems
summary:
Machine Learning (ML) algorithms are generally designed for scenarios in
which all data is stored in one data center, where the training is performed.
However, in many applications, e.g., in the healthcare domain, the training
data is distributed among several entities, e.g., different hospitals or
patients' mobile devices/sensors. At the same time, transferring the data to a
central location for learning is certainly not an option, due to privacy
concerns and legal issues, and in certain cases, because of the communication
and computation overheads. Federated Learning (FL) is the state-of-the-art
collaborative ML approach for training an ML model across multiple parties
holding local data samples, without sharing them. However, enabling learning
from distributed data over such edge Internet of Things (IoT) systems (e.g.,
mobile-health and wearable technologies, involving sensitive personal/medical
data) in a privacy-preserving fashion presents a major challenge mainly due to
their stringent resource constraints, i.e., limited computing capacity,
communication bandwidth, memory storage, and battery lifetime. In this paper,
we propose a privacy-preserving edge FL framework for resource-constrained
mobile-health and wearable technologies over the IoT infrastructure. We
evaluate our proposed framework extensively and provide the implementation of
our technique on Amazon's AWS cloud platform based on the seizure detection
application in epilepsy monitoring using wearable technologies.
translated: 机器学习(ML)算法通常是为所有数据存储在一个数据中心的场景而设计的，在这个场景中，训练被执行。然而，在许多应用程序中，例如，在医疗领域，培训数据分布在几个实体之间，例如，不同的医院或患者的移动设备/传感器。与此同时，由于隐私问题和法律问题，以及在某些情况下，由于通信和计算开销，将数据传输到中心位置进行学习肯定不是一种选择。联邦学习(Federated Learning，FL)是一种最先进的机器学习协作方法，用于跨多方培训机器学习模型，这些机器学习模型持有本地数据样本，而不需要共享这些样本。然而，通过物联网(IoT)这样的边缘系统(例如，移动健康和可穿戴技术，涉及敏感的个人/医疗数据)以保护隐私的方式从分布式数据中学习提出了一个主要的挑战，主要是由于其严格的资源限制，即有限的计算能力，通信带宽，内存存储和电池寿命。在本文中，我们提出了一个基于物联网基础设施的资源受限的移动健康和可穿戴技术的隐私保护边缘 FL 框架。我们广泛地评估了我们提出的框架，并提供了我们的技术在 Amazon 的 AWS 云平台上的实现，该平台基于使用可穿戴技术的癫痫监测中的癫痫发作检测应用程序。

title:
Chain of Attack: a Semantic-Driven Contextual Multi-Turn attacker for
  LLM
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable performance in various
natural language processing tasks, especially in dialogue systems. However, LLM
may also pose security and moral threats, especially in multi round
conversations where large models are more easily guided by contextual content,
resulting in harmful or biased responses. In this paper, we present a novel
method to attack LLMs in multi-turn dialogues, called CoA (Chain of Attack).
CoA is a semantic-driven contextual multi-turn attack method that adaptively
adjusts the attack policy through contextual feedback and semantic relevance
during multi-turn of dialogue with a large model, resulting in the model
producing unreasonable or harmful content. We evaluate CoA on different LLMs
and datasets, and show that it can effectively expose the vulnerabilities of
LLMs, and outperform existing attack methods. Our work provides a new
perspective and tool for attacking and defending LLMs, and contributes to the
security and ethical assessment of dialogue systems.
translated: 大语言模型(LLM)在各种自然语言处理任务中，尤其是在对话系统中取得了显著的性能。然而，LLM 也可能构成安全和道德威胁，特别是在多轮对话中，大型模型更容易受到上下文内容的引导，导致有害或有偏见的反应。本文提出了一种多回合对话中攻击 LLM 的新方法，称为攻击链 CoA。CoA 是一种语义驱动的语境多回合攻击方法，在大型模型的多回合对话过程中，通过语境反馈和语义相关性自适应调整攻击策略，导致模型产生不合理或有害的内容。通过对不同 LLM 和数据集的 CoA 评估，表明该方法能够有效地暴露 LLM 的漏洞，并优于现有的攻击方法。我们的工作为打击和防御 LLM 提供了一个新的视角和工具，并有助于对话系统的安全和道德评估。

title:
TroLLoc: Logic Locking and Layout Hardening for IC Security Closure
  against Hardware Trojans
summary:
Due to cost benefits, supply chains of integrated circuits (ICs) are largely
outsourced nowadays. However, passing ICs through various third-party providers
gives rise to many security threats, like piracy of IC intellectual property or
insertion of hardware Trojans, i.e., malicious circuit modifications.
  In this work, we proactively and systematically protect the physical layouts
of ICs against post-design insertion of Trojans. Toward that end, we propose
TroLLoc, a novel scheme for IC security closure that employs, for the first
time, logic locking and layout hardening in unison. TroLLoc is fully integrated
into a commercial-grade design flow, and TroLLoc is shown to be effective,
efficient, and robust. Our work provides in-depth layout and security analysis
considering the challenging benchmarks of the ISPD'22/23 contests for security
closure. We show that TroLLoc successfully renders layouts resilient, with
reasonable overheads, against (i) general prospects for Trojan insertion as in
the ISPD'22 contest, (ii) actual Trojan insertion as in the ISPD'23 contest,
and (iii) potential second-order attacks where adversaries would first (i.e.,
before Trojan insertion) try to bypass the locking defense, e.g., using
advanced machine learning attacks. Finally, we release all our artifacts for
independent verification [2].
translated: 由于成本效益，集成电路(IC)的供应链现在大量外包。然而，通过不同的第三方供应商传递集成电路会引起许多安全威胁，如盗版集成电路知识产权或插入硬件木马，即恶意电路修改。在这项工作中，我们主动和系统地保护集成电路的物理布局，防止设计后插入木马。为此，我们提出了一种新颖的集成电路安全闭包方案 TroLLoc，该方案首次采用了逻辑锁和布局强化相结合的方法。TroLLoc 完全集成到商业级的设计流程中，并且 TroLLoc 被证明是有效的、高效的和健壮的。我们的工作提供了深入的布局和安全分析，考虑到具有挑战性的基准 ISPD’22/23竞赛的安全关闭。我们展示了 TroLLoc 在合理的开销下，成功地使布局具有弹性，对抗(i) ISPD’22竞赛中的木马插入的总体前景，(ii) ISPD’23竞赛中的实际木马插入，以及(iii)潜在的二阶攻击，其中对手会首先(即，在木马插入之前)试图绕过锁定防御，例如，使用先进的机器学习攻击。最后，我们释放所有工件以进行独立验证[2]。

title: Model Inversion Robustness: Can Transfer Learning Help?
summary:
Model Inversion (MI) attacks aim to reconstruct private training data by
abusing access to machine learning models. Contemporary MI attacks have
achieved impressive attack performance, posing serious threats to privacy.
Meanwhile, all existing MI defense methods rely on regularization that is in
direct conflict with the training objective, resulting in noticeable
degradation in model utility. In this work, we take a different perspective,
and propose a novel and simple Transfer Learning-based Defense against Model
Inversion (TL-DMI) to render MI-robust models. Particularly, by leveraging TL,
we limit the number of layers encoding sensitive information from private
training dataset, thereby degrading the performance of MI attack. We conduct an
analysis using Fisher Information to justify our method. Our defense is
remarkably simple to implement. Without bells and whistles, we show in
extensive experiments that TL-DMI achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) MI
robustness. Our code, pre-trained models, demo and inverted data are available
at: https://hosytuyen.github.io/projects/TL-DMI
translated: 模型反演(MI)攻击的目的是通过滥用对机器学习模型的访问来重建私有的训练数据。当代 MI 攻击取得了令人印象深刻的攻击性能，对隐私构成严重威胁。同时，所有现有的 MI 防御方法都依赖于与训练目标直接冲突的正则化，导致模型效用的明显下降。本文从不同的角度出发，提出了一种新颖简单的基于转移学习的模型反演防御方法(TL-DMI) ，用于描述基于转移学习的模型鲁棒性。特别是，通过利用 TL，我们限制了从私有训练数据集编码敏感信息的层数，从而降低了 MI 攻击的性能。我们用费雪资讯分析来证明我们的方法是正确的。我们的辩护非常简单。没有花哨，我们显示在广泛的实验中，TL-DMI 实现了最先进的(SOTA) MI 健壮性。我们的代码，预先训练的模型，演示和反向数据可在以下 https://hosytuyen.github.io/projects/tl-dmi 获得

title:
Implementation Study of Cost-Effective Verification for Pietrzak's
  Verifiable Delay Function in Ethereum Smart Contracts
summary:
Verifiable Delay Function (VDF) is a cryptographic concept that ensures a
minimum delay before output through sequential processing, which is resistant
to parallel computing. Among the two well-known VDF protocols, Wesolowski and
Pietrzak VDF, we focus on the Pietrzak VDF due to its computational efficiency
and suitability for blockchain environments. Pietrzak's approach uses a
recursive proof verification with the halving protocol, offering a practical
alternative despite the longer proof length than Wesolowski's approach. Given
the scarcity of research on practical VDF verification implementation,
especially within smart contracts, this paper aims to implement cost-effective
verification for the Pietrzak VDF in an Ethereum-based environment without
compromising the VDF verification's integrity and reliability. Firstly, we
propose generalized proof generation and verification algorithms for potential
efficiency improvement. Secondly, we categorize and measure the gas cost of
each part in a transaction for VDF verification. Thirdly, based on the
analysis, we theoretically predict the optimized proof construction. Finally,
we demonstrate the theoretical prediction matches the implementation results.
Furthermore, our research shows that the proof length of the Pietrzak VDF is
generated under 8 KB with the security level of 2048 bits, much smaller than
the previous expectation. This implies that the Pietrzak VDF can be practically
used for cryptographic applications on blockchains.
translated: 可验证延迟函数(VDF)是一个密码学概念，它通过顺序处理确保输出之前的最小延迟，这对并行计算是有抵抗力的。在两个著名的 VDF 协议，Wesolowski 和 Pietrzak VDF，我们重点关注 Pietrzak VDF，因为它的计算效率和适用于区块链环境。Pietrzak 的方法使用了一个递归的证明验证与一半的协议，提供了一个实用的替代方案，尽管证明长度比韦索洛夫斯基的方法。鉴于目前对实际 VDF 验证实现的研究较少，尤其是在智能合同环境下，本文旨在在不影响 VDF 验证完整性和可靠性的前提下，在基于 Etherum 的环境下对 Pietrzak VDF 进行经济有效的验证。首先，我们提出了广义证明生成和验证算法来提高潜在的效率。其次，我们对交易中各部分的燃气成本进行分类和测量，以便 VDF 验证。在此基础上，对优化证明结构进行了理论预测。最后，论证了理论预测与实现结果的一致性。此外，我们的研究表明，Pietrzak VDF 的证明长度是在8 KB 以下产生的2048位的安全水平，远小于以前的期望。这意味着 Pietrzak VDF 实际上可以用于区块链上的加密应用。

title: Sandboxing Adoption in Open Source Ecosystems
summary:
Sandboxing mechanisms allow developers to limit how much access applications
have to resources, following the least-privilege principle. However, it's not
clear how much and in what ways developers are using these mechanisms. This
study looks at the use of Seccomp, Landlock, Capsicum, Pledge, and Unveil in
all packages of four open-source operating systems. We found that less than 1%
of packages directly use these mechanisms, but many more indirectly use them.
Examining how developers apply these mechanisms reveals interesting usage
patterns, such as cases where developers simplify their sandbox implementation.
It also highlights challenges that may be hindering the widespread adoption of
sandboxing mechanisms.
translated: 沙箱机制允许开发人员根据最小特权原则限制应用程序对资源的访问量。然而，开发人员使用这些机制的程度和方式尚不清楚。这项研究着眼于 Seccomp，Landlock，辣椒，誓言和揭幕在四个开源操作系统的所有软件包中的使用。我们发现只有不到1% 的软件包直接使用这些机制，但是更多的软件包间接地使用它们。研究开发人员如何应用这些机制揭示了有趣的使用模式，例如开发人员简化其沙箱实现的情况。它还强调了可能阻碍广泛采用沙箱机制的挑战。

title:
Using AI Assistants in Software Development: A Qualitative Study on
  Security Practices and Concerns
summary:
Following the recent release of AI assistants, such as OpenAI's ChatGPT and
GitHub Copilot, the software industry quickly utilized these tools for software
development tasks, e.g., generating code or consulting AI for advice. While
recent research has demonstrated that AI-generated code can contain security
issues, how software professionals balance AI assistant usage and security
remains unclear. This paper investigates how software professionals use AI
assistants in secure software development, what security implications and
considerations arise, and what impact they foresee on secure software
development. We conducted 27 semi-structured interviews with software
professionals, including software engineers, team leads, and security testers.
We also reviewed 190 relevant Reddit posts and comments to gain insights into
the current discourse surrounding AI assistants for software development. Our
analysis of the interviews and Reddit posts finds that despite many security
and quality concerns, participants widely use AI assistants for
security-critical tasks, e.g., code generation, threat modeling, and
vulnerability detection. Their overall mistrust leads to checking AI
suggestions in similar ways to human code, although they expect improvements
and, therefore, a heavier use for security tasks in the future. We conclude
with recommendations for software professionals to critically check AI
suggestions, AI creators to improve suggestion security and capabilities for
ethical security tasks, and academic researchers to consider general-purpose AI
in software development.
translated: 随着最近人工智能助手(如 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 和 GitHub Copilot)的发布，软件行业迅速将这些工具用于软件开发任务，例如生成代码或咨询人工智能的建议。虽然最近的研究表明，人工智能生成的代码可以包含安全问题，但软件专业人员如何平衡人工智能助手的使用和安全仍然不清楚。本文研究了软件专业人员在安全软件开发中如何使用 AI 助手，出现了哪些安全含义和考虑因素，以及他们对安全软件开发的预见影响。我们对软件专业人士进行了27次半结构化访谈，包括软件工程师、团队负责人和安全测试人员。我们还回顾了190个相关的 Reddit 帖子和评论，以深入了解当前围绕人工智能助手软件开发的讨论。我们对访谈和 Reddit 帖子的分析发现，尽管存在许多安全和质量方面的问题，但参与者广泛使用 AI 助手完成安全关键任务，例如代码生成、威胁建模和漏洞检测。他们总体上的不信任导致检查 AI 建议的方式类似于人类代码，尽管他们期望改进，因此，在未来更多地使用安全任务。最后，我们建议软件专业人员严格检查人工智能建议，人工智能创建者提高建议安全性和道德安全任务的能力，以及学术研究人员在软件开发中考虑通用人工智能。

title:
DP-DyLoRA: Fine-Tuning Transformer-Based Models On-Device under
  Differentially Private Federated Learning using Dynamic Low-Rank Adaptation
summary:
Federated learning (FL) allows clients in an Internet of Things (IoT) system
to collaboratively train a global model without sharing their local data with a
server. However, clients' contributions to the server can still leak sensitive
information. Differential privacy (DP) addresses such leakage by providing
formal privacy guarantees, with mechanisms that add randomness to the clients'
contributions. The randomness makes it infeasible to train large
transformer-based models, common in modern IoT systems. In this work, we
empirically evaluate the practicality of fine-tuning large scale on-device
transformer-based models with differential privacy in a federated learning
system. We conduct comprehensive experiments on various system properties for
tasks spanning a multitude of domains: speech recognition, computer vision (CV)
and natural language understanding (NLU). Our results show that full
fine-tuning under differentially private federated learning (DP-FL) generally
leads to huge performance degradation which can be alleviated by reducing the
dimensionality of contributions through parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT).
Our benchmarks of existing DP-PEFT methods show that DP-Low-Rank Adaptation
(DP-LoRA) consistently outperforms other methods. An even more promising
approach, DyLoRA, which makes the low rank variable, when naively combined with
FL would straightforwardly break differential privacy. We therefore propose an
adaptation method that can be combined with differential privacy and call it
DP-DyLoRA. Finally, we are able to reduce the accuracy degradation and word
error rate (WER) increase due to DP to less than 2% and 7% respectively with 1
million clients and a stringent privacy budget of {\epsilon}=2.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)允许物联网(IoT)系统中的客户协同训练一个全球模型，而无需与服务器共享他们的本地数据。但是，客户机对服务器的贡献仍然可能泄露敏感信息。差分隐私(DP)通过提供正式的隐私保障来解决这种泄露问题，其机制增加了客户贡献的随机性。这种随机性使得现代物联网系统中常见的基于变压器的大型模型的培训变得不可行。在这项工作中，我们经验性地评估了在联邦学习系统中使用差分隐私微调大规模的基于设备上变压器的模型的实用性。我们对语音识别、计算机视觉(CV)和自然语言理解(NLU)等多个领域的任务的各种系统特性进行了全面的实验研究。我们的研究结果表明，在差分私有联邦学习(DP-FL)环境下的全微调通常会导致性能的严重下降，通过参数有效微调(PEFT)降低贡献的维数可以缓解这一问题。我们对现有 DP-PEFT 方法的基准测试表明，DP-Low-Rank 自适应(DP-LoRA)方法的性能始终优于其他方法。一个更有前途的方法，DyLoRA，使低等级变量，当天真地结合 FL 将直接打破差分隐私。因此，我们提出了一种适应方法，可以结合差分隐私，并称之为 DP-DyloRA。最后，在100万个客户端和严格的保密预算{ epsilon } = 2的情况下，我们能够将由于 DP 引起的准确性下降和字错误率(WER)增加分别降低到2% 和7% 以下。

title: CRATOR: a Dark Web Crawler
summary:
Dark web crawling is a complex process that involves specific methodologies
and techniques to navigate the Tor network and extract data from hidden
services. This study proposes a general dark web crawler designed to extract
pages handling security protocols, such as captchas, efficiently. Our approach
uses a combination of seed URL lists, link analysis, and scanning to discover
new content. We also incorporate methods for user-agent rotation and proxy
usage to maintain anonymity and avoid detection. We evaluate the effectiveness
of our crawler using metrics such as coverage, performance and robustness. Our
results demonstrate that our crawler effectively extracts pages handling
security protocols while maintaining anonymity and avoiding detection. Our
proposed dark web crawler can be used for various applications, including
threat intelligence, cybersecurity, and online investigations.
translated: 暗网爬行是一个复杂的过程，涉及到特定的方法和技术来导航 Tor 网络和从隐藏服务中提取数据。该研究提出了一种通用的暗网爬虫，用于有效地提取处理验证码等安全协议的网页。我们的方法结合使用种子 URL 列表、链接分析和扫描来发现新内容。我们还结合了用户-代理轮换和代理使用的方法，以保持匿名性和避免检测。我们使用覆盖率、性能和健壮性等指标来评估爬虫的有效性。实验结果表明，爬虫能够有效地提取处理安全协议的页面，同时保持匿名性，避免被检测。我们提出的暗网爬虫可以用于各种应用程序，包括威胁情报、网络安全和在线调查。

title: Smooth Sensitivity for Geo-Privacy
summary:
Suppose each user $i$ holds a private value $x_i$ in some metric space $(U,
\mathrm{dist})$, and an untrusted data analyst wishes to compute $\sum_i
f(x_i)$ for some function $f : U \rightarrow \mathbb{R}$ by asking each user to
send in a privatized $f(x_i)$. This is a fundamental problem in
privacy-preserving population analytics, and the local model of differential
privacy (LDP) is the predominant model under which the problem has been
studied. However, LDP requires any two different $x_i, x'_i$ to be
$\varepsilon$-distinguishable, which can be overly strong for
geometric/numerical data. On the other hand, Geo-Privacy (GP) stipulates that
the level of distinguishability be proportional to $\mathrm{dist}(x_i, x_i')$,
providing an attractive alternative notion of personal data privacy in a metric
space. However, existing GP mechanisms for this problem, which add a uniform
noise to either $x_i$ or $f(x_i)$, are not satisfactory. In this paper, we
generalize the smooth sensitivity framework from Differential Privacy to
Geo-Privacy, which allows us to add noise tailored to the hardness of the given
instance. We provide definitions, mechanisms, and a generic procedure for
computing the smooth sensitivity under GP equipped with a general metric. Then
we present three applications: one-way and two-way threshold functions, and
Gaussian kernel density estimation, to demonstrate the applicability and
utility of our smooth sensitivity framework.
translated: 假设每个用户 $i $在某个度量空间 $(U，mathrm { dist }) $中拥有一个私有值 $x _ i $，并且一个不受信任的数据分析师希望通过要求每个用户发送一个私有化的 $f (x _ i) $来计算某个函数 $f: U right tarrow mathbb { R } $的 $sum _ i f (x _ i) $。这是保护隐私的人口分析中的一个基本问题，而本地差分隐私模型(lDP)是研究这个问题的主要模型。然而，LDP 要求任意两个不同的 $x _ i，x’_ i $是 $varepsilon $- 可区分的，这对于几何/数值数据来说可能过于强大。另一方面，Geo-Privacy (GP)规定可区分性水平与 $mathrm { dist }(x _ i，x _ i’) $成正比，为度量空间中的个人数据隐私提供了一个有吸引力的替代概念。然而，对于这个问题，现有的 GP 机制，即给 $x _ i $或 $f (x _ i) $添加一个统一的噪声，是不能令人满意的。在本文中，我们将平滑灵敏度框架从差分隐私推广到了 geo-Privacy，它允许我们根据给定实例的硬度添加噪声。我们提供了定义，机制，和一个通用的程序计算平滑灵敏度下 GP 配备了一般的度量。然后，我们提出了三个应用: 单向和双向阈值函数，以及高斯核密度估计，以证明我们的平滑灵敏度框架的适用性和实用性。

title:
Exploring the Interplay of Interpretability and Robustness in Deep
  Neural Networks: A Saliency-guided Approach
summary:
Adversarial attacks pose a significant challenge to deploying deep learning
models in safety-critical applications. Maintaining model robustness while
ensuring interpretability is vital for fostering trust and comprehension in
these models. This study investigates the impact of Saliency-guided Training
(SGT) on model robustness, a technique aimed at improving the clarity of
saliency maps to deepen understanding of the model's decision-making process.
Experiments were conducted on standard benchmark datasets using various deep
learning architectures trained with and without SGT. Findings demonstrate that
SGT enhances both model robustness and interpretability. Additionally, we
propose a novel approach combining SGT with standard adversarial training to
achieve even greater robustness while preserving saliency map quality. Our
strategy is grounded in the assumption that preserving salient features crucial
for correctly classifying adversarial examples enhances model robustness, while
masking non-relevant features improves interpretability. Our technique yields
significant gains, achieving a 35\% and 20\% improvement in robustness against
PGD attack with noise magnitudes of $0.2$ and $0.02$ for the MNIST and CIFAR-10
datasets, respectively, while producing high-quality saliency maps.
translated: 对抗性攻击对在安全关键应用程序中部署深度学习模型构成了重大挑战。在确保可解释性的同时保持模型的健壮性对于在这些模型中培养信任和理解是至关重要的。本研究探讨显著性引导训练(SGT)对模型稳健性的影响，该技术旨在提高显著性映射的清晰度，以加深对模型决策过程的理解。在标准基准数据集上使用不同的深度学习体系结构进行实验，结果表明，SGT 增强了模型的鲁棒性和可解释性。此外，我们提出了一种新的方法结合 SGT 与标准的对抗性训练，以实现更大的鲁棒性，同时保持突出地图的质量。我们的策略基于这样的假设，即保留对于正确分类对手示例至关重要的显著特征可以提高模型的鲁棒性，而掩盖非相关特征可以提高可解释性。我们的技术产生了显着的收益，对于 MNIST 和 CIFAR-10数据集的噪声幅度分别为0.2 $和0.02 $，在对 PGD 攻击的鲁棒性方面分别提高了35% 和20% ，同时产生了高质量的显着性图。

title:
Improving the Privacy Loss Under User-Level DP Composition for Fixed
  Estimation Error
summary:
This paper considers the private release of statistics of several disjoint
subsets of a datasets, under user-level $\epsilon$-differential privacy (DP).
In particular, we consider the user-level differentially private release of
sample means and variances of speed values in several grids in a city, in a
potentially sequential manner. Traditional analysis of the privacy loss due to
the sequential composition of queries necessitates a privacy loss degradation
by a factor that equals the total number of grids. Our main contribution is an
iterative, instance-dependent algorithm, based on clipping the number of user
contributions, which seeks to reduce the overall privacy loss degradation under
a canonical Laplace mechanism, while not increasing the {worst} estimation
error among the different grids. We test the performance of our algorithm on
synthetic datasets and demonstrate improvements in the privacy loss degradation
factor via our algorithm. We also demonstrate improvements in the worst-case
error using a simple extension of a pseudo-user creation-based mechanism. An
important component of this analysis is our exact characterization of the
sensitivities and the worst-case estimation errors of sample means and
variances incurred by clipping user contributions in an arbitrary fashion,
which we believe is of independent interest.
translated: 本文考虑了在用户级别 $epsilon $- 差分隐私(DP)下，一个数据集的几个不相交的子集的统计信息的私有发布。特别是，我们考虑用户级别的差别私人发布的样本平均值和速度值的方差在一个城市的几个网格，在一个潜在的连续方式。传统的分析由于查询的顺序组合而导致的隐私损失需要一个等于网格总数的因子来降低隐私损失。我们的主要贡献是一个迭代的，实例相关的算法，基于削减用户贡献的数量，它寻求减少整体隐私损失的退化在一个规范的拉普拉斯机制下，同时不增加{最坏}估计误差在不同的网格。我们在合成数据集上测试了算法的性能，并通过算法演示了隐私损失退化因子的改进。我们还演示了使用基于伪用户创建机制的简单扩展对最坏情况错误的改进。这种分析的一个重要组成部分是我们对样本平均值的敏感性和最坏情况估计误差的精确角色塑造，以及以任意方式剪裁用户贡献所引起的方差，我们认为这是独立的利益。

title: Disttack: Graph Adversarial Attacks Toward Distributed GNN Training
summary:
Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have emerged as potent models for graph
learning. Distributing the training process across multiple computing nodes is
the most promising solution to address the challenges of ever-growing
real-world graphs. However, current adversarial attack methods on GNNs neglect
the characteristics and applications of the distributed scenario, leading to
suboptimal performance and inefficiency in attacking distributed GNN training.
  In this study, we introduce Disttack, the first framework of adversarial
attacks for distributed GNN training that leverages the characteristics of
frequent gradient updates in a distributed system. Specifically, Disttack
corrupts distributed GNN training by injecting adversarial attacks into one
single computing node. The attacked subgraphs are precisely perturbed to induce
an abnormal gradient ascent in backpropagation, disrupting gradient
synchronization between computing nodes and thus leading to a significant
performance decline of the trained GNN. We evaluate Disttack on four large
real-world graphs by attacking five widely adopted GNNs. Compared with the
state-of-the-art attack method, experimental results demonstrate that Disttack
amplifies the model accuracy degradation by 2.75$\times$ and achieves speedup
by 17.33$\times$ on average while maintaining unnoticeability.
translated: 图形神经网络(GNN)已经成为图形学习的有力模型。将训练过程分布在多个计算节点上是解决日益增长的实际图形挑战的最有前途的解决方案。然而，目前针对 GNN 的对抗性攻击方法忽视了分布式场景的特点和应用，导致攻击分布式 GNN 训练的性能不理想和效率低下。在本研究中，我们介绍了 Disttack，这是第一个针对分布式 GNN 训练的对抗性攻击框架，它利用了分布式系统中频繁梯度更新的特性。具体来说，Disttack 通过向单个计算节点注入对抗性攻击来破坏分布式 GNN 训练。被攻击的子图被精确地扰动以引起反向传播中的异常梯度上升，破坏计算节点之间的梯度同步，从而导致训练后的 GNN 性能的显著下降。我们通过攻击五个广泛采用的 GNN 来评估四个大型真实世界图上的 Disttack。实验结果表明，与最先进的攻击方法相比，Disttack 在不引起注意的情况下，模型精度下降了2.75美元，平均加速了17.33美元。

title: Impedance vs. Power Side-channel Vulnerabilities: A Comparative Study
summary:
In recent times, impedance side-channel analysis has emerged as a potent
strategy for adversaries seeking to extract sensitive information from
computing systems. It leverages variations in the intrinsic impedance of a
chip's internal structure across different logic states. In this study, we
conduct a comparative analysis between the newly explored impedance side
channel and the well-established power side channel. Through experimental
evaluation, we investigate the efficacy of these two side channels in
extracting the cryptographic key from the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)
and analyze their performance. Our results indicate that impedance analysis
demonstrates a higher potential for cryptographic key extraction compared to
power side-channel analysis. Moreover, we identify scenarios where power
side-channel analysis does not yield satisfactory results, whereas impedance
analysis proves to be more robust and effective. This work not only underscores
the significance of impedance side-channel analysis in enhancing cryptographic
security but also emphasizes the necessity for a deeper understanding of its
mechanisms and implications.
translated: 近年来，阻抗侧信道分析已经成为对手从计算机系统中提取敏感信息的有力策略。它利用了芯片内部结构在不同逻辑状态下的内部阻抗变化。在这项研究中，我们对新开发的阻抗侧信道和已建立的功率侧信道进行了比较分析。通过实验评估，我们研究了这两个侧通道从单密钥中提取高级加密标准的效果，并分析了它们的性能。我们的研究结果表明，阻抗分析表明，与功率侧通道分析相比，单密钥提取的潜力更大。此外，我们确定的情况下，功率侧通道分析不产生令人满意的结果，而阻抗分析被证明是更健壮和有效的。这项工作不仅强调了阻抗侧信道分析在提高密码安全性方面的重要性，而且也强调了深入理解其机制和含义的必要性。

title: Efficient and Universal Merkle Tree Inclusion Proofs via OR Aggregation
summary:
Zero-knowledge proofs have emerged as a powerful tool for enhancing privacy
and security in blockchain applications. However, the efficiency and
scalability of proof systems remain a significant challenge, particularly in
the context of Merkle tree inclusion proofs. Traditional proof aggregation
techniques based on AND logic suffer from high verification complexity and data
communication overhead, limiting their practicality for large-scale
applications. In this paper, we propose a novel proof aggregation approach
based on OR logic, which enables the generation of compact and universally
verifiable proofs for Merkle tree inclusion. By aggregating proofs using OR
logic, we achieve a proof size that is independent of the number of leaves in
the tree, and verification can be performed using any single valid leaf hash.
This represents a significant improvement over AND aggregation, which requires
the verifier to process all leaf hashes. We formally define the OR aggregation
logic, describe the process of generating universal proofs, and provide a
comparative analysis demonstrating the advantages of our approach in terms of
proof size, verification data, and universality. Furthermore, we discuss the
potential of combining OR and AND aggregation logics to create complex
acceptance functions, enabling the development of expressive and efficient
proof systems for various blockchain applications. The proposed techniques have
the potential to significantly enhance the scalability, efficiency, and
flexibility of zero-knowledge proof systems, paving the way for more practical
and adaptive solutions in the blockchain ecosystem.
translated: 零知识证明已经成为区块链应用中增强隐私和安全性的强大工具。然而，证明系统的效率和可扩展性仍然是一个重大的挑战，特别是在 Merkle 树包含证明的背景下。传统的基于与逻辑的证明聚合技术存在验证复杂度高、数据通信开销大等问题，限制了其在大规模应用中的实用性。本文提出了一种新的基于 OR 逻辑的证明聚合方法，该方法能够生成 Merkle 树包含的紧致且普遍可验证的证明。通过使用 OR 逻辑聚合证明，我们得到了一个与树中的叶子数无关的证明大小，并且可以使用任意一个有效的叶子散列来执行验证。这表示与 AND 聚合相比有了显著的改进，AND 聚合要求验证程序处理所有叶散列。我们正式定义了 OR 聚合逻辑，描述了生成通用证明的过程，并提供了一个比较分析，展示了我们的方法在证明大小、验证数据和通用性方面的优势。此外，我们讨论了结合 OR 和 AND 聚合逻辑的潜力，以创建复杂的接受函数，使开发各种区块链应用的表达和高效的证明系统。提出的技术有可能显著提高零知识证明系统的可扩展性、效率和灵活性，为区块链生态系统中更实用和适应性更强的解决方案铺平道路。

title: Positional-Unigram Byte Models for Generalized TLS Fingerprinting
summary:
We use positional-unigram byte models along with maximum likelihood for
generalized TLS fingerprinting and empirically show that it is robust to cipher
stunting. Our approach creates a set of positional-unigram byte models from
client hello messages. Each positional-unigram byte model is a statistical
model of TLS client hello traffic created by a client application or process.
To fingerprint a TLS connection, we use its client hello, and compute the
likelihood as a function of a statistical model. The statistical model that
maximizes the likelihood function is the predicted client application for the
given client hello. Our data driven approach does not use side-channel
information and can be updated on-the-fly. We experimentally validate our
method on an internal dataset and show that it is robust to cipher stunting by
tracking an unbiased $f_{1}$ score as we synthetically increase randomization.
translated: 我们使用位置 -unigram 字节模型和最大似然方法进行广义 TLS 指纹识别，并且实验表明该方法对于密码发育是鲁棒的。我们的方法从客户机 hello 消息创建一组位置 -unigram 字节模型。每个位置 -unigram 字节模型都是由客户机应用程序或进程创建的 TLS 客户机 hello 流量的统计模型。为了指纹一个 TLS 连接，我们使用它的客户机 hello，并计算作为一个统计模型的函数的可能性。使似然函数最大化的统计模型是给定客户机 hello 的预测客户机应用程序。我们的数据驱动方法不使用边通道信息，并且可以实时更新。我们在一个内部数据集上实验验证了我们的方法，并且证明了当我们综合增加随机化时，通过跟踪一个无偏的 $f _ {1} $分数，该方法对于加密发展是鲁棒的。

title:
Decoding Geometric Properties in Non-Random Data from First
  Information-Theoretic Principles
summary:
Based on the principles of information theory, measure theory, and
theoretical computer science, we introduce a univariate signal deconvolution
method with a wide range of applications to coding theory, particularly in
zero-knowledge one-way communication channels, such as in deciphering messages
from unknown generating sources about which no prior knowledge is available and
to which no return message can be sent. Our multidimensional space
reconstruction method from an arbitrary received signal is proven to be
agnostic vis-a-vis the encoding-decoding scheme, computation model, programming
language, formal theory, the computable (or semi-computable) method of
approximation to algorithmic complexity, and any arbitrarily chosen
(computable) probability measure of the events. The method derives from the
principles of an approach to Artificial General Intelligence capable of
building a general-purpose model of models independent of any arbitrarily
assumed prior probability distribution. We argue that this optimal and
universal method of decoding non-random data has applications to signal
processing, causal deconvolution, topological and geometric properties
encoding, cryptography, and bio- and technosignature detection.
translated: 本文基于信息论、测度论和计算机科学理论，提出了一种单变量信号反褶积方法，该方法在编码理论中有着广泛的应用，特别是在零知识单向通信信道中，例如在破译来自未知生成源的信息时，这些信息没有先验知识，也不能向其发送回复信息。我们的多维空间重建方法从一个任意接收信号被证明是不可知的编码解码方案，计算模型，编程语言，形式理论，可计算(或半可计算)方法的近似算法的复杂性，以及任意选择(可计算)机率量测的事件。该方法源于人工通用智能方法的原理，该方法能够建立一个独立于任意假定的先验概率的通用模型。我们认为这种最佳和通用的非随机数据解码方法在信号处理、因果反褶积、拓扑和几何特性编码、密码学以及生物和技术签名检测等方面都有应用。

title:
CrossCert: A Cross-Checking Detection Approach to Patch Robustness
  Certification for Deep Learning Models
summary:
Patch robustness certification is an emerging kind of defense technique
against adversarial patch attacks with provable guarantees. There are two
research lines: certified recovery and certified detection. They aim to label
malicious samples with provable guarantees correctly and issue warnings for
malicious samples predicted to non-benign labels with provable guarantees,
respectively. However, existing certified detection defenders suffer from
protecting labels subject to manipulation, and existing certified recovery
defenders cannot systematically warn samples about their labels. A certified
defense that simultaneously offers robust labels and systematic warning
protection against patch attacks is desirable. This paper proposes a novel
certified defense technique called CrossCert. CrossCert formulates a novel
approach by cross-checking two certified recovery defenders to provide
unwavering certification and detection certification. Unwavering certification
ensures that a certified sample, when subjected to a patched perturbation, will
always be returned with a benign label without triggering any warnings with a
provable guarantee. To our knowledge, CrossCert is the first certified
detection technique to offer this guarantee. Our experiments show that, with a
slightly lower performance than ViP and comparable performance with PatchCensor
in terms of detection certification, CrossCert certifies a significant
proportion of samples with the guarantee of unwavering certification.
translated: 补丁鲁棒性认证是一种新兴的具有可证明保证的对抗补丁攻击的防御技术。有两条研究路线: 认证恢复和认证检测。他们的目标是正确地给恶意样品贴上可证明的保证标签，并分别对预测为具有可证明的保证的非良性标签的恶意样品发出警告。然而，现有的认证检测辩护律师受到保护标签受到操纵，现有的认证恢复辩护律师无法系统地警告样品关于他们的标签。一个认证的防御，同时提供强大的标签和系统的警告保护，以防补丁攻击是可取的。提出了一种新的认证防御技术 CrossCert。CrossCert 提出了一种新的方法，通过交叉检查两个经过认证的恢复防御者来提供坚定的认证和检测认证。坚定不移的认证确保一个经过认证的样品，当受到一个补丁扰动，将始终与良性标签返回，而不会触发任何警告与可证明的保证。据我们所知，CrossCert 是第一个提供这种保证的认证检测技术。我们的实验表明，在检测认证方面，CrossCert 的性能略低于 ViP，与 PatchCensor 的性能相当，CrossCert 认证了相当大比例的样本，并保证了坚定不移的认证。

title: Backdoor Removal for Generative Large Language Models
summary:
With rapid advances, generative large language models (LLMs) dominate various
Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks from understanding to reasoning. Yet,
language models' inherent vulnerabilities may be exacerbated due to increased
accessibility and unrestricted model training on massive textual data from the
Internet. A malicious adversary may publish poisoned data online and conduct
backdoor attacks on the victim LLMs pre-trained on the poisoned data.
Backdoored LLMs behave innocuously for normal queries and generate harmful
responses when the backdoor trigger is activated. Despite significant efforts
paid to LLMs' safety issues, LLMs are still struggling against backdoor
attacks. As Anthropic recently revealed, existing safety training strategies,
including supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human
Feedback (RLHF), fail to revoke the backdoors once the LLM is backdoored during
the pre-training stage. In this paper, we present Simulate and Eliminate
(SANDE) to erase the undesired backdoored mappings for generative LLMs. We
initially propose Overwrite Supervised Fine-tuning (OSFT) for effective
backdoor removal when the trigger is known. Then, to handle the scenarios where
the trigger patterns are unknown, we integrate OSFT into our two-stage
framework, SANDE. Unlike previous works that center on the identification of
backdoors, our safety-enhanced LLMs are able to behave normally even when the
exact triggers are activated. We conduct comprehensive experiments to show that
our proposed SANDE is effective against backdoor attacks while bringing minimal
harm to LLMs' powerful capability without any additional access to unbackdoored
clean models. We will release the reproducible code.
translated: 随着技术的快速发展，生成式大语言模型(LLM)主导着从理解到推理的各种自然语言处理(NLP)任务。然而，语言模型固有的脆弱性可能会加剧，由于增加了可访问性和不受限制的模型训练从互联网上的大量文本数据。一个恶意的对手可能会在线发布有毒数据，并对预先根据有毒数据训练的受害 LLM 进行后门攻击。后门 LLM 对于正常查询无害，当后门触发器被激活时会产生有害的响应。尽管在 LLM 的安全问题上付出了巨大的努力，LLM 仍然在与后门攻击作斗争。正如最近透露的，现有的安全培训策略，包括监督微调(SFT)和人类反馈(rLHF)的强化学习，一旦 LLM 在培训前阶段出现后门，就不能撤销后门。在本文中，我们提出了模拟和消除(SANDE) ，以消除不希望的后门映射的生成 LLM。我们最初建议覆盖监督微调(OSFT)有效的后门删除时，触发器是已知的。然后，为了处理未知触发模式的场景，我们将 OSFT 集成到我们的两阶段框架 SANDE 中。不同于以前的工作，中心的识别后门，我们的安全增强 LLM 能够表现正常，即使当确切的触发器被激活。我们进行了全面的实验，以表明我们提出的 SANDE 是有效的对后门攻击，同时带来最小的损害 LLM 的强大能力，没有任何额外的访问无后门清洁模型。我们会发布可重复的代码。

title:
DoLLM: How Large Language Models Understanding Network Flow Data to
  Detect Carpet Bombing DDoS
summary:
It is an interesting question Can and How Large Language Models (LLMs)
understand non-language network data, and help us detect unknown malicious
flows. This paper takes Carpet Bombing as a case study and shows how to exploit
LLMs' powerful capability in the networking area. Carpet Bombing is a new DDoS
attack that has dramatically increased in recent years, significantly
threatening network infrastructures. It targets multiple victim IPs within
subnets, causing congestion on access links and disrupting network services for
a vast number of users. Characterized by low-rates, multi-vectors, these
attacks challenge traditional DDoS defenses. We propose DoLLM, a DDoS detection
model utilizes open-source LLMs as backbone. By reorganizing non-contextual
network flows into Flow-Sequences and projecting them into LLMs semantic space
as token embeddings, DoLLM leverages LLMs' contextual understanding to extract
flow representations in overall network context. The representations are used
to improve the DDoS detection performance. We evaluate DoLLM with public
datasets CIC-DDoS2019 and real NetFlow trace from Top-3 countrywide ISP. The
tests have proven that DoLLM possesses strong detection capabilities. Its F1
score increased by up to 33.3% in zero-shot scenarios and by at least 20.6% in
real ISP traces.
translated: 这是一个有趣的问题，大型语言模型(LLM)可以理解非语言网络数据，并帮助我们检测未知的恶意流。本文以地毯式轰炸为例，说明如何利用 LLM 在网络领域的强大能力。地毯式轰炸是一种新型的 DDoS 攻击，近年来大幅增加，严重威胁网络基础设施。它针对子网内的多个受害 IP，造成接入链路拥塞，并扰乱大量用户的网络服务。这些攻击拥有属性低、多向量，挑战了传统的分布式拒绝服务(DDoS)防御。我们提出了 DoLLM，一种利用开源 LLM 作为骨干的 DDoS 检测模型。通过将非上下文网络流重组成流序列，并将其投射到 LLM 语义空间中作为令牌嵌入，DoLLM 利用 LLM 的上下文理解来提取整个网络上下文中的流表示。这些表示用于提高 DDoS 检测性能。我们使用公共数据集 CIC-DDoS2019和来自全国排名前三的 ISP 的实际 NetFlow 跟踪来评估 DoLLM。测试证明 DoLLM 具有很强的检测能力。它的 F1得分增加了高达33.3% 的零射击场景和至少20.6% 的真正的 ISP 跟踪。

title: Uncovering GNSS Interference with Aerial Mapping UAV
summary:
Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receivers provide ubiquitous and
precise position, navigation, and time (PNT) to a wide gamut of civilian and
tactical infrastructures and devices. Due to the low GNSS received signal
power, even low-power radiofrequency interference (RFI) sources are a serious
threat to the GNSS integrity and availability. Nonetheless, RFI source
localization is paramount yet hard, especially over large areas. Methods based
on multi-rotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV) exist but are often limited by
hovering time, and require specific antenna and detectors. In comparison,
fixed-wing planes allow longer missions but are more complex to operate and
deploy. A vertical take-off and landing (VTOL) UAV combines the positive
aspects of both platforms: high maneuverability, and long mission time and,
jointly with highly integrated control systems, simple operation and
deployment. Building upon the flexibility allowed by such a platform, we
propose a method that combines advanced flight dynamics with high-performance
consumer receivers to detect interference over large areas, with minimal
interaction with the operator. The proposed system can detect multiple
interference sources and map their area of influence, gaining situational
awareness of poor GNSS quality or denied environments. Furthermore, it can
estimate the relative heading and position of the interference source within
tens of meters. The proposed method is validated with real-life measurements,
successfully mapping two interference-affected areas and exposing radio
equipment causing involuntary in-band interference.
translated: 全球导航卫星系统(GNSS)接收机为广泛的民用和战术基础设施和设备提供无处不在的精确定位、导航和时间(PNT)。由于 GNSS 接收信号功率低，即使是低功率的射频干扰(RFI)源也对 GNSS 的完整性和可用性构成严重威胁。尽管如此，RFI 源本地化仍然非常困难，特别是在大范围内。基于多旋翼无人机(UAV)的方法虽然存在，但往往受到悬停时间的限制，需要特定的天线和探测器。相比之下，固定翼飞机可以执行更长的任务，但操作和部署更复杂。垂直起降无人机结合了两个平台的优点: 高机动性、长任务时间，以及高度集成的控制系统、简单的操作和部署。基于这样一个平台所允许的灵活性，我们提出了一种方法，将先进的飞行动力学和高性能的消费者接收机相结合，以检测大面积的干扰，与操作者的最小交互。该系统能够探测多个干扰源，并绘制其影响范围，从而获得低质量的全球导航卫星系统情势察觉或无法使用的环境。此外，它还可以估计干扰源在数十米内的相对方向和位置。通过实际测量验证了该方法的有效性，成功地绘制了两个受干扰影响的区域，暴露了无线电设备引起的非自愿带内干扰。

title:
DID Link: Authentication in TLS with Decentralized Identifiers and
  Verifiable Credentials
summary:
Authentication in TLS is predominately carried out with X.509 digital
certificates issued by certificate authorities (CA). The centralized nature of
current public key infrastructures, however, comes along with severe risks,
such as single points of failure and susceptibility to cyber-attacks,
potentially undermining the security and trustworthiness of the entire system.
With Decentralized Identifiers (DID) alongside distributed ledger technology,
it becomes technically feasible to prove ownership of a unique identifier
without requiring an attestation of the proof's public key by a centralized and
therefore vulnerable CA. This article presents DID Link, a novel authentication
scheme for TLS 1.3 that empowers entities to authenticate in a TLS-compliant
way with self-issued X.509 certificates that are equipped with ledger-anchored
DIDs instead of CA-issued identifiers. It facilitates the exchange of
tamper-proof and 3rd-party attested claims in the form of DID-bound Verifiable
Credentials after the TLS handshake to complete the authentication with a full
identification of the communication partner. A prototypical implementation
shows comparable TLS handshake durations of DID Link if verification material
is cached and reasonable prolongations if it is obtained from a ledger. The
significant speed improvement of the resulting TLS channel over a widely used,
DID-based alternative transport protocol on the application layer demonstrates
the potential of DID Link to become a viable solution for the establishment of
secure and trustful end-to-end communication links with decentrally managed
digital identities.
translated: TLS 中的身份验证主要使用由证书颁发机构(CA)颁发的 X.509数字证书进行。然而，当前公开密钥基础设施的集中性质伴随着严重的风险，如单点故障和易受网络攻击，可能会破坏整个系统的安全性和可信度。有了分散标识符和分布式分类账技术，就可以在技术上证明唯一标识符的所有权，而不需要通过一个集中的、因此易受攻击的 CA 对证明的公钥进行认证。这篇文章介绍了一种新的 TLS 1.3认证方案，它授权实体使用自发的 X.509证书以符合 TLS 的方式进行认证，这些证书配备了分类锚定的 DID，而不是 CA 颁发的标识符。它便于在 TLS 握手之后交换防篡改和第三方认证的声明，其形式为分区域身份识别系统绑定的可验证证书，以完成通信合作伙伴的完整身份验证。一个原型实现显示了可比的 TLS 握手持续时间的差分链接，如果验证材料缓存和合理的延长，如果它是从一个分类账。由此产生的 TLS 信道相对于应用层上广泛使用的基于差分分离的替代传输协议的显著速度提高表明，差分分离链路有潜力成为一种可行的解决方案，用分散管理的数字身份建立安全和可信的端到端通信链路。

title: Oedipus: LLM-enchanced Reasoning CAPTCHA Solver
summary:
CAPTCHAs have become a ubiquitous tool in safeguarding applications from
automated bots. Over time, the arms race between CAPTCHA development and
evasion techniques has led to increasingly sophisticated and diverse designs.
The latest iteration, reasoning CAPTCHAs, exploits tasks that are intuitively
simple for humans but challenging for conventional AI technologies, thereby
enhancing security measures.
  Driven by the evolving AI capabilities, particularly the advancements in
Large Language Models (LLMs), we investigate the potential of multimodal LLMs
to solve modern reasoning CAPTCHAs. Our empirical analysis reveals that,
despite their advanced reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle to solve these
CAPTCHAs effectively. In response, we introduce Oedipus, an innovative
end-to-end framework for automated reasoning CAPTCHA solving. Central to this
framework is a novel strategy that dissects the complex and human-easy-AI-hard
tasks into a sequence of simpler and AI-easy steps. This is achieved through
the development of a Domain Specific Language (DSL) for CAPTCHAs that guides
LLMs in generating actionable sub-steps for each CAPTCHA challenge. The DSL is
customized to ensure that each unit operation is a highly solvable subtask
revealed in our previous empirical study. These sub-steps are then tackled
sequentially using the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) methodology.
  Our evaluation shows that Oedipus effectively resolves the studied CAPTCHAs,
achieving an average success rate of 63.5\%. Remarkably, it also shows
adaptability to the most recent CAPTCHA designs introduced in late 2023, which
are not included in our initial study. This prompts a discussion on future
strategies for designing reasoning CAPTCHAs that can effectively counter
advanced AI solutions.
translated: CAPTCHA 已经成为一个无处不在的工具，用于保护应用程序免受自动化机器人的攻击。随着时间的推移，验证码开发和规避技术之间的军备竞赛导致了越来越复杂和多样化的设计。最新的迭代，推理验证码，利用任务是直观上简单的人类，但挑战传统的人工智能技术，从而加强安全措施。在不断发展的人工智能能力的驱动下，特别是大型语言模型(LLM)的进步，我们研究了多模态 LLM 在解决现代推理验证码方面的潜力。我们的实证分析表明，尽管 LLM 具有先进的推理能力，但它们很难有效地解决这些 CAPTCHA 问题。作为回应，我们介绍了俄狄浦斯，一个创新的端到端的框架来解决自动推理验证码。这个框架的核心是一个新颖的策略，它将复杂的和人工智能简单的困难任务分解成一系列更简单的和人工智能简单的步骤。这是通过为 CAPTCHA 开发领域特定语言(DSL)来实现的，该语言指导 LLM 为每个 CAPTCHA 挑战生成可操作的子步骤。DSL 是定制的，以确保每个单元操作是一个高度可解的子任务显示在我们以前的实证研究。然后使用思维链(Chain-of-Thought，CoT)方法依次处理这些子步骤。我们的评估结果表明，俄狄浦斯算法有效地解决了所研究的 CAPTCHA 问题，平均成功率为63.5% 。值得注意的是，它还显示了对2023年末引入的最新 CAPTCHA 设计的适应性，这些设计并没有包括在我们的初步研究中。这促使我们讨论设计能够有效对抗高级人工智能解决方案的推理 CAPTCHA 的未来策略。

title:
Maximizing Information Gain in Privacy-Aware Active Learning of Email
  Anomalies
summary:
Redacted emails satisfy most privacy requirements but they make it more
difficult to detect anomalous emails that may be indicative of data
exfiltration. In this paper we develop an enhanced method of Active Learning
using an information gain maximizing heuristic, and we evaluate its
effectiveness in a real world setting where only redacted versions of email
could be labeled by human analysts due to privacy concerns. In the first case
study we examined how Active Learning should be carried out. We found that
model performance was best when a single highly skilled (in terms of the
labelling task) analyst provided the labels. In the second case study we used
confidence ratings to estimate the labeling uncertainty of analysts and then
prioritized instances for labeling based on the expected information gain (the
difference between model uncertainty and analyst uncertainty) that would be
provided by labelling each instance. We found that the information maximization
gain heuristic improved model performance over existing sampling methods for
Active Learning. Based on the results obtained, we recommend that analysts
should be screened, and possibly trained, prior to implementation of Active
Learning in cybersecurity applications. We also recommend that the information
gain maximizing sample method (based on expert confidence) should be used in
early stages of Active Learning, providing that well-calibrated confidence can
be obtained. We also note that the expertise of analysts should be assessed
prior to Active Learning, as we found that analysts with lower labelling skill
had poorly calibrated (over-) confidence in their labels.
translated: 经过编辑的电子邮件满足了大多数隐私要求，但它们使得检测可能表明数据外泄的异常电子邮件变得更加困难。本文提出了一种基于信息增益最大化启发式的增强型主动学习方法，并在现实环境中对其有效性进行了评估，在现实环境中，由于隐私问题，只有经过编辑的电子邮件版本才能被人类分析师标记出来。在第一个案例研究中，我们研究了如何实施主动学习。我们发现，当一个高度熟练(就标签任务而言)的分析师提供标签时，模型性能最好。在第二个案例研究中，我们使用置信度评级来估计分析师的标签不确定性，然后根据预期的信息增益(模型不确定性和分析师不确定性之间的差异)对标签实例进行优先排序，这将通过标签每个实例来提供。我们发现，与现有的主动学习抽样方法相比，信息最大化增益启发式方法改善了模型的性能。根据所获得的结果，我们建议在网络安全应用程序中实施主动学习之前，应该对分析师进行筛选，并可能对他们进行培训。我们还建议在主动学习的早期阶段使用信息增益最大化抽样方法(基于专家置信度) ，前提是能够获得良好校准的置信度。我们还注意到，分析师的专业知识应该在主动学习之前进行评估，因为我们发现，标签技能较低的分析师对其标签的校准(过度)信心不足。

title: S3C2 Summit 2024-03: Industry Secure Supply Chain Summit
summary:
Supply chain security has become a very important vector to consider when
defending against adversary attacks. Due to this, more and more developers are
keen on improving their supply chains to make them more robust against future
threats. On March 7th, 2024 researchers from the Secure Software Supply Chain
Center (S3C2) gathered 14 industry leaders, developers and consumers of the
open source ecosystem to discuss the state of supply chain security. The goal
of the summit is to share insights between companies and developers alike to
foster new collaborations and ideas moving forward. Through this meeting,
participants were questions on best practices and thoughts how to improve
things for the future. In this paper we summarize the responses and discussions
of the summit. The panel questions can be found in the appendix.
translated: 供应链安全已经成为防御对手攻击时需要考虑的一个重要因素。正因为如此，越来越多的开发商热衷于改善他们的供应链，使他们更加强大，以应对未来的威胁。2024年3月7日，来自安全软件供应链中心(S3C2)的研究人员召集了14位开源生态系统的行业领袖、开发人员和消费者，讨论供应链安全的状态。峰会的目标是在公司和开发人员之间分享见解，以促进新的协作和向前发展的想法。通过这次会议，与会者就最佳实践提出了问题，并就如何改进未来的事情提出了想法。本文总结了峰会的回应和讨论。小组提问见附录。

title:
Distributed Threat Intelligence at the Edge Devices: A Large Language
  Model-Driven Approach
summary:
With the proliferation of edge devices, there is a significant increase in
attack surface on these devices. The decentralized deployment of threat
intelligence on edge devices, coupled with adaptive machine learning techniques
such as the in-context learning feature of large language models (LLMs),
represents a promising paradigm for enhancing cybersecurity on low-powered edge
devices. This approach involves the deployment of lightweight machine learning
models directly onto edge devices to analyze local data streams, such as
network traffic and system logs, in real-time. Additionally, distributing
computational tasks to an edge server reduces latency and improves
responsiveness while also enhancing privacy by processing sensitive data
locally. LLM servers can enable these edge servers to autonomously adapt to
evolving threats and attack patterns, continuously updating their models to
improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives. Furthermore,
collaborative learning mechanisms facilitate peer-to-peer secure and
trustworthy knowledge sharing among edge devices, enhancing the collective
intelligence of the network and enabling dynamic threat mitigation measures
such as device quarantine in response to detected anomalies. The scalability
and flexibility of this approach make it well-suited for diverse and evolving
network environments, as edge devices only send suspicious information such as
network traffic and system log changes, offering a resilient and efficient
solution to combat emerging cyber threats at the network edge. Thus, our
proposed framework can improve edge computing security by providing better
security in cyber threat detection and mitigation by isolating the edge devices
from the network.
translated: 随着边缘设备的增加，这些设备上的攻击面显著增加。威胁情报在边缘设备上的分散部署，加上自适应机器学习技术，如大型语言模型(LLM)的上下文学习特性，代表了在低功耗边缘设备上增强网络安全的一个有希望的范例。这种方法包括将轻量级机器学习模型直接部署到边缘设备上，以实时分析本地数据流，如网络流量和系统日志。此外，将计算任务分发到边缘服务器可以减少延迟并提高响应能力，同时还可以通过在本地处理敏感数据来增强隐私。LLM 服务器可以使这些边缘服务器自动适应不断变化的威胁和攻击模式，不断更新它们的模型，以提高检测的准确性和减少误报。此外，合作学习机制可促进边缘设备之间的点对点安全和可信赖的知识共享，提高网络的集体智能，以及针对检测到的异常情况采取动态的威胁缓解措施，例如设备检疫。这种方法的可扩展性和灵活性使其非常适合于多样化和不断发展的网络环境，因为边缘设备只发送可疑信息，如网络流量和系统日志更改，提供了一个弹性和有效的解决方案，以打击新出现的网络威胁在网络边缘。因此，我们提出的框架可以提高边缘计算的安全性，通过提供更好的安全性，在网络威胁检测和缓解，从网络中隔离边缘设备。

title:
On Maximal Families of Binary Polynomials with Pairwise Linear Common
  Factors
summary:
We consider the construction of maximal families of polynomials over the
finite field $\mathbb{F}_q$, all having the same degree $n$ and a nonzero
constant term, where the degree of the GCD of any two polynomials is $d$ with
$1 \le d\le n$. The motivation for this problem lies in a recent construction
for subspace codes based on cellular automata. More precisely, the minimum
distance of such subspace codes relates to the maximum degree $d$ of the
pairwise GCD in this family of polynomials. Hence, characterizing the maximal
families of such polynomials is equivalent to determining the maximum
cardinality of the corresponding subspace codes for a given minimum distance.
We first show a lower bound on the cardinality of such families, and then focus
on the specific case where $d=1$. There, we characterize the maximal families
of polynomials over the binary field $\mathbb{F}_2$. Our findings prompt
several more open questions, which we plan to address in an extended version of
this work.
translated: 讨论了有限域上多项式的极大族的构造问题，其中任意两个多项式的 GCD 的次数都是 $d $与 $1 le de le n $，且所有多项式都具有相同的次数 n $和非零常数项。这个问题的动机在于最近基于元胞自动机的子空间码的构造。更准确地说，这类子空间编码的最小距离与该多项式族中成对 GCD 的最大度 $d $有关。因此，刻画这类多项式的最大族等价于确定给定最小距离的相应子空间码的最大基数。我们首先给出这类家族的基数的下界，然后关注 $d = 1 $的特定情况。在这里，我们刻画了二元域 $mathbb { F } _ 2 $上多项式的极大族。我们的发现提出了几个更加开放的问题，我们计划在这项工作的扩展版本中解决这些问题。

title:
Byzantine-Resilient Secure Aggregation for Federated Learning Without
  Privacy Compromises
summary:
Federated learning (FL) shows great promise in large scale machine learning,
but brings new risks in terms of privacy and security. We propose ByITFL, a
novel scheme for FL that provides resilience against Byzantine users while
keeping the users' data private from the federator and private from other
users. The scheme builds on the preexisting non-private FLTrust scheme, which
tolerates malicious users through trust scores (TS) that attenuate or amplify
the users' gradients. The trust scores are based on the ReLU function, which we
approximate by a polynomial. The distributed and privacy-preserving computation
in ByITFL is designed using a combination of Lagrange coded computing,
verifiable secret sharing and re-randomization steps. ByITFL is the first
Byzantine resilient scheme for FL with full information-theoretic privacy.
translated: 联邦学习(FL)在大规模机器学习中显示了巨大的潜力，但是在隐私和安全方面也带来了新的风险。我们提出了 ByITFL，一个新颖的 FL 方案，提供了对拜占庭用户的弹性，同时保持用户的数据私有的联邦者和私有的其他用户。该方案建立在先前存在的非私有 FLTrust 方案的基础上，该方案通过信任评分(TS)来容忍恶意用户，TS 会减弱或放大用户的梯度。信任评分基于 ReLU 函数，我们用一个多项式逼近。ByITFL 中的分布式和保密计算结合了拉格兰奇编码计算、可验证秘密共享和重新随机化步骤。ByITFL 是第一个具有完全信息理论隐私的拜占庭弹性 FL 方案。

title: Intelligent Control in 6G Open RAN: Security Risk or Opportunity?
summary:
The Open Radio Access Network (Open RAN) framework, emerging as the
cornerstone for Artificial Intelligence (AI)-enabled Sixth-Generation (6G)
mobile networks, heralds a transformative shift in radio access network
architecture. As the adoption of Open RAN accelerates, ensuring its security
becomes critical. The RAN Intelligent Controller (RIC) plays a central role in
Open RAN by improving network efficiency and flexibility. Nevertheless, it also
brings about potential security risks that need careful scrutiny. Therefore, it
is imperative to evaluate the current state of RIC security comprehensively.
This assessment is essential to gain a profound understanding of the security
considerations associated with RIC. This survey combines a comprehensive
analysis of RAN security, tracing its evolution from 2G to 5G, with an in-depth
exploration of RIC security, marking the first comprehensive examination of its
kind in the literature. Real-world security incidents involving RIC are vividly
illustrated, providing practical insights. The study evaluates the security
implications of the RIC within the 6G Open RAN context, addressing security
vulnerabilities, mitigation strategies, and potential enhancements. It aims to
guide stakeholders in the telecom industry toward a secure and dependable
telecommunications infrastructure. The article serves as a valuable reference,
shedding light on the RIC's crucial role within the broader network
infrastructure and emphasizing security's paramount importance. This survey
also explores the promising security opportunities that the RIC presents for
enhancing network security and resilience in the context of 6G mobile networks.
It outlines open issues, lessons learned, and future research directions in the
domain of intelligent control in 6G open RAN, facilitating a comprehensive
understanding of this dynamic landscape.
translated: 开放无线接入网(Open RAN)框架是人工智能(AI)支持的第六代(6G)移动网络的基石，它预示着无线接入网架构的变革性转变。随着 OpenRAN 的加速采用，确保其安全性变得至关重要。RAN 智能控制器(RIC)通过提高网络效率和灵活性，在开放式 RAN 中发挥着核心作用。然而，它也带来了需要仔细审查的潜在安全风险。因此，全面评估 RIC 安全现状势在必行。这种评估对于深入了解与 RIC 相关的安全考虑是必不可少的。本文综合分析了 RAN 网络的安全性，追溯了 RAN 网络从2G 到5G 的演进过程，并对 RIC 网络的安全性进行了深入的探讨，这是文献中对 RAN 网络安全性的首次综合分析。对涉及 RIC 的真实世界安全事件进行了生动的说明，提供了实用的见解。该研究评估了 RIC 在6G Open RAN 上下文中的安全含义，解决了安全漏洞、缓解策略和潜在的增强。它旨在指导电信行业的利益相关者建立安全可靠的电信基础设施。本文提供了有价值的参考，阐明了 RIC 在更广泛的网络基础设施中的关键作用，并强调了安全性的至关重要性。这项调查还探讨了 RIC 为在6G 移动网络环境下提高网络安全性和恢复能力所提供的有希望的安全机会。它概述了6G 开放 RAN 中智能控制领域的开放问题、经验教训和未来的研究方向，促进了对这一动态景观的全面理解。

title:
SecScore: Enhancing the CVSS Threat Metric Group with Empirical
  Evidences
summary:
Background: Timely prioritising and remediating vulnerabilities are paramount
in the dynamic cybersecurity field, and one of the most widely used
vulnerability scoring systems (CVSS) does not address the increasing likelihood
of emerging an exploit code. Aims: We present SecScore, an innovative
vulnerability severity score that enhances CVSS Threat metric group with
statistical models from empirical evidences of real-world exploit codes.
Method: SecScore adjusts the traditional CVSS score using an explainable and
empirical method that more accurately and promptly captures the dynamics of
exploit code development. Results: Our approach can integrate seamlessly into
the assessment/prioritisation stage of several vulnerability management
processes, improving the effectiveness of prioritisation and ensuring timely
remediation. We provide real-world statistical analysis and models for a wide
range of vulnerability types and platforms, demonstrating that SecScore is
flexible according to the vulnerability's profile. Comprehensive experiments
validate the value and timeliness of SecScore in vulnerability prioritisation.
Conclusions: SecScore advances the vulnerability metrics theory and enhances
organisational cybersecurity with practical insights.
translated: 背景: 在动态网络安全领域，及时排列和补救漏洞是至关重要的，而最广泛使用的漏洞评分系统(CVSS)之一并没有解决出现漏洞代码的可能性日益增加的问题。目的: 我们提出的 SecScore，一个创新的脆弱性严重性评分，增强 CVSS 威胁度量组的统计模型从现实世界的开发代码的经验证据。方法: SecScore 调整传统的 CVSS 评分，使用一种可解释的、经验性的方法，更准确、更迅速地捕捉利用代码开发的动态。结果: 我们的方法可以无缝集成到几个脆弱性管理过程的评估/优先级阶段，提高优先级的有效性，并确保及时补救。我们提供了现实世界的统计分析和模型，为广泛的脆弱性类型和平台，证明 SecScore 是灵活的根据脆弱性的概况。综合实验验证了 SecScore 在漏洞优先级排序中的价值和及时性。结论: SecScore 提出了脆弱性度量理论，以实用的见解增强了组织的网络安全。

title:
Semantic Contextualization of Face Forgery: A New Definition, Dataset,
  and Detection Method
summary:
In recent years, deep learning has greatly streamlined the process of
generating realistic fake face images. Aware of the dangers, researchers have
developed various tools to spot these counterfeits. Yet none asked the
fundamental question: What digital manipulations make a real photographic face
image fake, while others do not? In this paper, we put face forgery in a
semantic context and define that computational methods that alter semantic face
attributes to exceed human discrimination thresholds are sources of face
forgery. Guided by our new definition, we construct a large face forgery image
dataset, where each image is associated with a set of labels organized in a
hierarchical graph. Our dataset enables two new testing protocols to probe the
generalization of face forgery detectors. Moreover, we propose a
semantics-oriented face forgery detection method that captures label relations
and prioritizes the primary task (\ie, real or fake face detection). We show
that the proposed dataset successfully exposes the weaknesses of current
detectors as the test set and consistently improves their generalizability as
the training set. Additionally, we demonstrate the superiority of our
semantics-oriented method over traditional binary and multi-class
classification-based detectors.
translated: 近年来，深度学习极大地简化了生成逼真的人脸图像的过程。意识到这些危险，研究人员已经开发了各种工具来发现这些假冒产品。然而，没有人提出一个根本性的问题: 什么样的数字技术可以让一张真实的人脸照片变得虚假，而其他人却不能？本文将人脸伪造放在一个语义上下文中，定义了改变语义人脸属性以超过人类识别阈值的计算方法是人脸伪造的来源。在新定义的指导下，我们构建了一个大型人脸伪造图像数据集，其中每个图像与一组组织在层次图中的标签相关联。我们的数据集使两个新的测试协议来探讨人脸伪造检测器的通用性。此外，我们提出了一个面向语义的人脸伪造检测方法，捕捉标签关系和优先级的主要任务(即，真实或假人脸检测)。结果表明，所提出的数据集成功地暴露了当前检测器作为测试集的弱点，并一致地提高了它们作为训练集的通用性。此外，本文还论证了面向语义的检测方法相对于传统的基于二进制和多类分类的检测器的优越性。

title: A Survey on Complexity Measures of Pseudo-Random Sequences
summary:
Since the introduction of the Kolmogorov complexity of binary sequences in
the 1960s, there have been significant advancements in the topic of complexity
measures for randomness assessment, which are of fundamental importance in
theoretical computer science and of practical interest in cryptography. This
survey reviews notable research from the past four decades on the linear,
quadratic and maximum-order complexities of pseudo-random sequences and their
relations with Lempel-Ziv complexity, expansion complexity, 2-adic complexity,
and correlation measures.
translated: 自二十世纪六十年代引入二进制序列柯氏复杂性以来，随机性评估的复杂度度量这一课题取得了重大进展，这对于理论计算机科学和密码学具有重要的实际意义。本文综述了近四十年来关于伪随机序列的线性复杂度、二次复杂度和最大阶复杂度及其与 Lempel-Ziv 复杂度、扩张复杂度、二进复杂度和相关测度的关系的研究。

title:
Work-in-Progress: Crash Course: Can (Under Attack) Autonomous Driving
  Beat Human Drivers?
summary:
Autonomous driving is a research direction that has gained enormous traction
in the last few years thanks to advancements in Artificial Intelligence (AI).
Depending on the level of independence from the human driver, several studies
show that Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) can reduce the number of on-road crashes
and decrease overall fuel emissions by improving efficiency. However, security
research on this topic is mixed and presents some gaps. On one hand, these
studies often neglect the intrinsic vulnerabilities of AI algorithms, which are
known to compromise the security of these systems. On the other, the most
prevalent attacks towards AI rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as access to
the model parameters or the training dataset. As such, it is unclear if
autonomous driving can still claim several advantages over human driving in
real-world applications. This paper evaluates the inherent risks in autonomous
driving by examining the current landscape of AVs and establishing a pragmatic
threat model. Through our analysis, we develop specific claims highlighting the
delicate balance between the advantages of AVs and potential security
challenges in real-world scenarios. Our evaluation serves as a foundation for
providing essential takeaway messages, guiding both researchers and
practitioners at various stages of the automation pipeline. In doing so, we
contribute valuable insights to advance the discourse on the security and
viability of autonomous driving in real-world applications.
translated: 由于人工智能(AI)的进步，自动驾驶在过去几年中已经成为一个研究方向，并且获得了巨大的推动力。根据独立于人类驾驶员的程度，一些研究表明，自动驾驶汽车(AVs)可以通过提高效率来减少道路碰撞事故的数量和减少整体燃油排放。然而，关于这个主题的安全性研究是混杂的，并且提出了一些空白。一方面，这些研究往往忽视了人工智能算法固有的弱点，这是众所周知的危害这些系统的安全。另一方面，对人工智能最普遍的攻击依赖于不切实际的假设，如访问模型参数或训练数据集。因此，目前还不清楚自动驾驶是否仍然可以宣称在现实世界应用中比人类驾驶有几个优势。本文通过研究自动驾驶的现状，建立了一个实用的威胁模型，对自动驾驶的内在风险进行了评估。通过我们的分析，我们提出了具体的主张，强调虚拟现实的优势和现实世界中潜在的安全挑战之间的微妙平衡。我们的评估为提供必要的外卖信息奠定了基础，在自动化流水线的各个阶段指导研究人员和从业人员。通过这样做，我们贡献了宝贵的见解，以推进讨论的安全性和可行性自动驾驶在现实世界的应用。

title:
Cross-Blockchain Communication Using Oracles With an Off-Chain
  Aggregation Mechanism Based on zk-SNARKs
summary:
The closed architecture of prevailing blockchain systems renders the usage of
this technology mostly infeasible for a wide range of real-world problems. Most
blockchains trap users and applications in their isolated space without the
possibility of cooperating or switching to other blockchains. Therefore,
blockchains need additional mechanisms for seamless communication and arbitrary
data exchange between each other and external systems. Unfortunately, current
approaches for cross-blockchain communication are resource-intensive or require
additional blockchains or tailored solutions depending on the applied consensus
mechanisms of the connected blockchains. Therefore, we propose an oracle with
an off-chain aggregation mechanism based on ZeroKnowledge Succinct
Non-interactive Arguments of Knowledge (zk-SNARKs) to facilitate
cross-blockchain communication. The oracle queries data from another blockchain
and applies a rollup-like mechanism to move state and computation off-chain.
The zkOracle contract only expects the transferred data, an updated state root,
and proof of the correct execution of the aggregation mechanism. The proposed
solution only requires constant 378 kgas to submit data on the Ethereum
blockchain and is primarily independent of the underlying technology of the
queried blockchains.
translated: 流行的区块链系统的封闭体系结构使这种技术的使用在很大程度上不适用于大量的实际问题。大多数区块链将用户和应用程序困在其孤立的空间中，不可能进行合作或切换到其他区块链。因此，区块链需要额外的机制来实现彼此和外部系统之间的无缝通信和任意数据交换。不幸的是，目前的跨区块链通信方法是资源密集型的，或者需要额外的区块链或定制的解决方案，这取决于所连接的区块链的应用共识机制。因此，我们提出了一种基于零知识简洁非交互式知识论证(zk-SNARKs)的离链聚合机制，以促进跨区块链通信。Oracle 查询来自另一个区块链的数据，并应用类似于汇总的机制将状态和计算移出链。ZkOracle 契约只需要传输的数据、更新后的状态根以及聚合机制正确执行的证明。提出的解决方案只需要常数378千瓦气体提交数据的以太区块链，主要是独立于基础技术的查询区块链。

title:
Towards Evaluating the Robustness of Automatic Speech Recognition
  Systems via Audio Style Transfer
summary:
In light of the widespread application of Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR)
systems, their security concerns have received much more attention than ever
before, primarily due to the susceptibility of Deep Neural Networks. Previous
studies have illustrated that surreptitiously crafting adversarial
perturbations enables the manipulation of speech recognition systems, resulting
in the production of malicious commands. These attack methods mostly require
adding noise perturbations under $\ell_p$ norm constraints, inevitably leaving
behind artifacts of manual modifications. Recent research has alleviated this
limitation by manipulating style vectors to synthesize adversarial examples
based on Text-to-Speech (TTS) synthesis audio. However, style modifications
based on optimization objectives significantly reduce the controllability and
editability of audio styles. In this paper, we propose an attack on ASR systems
based on user-customized style transfer. We first test the effect of Style
Transfer Attack (STA) which combines style transfer and adversarial attack in
sequential order. And then, as an improvement, we propose an iterative Style
Code Attack (SCA) to maintain audio quality. Experimental results show that our
method can meet the need for user-customized styles and achieve a success rate
of 82% in attacks, while keeping sound naturalness due to our user study.
translated: 随着自动语音识别(ASR)系统的广泛应用，其安全性问题受到了前所未有的关注，主要是由于深度神经网络的易受攻击性。先前的研究表明，暗中制造对抗性扰动可以操纵语音识别系统，导致恶意命令的产生。这些攻击方法大多需要在 $ell _ p $standard 约束下添加噪声扰动，不可避免地会留下手工修改的工件。最近的研究通过操纵样式向量来合成基于 TTS (TTS)合成音频的对抗性实例，从而缓解了这一局限性。然而，基于优化目标的风格修改显著降低了音频风格的可控性和可编辑性。本文提出了一种基于用户自定义风格转移的 ASR 系统攻击方法。我们首先测试了风格转移攻击(STA)的效果，它将风格转移和对抗性攻击按顺序结合起来。然后，作为改进，我们提出了一种迭代样式代码攻击(SCA)来维护音频质量。实验结果表明，该方法能够满足用户自定义风格的要求，在保持声音自然性的同时，攻击成功率达到82% 。

title:
Flashback: Enhancing Proposer-Builder Design with Future-Block Auctions
  in Proof-of-Stake Ethereum
summary:
Maximal extractable value (MEV) in which block proposers unethically gain
profits by manipulating the order in which transactions are included within a
block, is a key challenge facing blockchains such as Ethereum today. Left
unchecked, MEV can lead to a centralization of stake distribution thereby
ultimately compromising the security of blockchain consensus. To preserve
proposer decentralization (and hence security) of the blockchain, Ethereum has
advocated for a proposer-builder separation (PBS) in which the functionality of
transaction ordering is separated from proposers and assigned to separate
entities called builders. Builders accept transaction bundles from searchers,
who compete to find the most profitable bundles. Builders then bid completed
blocks to proposers, who accept the most profitable blocks for publication. The
auction mechanisms used between searchers, builders and proposers are crucial
to the overall health of the blockchain. In this paper, we consider PBS design
in Ethereum as a game between searchers, builders and proposers. A key novelty
in our design is the inclusion of future block proposers, as all proposers of
an epoch are decided ahead of time in proof-of-stake (PoS) Ethereum within the
game model. Our analysis shows the existence of alternative auction mechanisms
that result in a better (more profitable) equilibrium to players compared to
state-of-the-art. Experimental evaluations based on synthetic and real-world
data traces corroborate the analysis. Our results highlight that a rethinking
of auction mechanism designs is necessary in PoS Ethereum to prevent
disruption.
translated: 最大可提取价值(MEV)是区块提议者通过操纵交易在区块中的包含顺序而不道德地获取利润的一种方式，是当今区块链(如以太坊)面临的一个关键挑战。如果不加以限制，MEV 可能导致股权分配的集中化，从而最终损害区块链共识的安全性。为了保护区块链的建议者地方分权(以及安全性) ，Ethereum 提倡建议者-建设者分离(PBS) ，其中交易排序的功能与建议者分离，并分配给称为建设者的独立实体。开发者接受来自搜索者的交易捆绑包，这些搜索者竞相寻找最有利可图的捆绑包。然后，建造者将完成的区块投标给提议者，提议者接受最有利可图的区块发布。搜索者、建造者和提议者之间使用的拍卖机制对区块链的整体健康至关重要。本文将以太空中的 PBS 设计视为搜索者、建造者和提议者之间的博弈。我们设计中的一个关键新颖之处是包含了未来的块提议者，因为一个时代的所有提议者都是在游戏模型中的利益证明(PoS)以太坊中提前决定的。我们的分析表明，与最先进的拍卖机制相比，替代拍卖机制的存在能够为参与者带来更好(更有利可图)的均衡。基于合成和真实数据跟踪的实验结果验证了分析的正确性。我们的研究结果强调，拍卖机制设计的重新思考是必要的，在 PoS 以太，以防止中断。

title:
Distinguishing Tor From Other Encrypted Network Traffic Through
  Character Analysis
summary:
For journalists reporting from a totalitarian regime, whistleblowers and
resistance fighters, the anonymous use of cloud services on the Internet can be
vital for survival. The Tor network provides a free and widely used
anonymization service for everyone. However, there are different approaches to
distinguishing Tor from non-Tor encrypted network traffic, most recently only
due to the (relative) frequencies of hex digits in a single encrypted payload
